jobs.description: Job Description Full Stack Developer\-SME Nightwing is currently seeking a Full Stack Web Application Developer SME in Herndon VA to work on a suite of services that will supply users with tools to automate a wide range of enterprise\-wide applications and data centric mission management applications. The candidate will be part of a team of Software Developers, ETL Developers, and Data Scientists to enhance existing production applications and build out new web services on a routinized production cadence to meet the evolving needs of users. This is an exciting opportunity for Software Developers wanting to broaden their credentials in the realm of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML). Development will take place in an iterative fashion using Agile development methodology with input from all levels of stakeholders. The candidate must have the ability to communicate with project team members, user community, and leadership to assess changes and demonstrate iterative progress. **This position will include a variety of activities, including:** Integrating AI/ML technology into a production web application. Participation with iterative software development teams with adherence to all reporting requirements. Designing, developing and unit testing code for a production system and demonstration capabilities. Developing rapid prototypes to drive out requirements and design. Providing demonstrations and detailed walk through of features to a variety of technical and non\-technical audiences. Meeting with stakeholders, analyzing requirements, developing user stories, and translating these into software development tasks. Development of technical documentation and briefing materials to support program status reviews, control gates, and other presentations as directed. Write and maintain technical documentation for application workflows, integrations, and compliance procedures. Optimize and enhance application performance, ensuring scalability and security., Required Skills 1\. Demonstrated experience on Agile software development teams following Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban. 2\. Demonstrated experience using Jira, Confluence, and GitHub for documenting work and team collaboration. 3\. Minimum 8\-10 years building web applications and UX/UI frameworks using Angular, React or JavaScript with specific examples. Java Spring framework is a plus. 4\. Minimum 6\-8 years working in Linux Operating system. 5\. Minimum 4\-6 years of demonstrated experience with development and deployment of applications in the Commercial Cloud Services (C2S) environment or an Amazon Web Services cloud environment. Willing to consider to substitute C2S if candidate has a minimum 4\-6 years of cloud computing technology to include Azure, Oracle, Google, etc. 6\. Minimum 2\-3 years of demonstrated experience with search \& analytic tools. Examples to include ElasticSearch, Solr, OpenSearch. 7\. Minimum 2\-3 years of demonstrated (Extract, Transform, Load \- ETL) with large structured and unstructured raw data sets. 8\. Minimum 2\-4 years of demonstrated ability to design, develop, test and implement new applications based on project requirements. 9\. The ability to work individually as well as the ability to work in project teams. Proven ability in decomposing concepts to discrete development tasks and managing your work to a deadline. 10\. Minimum 6\-8 years of demonstrated ability in microservices up to and including docker, podman, and or containerization services. 11\. Minimum 4\-6 years in Object Oriented programming. Python is preferred software development language, but would consider Java, JavaScript, C\#, SQL, Etc. 12\. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math, or other relevant field and minimum of six years of experience (Master’s degree equates to an additional 2 years of relevant work experience), Desired Skills 1\. Demonstrated experience with text analytics and its applications/role/use in business intelligence/business analytics (i.e. search, entity extraction, sentiment analysis, document summarization, document categorization) whether through education or experience. 2\. Demonstrated experience developing proof of concepts of new technologies and evaluating the state of the art in machine learning algorithms for text analytics whether through education or experience. 3\. Demonstrated experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, Keras, Tensorflow whether through education or experience. 4\. Demonstrated experience with data visualization tools (i.e. Tableau, Pandas, D3\.js, ggplot, etc) whether through education or experience. 5\. Demonstrated experience with Relational or Non\-Relational data stores such as MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, or DynamoDB whether through education or experience. 6\. jobs.title: Applied Research Engineer
jobs.description: Description: The Applied Research Engineer will conduct cybersecurity assessments, penetration testing, vulnerability analysis, and open\-source intelligence (OSINT) research to identify and evaluate security risks. This position involves developing technical tools and scripts, analyzing security findings, and producing actionable reports and recommendations. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical and analytical skills, works effectively both independently and collaboratively, and demonstrates the ability to solve complex cybersecurity challenges. All candidates need a strong technical background, but not in all listed skills and competencies. Requirements: ***Primary Responsibilities*** * Conduct cybersecurity assessments, vulnerability assessments, authorized penetration testing activities, and open source research tasks. * Perform vulnerability and network scanning and analyze results to identify potential security weaknesses. * Support red team and other offensive security activities, as appropriate to the engagement. * Conduct open\-source intelligence (OSINT) research, including dark web analysis. * Develop scripts and technical tools to support cybersecurity assessment, testing, and analysis activities. * Analyze technical findings and prepare clear, accurate reports documenting results and recommended actions. * Communicate technical findings effectively to team members and other stakeholders. * Work collaboratively with technical teams while independently managing assigned tasks and responsibilities. * Research and evaluate unfamiliar technologies, tools, and security problems as required by project needs. * Perform other duties as assigned by program staff. ***Skills and Competencies*** * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a commitment to accurate recordkeeping, secure information handling, and consistent and timely follow\-through. * Ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a dynamic, evolving work environment. * Working knowledge of penetration testing methodologies and practices. * Understanding of red team concepts, techniques, and capabilities. * Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python. * Experience with compiled programming languages such as C or C\+\+. * Strong understanding of fundamental computer networking concepts. * Experience using vulnerability assessment and network scanning tools. * Familiarity with OSINT techniques and tools, including dark web research. * Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts, including: training, validation, and testing processes, supervised and unsupervised learning, LLMs, model weaknesses and vulnerabilities. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate novel technical problems. * Ability to learn new technologies, tools, and technical concepts independently. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to translate technical analysis into clear, well\-organized reports. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills. * Bachelor's degree with 5\+ years of relevant experience; or * Master's degree with 3\+ years of relevant experience.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Backbase Americas is seeking a skilled and motivated Backend Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and high\-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills, experience with server\-side development, and an understanding of modern distributed application architecture. In this role, you will help develop technology solutions for digital banking platforms, build reliable backend services, and collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver innovative financial technology solutions. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services. * Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices. * Develop secure and efficient server\-side software components. * Work with relational and NoSQL database systems. * Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability. * Implement authentication, authorization, and data security practices. * Troubleshoot technical issues and resolve software defects. * Participate in code reviews and technical architecture discussions. * Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA specialists, and product teams. * Support automated testing, deployment, and continuous integration. Technical Skills * Strong programming experience with Java, Kotlin, or similar backend languages. * Knowledge of Spring Boot and microservices architecture. * Experience developing REST APIs and backend integrations. * Understanding of SQL databases and data modeling. * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms. * Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. * Understanding of secure software development practices. * Experience with Agile development methodologies. About the Company Backbase is a global financial technology company founded in Amsterdam in 2003\. The company specializes in digital banking software and provides technology platforms that help financial institutions modernize their banking services. Its Banking Operating System supports digital customer experiences, banking operations, and financial service delivery across web and mobile channels. Backbase works with banks and financial institutions worldwide to improve digital engagement, streamline banking processes, and deliver modern financial technology solutions. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Administrator - POSE-059
jobs.description: Job Description Poseidon is seeking a Cloud Observability Engineer to design, operate, and enhance monitoring and reliability capabilities across cloud native environments. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in distributed systems, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is passionate about building resilient, well instrumented cloud platforms. In this role, you will collaborate with product managers, software developers, DevOps engineers, and cybersecurity personnel to ensure our systems are observable, reliable, secure, and aligned with best practices in cloud operations and governance. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain observability solutions supporting monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting across cloud native platforms. Analyze system performance and telemetry to detect anomalies, identify trends, and recommend improvements. Support incident response activities, participate in on call rotations, and contribute to post incident reviews. Diagnose and resolve system level issues using structured triage and root cause analysis. Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy and manage containerized workloads using Kubernetes and Helm Charts. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to automate provisioning, configuration, and operational workflows. Maintain and continuously improve operational runbooks, SOPs, and documentation supporting cloud operations and governance. Work within Agile/Scrum teams to deliver cloud based solutions aligned with cloud service provider (CSP) and organizational best practices. Ensure compliance with security, governance, and operational standards across cloud environments. Required Skills Observability \& Performance Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining observability systems, including monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting within cloud native environments (e.g., CloudWatch, ELK Stack, Logstash, Icinga). Demonstrated experience analyzing system performance, reviewing telemetry data, detecting anomalies, and identifying opportunities for reliability improvements and cost optimization. Incident Response \& Troubleshooting Demonstrated experience troubleshooting incidents and participating in on call support rotations to ensure system reliability and availability. Demonstrated experience diagnosing and resolving system level issues through structured triage and root cause analysis. Cloud Platform, DevOps, \& Microservices Demonstrated experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), EC2, ECS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation, and Route 53, as well as DevOps tools including GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, and CI/CD pipeline development. Demonstrated experience deploying and managing containerized workloads in microservices based architectures using Kubernetes and Helm. Demonstrated experience developing and operating cloud based IT solutions in alignment with cloud service provider (CSP) best practices and customer requirements, standards, and architectural guidelines. Cloud Operations \& Automation Demonstrated experience with cloud environment provisioning, lifecycle management, Auto Scaling configuration, and the automation of operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash). Demonstrated experience managing infrastructure, application, and monitoring patching processes, including vulnerability remediation and coordinated maintenance activities across cloud native environments. Demonstrated experience managing TLS/SSL certificate lifecycles, including issuance, renewal, rotation, and integration with cloud native services and load balancers. Process \& Governance Demonstrated experience working with Agile/Scrum teams and using collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence. Demonstrated experience applying compliance and security practices, including authentication, authorization, access control, and operational governance within cloud native environments. jobs.title: Crystal Growth Process Engineer 3
jobs.description: From smartphones to solar panels, innovative technology is needed to create the devices we use every day. Silfex’s silicon components help make that technology a reality. Silfex Inc., A Lam Research Company is the leading provider of precision silicon components used to make and operate semiconductor tools, which enable the trillion\-dollar global electronics industry. Our company’s products are integral to the semiconductor equipment and optical markets. The outstanding team at Silfex makes that possible – through our people, we are advancing the world. The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams’ achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone’s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities. **Our Perks and Benefits** At Silfex, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits that start on your first day of employment. Discover more at Lam Benefits **Job Description:** As a Crystal Growth Process Engineer you will develop innovative and scalable solutions for silicon crystal manufacturing, from applied research to mass production. As a process engineer, you will use applied research, data analysis and machine learning tools to continuously push the boundaries of process performance, equipment intelligence and manufacturing efficiency. In addition, this position provides technical oversight of crystal growing equipment and manufacturing processes, and cross\-functional work with operations, maintenance and other stakeholders to achieve production goals. The process engineering role requires strong technical fundamentals, a learning mindset, a high level of initiative, effective communication skills and a methodical and organized approach to managing multiple project elements. testing, code review, and version control. * Strong intuitive understanding of linear algebra, quaternions, multivariable calculus, and numerical methods. * Ability to read, understand, and adapt approaches. * Experience with contact and collision handling in a simulation context (e.g. penalty methods, constraint\-based methods, friction models). * Practical experience building dynamics simulations at scale (e.g. BVH\-based collision detection, multithreading, GPU programming, or sparse matrix management). * Strong debugging and profiling skills in a numerical context — diagnosing instabilities, tracking down blow ups and energy drift, and benchmarking solver performance. * Proficient in Rust and/or C\+\+. * Bonus: Deep familiarity with variational/energy\-based formulations of implicit integration (e.g. Incremental Potential Contact, Projective Dynamics) and modern solvers such as Vertex Block Descent. * Bonus: High\-fidelity, penetration\-free contact handling at scale, including primal\-dual or dual methods. * Bonus: Domain expertise in a specific simulation area (e.g. codimensional rods, cloth, FEM, MPM/SPH, material modeling). * Bonus: Published research in a top venue (e.g. SIGGRAPH) and/or experience applying novel research methods in an industrial (non\-academic) setting. * Bonus: Experience with variational/energy\-based, block\-structured, or similarly modular physics engine architectures. * Bonus: Experience with vehicle, aircraft, drone, or robotics dynamics simulation, or sim\-to\-real transfer. * Bonus: Familiarity with machine learning strong systems programming and performance profiling skills. * Experience deploying ML models on edge or embedded hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Orin, or equivalent ARM/GPU SoCs). * **Requires 5 days/week in\-office collaboration with the teams.** **Bonus Qualifications** * Familiarity with embodied AI models — VLA, multimodal transformers, or diffusion\-based policies — and their inference characteristics. * Familiarity with compiler\-based optimization pipelines such as XLA, torch.compile, or MLIR for graph\-level model acceleration. * Understanding of robotics system constraints such as control\-loop timing, sensor fusion latency, and memory bandwidth limits on edge SoCs. * Publication or production work in efficient deep learning or on\-device ML systems. **Benefits** * Competitive stock options/equity programs. * Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plan. * Visa sponsorship and green card support for qualified candidates. * Lunches and dinners, a fully stocked kitchen, and regular team\-building events. jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About the role** ------------------ Applied AI is where Concurrence meets the real world. Our core engineering team builds the platform. We take it into health systems and build what each customer actually needs on top of it, as durable software that runs in production. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you own an entire customer use case, not a ticket or a slice of one. You take a deployment from brief to production. You make the architecture calls inside it, commit the timeline, and carry the outcome. Success isn't your agent staying up. It's the customer's number moving: more intake handled, fewer denials, faster time to billing close. Your work doesn't stop at one customer. We build custom first, on purpose. When the same shape shows up under two customers, you're the one who sees it, and the pattern you proved becomes part of the platform everyone builds on next. Applied AI runs ahead of the platform, not behind it. Our field work is the R\&D that decides what Concurrence becomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own a whole use case, end to end.** You run the build from the deployment brief to production and beyond. You set its internal design, commit the timelines, and ship at a bar that doesn't need anyone checking behind you. * **Build agent systems that hold up in clinical settings.** That means hierarchies of agents and skills rather than one monolith, and evals that measure distributions, not vibes. Nothing reaches a patient until it clears our safety floor and eval gate. * **Take on the integration reality.** EHRs, legacy systems, and customer data come in every shape. You find the path from what the customer has to what the platform needs. * **Make it compound.** You turn field\-proven patterns into first\-class platform capabilities. You also push proven work down from agent reasoning into deterministic data lookups, the move where twenty tool calls become one. That's how we grow without turning into a services shop. * **Push back early.** When a spec was never vetted, an integration isn't supported, or scope quietly changed mid\-build, you raise it before the build pays for it. * **Raise the people around you.** Mentor the engineers on your use case and help set how the team builds. Write documentation good enough that a coding agent or a new hire could pick up your work. **You might be a great fit if you** ----------------------------------- * Have shipped and owned complex production systems end to end, with real users depending on them. * Have real experience building with LLMs and agents in production, or the engineering depth to get there fast. * Treat non\-deterministic systems with rigor. You know three runs of an agent is a feeling, not evidence. * Hold the near term and the long term at once: what a decision costs now, and what it makes easier or harder for the team later. * Are comfortable in the room with customers and clinicians. You'd rather understand the workflow than wait for a perfect spec. * Care about craft. Your systems fail loudly to you before they fail to a customer, and they keep working while you're on vacation. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Healthcare experience: EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth), HL7, FHIR, or clinical workflows. * Experience with Databricks, voice agents, or forward deployed or customer engineering. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Why this role** ----------------- * **Stakes.** Your work runs inside health systems and touches patient care. * **Ownership, early.** You own whole use cases from the start. At a 35\-person company, scope arrives fast. * **Leverage.** What you build in the field becomes the platform. Few roles let you shape the product this directly. * **A clear path.** Our Applied AI ladder runs from Senior to Staff or Tech Lead. You move up by the kind of work you can be trusted to own, not by how much you ship. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Systems
jobs.description: Description: ***Are you Ready to Change the Industry Together?*** Milestone is a technology\-driven platform modernizing aggregate distribution. We connect customers, carriers, and suppliers through real\-time visibility to deliver the service standard the industry has always needed. Operating across Florida, Texas, and South Carolina, we're committed to raising the standard of service in aggregate distribution. Milestone is powered by NewMile, the technology behind everything we do. NewMile builds the products and services that run our operations, from dispatch and real\-time visibility to the AI\-driven tools that will shape what comes next. It's a fast\-growing team that embraces technology and elevates the experience for our customers, carriers, and team members. We are seeking an experienced, AI\-first Software Engineer to be a pivotal player in building what lies ahead. Based in Jacksonville, FL and reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will design, build, and ship AI\-powered products and agent workflows across the NewMile platform, including our web, mobile, and API services. You're a seasoned engineer who uses AI as a force multiplier every day: you pair with AI coding tools to move faster, you know when to trust the output and when to rewrite it, and you're excited about putting LLMs and agents to work on real problems in aggregate transportation. Whether it was building an agent workflow last month or testing a new model last weekend, your curiosity and enthusiasm make you the right fit. * **Mission:** We are a family of brands committed to raising the standard of service in the aggregate distribution industry. * **Vision:** Accelerating the world’s infrastructure. **Our Values** * **1% Better, Every Day:** Continuous growth is a part of who we are as professionals and people. We are committed to being better today than yesterday, so we are ready for who our organization needs us to be tomorrow. * **Promise \& Deliver:** Pick up the phone, respond, then get it done. We are reliable in every sense of the word and deliver quality work and customer service no matter our role. We own our areas and are accountable to ourselves and each other to build trust. * **Find a Way or Make a Way:** There is no problem we can’t solve. We work together and do hard things to simplify the lives of clients, haulers and each other. We find the best way and are open\-minded to innovation, technology and new ways of working because we are building an organization to change our industry. * **Candid, but Kind:** We tell each other the truth and challenge when we don’t agree. We build real relationships rooted in kindness and thoughtfulness. Our people will always be our \#1 unique and we will never lose sight of that. * **Rev it Up:** Positive energy fuels us to get us to our vision. Each of us contribute to our culture by bringing consistent energy and passion that ripples through our teams like a fire. We celebrate and praise each other’s contributions and strive to create a place we all want to be. **Who You Are** You're a builder who thinks like an engineer, an architect, and a product owner. You have a strong software engineering foundation: you've designed systems, shipped production code, and owned what you built. And you've leaned hard into AI. You use AI coding tools to accelerate development without sacrificing quality, and you can design, build, and evaluate AI\-based systems, including LLM integrations, agent workflows, retrieval and data pipelines, and the guardrails that keep them reliable. You're language\-agnostic and pick up new stacks quickly (we build in Elixir/Phoenix, Flutter/Dart, and SQL). In a small team, you work independently: you take a problem from idea to production with minimal oversight, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical partners. Experience moving between engineering and product, architecture, or solution design is a big plus. **Why This Role Matters** NewMile is building the future of aggregate transportation, and AI is how we'll get there faster. In this role, you'll turn that ambition into working software: finding where AI can remove manual work, sharpen decisions, and improve the experience for haulers, customers, and our internal teams, and then building it. You'll own the design and delivery of AI\-powered features and agent workflows across NewMile while keeping the core platform performant, secure, and scalable. On a small, fast\-moving team, your ability to architect sound solutions, ship independently, and use AI to multiply your output directly expands what our technology team can deliver. Join us in shaping the future of logistics technology, where your skills and dedication matter every day. **Who Your Internal Customers Are and How This Role Delivers Value to Them:** * **Leadership Team:** You translate strategic priorities into practical AI and technology solutions, giving leadership clear o able, and easy to use, you create products that meet and exceed their expectations. **Your Impact:** **Build AI\-powered products and agent workflows that move the business.** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents and LLM\-powered workflows that automate manual processes and improve decision\-making across NewMile. * Integrate AI capabilities (LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, tool use, Model Context Protocol and similar frameworks) into our web, mobile, and API services. * Build in evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails so AI features are accurate, secure, cost\-effective, and trustworthy in production. **Architect a robust, scalable, AI\-ready platform.** * Design and develop server\-side functionality and data access (Elixir/Phoenix, Ecto, SQL) that supports both core platform needs and AI use cases. * Shape system architecture and data structures so NewMile's data is clean, accessible, and ready to power AI. * Ensure new functionality meets internal standards for performance, quality, security, and scalability. **Use AI as a force multiplier to ship faster without cutting corners.** * Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, and documentation. * Review, test, and own AI\-generated code with the same rigor as your own, knowing when to trust the output and when to rewrite it. * Triage and resolve technology issues promptly to keep users and operations running smoothly. **Bring a product mindset to every build.** * Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, scope solutions, and prioritize the work with the highest impact. * Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on AI\-driven ideas, then take the winners from concept to production. * Own work items end to end with minimal oversight, keeping the CTO and stakeholders informed along the way. **Lead AI adoption and continuous learning.** * Stay current on emerging AI models, tools, and practices, and recommend where they can give NewMile a competitive edge. * Share knowledge, document patterns, and help raise the AI fluency of the tech team and the broader organization. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications, ideally in a small\-team SaaS or similar environment. * Strong full\-stack fundamentals: back\-end development, APIs, data modeling, and SQL, plus front\-end experience. Proficiency in at least one modern language; Elixir/Phoenix experience is a plus (or the ability to ramp up quickly). * Hands\-on experience building AI\-based systems: integrating LLMs, designing agent workflows, prompt engineering, retrieval/RAG, and evaluating AI output for accuracy and reliability. * Daily, practical use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with sound judgment on code quality, testing, and security. * Experience with systems design or software architecture; a background in technical product management, solution architecture, or product development is a strong plus. * Experience with mobile app development (Flutter \+ Dart, React Native, or similar) is a plus. * Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms, including deploying and monitoring services. * Proven ability to work independently, own projects from concept to production, and troubleshoot complex issues without heavy guidance. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a pragmatic bias toward shipping effective solutions over perfect ones. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non\-technical partners. * Experience with Git, Agile development practices, and basic project management. * Understanding of data privacy, security, and responsible AI practices. * Collaborative, curious, and committed to continuous learning. * Based in or willing to relocate to Jacksonville, FL.

jobs.title: Sr DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Artos:** At Artos, we build tools that help biopharma companies create and manage their R\&D documentation in a fraction of the time. You'll play a critical role in scaling our AWS infrastructure, improving Kubernetes environments, automating deployments, and building tools that make our engineering team more productive. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems, building reliable systems, and eliminating operational friction through automation. You'll help establish scalable infrastructure patterns and developer\-friendly workflows that allow engineers to ship software quickly, reliably, and securely. We value pragmatic engineering, thoughtful automation, and choosing the right tools for the problem rather than introducing complexity for its own sake. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable AWS infrastructure across production and development environments. * Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters, containerized applications, and deployment workflows. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Argo CD, incorporating automated testing, dependency scanning, and container image scanning. * Develop reusable infrastructure components and automate provisioning using Terraform and infrastructure\-as\-code best practices. * Create standardized deployment patterns, infrastructure templates, and self\-service tooling that improve developer productivity. * Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar policies, secrets management, and secure configuration practices using AWS\-native services or tools such as HashiCorp Vault. * Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement long\-term improvements. * Collaborate closely with software engineers to improve deployment workflows, application performance, and overall developer experience. * Help establish infrastructure standards and operational practices that support a growing engineering organization. **What We're Looking For:** --------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering. * Strong hands\-on experience designing and operating production infrastructure on AWS. * Deep experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar tools. * Strong experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code tooling. * Proficiency in Python, Go, Bash, or similar scripting and programming languages. * Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, and distributed systems. * Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry. * Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes. * Familiarity with container security scanning, dependency scanning, and infrastructure validation tools. * Working knowledge of AWS IAM, secrets management, and cloud networking best practices. * Experience troubleshooting complex production issues and improving system reliability. * Ability to make sound architectural decisions while balancing scalability, maintainability, cost, and operational simplicity. * Strong ownership mindset and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving engineering environment. **Nice to Have:** ----------------- * Experience building internal developer platforms, self\-service infrastructure, or standardized deployment workflows (paved roads). * Experience with Kubernetes packaging and configuration tools such as **Helm templates or Jsonnet**. * Familiarity with declarative configuration languages and tools such as **ytt/Starlark, CUE, or Dhall**. * Experience evaluating configuration and templating approaches based on expressiveness, maintainability, and operational practicality. * Experience with GitOps workflows using Argo CD or Flux. * Experience with Kubernetes operators, service meshes, or advanced cluster networking. * Experience with cloud security and infrastructure scanning tools such as Trivy, Snyk, Checkov, or tfsec. * Familiarity with policy\-as\-code tools such as Open Policy Agent (OPA), Kyverno, or HashiCorp Sentinel. * Experience with secrets management tools such as HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager. * Experience supporting multi\-tenant SaaS applications or distributed systems at scale. * Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, data pipelines, or compute\-intensive workloads. * Experience operating infrastructure in regulated environments or supporting SOC 2 compliance requirements. * Experience working in an early\-stage or rapidly scaling startup. **What Success Looks Like:** ---------------------------- * Cloud infrastructure is reliable, scalable, observable, and cost\-efficient. * Kubernetes environments and deployment pipelines are stable, automated, and easy to maintain. * Engineers can provision infrastructure and deploy applications with minimal operational friction. * Infrastructure changes are repeatable, version\-controlled, and consistently validated. * Monitoring and alerting provide clear visibility into system health and performance. * Security checks are integrated into existing engineering workflows without creating unnecessary bottlenecks. * Manual operational work is reduced through automation and improved developer tooling. * The engineering organization has infrastructure foundations that support continued growth and faster software delivery. **Other Information:** Very comfortable working in a fast\-paced and intense startup environment Willing to work in\-person in our office in Mission Bay 4\-5 days/week Likes matcha KitKats, believes every LLM prompt is just Schrödinger’s cat waiting to be observed, and knows too many random facts about the Mongol postal system Compensation Range: $166\.5K \- $231K

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Conversational Agents
jobs.description: AssistCall, a product of Starling Global, builds AI receptionist and business calling software. The product connects live conversations with business information, appointments and human handoffs. In this role, you will improve the reliability, quality and operation of the systems behind those conversations. THE OPPORTUNITY You will lead the engineering of agent behavior across real\-time conversations, tool execution, retrieval and human handoff. This is a hands\-on staff role for someone who can turn an ambiguous product problem into a measured system, explain its failure modes, and carry it through production. The work includes distinguishing dialogue failures from telephony failures, controlling side effects, preserving tenant boundaries and measuring task completion beyond a convincing demo. INITIAL PRIORITIES * Establish a baseline for answer latency, interruption handling, task completion, incorrect tool execution and cost per successful call. * Ship a bounded workflow with explicit action permissions, confirmation rules, idempotent execution and a recoverable human handoff. * Build replayable evaluations and release criteria, then document a production incident or failed experiment with the evidence behind the fix. TECHNICAL CONTEXT Relevant experience includes real\-time model APIs, speech pipelines, retrieval systems, typed tool execution, event\-driven services and observability. Experience with WebRTC, SIP or telephony is useful. We evaluate architecture choices through measurements rather than assuming one vendor or orchestration framework is always appropriate. COMPENSATION US$220,000–285,000 per year (base salary). This is the expected base salary range for this role. An offer within the range is based on relevant skills, experience, the scope of the role and internal equity. Any separately offered bonus, equity or benefits are not included in this base salary range. WORK ARRANGEMENT Remote within the United States. Full\-time employee role. Working hours and any role\-specific operational coverage will be discussed during hiring. HOW WE HIRE Apply to this role through Indeed. Our hiring team can invite you into the AssistCall application process after reviewing your application. Share a résumé and a concise account of relevant work; public project, publication and portfolio links are optional. You can choose a recorded 15\-minute technical conversation with Ava, our AI interviewer, or request a human interview. Ava collects and transcribes answers for people to review; these technical roles do not use automated hiring scores, rankings or recommendations. Human reviewers determine next steps, which may include a project discussion, system\-design conversation or bounded role\-relevant exercise. Do not disclose confidential employer material or customer data. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AND ACCESSIBILITY AssistCall considers applicants based on job\-related qualifications without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or other status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available in the application process as required by law. Contact hello@assistcall.ai for hiring support, an alternative interview format or accommodation; no diagnosis is required in the initial request. We do not request salary history. See https://career.assistcall.ai/hiring\-process and https://assistcall.ai/privacy for information about application processing. RESPONSIBILITIES * Design dialogue state, structured tool contracts, retrieval boundaries and durable workflow state for live voice agents. * Implement cancellation, retries, timeouts and idempotency across model requests, telephony events and external business APIs. * Build evaluation sets from consented, appropriately handled examples; prevent train/test leakage and track scenario coverage. * Separate model reasoning from execution authority, including confirmation before payments, account changes and other consequential actions. * Diagnose latency across speech detection, model inference, tool calls and audio playback using traces and reproducible experiments. * Lead design reviews and mentor engineers while continuing to write and operate production code. QUALIFICATIONS * Deep production experience building LLM applications or conversational agents with measurable reliability requirements. * Strong Python or TypeScript engineering, asynchronous systems, API design and automated testing. * Practical experience with tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, prompt\-injection defenses and evaluation design. * Ability to reason about state machines, distributed failure, authorization and multitenant isolation. * Evidence of leading a substantial technical project from design through production and operational follow\-through. * A degree in a relevant field or equivalent demonstrable professional experience; a specific degree is not required. Pay: $220,000\.00 \- $285,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About the role** ------------------ Applied AI is where Concurrence meets the real world. Our core engineering team builds the platform. We take it into health systems and build what each customer actually needs on top of it, as durable software that runs in production. As a Staff Applied AI Engineer, you own our most complex customer use cases and set technical direction across deployments. You take a deployment from brief to production. You make the architecture calls inside it and across shared systems, commit the timeline, and carry the outcome. Success isn't your agent staying up. It's the customer's number moving: more intake handled, fewer denials, faster time to billing close. Your work doesn't stop at one customer. We build custom first, on purpose. When the same shape shows up under two customers, you're the one who sees it, and the pattern you proved becomes part of the platform everyone builds on next. Applied AI runs ahead of the platform, not behind it. Our field work is the R\&D that decides what Concurrence becomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own our most complex use cases, end to end.** You run the build from the deployment brief to production and beyond. You set technical direction within and across deployments, resolve tradeoffs with the platform team, commit the timelines, and stay hands\-on in the hardest parts of the build. * **Build agent systems that hold up in clinical settings.** That means hierarchies of agents and skills rather than one monolith, and evals that measure distributions, not vibes. Nothing reaches a patient until it clears our safety floor and eval gate. * **Take on the integration reality.** EHRs, legacy systems, and customer data come in every shape. You find the path from what the customer has to what the platform needs. * **Make it compound.** You turn field\-proven patterns into first\-class platform capabilities. You also push proven work down from agent reasoning into deterministic data lookups, the move where twenty tool calls become one. That's how we grow without turning into a services shop. * **Push back early.** When a spec was never vetted, an integration isn't supported, or scope quietly changed mid\-build, you raise it before the build pays for it. * **Raise the people around you.** Mentor engineers across deployments and help set the team's architecture and engineering standards. Write documentation good enough that a coding agent or a new hire could pick up your work. **You might be a great fit if you** ----------------------------------- * Have shipped and owned complex production systems end to end, with real users depending on them. * Have set technical direction across multiple projects or teams, and helped other engineers make sound architecture decisions. * Have real experience building with LLMs and agents in production, or the engineering depth to get there fast. * Treat non\-deterministic systems with rigor. You know three runs of an agent is a feeling, not evidence. * Hold the near term and the long term at once: what a decision costs now, and what it makes easier or harder for the team later. * Are comfortable in the room with customers and clinicians. You'd rather understand the workflow than wait for a perfect spec. * Care about craft. Your systems fail loudly to you before they fail to a customer, and they keep working while you're on vacation. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Healthcare experience: EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth), HL7, FHIR, or clinical workflows. * Experience with Databricks, voice agents, or forward deployed or customer engineering. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Why this role** ----------------- * **Stakes.** Your work runs inside health systems and touches patient care. * **Ownership, early.** You own complex use cases and shared technical decisions from the start. At a 35\-person company, scope arrives fast. * **Leverage.** What you build in the field becomes the platform. Few roles let you shape the product this directly. * **Technical leadership.** Set direction across Applied AI while staying close to the code. Your impact grows through the decisions and patterns the whole team builds on. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $240K \- $300K

Your work will directly support robotics, gas delivery systems, temperature control hardware, and factory automation, delivering real\-time solutions that drive chip production. Based in Phoenix, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams and play a key role in shaping the future of semiconductor automation and equipment connectivity. You will play a key role in advancing ASM's software engineering capabilities through the responsible adoption of AI\-enabled development, helping teams accelerate problem resolution, improve software quality, and scale engineering excellence across global product platforms. **What You'll Be Working On** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. * Develop applications for Windows and real\-time operating systems. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues within real\-time control systems. * Diagnose and resolve software, electrical, and mechanical system issues. * Lead technical escalation with field engineers and global customers. * Partner with Quality Assurance and Support teams to investigate issues and improve regression test coverage. * Author and review software requirements, system specifications, design documents, and test plans. * Investigate internal and customer\-reported issues and develop solutions. * Evaluate and recommend software engineering tools, processes, and best practices. * Participate in system architecture, design, and scheduling initiatives. * Integrate and support factory automation interfaces, including SECS/GEM and related industry protocols. * Collaborate with automation teams to ensure reliable communication between manufacturing equipment and factory systems. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. * Strong software development experience using C\#. * 5\+ years of experience in software development, preferably in a full\-stack or systems\-focused environment. * Semiconductor industry experience. * Hands\-on experience with factory automation systems. * Familiarity with SECS/GEM, GEM300, and EDA (Interface A) protocols. * Experience working with Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS). * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools, large language models (LLMs), and modern software engineering practices leveraging generative AI. * Ability to travel 10\-25% domestically and internationally. **What Sets You Apart** * 10\+ years of software development experience, including software architecture and system design. * Experience developing machine control software, preferably for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. * Strong knowledge of Windows and real\-time operating systems. * Experience building multi\-threaded and real\-time applications. * Hands\-on experience with GUI development and device drivers. * Knowledge of networking, industrial communications, and EtherCAT. * Understanding dynamic scheduling algorithms and deadlock avoidance techniques. * Ability to analyze complex system interactions and drive long\-term technical improvements. * Hands\-on experience integrating AI, machine learning, or data\-driven solutions into production software systems or engineering workflows. **Apply today to be part of what’s next.** We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect. jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Garage)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day\-to\-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top\-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com. As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer (On\-Prem) at AeroVect, you will own and scale the physical infrastructure that supports our autonomous vehicle operations at our garage facilities. Your primary focus will be deploying, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting bare\-metal servers, networking equipment, and rack infrastructure to ensure reliable operations across our active airport deployments. This is a highly hands\-on infrastructure role, ideal for someone with a strong background in Linux systems administration, data center infrastructure, physical networking, and hardware reliability. You don't need to be a software engineer. We're looking for someone who enjoys working directly with hardware, building reliable infrastructure, and solving complex operational challenges. You'll work in a fast\-paced environment where infrastructure directly supports autonomous vehicles operating in live airport environments. As AeroVect scales its fleet and expands to new locations, you'll play a key role in building standardized, reliable, and scalable on\-prem infrastructure. **You Will** * Deploy, configure, and maintain bare\-metal Linux servers and computing infrastructure at AeroVect's garage facilities. * Own physical infrastructure setup, including server racks, cabling, power distribution, hardware installation, and equipment organization. * Configure, manage, and troubleshoot networking equipment, including switches, routers, firewalls, and network connectivity across on\-prem systems. * Manage the lifecycle of physical infrastructure, from hardware selection and procurement through installation, maintenance, upgrades, and replacement. * Monitor and troubleshoot server health, network performance, hardware failures, and infrastructure reliability to minimize operational downtime. * Establish infrastructure standards, documentation, and repeatable deployment processes as AeroVect expands to additional garage locations. * Support connectivity and data transfer between autonomous vehicles, garage infrastructure, and cloud systems. * Maintain and improve existing infrastructure supporting vehicle software delivery and operational data uploads. * Develop lightweight automation and scripting solutions using Bash or Python to simplify system administration, monitoring, and infrastructure management. * Collaborate with software, cloud infrastructure, and autonomy engineering teams to ensure reliable integration between physical infrastructure and software systems. * Provide hands\-on troubleshooting and operational support in a dynamic environment where infrastructure availability directly impacts vehicle operations. **You Have** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in infrastructure engineering, Linux systems administration, data center operations, or a similar technical role. * Strong experience deploying, configuring, and maintaining bare\-metal Linux servers in on\-prem environments. * Hands\-on experience with server racks, cabling, hardware installation, power management, and physical infrastructure troubleshooting. * Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting. * Experience configuring and maintaining physical networking equipment such as switches, routers, and firewalls. * Strong Linux administration skills, including system configuration, troubleshooting, performance monitoring, storage management, and system\-level debugging. * Experience diagnosing hardware and network failures and implementing solutions to improve infrastructure reliability. * Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring, logging, and alerting tools. * Ability to work independently, take ownership of infrastructure projects, and troubleshoot issues directly in the field. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced operational environment with evolving infrastructure needs and priorities. **We Prefer** * Experience managing on\-prem infrastructure in robotics, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, manufacturing, or other hardware\-intensive environments. * Experience building or scaling physical infrastructure across multiple operational sites. * Familiarity with server provisioning, configuration management, or infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible. * Experience with virtualization, containerization, or on\-prem compute orchestration. * Basic Python or Bash scripting experience for infrastructure automation. * Familiarity with edge computing, vehicle connectivity, or data transfer between on\-prem and cloud environments. * Experience supporting software deployment to physical devices or embedded systems. * Familiarity with hardware lifecycle management, infrastructure capacity planning, and redundancy strategies. * Exposure to high\-availability environments where infrastructure downtime directly impacts physical operations.

environments * Improve logging, monitoring, observability, and documentation so the next person can understand and support what you built * Investigate and resolve production issues, using logs and monitoring to find root causes rather than symptoms **Team \& Delivery** * Work closely with the Technical Lead on design decisions, estimates, and priorities * Collaborate with operations, product, QA, and business stakeholders to understand how the work is actually done * Mentor and support other developers as the team grows * Surface blockers and risks early, and communicate clearly about tradeoffs **What We're Looking For** **Required** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with recent hands\-on work building backend services in C\#/.NET (ASP.NET Core) or an equivalent modern language and framework (for example, Java with Spring Boot, Go, or Node.js with TypeScript) * Experience building and supporting production backend services and REST APIs * database skills (SQL Server or similar) * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS (or an equivalent cloud platform) * Experience integrating with third\-party APIs, enterprise platforms, or data feeds * Solid testing habits, Git\-based workflows, and experience with code review * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools, with the judgment to know when not to trust them * Clear communicator who can work with non\-technical stakeholders and explain technical tradeoffs accurately * Comfortable in a live environment where systems are still being built and not everything is defined **Preferred** * Background in healthcare, revenue cycle management, medical billing, or claims processing * Familiarity with healthcare data and transactions such as X12 EDI (270/271, 276/277, 835, 837\) or FHIR * Experience with payer connectivity, clearinghouses, or eligibility and claim status automation * Salesforce or other enterprise CRM integration experience * Experience with document processing, OCR, or intelligent data extraction * Event\-driven or message\-based architecture (for example, AMQP or RabbitMQ) * CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and observability with OpenTelemetry and a backend such as Application Insights * Front\-end experience (React or Angular) for internal tools * Experience working alongside outsourced or distributed development teams * jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer, Night Shift, ATL DCEO
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a detail\-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Nights Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first\-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers. The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Key job responsibilities * This position is for NIGHTS * Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities\-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc. * Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures, and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA). * Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture. * Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams * May assist in the build out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency * Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out\-of\-hours emergency calls. * Communicate complex technical information to a non\-technical audience. * Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency * Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff * Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance. * Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day to day tasks Physical Requirements: * Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations: * Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently * Participate in group lifts for 40\+ pounds * Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder * Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position * Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection A day in the life This NIGHTS role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission\-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment that supports servers that must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand\-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment. The CE directs, trains and supports technicians in their role of providing hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment\-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 3\+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 2\+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience * 3\+ years of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel experience * Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in data center engineering or operations * Experience in construction or project management * Experience leading technical teams through daily operations and maintenance evolutions * Can work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS runs the world's largest fleet of AI/ML accelerator servers. We build the services, control planes, and data platforms that turn hundreds of thousands of servers into a reliable, self\-managing system. If you want to build software at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems and the physical infrastructure powering frontier AI, this is the role. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to design and build the software that operates our accelerated compute fleet: fleet\-management services, orchestration and remediation control planes, telemetry and analytics pipelines, and the APIs and tools that engineering, operations, and partner teams depend on. You will own software from design through production, working across multiple teams and organizations to deliver scalable, reliable services. What You Will Do You will design and build distributed services and data platforms that manage the fleet end to end. You will turn ambiguous problems into well\-architected software: designing APIs, choosing data models, making the latency, availability, and cost trade\-offs that come with operating at fleet scale. You will build the control planes that automate provisioning, health evaluation, and remediation, and the pipelines that transform raw telemetry into signals other teams act on. When your service catches and routes a failing node automatically before it disrupts a training job, that is your impact. You communicate clearly, raise the engineering bar for your team, and can partner with hardware, firmware, and operations engineers to build software that reflects how the fleet actually behaves.
