jobs.title: Senior Mission Operations Engineer, Connected Warfare
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ### **ABOUT THE TEAM** The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support and execute global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, aggregating together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe for battlefield dominance. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for critical commander decision\-making, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy. The Mission Operations (MOPs) team is responsible for managing the execution, delivery, growth, and success of our customer accounts. Working across product, engineering, business development and logistics teams, our Mission Operations Engineers own and shape the customer relationships by embedding themselves with their units to develop, plan, and deploy Anduril products in support of their missions. They work side\-by\-side with customers to understand their specific problem sets and then shape Anduril's offerings alongside our engineering teams to fit the mission needs. Because the problems we solve are uniquely challenging, our Mission Operations Engineers naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and are adept at identifying and navigating organizational hurdles. They are ultimately responsible for customer and mission success and therefore play a critical role in the shaping and future of Anduril Industries and the Warfighter. ### **ABOUT THE JOB** **Orchestrate the deployment of Anduril products.** Lead the planning and deployment of Anduril's flagship hardware and software products in support of customer missions. Through collaboration with our engineering, logistics, and technical operations teams, Mission Operators are in charge of deploying our products to the field, training end users, and ensuring the high performance of our products. We are obsessed about engagement and keeping our finger on the pulse of how customers interact with our products. This helps us improve the user experience and evolve their operational tactics and techniques. And if something isn't quite right, we work with product teams to quickly address the issue on behalf of our customer. **Grow your business through customer success.** In addition to the operational and executive relationships you own, you will be responsible for meeting commercial targets that drive top line growth. This requires establishing committed and trust\-based partnerships with our customers to not only help them solve their immediate problems, but also to foresee future opportunities where Anduril's technology can make them more effective. Understanding Anduril's value proposition and articulating how we can have an impact on a customer's problem set, from the executive level to the end user, is critical to positioning Anduril for the future. **Shape our products to meet mission needs.** Work side\-by\-side with our customers to understand their specific mission challenges and represent the customer as you work with Anduril engineers to shape products that solve critical national and international security challenges. Anduril engineers rely on Mission Operators to understand the lay of the land and bring a perspective that informs the product development process. **Collaborate across nearly every Anduril team.** Successfully deploying our complex hardware and software products requires collaborating with nearly every internal Anduril team \- business development, engineering, product, logistics, finance, legal, contracting, technical operations, and many more. You'll be responsible for ensuring each party is engaged and informed, and will therefore become well\-versed in what it takes to really bring the best of Anduril to our customers. ### **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** **Mission First Mindset.** We put the needs of the mission and our customers first and understand that the US and its allies have no preordained right to victory in any future conflict. We actively seek out opportunities to better understand our customers' mission needs, with a goal to build the best possible products for the warfighter and rad anning, targeting, and fires systems and workflows * Experience and familiarity in mobile compute challenges and tradeoffs for dismounted soldiers in varying form factors * Familiarity with operational constraints of military workflows in Disconnected, Denied, Intermittent, and Low\-Bandwidth (DDIL) environments * Familiarity with mesh networking and data federation across disparate systems * Familiarity with doctrinal, functional, and technical command and control concepts, processes, and principles The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Democratic Partnerships
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As a member of the Applied AI, Democratic Partnerships team at Anthropic you will provide technical support to the governments of key international allies and civil\-sector partners to support democratic resilience. Near\-term work focuses on a few priority countries and partners, and will continue to expand with capacity. This role serves Anthropic's mission and public benefit goals. In collaboration with the Policy, National Security, Product, Research, and Engineering teams, you'll help partners build, integrate, and ship Claude deployments. You will use your excellent communication skills to explain complex topics, including the potential benefits and harms of frontier AI, to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. You will also play a critical role in identifying how our AI systems can best serve public interests in frontline democracies, while maintaining our best\-in\-class safety standards. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Work directly with partner technical teams to build and ship Claude deployments. Guide their setup, architecture, and integration as they build with Claude Code and the Claude API. * Build pilots and repeatable workflows that can scale across partner agencies, and support developer and university enablement. * Document how to deploy Claude in low\-connectivity, multilingual, and security\-conscious environments, for reuse across partners. * Act as the voice of our partners in frontline democracies and a key collaborator with our Product and Research teams to ensure we deliver the capabilities they need. * Travel internationally to partner institutions for technical enablement and building relationships. * Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI. * Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of innovative solutions that leverage our latest models’ capabilities. * Support partner deployments in areas such as education, cyber resiliency and global health. **You may be a good fit if you have:** -------------------------------------- * 4\+ years of experience as a Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Cybersecurity Engineer, working with governments, civil\-sector organizations, or the public sector * Experience shipping software in imperfect conditions, and a practical approach to infrastructure constraints * Designed novel and innovative solutions for technical platforms in a developing mission area * Comfort working directly with partner technical teams, and motivation to work on deployments where the stakes are civic rather than commercial * Strong technical aptitude to partner with engineers and strong proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred) * Understanding of and experience with LLM fundamentals * The ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, and to flex into different domains based on the problem at hand, finding simple, easy\-to\-understand solutions * Excitement for engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders, from engineers to senior government officials * Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 \- $315,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

If you want deep technical challenges, global product impact, and the satisfaction of seeing your work reach people in their own language across the world, this is the right role. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, ML
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** Apptronik is seeking a Staff MLOps Engineer to own the technical direction of our MLOps platform — the system of record for datasets, experiments, model artifacts, and serving paths that connects teleoperation data collection on one side to deployed autonomy on Apollo on the other. In this role, you will set the architecture for the platform layer above the training cluster: dataset lifecycle, experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation harnesses, and the serving / packaging path that delivers trained policies to robots in the field. You will lead by influence across MLOps, Autonomy, Data Platform, and TeleOp — establishing the standards, contracts, and tooling that turn one\-off research code into a repeatable, auditable pipeline from data to deployed model. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role, not a management position; you will be a primary contributor while mentoring the engineers around you, and partnering closely with the Training Infrastructure engineer who owns the cluster layer beneath the platform. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **Platform Architecture \& Ownership** * **Technical Direction:** Own the technical direction for the MLOps platform — define subsystem interfaces, drive architecture decisions, and establish engineering standards for how datasets, experiments, and models move through Apptronik's systems. * **Cross\-Team Authority:** Serve as the primary technical point of contact for Autonomy, Data Platform, and TeleOp on all matters of model lifecycle and platform contracts. **Dataset Lifecycle \& Versioning** * **Versioning \& Lineage:** Design and operate the dataset layer end\-to\-end — versioning, lineage, splits, and labeling\-integration handoff. * **Reproducibility:** Ensure jobs.title: Senior CAD Designer
jobs.description: **What we're building** ----------------------- The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now. Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We're now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we're extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water. The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it **Who we're looking for** ------------------------- As Arc's Senior CAD Designer, you will own the CAD backbone of our vessels: the models, the drawing packages, and the standards the rest of Engineering builds against. You'll be our resident NX and Teamcenter expert, creating production\-intent CAD across disciplines, releasing drawing packages a vendor can quote without a phone call, and aligning every engineering team on the same best practices and source of truth. We're looking for someone fired up by the mission and ready to build. You'll thrive here if you move fast, take ownership, and care about the details. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Creating production\-intent CAD in NX across disciplines including solid and surface modeling, sheet metal, assembly \& mechanisms, weldments, piping and plumbing routing for hull and deck structures, mechanical systems, and powertrain interfaces. * Checking drawings and leading workflows to release designs across Engineering * Owning large assemblies, the boat\-level eBOM, and mass properties, with a clean, scalable assembly architecture and configuration structure * Releasing fully dimensioned drawing packages to manufacturing and suppliers, applying GD\&T per ASME Y14\.5 and running tolerance stack\-ups on critical interfaces * Serving as Arc's resident NX and Teamcenter expert: developing CAD standards, templates, naming conventions, revision control, and shared libraries to align all engineering teams on best practices * Supporting and improving our Teamcenter environment, including workflows, eBOM configuration, troubleshooting, and training engineers, and growing into administration and backend setup * Partnering with manufacturing and supply chain on DFM to catch problems while they're still pixels * Supporting prototype builds on the floor and folding what you learn back into the models **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related Engineering field, or equivalent professional experience * 5\+ years of mechanical design and drafting, with a track record of releasing drawings to production * Demonstrated expertise in CAD (NX required) across multiple disciplines. SolidWorks or CATIA experience alone is not sufficient. * A generalist who is comfortable across disciplines, rather than a specialist in one area such as surfacing or sheet metal * Demonstrated Teamcenter experience, including workflows * Experience developing CAD standards or best practices and training other engineers * Strong command of GD\&T per ASME Y14\.5, with experience releasing parts to vendors across machining, fabrication, composites, or molding * Thrives with incomplete requirements and fast\-changing designs * Communicates clearly with engineers, technicians, and suppliers, and can align multiple teams on shared standards **Bonus Qualifications** ------------------------ * 10\+ years of design experience * Teamcenter administration and backend setup experience * Partnering with industrial designers to turn sketches into Class A surfaces * Building CAD standards and PDM structure from scratch at an early\-stage company * Marine hardware experience preferred; automotive, aerospace, or EV also relevant * Background in composite structures or large weldment design * Experience with high\-voltage packaging * Comfortable pushing a fast but sustainable pace * Enthusiasm for boating and clean energy At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You're always welcome to reach out even if you don't meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot. **What we offer** ----------------- The base salary for this role is P3: $150,000 P4: $175,000 annually. Highly competitive equity grants are included with full time offers. As well as semi\-annual bonuses tied to your impact, not just your tenure. Additionally, Arc offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: * **Healthcare benefits** — 99% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision * **Parental leave** — 14 weeks fully paid for birthing and non\-birthing parents * **Generous time off** — Highly competitive PTO with an opportunity to earn more time with tenure * **Income protection** — Life and disability insurance for all employees * **Retirement savings** —Traditional and Roth 401(k) access * **Water fund** — $500 for you to spend each year to get out on the water, however you choose * **Professional development** — $500 annual reimbursement for professional development and a monthly AI stipend * **Safety Support\-** Annual reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe * **Captain training** — Training and access to take Arc boats out with friends and family * **Office perks** — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite * **Relocation assistance** — Available depending on role eligibility. **Our values** -------------- We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else: * **Ownership** over both your work and the company's success * **Empathy** for colleagues and for customers * **Humility** in problem solving and collaboration * **Pragmatism** for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly * **Inclusion** of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives. We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align \- we'd be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

and * Writing acceptance criteria and confirming completed work directly with the users. **20% Build proofs of concept and direct AI agents, which includes:** --------------------------------------------------------------------- * Building working proofs of concept independently with AI agents or n8n, such as business rules, workflow steps, portal pages, and letters, and generating the requirements from them; * Delegating substantial analysis work to approved agents, such as requirements, decision tables, stories, data mappings, test plans, and validation queries, with clear intent, business context, constraints, and completion criteria refined as new information emerges; * Confirming AI\-produced analysis against business needs and with business users before it is used; * Identifying automation and AI candidates in your business area, with success measures, and recommending them; and * Establishing specifications, templates, and context practices that demonstrably improve the team’s work, recording material AI contributions, and following approved tool and data rules. **15% Test, verify, and carry solutions to production, which includes:** ------------------------------------------------------------------------ * Creating test cases, which can include ad\-hoc querying of SQL databases, and evaluation cases; developing and executing test plans, including automated regression tests and testing, and managing the testing, of RESTful APIs, Windows services, and database integrations; analyzing outcomes, resolving differences, and reviewing the test results of others as required; * Leading UAT for large and cross\-system work and carrying solutions through dev, test, stage, and production with evaluation cases, human review steps, and controls verified with engineers, agreeing production ownership before release; and * Establishing verification strategies and review practices and identifying recurring failure modes. **10% Lead and coach, which includes:** --------------------------------------- * Serving a on, and exactness. **Preferred experience** ------------------------ * Knowledge of Claude, Claude Code, Microsoft CoPilot, or similar agentic tools; n8n; Git and GitHub; Azure DevOps or Jira; ability to read C\#, Python or TypeScript. * Experience identifying automation and AI opportunities and defining success measures; decision tables and business rules, workflow and state\-machine design, and human\-in\-the\-loop review design. * Insurance or financial services experience, such as new business, underwriting, claims, or policy administration. **AI FLUENCY** ============== Directing AI agents is the default way you produce work on this team. You choose another approach when quality, security, or the platform calls for it, and can explain why. You own the correctness, security, and quality of everything you deliver, however it was produced. * **Delegation –** Routinely directs agents on substantial analysis, documentation, and validation work, such as requirements, decision tables, user stories, data mappings, test plans, and validation queries, where they suit the task. Choose a sensible division of work between you and the agent, explain significant exceptions, and recover when an agent becomes unproductive. * **Description –** Give agents clear intent, business context, constraints, and completion criteria, and improve them as users react and new information emerges. Clarifying questions, prompt revisions, and discovering a genuine requirement gap are normal parts of good work. Establish AI\-ready specifications, templates, or context practices that demonstrably improve work across a team, including decision logic, data definitions, exception handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop steps. * **Discernment –** Confirm AI\-produced analysis, generated requirements, data, and test results against business needs and with business users before they are used. Explain the result and its limit, redirect or stop ineffective work, and own and learn from defects. Establish verification strategies and review practices, identify recurring failure modes, and improve the team’s quality of judgment. * **Diligence –** Follow approved tool and data rules independently, protect sensitive data and evidence, record material AI contributions, and raise control gaps promptly. * **Leverage –** Apply repeatable AI workflows to recurring analysis and testing work and show a credible benefit in delivery time, clarity, coverage, quality, or reduced effort. Count verification and rework honestly and explain limitations. **EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS** ============================================ Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience. Relevant technical, analysis, cloud, insurance, or leadership certifications are beneficial; demonstrated capability remains central. **PHYSICAL AND WORK SCHEDULE REQUIREMENTS** =========================================== This position is remote, with occasional on\-site attendance. Travel arrangements and team collaboration hours are communicated for the specific opening. Consistent and reliable attendance is an essential function. Work may exceed 40 hours a week. * **On\-call rotation –** Participates in a rotating on\-call schedule after training, including nights and weekends. While on call, remains reachable and responds promptly to production alerts within defined response times and escalation paths. * **Contain first –** While on call, is empowered to take immediate containing actions, such as rolling back a release, pausing outbound communications, parking workflows, or disabling a feature. Fixes forward during business hours unless impact requires otherwise, and records a brief incident note. * **Planned off\-hours work –** Occasional scheduled evening or weekend work for production deploys, cutovers, data migrations, and go\-lives, with advance notice. Note: We are not currently considering applicants in CA, CO, CT, DC, HI, IL, MA, MD, MN, NV, NJ, NY, RI, VT, WA, for this position.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Do you enjoy turning real business problems into working software and seeing your solutions used every day? At **Auld \& White Constructors**, technology helps our teams work faster and smarter. As our **Software Developer**, you'll build the custom applications, automations, and AI\-enabled tools that remove manual work and improve how our business teams operate. This hands\-on role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with people, learning how they work, and shipping practical solutions that make a measurable difference. **Why Join Auld \& White Constructors?** * Deep local roots, proudly serving Northeast Florida for nearly 40 years * Great earning potential and competitive benefits * A close\-knit, knowledgeable and supportive team of experts * On\-going training and opportunities for career advancement * We're consistently ranked one of Jacksonville's "Best Places to Work" **Position Summary** The **Software Developer** designs, builds, and supports custom applications, integrations, automations, and AI\-enabled tools for teams across the company. This role blends requirements gathering, hands\-on development, deployment, and end\-user support. You'll work directly with non\-technical colleagues to understand their workflows, turn informal processes into scoped solutions, and see them through to daily use, using modern development practices alongside AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot. Success is measured by deployed solutions, sustained adoption, and real improvement over the old way of doing things. This is an in\-office position located in Jacksonville, FL. Remote or hybrid schedules will not be considered. **Position Description** * Partner with business teams to observe workflows and identify manual effort, errors, and delays * Define a clear problem statement, scope, success measure, and human\-oversight requirement before building * Evaluate and prioritize use cases by business value, feasibility, data availability, security, effort, and risk * Maintain a prioritized backlog of development work * Design, develop, and deploy applications, scripts, workflow automations, dashboards, and reporting tools using clean, version\-controlled code * Build AI\-enabled solutions, including agents, prompt\-driven workflows, document and email automations, data extraction, and summarization tools * Integrate solutions with business systems through APIs, connectors, and platforms such as Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Excel, and Power Platform * Prototype quickly, test with end users, and iterate until solutions are reliable and measurably better than the prior process * Plan rollouts around business schedules and provide side\-by\-side testing, coaching, and knowledge transfer to end users and power users * Monitor usage, performance, and adoption, and recommend fixes, redesign, or retirement as needed * Document functionality, procedures, limitations, data dependencies, and situations that require human judgment * Partner with IT, security, data, and business stakeholders on access, licensing, governance, and responsible AI use **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered * 2\+ years of professional or project experience in software development * Proficiency in Python or a comparable language (JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#), plus SQL and Git * Experience with APIs, JSON, connectors, and lightweight system integrations * Proficiency with generative AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT (including coding agents like Claude Code or Codex), along with prompt design and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including SharePoint, Excel, and Power Automate * Ability to gather requirements from non\-technical users and turn informal processes into scoped solutions * Strong communication skills and sound judgment with confidential business information **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying LLM solutions (agents, assistants, retrieval or document workflows) that end users adopted * Experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI), Azure, containers, or basic CI/CD is a plus * Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, or Construction (AEC) industry is a plus **Auld \& White Constructors is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** Auld \& White does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer Enterprise Search
jobs.description: As a Software Engineer, Enterprise Search at AutoZone, you will contribute to building and enhancing the search platform that powers our store and digital experiences. You will develop and support scalable search solutions using Elasticsearch, Java, Spring Boot, Apache Spark, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Dataproc and Dataflow to deliver fast, relevant, and reliable product discovery for our customers. You will collaborate with engineers and cross\-functional teams to implement features, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve our search capabilities. You will also build and support cloud\-based solutions on GCP and leverage modern agentic AI tools such as Claude Code or similar platforms to improve development productivity, code quality, and delivery. * Develop and enhance e\-commerce search capabilities using Elasticsearch, contributing to the design, implementation, and ongoing improvement of search functionality. * Develop and maintain scalable indexing and data\-processing pipelines using Apache Spark and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Dataproc and Dataflow. * Improve search relevance, ranking, filtering, faceting, autocomplete, and product discovery experiences across e\-commerce platforms. * Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional engineering teams to understand search requirements and translate them into high\-quality technical solutions. * Develop low\-level designs (LLDs) for assigned features and participate with architects and senior engineers in establishing high\-level designs (HLDs) and technical approaches. * Develop comprehensive automated unit tests and maintain a target of at least 90%\-unit test code coverage for new and modified code. * Follow strong engineering practices, including clean and maintainable code, test automation, code reviews, CI/CD, and operational readiness. * Implement clean, structured, and meaningful application logging to support troubleshooting, observability, and production support. * Build and maintain operational dashboards, metrics, and alerts to enable continuous monitoring of application health, performance, and search services. * Monitor production applications, proactively identify issues, and participate in the team's monthly on\-call rotation to support production systems and incident resolution. * Use Claude Code or other agentic AI development tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, strengthen test coverage, and improve the overall quality of engineering output * Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. * 4\+ years of software engineering experience developing backend applications and services. * Hands\-on experience with Elasticsearch, including indexing, mappings, Query DSL, relevance tuning, aggregations, and performance optimization. * Strong Java and Spring Boot experience, including REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise application development. * Experience with Apache Spark and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Dataproc, Dataflow, or similar data\-processing technologies. * Good understanding of unit testing, test automation, API design, observability, logging, and production support practices. * Experience developing low\-level designs and collaborating with architects and engineers on solutions and high\-level designs. * Experience with Claude Code or other agentic AI development tools to support coding, testing, documentation, and engineering productivity. Since opening our first store in 1979, AutoZone has grown into a leading retailer and distributor of automotive parts and accessories across the Americas. Our customer\-first mindset and commitment to Going the Extra Mile define who we are, for both our customers and AutoZoners. Working at AutoZone means being part of a team that values dedication, teamwork, and growth. Whether you're helping customers or building your career, we provide tools and support to help you succeed and drive your future. **Benefits at AutoZone**AutoZone offers thoughtful benefits programs with one\-on\-one benefits guidance designed to improve AutoZoners’ physical, mental and financial well\-being. **All AutoZoners (Full\-Time and Part\-Time):*** Competitive pay * Unrivaled company culture * Medical, dental and vision plans * Exclusive discounts and perks, including an AutoZone in\-store discount * 401(k) with company match and Stock Purchase Plan * AutoZoners Living Well Program for free mental health support * Opportunities for career growth **Additional Benefits for Full\-Time AutoZoners:*** Paid time off * Life, and short\- and long\-term disability insurance options * Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts with wellness rewards * Tuition reimbursement Minimum age requirements may apply. Eligibility and waiting period requirements may apply; benefits for AutoZoners in Puerto Rico, Hawaii, or the U.S. Virgin Islands may differ. Learn more about all that AutoZone has to offer at Careers.AutoZone.com. We proudly support Veterans, Active\-duty Service Members, Reservists, National Guard and Military Families. Your experience is highly valued, and we encourage you to apply to join our team. **Online Application:**An online application is required. Click the Apply button to complete your application. For step\-by\-step instructions on how to apply visit careers.autozone.com/candidateresources. AutoZone, and its subsidiary, ALLDATA are equal opportunity employers. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other legally protected categories.

jobs.title: Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions
jobs.description: Job ID 26WD101846 **Job Requisition ID \#** 26WD101846 **Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions** **Position Overview** Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer\-focused **Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions** to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward\-deployed engineering) team. You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high\-value workflows, model the **data** those workflows depend on, and build the **AI systems** for their Design \& Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes. You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs \- inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge\-graph extensions, retrieval and context\-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production. Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap. The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement\-driven with travel **up to 75%** during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below. **Responsibilities** **Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome** * Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI\-enabled workflow outcomes. * Lead co\-innovation with customers to find high\-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions. * Analyze end\-to\-end workflows across Autodesk and non\-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics. * Own technical execution end\-to\-end \- rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption \- with accountability for customer impact. * Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade\-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder **Make Data and Context AI\-Ready** * Assess customer data readiness \- fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints \- required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows. * Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI\-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action. * Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality. **Build and Ship Production AI** * Design and build production\-grade AI\-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments. * Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on \- hybrid search, graph\-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely. * Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users. * Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments. * Define the operating model for what you build \- runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost \- and hand it over cleanly to customer tea  and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response. **Ideal Candidate** * **Ships.** Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved. * **Treats evaluation as part of the product.** Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling. * **Is fluent in both worlds.** Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non\-deterministic systems. * **Thinks in reusable patterns.** Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?” * **Moves fast without leaving a mess**. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade\-off deliberately. \#AC\-1 **Learn More** **About Autodesk** Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! **Salary transparency** Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.\-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $139,000 and $249,260\. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $131,000 and $191,400 Annual. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Le salaire est l'un des éléments du programme de rémunération concurrentiel d'Autodesk. Pour les postes basés au Canada, nous offrons un salaire de base entre $131,000 et $191,400 annuel. Le salaire est déterminé selon l'expérience professionnelle et l'emplacement du candidat(e), et peut dépasser cette fourchette. En plus du salaire de base, notre programme de rémunération peut inclure une prime annuelle, des commissions pour les postes de ventes, des attributions d'actions et un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux. **Sales Careers** Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/careers/sales **Equal Employment Opportunity** At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law. **Belonging** We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global\-belonging **In\-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification** This role may require in\-person onboarding and/or in\-person ID verification.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Since 2006, BN (an Augeo company since our acquisition in 2023\) has been a leader in social media tech innovation and media excellence. BN's mission is to provide cutting\-edge social advertising solutions that allow brands to maximize their brand voice on social media and drive meaningful results to their bottom line with our suite of tools: * **BN Influencer**, which enables brands to transform their employees and fans into influencers to create authentic social content on the brand's behalf, all while abiding by brand safety standards. * **BN Ads**, our in\-house media agency that has worked with Fortune 500 clients for over 10 years. * **BN Innovate**, our tech innovation hub that partners with social platforms and brands including Amex, Meta, TikTok, X, Snapchat, and Pinterest, and creates technologies that sit on top of their ad buying platforms to solve business objectives with our tech expertise. BN has offices in Rochester, NYC, Boston, Bentonville, Kansas City, Hyderabad, and Sydney in addition to Augeo's offices across the country. **Location** Rochester, NY. Candidates must currently live in Rochester, NY, or be willing to relocate to Rochester, NY at their own expense before their start date. **Work Authorization** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and throughout employment without employer immigration sponsorship. jobs.title: Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Backblaze** Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customersuccess with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands. Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud \- managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K\+ customers in 175\+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals. ### **Role Overview** The Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Engineer designs, implements, and operates identity and access capabilities for human users, non\-human identities, workloads, devices, services, and AI agents. The role focuses on the subject side of access control—identity, authentication, roles, groups, entitlements, and privileges—with an emphasis on least privilege, separation of duties, strong authentication, automated lifecycle management, and short\-lived credentials. The engineer partners with others across the organization to ensure applications, infrastructure, and services appropriately mediate access, separate security domains, minimize unnecessary sharing, and limit common mechanisms that could increase privilege or blast radius. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design and operate authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, RBAC/ABAC, PAM, conditional access, policy\-based authorization, just\-in\-time access, continuous verification, and privileged\-access capabilities. * Engineer roles, groups, entitlements, and privilege assignments around least privilege and separation of duties. * Automate identity provisioning, access reviews, privilege changes, revocation, and deprovisioning. * Implement phishing\-resistant MFA, cryptographically bound authentication, and strong identity assurance across enrollment, authentication, federation, and recovery. * Govern service accounts, machine and device identities, workloads, automated processes, APIs, and AI\-agent identities. * Implement short\-lived workload and agent identities using federation, certificates, and modern workload\-identity approaches while reducing reliance on persistent secrets. * Partner with architects, engineers, and resource owners to ensure access is efficiently mediated and designs minimize excessive privilege, unnecessary sharing, and cross\-domain exposure. * Monitor identity posture and partner with Security Operations to investigate identity threats and rapidly revoke compromised access. ### **Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience engineering enterprise IAM systems and integrations. * Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, federation, identity lifecycle management, role/group design, separation of duties, and least privilege. * Knowledge of phishing\-resistant MFA, cryptographic authentication, identity proofing, federation, and modern identity assurance practices. * Experience managing human and non\-human identities, including service, machine, workload, or device identities. * Experience automating identity processes using APIs, scripting, or Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * Understanding of PKI, secrets management, short\-lived credentials, workload identity federation, and technologies such as OIDC, OAuth, and SPIFFE/SPIRE. * Ability to reason about identity and authorization across distributed systems and collaborate with architects and engineers on secure access design. ### **Backblaze Perks:** * Healthcare for family, including dental and vision * Competitive compensation and 401K * RSU grants for full\-time employees * ESPP program * Flexible vacation policy * Maternity \& paternity leave * MacBook Pro to use for work plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation * Childcare bonus (human children only) * Fertility treatment and support * Learning \& development program * Commuter benefits * Culture that supports a healthy work\-life balance To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar\-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base pay range for this position is $155,000 \- $195,000 At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio\-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries, but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. **We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.** To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Backblaze Employee Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy\-grow\-and\-hold\-for\-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. **About the role** ================== **Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI** Medicat builds MedicatOne, the EHR used by college health and counseling centers across the US. Banyan Software acquires and grows vertical software companies like ours, and we're investing in AI that reaches clinicians and students in production. This is an engineering role first. You will write production code most days: LLM integrations, automations, data workflows and the APIs that connect them to MedicatOne. You'll also sit close to our clinic customers and internal teams, turning what you see in their workflows into working software, often in days, not quarters. If you're happiest owning a roadmap and writing specs for others to build, this isn't the role. If you want to be the person who ships the feature, debugs it with the customer on the call, and hardens it for HIPAA, keep reading. **What you'll do** ================== Expect roughly 70% hands\-on engineering and 30% embedded with customers and internal teams. * **Build and ship AI features end to end.** Design, code, test and deploy LLM\-powered features in MedicatOne: prompt design, tool calling, retrieval where it earns its place, and evaluation harnesses. * **Pick the simplest reliable solution.** Sometimes that's an LLM, often it's plain code. * **Integrate with real clinical data.** Write the services, SQL and data pipelines that move PHI safely between MedicatOne, customer systems and model providers. * **Deploy alongside customers.** Join clinic implementation and discovery calls as the technical lead, scope what can be built, prototype against their data, and stay through go\-live. * **Embed with internal teams.** Find and automate repetitive work, and help analysts and developers get the most out of AI tools. * **Own production quality.** Instrument, monitor and debug what you ship: latency, cost, accuracy and failure modes. Write evals so regressions are caught before customers see them. * **Make AI safe for healthcare.** Implement HIPAA\-compliant patterns for PHI handling, logging, access control, de\-identification and vendor data boundaries. * **Harden internal tools.** Review and productionize AI tools built by non\-engineering teams before they touch customer data. * **Feed the roadmap with evidence.** Bring back what you learned in the field as working prototypes and technical recommendations, not slide decks. **What you bring** ================== * **3\+ years as a software engineer** shipping production code in B2B SaaS, with an individual\-contributor track record. You still write code every week. * **Strong in at least one backend language** (Python, C\#/.NET or TypeScript/Node) and comfortable reading the others. * **Hands\-on LLM API experience**: you've shipped production features on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI), including prompt design and function/tool calling, and you know when not to use one. * **End\-to\-end system design**: you've designed a production system from the ground up, including data flow, security and multi\-tenancy. * **Solid data skills**: production SQL, schema design and data pipelines against relational databases. * **API and integration experience**: REST API design, authentication, webhooks and third\-party integrations. * **Production engineering habits**: Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and deploying to a major cloud (Azure or AWS). * **Regulated or sensitive data experience**: you've built software that handles PHI, PII, financial or similarly protected data, with the access controls and audit trails it requires. * **Comfort with customers and colleagues**: you can explain a technical trade\-off to a clinic director or an analyst, then go build it. * Authorized to work in and resides in the US; we can't sponsor visas. **Nice to have** ================ * RAG, embeddings and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone or similar), plus the judgment to know when retrieval is worth the complexity * HL7 v2, FHIR or EHR integration experience (we can teach this) * HIPAA experience specifically * Prior Forward Deployed, Solutions Engineering or implementation\-engineering experience at a software company * LLM evaluation and observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, custom eval suites) * Agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * College health, student health or behavioral health software * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio of shipped AI projects Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance. **Please Note**: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed. ***Recruitment Notice*** Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation. ***Beware of Recruitment Scams*** We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. **Protect yourself by following these steps:** * Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address. * Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process. * If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

jobs.title: Fullstack React Native Developer

Today, TuneCore is the leading independent development partner for self\-releasing artists to build audiences and careers, with technology and services across distribution, publishing administration and a range of promotional services. Join TuneCore as we embark on the next phase of innovation in the music industry. What You’ll Do * Design, build, and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native for iOS and Android from a single codebase * Build and maintain the Rails API endpoints that power the mobile app — request/response contracts, background jobs, and data models the client depends on * Work closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate designs and wireframes into high\-quality, reusable code across the full stack * Integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party SDKs; optimize app performance, responsiveness, and stability * Write unit and integration tests, and help shape our mobile testing strategy as we build out React Native end\-to\-end coverage * Debug and resolve platform\-specific issues, including native modules and bridging * Manage app store submissions and release processes for both the App Store and Google Play * Stay current with the React Native ecosystem and mobile best practices, and bring relevant updates back to the team * Uphold TuneCore’s core mission, vision, and values in the code you ship and the decisions you make Leadership Expectations * Provide technical leadership on mobile architecture decisions, balancing durability and scalability against delivery speed * Set and evolve coding standards and best practices for the mobile codebase * Give effective, constructive code review feedback to other engineers * Mentor and guide engineers on the team in both technical growth and career development * Research and recommend new tools and technologies where they’d meaningfully improve the team’s output **Qualifications*** Skills and Attributes * 6\+ years of experience writing production code, including 3\+ years building and shipping mobile applications * Strong proficiency in React / React Native, and in JavaScript/TypeScript * Demonstrated fluency with Ruby on Rails in production — building and maintaining API\-only Rails services, not just “a web framework of some kind” * Familiarity with state management approaches (we currently use React Query and Context API) * Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and mobile release workflows * Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and platform guidelines (Apple HIG, Material Design) * Experience with REST APIs and async data handling; GraphQL a plus * Experience with native iOS (Swift/Objective\-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) a plus, but not required * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience **Additional Information** **Salary Transparency** **TuneCore is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary range for this position is $120,000\-$135,000\. The final salary offer will be determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, specialized skills, internal equity, and specific work location. This range represents our good faith estimate at the time of posting.** Wher ate and offer more innovative solutions and better serve our artists, labels, partners, and employees. We strive to build a company that reflects the communities we serve and embraces the diversity of the world we live in, where each person’s unique perspective is valued, and where everyone has the same opportunities and is supported in their personal and professional growth. From our hiring practices to the culture we create and nurture, we are committed to listening, learning and evolving. Our goal is to make TuneCore an inspirational place that feels comfortable and familiar no matter how you look, where you call home, who you love, what you believe, or what’s on your playlist. CSR Strategy: Shaping Music for Good Our core values are put into action through Shaping Music for Good, Believe and TuneCore’s global corporate social responsibility strategy, integrated at all levels of the company and at the heart of our business model. We strive to shape the music industry for good by building trusting relationships with artists and partners, investing in the growth and talent development of our local markets, and empowering our community to positively impact society. We work to achieve progress on our core priorities: gender equity, diversity, equity \& inclusion, environmental sustainability, and wellness for our employees, artists, and industry partners. Shapers Program Employees have the opportunity to join the Shapers Program, a resource group made up of teammates who want to dedicate their time and skills to Shaping Music For Good initiatives. Shapers develop action plans, educate teammates, support the implementation of programs, and inspire action within the organization on causes and issues that align with TuneCore and Believe’s SMFG priorities. Inclusion in the Music Business Report In 2025, Believe and TuneCore partnered with the Annenberg Inclusion Initiative, the world’s leading think tank studying diversity and inclusion in the entertainment industry, to produce the second Inclusion in the Music Business report which analyzes the gender, race, and ethnicity among executive leadership in the music industry. Recognition and Awards: * Fast Company's 10 Most Innovative Companies in Music list (2023\-2025\) * Crain's Best Places to Work in NYC (2022\-2024\) Benefits \& Perks: At TuneCore we’re committed to the well\-being of our employees and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to: * Paid Time Off including vacation, holidays, paid bereavement, unlimited paid sick days, and company\-wide week off between Christmas and New Years—every employee needs time to take care of themselves and their family. * “Wellness Fridays” year\-round (close at 1pm on Fridays) * Universal Paid Parental Leave for both parents \- because we know your newest family member(s) deserve your undivided attention. * Comprehensive health, vision, dental, FSA and dependent care from day 1 of employment \- your health comes first. * 401k match \- an investment in your future. * Company wide events, outings and volunteer days – we have team spirit and know how to have fun! * Hybrid Work \- employees have the option to work primarily remotely and work from the office 8 days per month on a flexible schedule organized at the department level, in accordance with Company policies. * Learning and development opportunities and career development training – we believe in promoting and growing our leadership from within the company and proactively invest in our people. * Free distribution subscription for employees – so you can experience the magic of releasing music worldwide (and give us valuable feedback!). jobs.title: Senior Backend & DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **The role, at a glance:** The Senior Backend Engineer is a 3\-month contract position that develops cloud services, APIs, and infrastructure for Biamp’s audiovisual conferencing solutions used worldwide. This role centers on identity and access control, including the permission model, APIs, and workflows that determine what users can do across the platform. The initial priority is to use SpiceDB to replace fixed, organization\-wide roles with permission sets, groups, and grants that reflect customers’ organizational structures. **How you'll contribute:** * Design, build, and maintain backend microservices and APIs (REST, GraphQL, and gRPC), primarily in Go * Design and implement fine\-grained authorization (role\-, resource\-, and relationship\-based) using SpiceDB * Plan and carry out zero\-downtime, verifiably equivalent migrations of existing customer access to the new permission model * Build event\-driven services using messaging systems such as NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ * Design and maintain SQL database schemas, queries, and data migrations * Troubleshoot and improve the reliability, security, and performance of production services * Work with the Web, Embedded Software, Product Verification (QA), and Product Management teams to deliver features and resolve issues * Participate in code reviews and document designs and processes in Confluence * Other duties as assigned by Supervisor **A successful candidate should have:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * Hands\-on experience with AI agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code) as a core part of daily development, including directing agents through multi\-step tasks, reviewing and validating AI\-generated code, and building reusable skills and tool integrations (MCP) * 6\+ years of commercial software development, including backend services and cloud infrastructure * Proficiency in Go (Golang) and experience building microservices * Experience designing and building APIs, with GraphQL preferred. Exposure to REST or gRPC is also valuable * Experience with SpiceDB, OpenFGA, or other Zanzibar\-style permission systems * Experience designing relationship\-based, hierarchical authorization models (ReBAC), including inherited and delegated access * Experience with SQL and relational databases * Experience working in Linux environments, including administration and shell scripting * Experience with agile development practices * Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work independently and in a team **Some nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker * Experience with Zitadel, Auth0, or similar OIDC providers * Experience with SCIM provisioning and SSO identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) * Experience with message systems such as NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ * Experience with Terraform for building and managing infrastructure * CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Bitbucket * Experience with Microsoft Azure **Tools \& Collaboration** Bitbucket, Jenkins, Docker, Azure Kubernetes Services, Terraform, Jira, and Confluence. **Work Environment:** This is a 3\-month, on\-site contract position. Biamp does not have a remote or hybrid work policy for this role. **Who is Biamp?** We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. observability for all internal and vendor\-built applications. * Guide Azure solution design, review code and pull requests, and hold vendor deliverables to the same standards. * Establish guardrails
