jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: New York Engineering In office Full\-time **What is Bilt?** Bilt is the membership for where you live. What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants. Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once. We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens. This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here. **What’s the role?** As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work on high\-impact projects that directly shape how our members interact with Bilt's most exciting initiatives. From powering our hit game show "Rent Free" to developing exclusive member experiences and Rent Day benefits, you'll be at the forefront of creating memorable digital touch\-points that make renting more rewarding. **In this role you will:** * Own projects end\-to\-end—from technical scoping and architecture through deployment and production support * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decision\-making * Work across the stack as needed, adapting to the demands of different projects and problems * Architect and build scalable web applications and services that serve millions of Bilt members * Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js frameworks (NestJS, Hono, Express) * Build performant frontend experiences using Next.js, React, and React Native * Collaborate with design teams to use our design system across web and mobile platforms * Work with relational databases (PostgreSQL) to design schemas, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity * Implement and maintain observability practices including structured logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring **In terms of qualifications, we’re seeking:** * 6\+ years of professional software development experience * Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript * Hands\-on experience with Node.js backend development using frameworks like NestJS, Express, or Hono * Experience with Next.js and/or React Native for building production applications * Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), including data modeling and query optimization * Familiarity with state management patterns and libraries (Redux or similar) * Experience working with design systems and component libraries * Understanding of observability fundamentals: logging, tracing, metrics, and alerting * Experience designing systems that scale—caching strategies, async processing, API design * Proficiency with Git and modern CI/CD workflows * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and web services * Excellent communication and collaboration abilities **You'll thrive here if you:** * Are excited about working across the full stack and don't box yourself into "frontend" or "backend" * Take ownership and see things through—you don't throw problems over the wall * Communicate clearly and collaborate well; you're a team player who doesn't deflect or finger\-point * Are comfortable with ambiguity and can drive projects forward with minimal hand\-holding * Care about code quality, testing, and building things that last * Embrace an AI\-augmented development workflow—you actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and/or Devin as part of how you build, debug, and ship software **Benefits:** * **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program * **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one. * **401k plan with a match** \- Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there. * **Commuter FSAs** \- We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive. * **UNLIMITED PTO** \- Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it. * **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points** \- We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt. At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations. We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process. Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time. The salary range for a **Senior Full Stack Engineer** is **$175,000\-$250,000** and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus. Req ID: R333

jobs.title: Customer Data Engineer - Pre-Sales
jobs.description: At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start\-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions. We are adding a new role to our Sales organization to support our customer growth and focus on data and product expansion. The Bluesight Customer Data Engineer owns data integration with our customers, ensuring they get value from Bluesight's platform quickly and seamlessly. You'll work directly with hospital customers to understand their data environments, guide them through Bluesight's requirements, and lead the technical work of getting the hospital customer into the platform. You'll also contribute to the internal tooling that makes the next implementation faster and to the product work that accelerates time\-to\-value. You'll spend roughly half your time in conversations with customers, maintaining/creating documentation and configuring the system. **The Customer Pre\-Sales Data Engineer is a customer advocate who connects the dots between the technical solution and the outcomes for the customer and Bluesight.** ### **Key and Representative Duties:** * Pre\-Sales Data Scope Development: Partner directly with the Sales teams during late\-stage sales cycles to evaluate prospective clients' data, sources, and identify potential integration hurdles, and define technical requirements and specifications * Data Discovery \& Collection: Lead technical workshops with hospital IT departments to map their data structures to our SaaS platform’s requirements. Drive the timeline and execution of data extracts, ensuring all required information is gathered accurately prior to implementation. * Technical Consultation: Serve as the trusted data advisor to healthcare clients, explaining complex integration requirements, data formatting, and security protocols in a clear, consultative manner. * Implementation Handoff: Translate client data models into actionable integration blueprints. Facilitate a seamless handover of data assets, mapping documentation, and integration requirements to the Implementation teams for go\-live. Contribute to internal documentation, playbooks, and tooling that improve the efficiency and consistency of future implementations. * Process Optimization: Develop and refine standardized data collection templates, scripts, and pre\-sales documentation to accelerate the onboarding timeline for new hospital clients. Partner with Bluesight's data engineering team to productize implementation and transformation logic. * Security \& Compliance: Ensure all data scoping and collection processes strictly adhere to HIPAA regulations, SOC2 standards, and best practices for handling Protected Health Information (PHI). ### **Skills and Qualifications Required:** * 4\+ years in a technical pre\-sales, sales engineering, or technical implementation role within a B2B SaaS environment, preferably in the health tech space. * Ability to lead customer\-facing technical engagements — managing expectations, communicating data requirements clearly, and driving deliveries to completion. * Ability to translate highly technical data requirements to non\-technical clinical leaders while holding your own in deep technical discussions with hospital database administrators. * SQL skills and demonstrated ability to analyze complex and sensitive datasets. * Direct experience working with major Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems such as Epic, Cerner, or Meditech. * Experience with cloud data infrastructure * A track record of building internal tools, leveraging AI\-assisted development tooling or automating manual work to improve process efficiency. * Comfort with ambiguity — customer data environments are varied and there won't always be a direct playbook. * Proactive and self\-directed — you see what needs doing and drive it to completion without close supervision. * Strong working knowledge of HIPAA compliance and secure data transfer protocols (SFTP, API security) for handling PHI. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with standard healthcare data interoperability frameworks and messaging protocols, specifically HL7 (v2 and v3\) and FHIR. * Familiarity with cloud data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery). In addition to the base salary, this role includes eligibility for incentive commission based on results. The actual wage offered depends on the candidate's experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications and geographic location. Bluesight offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to employees.**This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.** **Why Bluesight?** Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape! * Competitive salary * Time off when you need it – unlimited vacation days! * Generous insurance coverage * 401k program with a company match * Fun, collaborative culture! EOE AA M/F/VET/Disability All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description: Today we are a large health insurance agency selling coverage nationwide. We have grown through multiple market shifts, from Medicare Advantage to ACA plans, and built a team with many people who have been here for years. That's not an accident, and it's the thing we're most quietly proud of. We're not here to save the world. Health insurance is a complicated, often frustrating product to sell and service, and we don't pretend otherwise. We care about building something worth showing up to: a company where the work is real, people are treated well, and the clients we serve actually get helped. We also run a direct\-to\-consumer subscription e\-commerce business in a regulated category. Both businesses have outgrown off\-the\-shelf tools. As our first full\-time engineer, you'll work directly with the founder to build platforms that replace them and turn them into SaaS products we sell to other businesses. ### ### **What you will build** * A subscription commerce platform: product catalog, recurring billing with retries and dunning, order routing to fulfillment partners, shipment tracking, a customer self\-service portal, and the admin screens our team works in every day. * A multi\-tenant commission dashboard for insurance agencies, sold as a product: carrier commission statements in, clean numbers out for each agency, agent, and downline, covering revenue, chargebacks, persistency, payouts, and forecasts. * An AI sales assistant that works leads over SMS and turns them into customers: it qualifies, answers questions, handles objections, sends checkout links, and hands off to a human when needed. It plugs into both platforms and is also sold on its own. An early version exists; you will finish it or rebuild it. * The shared foundation under all three: auth and roles, tenant isolation, background jobs, webhooks, audit logs, and a design system. ### **What you bring** * 7\+ years building production web products, with at least 3 years of senior work before 2023\. * SaaS or e\-commerce products you built and shipped: checkout, subscriptions and recurring billing, orders and fulfillment, customer accounts. * Deep TypeScript, React, and Next.js; Postgres data modeling; typed APIs (tRPC or similar) with schema validation. * Multi\-tenant B2B SaaS: organizations, roles, data isolation enforced on the server, and subscription billing for your own customers. * Back\-end workflow experience: state machines, job queues, retries, webhooks that are safe to receive twice. * LLM features in production: prompt and tool design, testing conversations before they ship, guardrails, and keeping model costs under control. * Messaging and CRM integrations: SMS providers, CRMs such as GoHighLevel or HubSpot, and consent and opt\-out rules (TCPA, 10DLC). * Real third\-party integrations shipped, including messy data such as CSV or PDF files from partners. * Money and reporting you trust: you reconcile totals against the source system before you show a number. * A high bar for UI and UX. You design and build polished, original interfaces yourself: clear hierarchy, considered typography and spacing, every state handled (loading, empty, error), accessible, and fast. You can tell generic AI\-generated UI (default gradients, cards on everything, template layouts) from real design, and you do not ship it. Show us a portfolio of interfaces you designed. * Creative problem solving. When the obvious path is blocked (no API, messy data, a partner that won't cooperate, a budget that doesn't fit), you find a clever, practical way through instead of waiting for perfect conditions. * Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). You plan before you prompt, split work across agents by module, keep specs and handoff notes current, review every diff, and verify the running product before you call anything done. * Comfort with regulated data. HIPAA, PCI, or insurance\-industry experience is a strong plus. ### **How we work** * Small team, direct line to the founder, fast decisions. * You own architecture, and you ship to production weekly. * We judge work by the running product, not by tickets closed. * Design is part of engineering. Our products are used by customers and sold to other businesses, so every screen has to look intentional and trustworthy, never like an AI template. ### **First 90 days** * Weeks 1 to 2: learn the existing systems, set up the codebase, CI, and the AI workflow (codebase map, handoff notes, acceptance checklists). * Weeks 3 to 6: commission dashboard MVP live for our own agency, multi\-tenant from day one. * Weeks 6 to 9: AI sales assistant finished and working our own leads, with every conversation logged and reviewable. * Weeks 9 to 12: the subscription commerce platform running in shadow mode next to the current vendor, with the first product line cut over.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Join us at **BOXABL**, the most exciting tech start\-up on the planet, located in fabulous **LAS VEGAS**, Nevada. At **BOXABL**, we value hard\-working and dedicated individuals who thrive in fast\-paced, ever\-changing environments. If you're only interested in work\-life balance, please don't apply. However, if you want to live a life with real purpose, work alongside a wildly talented group of professionals to make a real difference, join us as we work to solve the national housing crisis. Behind every home is data: HubSpot and NetSuite, Tulip on the factory floor, Stripe payments, and a growing team of AI agents. Microsoft Azure is our primary cloud, and we're bringing it all together there. ### **Job Summary** As our **AI Engineer**, you'll own the BOXABL data platform on **Azure**: the one place where all company data lands, stays in sync and is safe to use. It powers Power BI, our Sales Intelligence app, and the AI tools our team uses every day, including GrokBot agents, Claude, OpenAI and Microsoft Copilot. You'll keep it running, connect new systems to it, and make sure AI only touches the data it should. If you want to put AI to work on a real factory, real customers and real homes, this is your seat. ### **Job Duties and Responsibilities** **Run the Azure data platform** * Own uptime, monitoring and alerting (Azure Monitor), backups, incident response and monthly Azure cost. **Own the integrations** * Build and maintain data feeds from HubSpot, NetSuite, Tulip, OpenBOM / Oracle PLM, Stripe, Aircall, GA4 and PostHog. * Keep HubSpot and NetSuite in sync: customers, orders and deposits reconcile every day. * Fix data written by AI or voice agents before it pollutes HubSpot. **Deliver trusted data** * Model the core datasets: sales funnel, deposits, sales orders and post\-sale delivery. * Administer Power BI workspaces, datasets and data sources. **Put AI on the data, safely** * Connect GrokBot agents, Claude, OpenAI and Microsoft Copilot to approved platform data instead of manual exports. * Build retrieval and agent workflows with business teams; keep the AI Agent Register current. * Monitor what agents read and write, especially outreach bots working in Microsoft 365 and HubSpot. **Secure it** * Manage access through Entra ID (Azure AD) SSO, role\-based access and least privilege. * Support SOC 2: access reviews, audit logs, change management and documented runbooks. * Enforce Boxabl's AI acceptable use policy: no company or customer data in unapproved tools. ### **Experience and Education** **Required** * 4\+ years in data or platform engineering, 2\+ running production workloads on Azure. * Strong SQL and Python. * Built and maintained API integrations with HubSpot, NetSuite or similar CRM / ERP systems. * Shipped at least one production app on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude or similar). * Entra ID, role\-based access and secrets management on Azure. * CI/CD with GitHub; In this role, you will collaborate with design teams to develop exhaustive verification plans, construct reusable testbenches, and continuously scale verification coverage to ensure first\-pass silicon success. **Key Responsibilities** * **Testbench Design \& Implementation:** Architect and develop robust, scalable, and reusable verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM. Create modular components including reference models, checkers, monitors, scoreboards, and targeted firmware code. * **Verification Strategy \& Execution:** Author detailed verification plans by analyzing architectural specs. Develop, execute, and debug directed and constrained\-random test cases to validate complex ASIC IP blocks. * **Coverage Closure \& Quality Assurance:** Track, analyze, and maximize functional and code coverage metrics. Write SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to implement assertion\-based verification and trap corner\-case design bugs. * **Database \& Regression Management:** Establish, maintain, and optimize operation processes for design database management and official database releases. Oversee automated daily/weekly regression runs, triage failures, and manage performance tracking. **Minimum Qualifications** * **Bachelor’s Degree** in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant ASIC verification experience. * *OR* **Master’s Degree** in a related field with a minimum of 6 years of relevant ASIC verification experience. **Preferred Skillsets \& Technical Knowledge** * **Languages:** Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog, Verilog coding, and SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA). * **Methodologies:** Hands\-on experience building testbenches from scratch using the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM). * **Flows:** Deep understanding of the front\-to\-back ASIC design and verification lifecycle (pre\-silicon simulation, debugging, and coverage closure). * **Architecture \& Subsystems:** Familiarity with ARM processor architectures and AMBA subsystem protocols (e.g., AXI, AHB, APB). * **Algorithms:** Exposure to Digital Signal Processing (DSP) algorithms and translating them into hardware verification reference models. **Software \& Scripting:** Strong programming skills in C/C\+\+ and scripting expertise in Python, Perl, or Tcl for environment automation and regression sorting. **Compensation and Benefits** The annual base salary range for this position is USD 109,700\.00 To USD 175,500\.00 As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage legal technology team building AI\-powered software for legal workflows. As a Founding Product Engineer, you will work closely with attorneys and AI engineers to develop core product capabilities and help establish engineering practices as the team grows. ### **What You'll Do** * Build and own full\-stack product features, from data models to interfaces used by attorneys and clients. * Translate legal workflows and review playbooks into reliable, production\-grade software with domain experts and AI engineers. * Make pragmatic architecture and tooling decisions that support rapid development and future needs. * Write maintainable code, improve reliability, and take responsibility for features in production. * Help shape engineering standards, culture, and hiring as the team expands. ### **What We're Looking For** * Three to four years of professional engineering experience, including experience building and shipping production software at an early\-stage company or as a founder. * Full\-stack skills, including TypeScript and React, a modern backend stack, and relational databases. * Hands\-on experience building with AI or large language models, professionally or through personal projects. * Experience owning features from conception through deployment, making sound engineering trade\-offs, and building reliable systems for complex workflows. * A completed computer science degree, strong product instincts, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-moving environment with ambiguity and minimal process. * Experience with legal technology, contract management, document processing, or working directly with domain experts is helpful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $140,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, six days per week. Relocation is not employer\-funded.

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage SaaS team building AI tools for industrial ingredient manufacturers. You will work closely with the founding team, owning products end to end, from customer discovery to shipped software across backend systems, AI agents, frontend, and infrastructure. ### **What You'll Do** * Speak with manufacturers to understand their workflows and translate customer needs into product improvements. * Build backend systems that ingest and process documents from customer ERPs and inboxes. * Develop AI agents that help complete complex food safety and compliance documents. * Own features across the full stack, from defining problems and building user interfaces to shipping and iterating based on feedback. * Move quickly, make pragmatic technical decisions, and take on emerging product and engineering needs. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 4 years of professional experience, including substantial hands\-on software engineering and production coding. * Experience as a product manager who transitioned into engineering, or as a sole or first product engineer with end\-to\-end ownership of product discovery, development, launch, and iteration. * A record of shipping products or major features used by real customers, with the ability to explain technical and product tradeoffs. * Strong full\-stack skills, including backend services, frontend development, and relational database design such as PostgreSQL. * Experience with Kotlin and Spring Boot or another JVM backend, plus React and Next.js, is relevant. * Production experience with AI or LLM products, agents, search, RAG, document processing, or unstructured data extraction is a plus. * Experience with GCP or another major cloud platform is helpful. Familiarity with food manufacturing, supply chains, or other traditional industrial sectors is also a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $180,000 to $250,000 annually, plus 0\.5% to 1\.5% equity. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early engineering team building software for property operations. You will shape the data model, workflows, and AI capabilities that help teams manage leasing, maintenance, payments, and accounting. ### **What You'll Do** * Build the data model and workflows for a property management operating system. * Develop AI systems that use property context to complete work, identify missing information, and escalate issues to people when needed. * Make practical engineering decisions in high\-stakes areas, including payments, financial records, and resident communications. * Ship software to users, learn from its limitations, and improve it based on feedback. ### **What We're Looking For** * Senior\-level, broad\-based software engineering experience spanning deployment, development, operations, and user adoption. * Experience at a startup or hypergrowth startup, with a track record of taking projects from problem definition through launch and iteration. * Experience building and shipping production software end to end, in a backend or full\-stack capacity. * Familiarity with TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Experience with AI or LLM systems, payments, accounting, or property management software is relevant. * Ability to take ownership, learn quickly, and work effectively amid ambiguity. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $150,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, United States. Candidates must be based in the Bay Area or willing to relocate.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Design Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a growing team building AI infrastructure for creating and evaluating reinforcement learning environments. You will design and build product experiences that help users understand agent behavior, improve training data, and make informed decisions. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and build interfaces across the platform and marketplace, from early concepts through release. * Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback clear and actionable. * Work with research and engineering to turn complex reinforcement learning and evaluation workflows into useful tools. * Talk with users, observe challenges, and improve the product based on feedback. * Develop reusable interaction patterns and maintain strong usability, visual quality, and implementation standards. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience as a design engineer, product designer, or in a similar role shipping product interfaces, with a primarily full\-stack engineering background. * Front\-end engineering skills and experience turning design work into working product interfaces. * A portfolio demonstrating shipped design\-engineering work and visual design quality. * Experience shipping products, learning from users, and iterating based on feedback. * Technical education or background, clear communication, and experience working closely with engineers and researchers. * Developer tools, data\-rich products, research software, AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, training data, or early\-stage company experience are useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, with remote arrangements also available.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build the product interfaces, backend services, and internal tools that support an AI reinforcement learning data platform. You will work with research, operations, and external partners to turn complex needs into useful tools for creating, evaluating, and improving training data. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior. * Build partner workflows for creating, submitting, testing, and iterating on reinforcement learning environments and training data. * Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health. * Design backend services and APIs that connect task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality review, and training systems. * Collaborate across research, operations, and go\-to\-market teams to ship and improve products. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of full\-stack software engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with a technical field of study or equivalent technical foundation. * Proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js. * Hands\-on experience with AI, machine learning, or reinforcement learning, and experience owning products end\-to\-end from design through deployment. * Experience building backend services, APIs, and databases, along with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging. * Experience creating dashboards, monitoring or observability interfaces, and tools for data inspection, review, or quality assessment. * Experience with data collection, annotation, or evaluation platforms, or with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or Grafana, is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for eligible full\-time candidates moving to the United States or Singapore. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Remote candidates may be considered if they can maintain 70% to 80% time zone overlap with San Francisco or Singapore.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** We're an early\-stage open\-source MLOps infrastructure startup building the orchestration layer for ML pipelines and AI agent workflows. We're looking for a **GTM Engineer** to own our entire US presence and community from the ground up — a one\-person outpost role based in San Francisco, reporting directly to the founding team. This isn't a traditional marketing or sales role. You'll be the connector, the voice, and the person who turns conversations into traceable pipeline. The mission: make this company a known name in the SF AI\-infra scene through events, community, and authentic technical evangelism. ### **What You'll Do** * Own and run the SF developer community from zero — including hosting a bi\-weekly meetup series that becomes the go\-to event for the ML\-infra crowd. * Work the AI\-infra meetups, hackathons, and conferences that matter; build a visible personal brand and network across the Valley. * Be the connector — the person who knows everyone, introduces them to each other, and turns relationships into community momentum. * Evangelize credibly through talks, blog posts, social content, and short demo videos rooted in real community insights. * Demo the product live in front of technical audiences, answer real questions, and hold your own with ML engineers. * Instrument community and product signals (Mixpanel, GitHub, CRM, enrichment tools) into an automated flow — enrichment, scoring, follow\-up — so every conversation becomes a traceable pipeline rather than a forgotten business card. * Serve as the eyes and ears in the Valley: what people are building, what frustrates them, who's evaluating what — and feed that intelligence directly back into product and GTM strategy. ### **What We're Looking For** **Must\-haves:** * 1–3\+ years in DevRel, community building, growth, or developer\-facing GTM roles, with a demonstrated track record of hosting events and converting attendee engagement into measurable business outcomes. * Ability to demo and explain Python frameworks live to technical audiences, read and understand code, work with APIs, and communicate technical concepts to ML engineers (you don't need to be an engineer yourself). * Experience building and scaling developer communities or running technical events from zero, with a track record of growing attendance and engagement. * Proficiency with modern GTM stack tools: CRM platforms, data enrichment tools (Clay or similar), API integrations, and basic automation workflows. * Experience instrumenting and measuring community/event initiatives using product analytics (Mixpanel or similar), GitHub signals, and CRM data to track pipeline and ROI. * Demonstrated ability to create and distribute technical content (blog posts, demo videos, social media) that resonates with developer audiences. * Proven ability to convert manual, one\-off community activities into repeatable, scalable, measurable systems. * Comfortable operating in a self\-directed, early\-stage environment with minimal hand\-holding. * Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate — **this role is on\-site and does not work remotely.** **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Existing professional network within the SF AI, ML infrastructure, or MLOps community. * Prior experience building or contributing to open\-source communities and familiarity with GitHub\-native developer behaviors. * Familiarity with the MLOps, LLMOps, or AI agent infrastructure landscape. * Experience running product\-led growth (PLG) or usage\-based GTM motions. * Visible personal brand: public speaking, conference talks, or recognizable community presence. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Salary:** $120,000 – $250,000 USD annually, depending on experience. * Direct access to founders and outsized early\-stage impact. * Visa sponsorship is **not available** for this role. ### **Location** This is a **fully on\-site role in San Francisco, CA**. Presence in the local AI/ML community is central to the job — remote work is not an option for this position.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a small engineering team building AI systems for hospitality workflows. You will own full\-stack components that help resolve guest requests end to end, from understanding intent and retrieving relevant information to coordinating tools and generating responses. ### **What You'll Do** * Design response\-generation pipelines, including intent routing, orchestration, context assembly, tool selection, and escalation decisions. * Build retrieval systems that ground responses in accurate, complete, and up\-to\-date customer information. * Develop reliable multi\-step tool workflows that handle third\-party API failures gracefully. * Create evaluation frameworks using real conversations to measure quality and catch regressions. * Implement observability and tracing that make complex agent behavior understandable to support teams. * Build interfaces and controls that let non\-technical teams adjust agent behavior. * Extend the platform to voice with real\-time transcription and tool use. * Improve speed and cost through model routing, caching, and prompt refinement, while contributing to infrastructure, data pipelines, integrations, and APIs. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production systems used by real people; 5 or more years is a plus. * Hands\-on experience designing and debugging production AI or machine learning systems, including retrieval pipelines, prompt engineering, or model orchestration. * Experience building and evaluating knowledge retrieval systems, such as semantic search, ranking, or context validation. * Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Rust, or Java, and the ability to work across the stack. * Experience with multi\-step workflows or function calling, third\-party integrations, production failure handling, observability, and system evaluation. * Product engineering ownership, ideally in a startup or as a product\-focused founder, with a record of shipping production products. * Experience with real\-time or low\-latency systems, voice or audio processing, user\-facing configuration tools, or model cost and latency optimization is useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $220,000 annually, plus 0\.20% to 1\.20% equity. Benefits include health insurance and a 401(k) match. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Agents
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a small, senior team building autonomous AI agents that handle real executive workflows. You will develop agent capabilities and the evaluation systems needed to verify reliability before changes reach users. ### **What You'll Do** * Build agents that complete delegated work end to end without requiring users to check every step. * Design reliable measures of agent success and maintain representative evaluations for real\-world tasks. * Develop new agent capabilities for tools executives already use, and verify their readiness before launch. * Investigate production failures, identify root causes, and deliver fixes that prevent recurrence. * Build scalable failure detection for known issues and unexpected patterns using evaluation and monitoring tools. * Improve agent recovery when a tool or website fails. * Create repeatable workflows so engineers can measure whether agent changes improve performance. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years in data science or machine learning roles building or delivering evaluation systems, metrics, or product quality measurement. * Production\-level Python and SQL skills for analysis, large datasets, and automated pipelines. * Experience designing evaluation frameworks, including success criteria, representative datasets, appropriate metrics, and trustworthy benchmarks. * Experience using statistics, experiment design, and realistic end\-to\-end simulations to evaluate agent changes. * Background building or operating agents for real users and improving their reliability; experience with post\-training, fine\-tuning, or reinforcement learning is valuable. * Experience owning and shipping systems to users, with demonstrated impact; familiarity with Django, React, and TypeScript. * A track record of sustained contribution and growth in a role, founding a startup, or earning a promotion. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in Palo Alto, California, with four days per week in the office.

jobs.title: Mid-Level AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a product engineering team building agentic systems that automate complex workflows across regulated and enterprise domains. You will ship production LLM services across the stack, with a focus on reliability, safety, and useful outcomes for customers. ### **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain agentic systems for multi\-step workflows across areas such as healthcare, legal, fintech, logistics, and compliance. * Own production RAG pipelines and retrieval infrastructure, including vector databases, embeddings, and indexing. * Implement multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-calling, memory, and reasoning features. * Build evaluation and safety infrastructure to track model performance, identify regressions, and support reliable enterprise use. * Develop full\-stack AI products, including APIs, data models, frontend and backend features, and production operations. * Use CI/CD, testing, monitoring, user feedback, and product telemetry to improve deployed systems. * Work with product and design partners to prioritize work and define success measures. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to eight years of software engineering experience delivering shipped user\-facing or backend products, including substantive AI engineering experience in a product\-focused setting. * Production experience deploying LLM\-based services, including prompt design, orchestration, and tool integration. * Full\-stack proficiency with Python and TypeScript/React or equivalent, along with cloud experience such as AWS or GCP and relational or NoSQL databases. * Working knowledge of RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines. * Experience building automated tests, evaluations, and monitoring for production AI systems. * Experience designing API\-driven, high\-throughput systems and real\-time product features. * Experience with agent or workflow frameworks and orchestration tools; familiarity with fine\-tuning or multimodal models is also useful. * Background in multi\-tenant or enterprise systems, or regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, or legal. * End\-to\-end ownership, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative, user\-focused approach. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $150,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Mid-Level Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI recruiting technology startup as a full\-stack Product Engineer. You will build reliable, user\-focused products that bring AI capabilities into practical workflows, working closely with product and design to deliver measurable outcomes and help shape technical direction. ### **What You'll Do** * Own product features end to end, from scoping requirements through production deployment. * Design APIs and data models, and build frontend and backend functionality. * Ship and improve user\-facing experiences using customer feedback and product metrics. * Integrate AI and LLM capabilities into product workflows with a focus on reliability. * Build scalable backend services, data schemas, and operational tooling for testing, monitoring, and deployment. * Collaborate with product and design on priorities and success measures, and contribute to architecture and roadmap discussions. * Make pragmatic technical tradeoffs suited to a growing startup. ### **What We're Looking For** * 2 to 8 years of software engineering experience, including delivery of user\-facing products. * Production full\-stack experience with TypeScript and React or Next.js, plus backend development in Python or Node.js. * Practical experience integrating LLMs or other AI services into production applications. * Experience with PostgreSQL and AWS or GCP. * Strong product judgment and end\-to\-end ownership, with comfort working in a small team and navigating ambiguity across frontend, backend, and infrastructure work. * Experience with multi\-tenant or enterprise\-ready systems, APIs, real\-time systems, or high\-throughput applications is valuable. * Background in regulated industries or complex internal tools is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $150,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Biotech
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a biotech AI team building data infrastructure that turns clinical, genomic, imaging, and other biomedical data into reliable, model\-ready assets. You will help design and operate the platform, with a focus on secure, governed data systems and production infrastructure for scientific and machine learning teams. ### **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain cloud data platform components, including object storage, lakehouse architecture, catalogs, lineage, dataset versioning, and query and access layers. * Design and operate data warehouses and governed systems for clinical records, molecular features, metadata, retention, and dataset releases. * Develop reproducible bioinformatics workflows for omics data, using containerized pipelines and cloud batch compute. * Implement data quality checks, biological validation, and visualizations that help teams identify issues across processing steps. * Deliver versioned, training\-ready datasets and data deployment interfaces for model use in partner environments. * Operate production infrastructure, including Kubernetes, CI/CD, workload orchestration, security, reliability, observability, and cost optimization. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to five years of experience building data infrastructure and production pipelines as a platform engineer in biotech, diagnostics, biobanking, health data, or a related field working with sensitive biological or clinical data. * Production experience operating Kubernetes clusters, writing infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar tools, and shipping tested, documented Python and/or Go code. * Experience designing CI/CD and deployment systems, orchestrating distributed workloads, and owning infrastructure reliability, observability, security, and cost. * Familiarity with a major cloud provider, preferably AWS, plus Docker, workflow managers such as Nextflow, lakehouse and warehouse design, data catalogs, and orchestration. * Experience with large\-scale data pipelines, machine learning infrastructure, or GPU workloads is valuable. Knowledge of omics workflows, bioinformatics tools, OMOP, FHIR, R, or SQL is also relevant. * Experience implementing compliance controls and audit evidence for standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, or SOC 2 is beneficial. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $180,000 to $240,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** Hybrid role based in San Francisco, California. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a 10\-person engineering team as its first product engineer, working closely with the CTO in a hybrid New York City role. You will take customer problems from conversation through launch and adoption, combining full\-stack engineering with product judgment to shape AI\-powered workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Talk with customers, use the product firsthand, and turn ambiguous needs into straightforward solutions. * Build full\-stack agents and features that connect models with tools, data, and customer\-facing interfaces. * Develop workflows such as turning campaign briefs into contests and helping creators move from invitation to published content. * Test brand and creator experiences end to end, then improve them using customer feedback, usage data, and agent evaluations. * Use AI coding tools to work efficiently, verify their output, and collaborate through clear decisions, demos, and code reviews. ### **What We're Looking For** * Proficiency in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. * Experience shipping and maintaining products across the frontend and backend, including customer\-facing web application features. * Experience with APIs and web service design. * Experience using AI tools to build agents or AI\-powered features. * Background in creator marketing or e\-commerce is relevant. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. ### **Location** Hybrid role based in New York, New York, United States.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a product engineering team building a platform and marketplace for reinforcement learning environments. You will combine product judgment, interaction design, and full\-stack engineering to make complex workflows clearer for environment creators and AI research teams. ### **What You'll Do** * Work with product, design, engineering, research, and go\-to\-market partners to identify user friction and prioritize improvements. * Speak directly with users to understand challenges in creating, testing, evaluating, and discovering reinforcement learning environments. * Own product improvements from problem definition and prototyping through implementation, launch, and iteration. * Build frontend and backend features for onboarding, environment submission, review, and discovery workflows. * Design interfaces that help users understand agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback. * Use user feedback and product data to refine experiences and inform tradeoffs. ### **What We're Looking For** * Experience shipping software products end\-to\-end, from understanding user needs through implementation and iteration. * A technical degree and full\-stack web application experience, including polished frontend interfaces and backend services or APIs. * Experience interviewing users and using qualitative feedback and product data to improve shipped products. * Strong interaction design and product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows and making decisions with incomplete information. * Background in developer tools, data\-rich products, marketplaces, or products serving distinct user groups. * Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, training data, or workflows involving review, debugging, and quality feedback. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary range: $100,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** Remote candidates are welcome, with 70% to 80% time zone overlap required with San Francisco or Singapore. Office locations are available in San Francisco and Singapore.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a consumer fintech product and engineering team building tools that help people manage cash flow and build credit. You will own backend features from design through production, contributing to reliable and accessible financial products. ### **What You'll Do** * Build product features end to end, including domain models, business logic, and API integrations. * Deliver and iterate on product milestones through data\-informed, incremental releases. * Use SQL and analytics tools to assess product and system performance. * Debug complex state machines in event\-driven systems to support a seamless user experience. * Ship through CI/CD, own implementations in production, and respond to incidents as needed. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience building backend features end to end for production systems. * Proficiency designing and consuming REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, and rate limiting. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and message queues such as Kafka or Pub/Sub, including debugging complex workflows. * Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, data modeling, query optimization, and SQL\-based analytics. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and code review. * Experience building consumer\-facing products and working in an early\-stage startup or similarly high\-velocity environment. * Strong computer science fundamentals and experience with distributed systems. * Go and GCP experience are useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $120,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Candidates based in Seattle or willing to relocate to San Francisco or Seattle may also be considered.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI infrastructure company as its first QA engineer, owning quality across a Kubernetes\-based GPU fleet management platform. You will test conversational and web interfaces alongside the backend systems that manage production clusters, helping ensure that user requests are handled accurately and safely. ### **What You'll Do** * Test the conversational interface end to end, including command accuracy and the actions it performs on live clusters. * Build evaluations for AI agent behavior, checking answer quality, safe actions, and handling of ambiguous or invalid requests. * Develop end\-to\-end tests for the web interface and verify consistent behavior across interfaces. * Write Go integration tests for multicluster backend workflows, including installation, upgrades, and failover. * Create and tear down Kubernetes test clusters to validate controllers, operators, and custom resources across Kubernetes versions. * Verify alert delivery across monitoring and user interfaces, and ensure alerts trigger appropriately. * Gate releases in CI and turn bugs and incidents into regression tests. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience in QA, SDET, or test automation, building or delivering test suites and automation frameworks. * Strong Go experience writing integration tests or backend test automation, and experience building end\-to\-end web UI tests. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, React, RPC systems such as gRPC, CI/CD, and Linux fundamentals. * Experience testing infrastructure or distributed systems; familiarity with multicluster tooling, chaos engineering, or Kubernetes testing tools is useful. * Familiarity with Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Playwright, Slack apps, or GPU and bare\-metal infrastructure is a plus. * Experience building test infrastructure from scratch or evaluating LLM\-powered and conversational products is valued. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $180,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build privacy and anonymization systems for an AI infrastructure team, helping make sensitive real\-world data safe and useful for model training. You will own production methods that protect private information while preserving the structure and signal needed for training and evaluation. ### **What You'll Do** * Build systems to detect PII, quasi\-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive information, and choose transformations suited to each data type and use case. * Develop and benchmark detection methods combining rules, statistical models, classifiers, and LLM\-based approaches. * Create production pipelines that anonymize raw data before downstream processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data generation. * Build evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained utility, including recall\-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re\-identification attempts. * Design robust systems for new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields. * Partner with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical policies and safeguards. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of experience building production data or ML systems in Python. * Hands\-on experience detecting, removing, or anonymizing PII while preserving useful data characteristics. * Experience with information extraction, named\-entity recognition, classification, or related techniques for detecting sensitive or rare content. * Experience building end\-to\-end data processing pipelines and benchmarking approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost, and data utility. * Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation. * Strong experimental skills and experience handling schema drift, unusual formats, and edge cases. * Technical education or equivalent background; experience with privacy\-enhancing technologies or sensitive data in healthcare, finance, or security is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineer, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an engineering and R\&D team as a Robotics Engineer focused on autonomous systems. You will design, build, integrate, and test drone\-based robotic systems from prototype through field validation, supporting safe and reliable delivery operations. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and integrate robotic mechanisms, sensors, actuators, controllers, and drone payload systems. * Develop control, navigation, path\-planning, and obstacle\-avoidance solutions. * Build robotics software with ROS or ROS 2 and C\+\+ or Python, and validate systems in simulation. * Integrate flight controllers, companion computers, communication links, and telemetry with drone systems. * Build, troubleshoot, and independently validate robotic systems in the field. * Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, and software teams on prototypes and deployments. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of hands\-on experience building or delivering robotics, UAV, or autonomous systems. * Strong fundamentals in kinematics, dynamics, control theory, PID, and system integration. * Proficiency in C\+\+ or Python, ROS or ROS 2, and Linux; MATLAB familiarity is useful. * Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, flight controllers, motors, ESCs, and batteries. * Knowledge of IMU, GPS/RTK, LiDAR, sensor fusion, and GPS\-denied navigation. * Embedded systems experience with microcontrollers, Raspberry Pi or Jetson, actuators, and hardware debugging. * Familiarity with CAN, UART, I2C, drone telemetry, simulation, flight\-log analysis, and field testing. * A degree in robotics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, aerospace, computer science, or a related field. * Computer vision, machine learning, SLAM, Gazebo or Webots, CAD, or BVLOS experience is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in Indianapolis, United States.

jobs.title: Senior Android Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a product\-focused engineering team building a consumer financial technology app. You will help scale its Android experience and shape product direction through pragmatic problem solving and close collaboration with product, engineering, and business partners. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain the Android application. * Contribute to platform development and Android architecture. * Solve product and engineering challenges pragmatically. * Help inform product design and direction. * Communicate and collaborate effectively across teams. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 5 years of mobile app development experience, including 2 or more years building and shipping production Android apps and 3 or more years in a startup environment. * Strong Kotlin skills and hands\-on experience with Jetpack Compose and MVVM or Clean Architecture. * Experience building consumer\-facing mobile applications and integrating Firebase Authentication, Firestore or Realtime Database, and Cloud Messaging. * Proficiency with protobufs, REST, and gRPC, ideally in data\-heavy or distributed systems environments. * Experience with Android unit, instrumentation, and UI testing, as well as mobile CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership supporting junior engineers, strong communication, and a solid university background. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $160,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, Perception
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Lead perception engineering for a defense technology team developing autonomous systems. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About This Role** ------------------- As a Principal Software Engineer for Infrastructure, you will partner with teams across the company to help shape the technical direction of the compute, storage, and networking platforms that power Crusoe’s AI\-first cloud. This is a high\-leverage leadership role that spans the full infrastructure stack: you will work alongside engineers and stakeholders on the systems that help massive GPU clusters run AI and HPC workloads at extreme throughput, low latency, and high reliability. Your work spans the Linux kernel, hypervisors and virtualization, distributed storage, network fabrics, and the control planes that tie them together. You will be a trusted technical partner across the infrastructure stack, helping guide architecture decisions and mentoring engineers to raise our collective technical bar. You will look at the whole system alongside the teams who own each layer: how a storage tier, a scheduler, and a network fabric interact under a multi\-node training job, and where the real bottleneck sits. You will collaborate closely with Product, Hardware, and Infrastructure teams to build a reliable, scalable platform together that aligns with Crusoe’s mission to innovate sustainably. This is a full\-time position. **What You’ll Be Working On** ----------------------------- * **Infrastructure Strategy:** Partner with engineering, product, and leadership to help shape the long\-term direction for compute, storage, and networking, and to turn that direction into practical plans and milestones. * **Architecture \& Design:** Collaborate with teams on architecture reviews, design documents, and code reviews for critical infrastructure components and services across all three domains. * **Compute \& Virtualization:** Work with compute teams on the virtualization and orchestration layers that deliver bare\-metal\-class performance to GPU workloads, including hypervisor tuning, SR\-IOV, vDPA, virtio, device passthrough, and NUMA\- and topology\-aware scheduling. * **Storage Systems:** Work with storage teams on high\-throughput, low\-latency storage for training and inference pipelines, including distributed block, file, and object storage, NVMe and NVMe\-oF, RDMA\-based data paths, and checkpointing and data\-loading performance. * **Networking \& Fabric:** Partner with networking teams on architectures for GPU\-to\-GPU fabrics, high\-speed Ethernet, and specialized AI clusters, using technologies such as XDP, eBPF, DPDK, OVS/OVN, BGP, EVPN, and VXLAN. * **Kernel \& Driver Work:** Contribute to Linux kernel modules and high\-performance drivers across the network, storage, and device stack. * **Hardware Integration:** Work with Hardware teams on accelerators and offload devices, including GPUs, SmartNICs, DPUs, IPUs, and NVMe, from qualification through bring\-up of new platforms. * **Cross\-Stack Performance \& Reliability:** Team up with on\-call, SRE, and domain engineers to troubleshoot complex production issues that cross compute, storage, and network boundaries, and to improve performance, observability, capacity planning, and failure\-domain design. * **Technology Evaluation:** Explore emerging infrastructure technologies with the team, contribute to open\-source projects where strategically relevant, and share learnings with the broader organization. * **Mentorship \& Collaboration:** Partner with internal stakeholders on end\-to\-end features, and mentor and support engineers across teams to foster a culture of engineering excellence. **What You’ll Bring to the Team** --------------------------------- * **Large\-Scale Infrastructure Mastery:** 10\+ years of experience building and operating large\-scale infrastructure systems in production, ideally within cloud or hyperscale data center environments. * Cross\-Domain **Breadth:** Hands\-on experience across compute, storage, and networking, and a track record of solving problems that cross domain boundaries. * **Systems Programming Excellence:** Strong systems programming skills in C, C\+\+, Rust, or Go, with experience working on performance\-critical services and control planes. * **Linux Internals Depth:** Extensive knowledge of the Linux kernel architecture, memory management, scheduler, I/O and network stacks, and device driver development. * **Virtualization \& Compute Literacy:** Experience with KVM/QEMU or similar hypervisors, container runtimes, and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, plus an understanding of GPU, CPU, and NUMA topology and its effect on workload performance. * **Storage Literacy:** Familiarity with distributed storage architectures (block, file, or object), NVMe/NVMe\-oF, RDMA, and the consistency, durability, and performance tradeoffs involved. * **Network \& Fabric Literacy:** Familiarity with data center fabrics (e.g., Spine\-Leaf, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN), network virtualization tools such as OVS or OVN, and high\-speed packet processing technologies such as XDP, eBPF, or DPDK. * **Accelerator Knowledge:** Familiarity with SmartNICs, DPUs, and accelerators, such as NVIDIA ConnectX\-6/7 and BlueField\-3 or Intel IPUs. * **Production Debugging:** Experience working with others to diagnose complex issues across the full stack, from hardware and firmware through the kernel to control\-plane software. * **Strategic Influence:** A proven track record of leading through influence, with excellent written communication skills and a strong mentoring mindset. * **Education:** A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related analytical field (or equivalent professional experience). **Bonus Points** ---------------- * **Open\-Source Contributions:** Active contributions to projects such as the Linux kernel, KVM/QEMU, Kubernetes, Ceph, OVS, OVN, Cilium, or Multus. * **Orchestration \& Automation Expertise:** Experience with infrastructure automation, fleet management, or complex orchestration tooling. * **GPU Training at Scale:** Prior experience building compute, storage, or networking stacks for multi\-node GPU training at scale. * **Hardware Co\-Design:** Experience working with hardware teams on platform design, qualification, and firmware\-to\-software integration. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $285,000 \- $335,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

The Senior Data Engineer will possess strong hands\-on experience with GCP data and compute services, relational and distributed databases, ETL tooling, and Unix/Linux environments. This individual will contribute to the design, development, performance tuning, and operational support of data platforms, working closely with senior engineers and architects to deliver reliable, efficient, and well\-monitored data solutions. *Expectations for the Role* * Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines using GCP services including BigQuery, Cloud Spanner, and Dataflow for batch and streaming data processing * Build and support ETL/ELT workflows that extract, transform, and load data across Oracle, Spanner, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and other relational databases * Develop and optimize BigQuery datasets, tables, partitioning, and clustering strategies to support efficient querying and reporting * Implement and tune Dataflow pipelines for data transformation, enrichment, and movement between source systems and target data stores * Monitor and manage Compute Engine VMs, including CPU utilization, resource allocation, and performance tuning across GCP workloads * Support jobs.description: **Software Developer** **Caltech** **Job Category:** Parttime Term **Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible **Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based Caltech is a world\-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community. **Job Summary** We're hiring a software developer to help build and maintain MathDB. https://mathdb.com/ MathDB is a large\-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear. We're looking for someone who has experience building web apps and AI agents, and who can join our effort in building and maintaining web apps, mobile apps, backend servers, databases and Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB. **Essential Job Duties** * Assist in the development and maintenance of interactive web and mobile applications for MathDB. * Support the development and maintenance of backend servers for MathDB. * Assist in the development and maintenance of MathDB's backend database infrastructure. * Support the development and maintenance of Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. * Experience developing interactive web and mobile applications. * Strong attention to detail in application design, performance, responsiveness, visual presentation, and user interface/user experience (UI/UX). * Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and incorporate feedback through an iterative development process. * Experience with version control, software testing, and software engineering best practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in
