jobs.title: Data Engineer III
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Data Engineer III independently designs, develops, implements, and supports complex enterprise data pipelines, data models, and analytical solutions that deliver reliable, actionable information to the business. This role contributes to solution architecture, strengthens data quality and governance, and applies hands\-on artificial intelligence (AI) experience to build AI\-ready data assets and integrate AI capabilities into data engineering workflows. The Data Engineer III owns technical delivery within assigned initiatives, resolves non\-routine problems, and collaborates with business and technology partners within established architecture, security, and governance standards. **Essential Functions:** * Independently design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and analytical data assets; improve performance, reliability, and maintainability throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Serve as a key contributor to data stewardship workgroups and cross\-functional teams supporting data management and governance. * Promote metadata management and data quality practices through knowledge\-sharing sessions, technical guidance, and collaboration across the organization. * Translate stakeholder priorities, business definitions, and data quality requirements into appropriate data models, technical specifications, and engineering solutions. * Own the technical delivery of assigned data governance engineering initiatives, including metadata cataloging and data quality solutions, within established program standards. * Analyze data and business processes to develop and maintain glossary definitions, policies, standards, guidelines, and workflows that support data management and governance programs. * Lead the development and maintenance of metadata catalogs for assigned data domains, including technical metadata, business definitions, and data lineage. * Identify and quantify data\-related issues, assess business impact, and collaborate with stakeholders to develop and implement remediation plans. * Partner with subject matter experts, end users, and data modelers to define business rules and implement automated controls that measure and improve data quality. * Lead the investigation and resolution of reported data quality issues; develop and report metrics that demonstrate remediation progress, data quality trends, and adherence to established standards. * Set objectives and manage technical delivery for assigned work, accounting for dependencies and impacts on related teams. Contribute to operational goals and work independently within established procedures, seeking direction for new domains or unique assignments. * Resolve ambiguous, non\-routine technical problems through analysis, data trends, and sound engineering judgment. Improve work methods based on experience, engage appropriate resources, and escalate risks or decisions outside established boundaries. * Build and maintain governed, AI\-ready datasets and pipelines for AI and machine learning use cases, including data preparation, validation, lineage, and access controls; collaborate with data science and application teams on integration requirements. * Implement and support approved AI capabilities within data engineering solutions, such as AI\-assisted data quality checks, metadata enrichment, or unstructured data processing. Validate outputs against defined acceptance criteria and monitor accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost. * Use approved AI\-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation. Independently review and test generated outputs, protect sensitive data, and follow established security, privacy, and responsible AI requirements. Perform any other job duties as requested * **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant work experience, is required. * A minimum of five (5\) years of experience designing and developing ETL/ELT and/or business intelligence solutions is required. * Demonstrated experience across requirements definition, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support of complex database, data integration, business intelligence, and analytical solutions is required. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience independently implementing and supporting AI\-enabled data engineering solutions in a production environment is required. Experience must include preparing and governing data, integrating AI services or models into data workflows, validating outputs, and monitoring operational performance; familiarity with AI concepts or use of AI chat tools alone does not satisfy this requirement. * Healthcare payer experience is preferred. Experience working within a formal data warehouse and data governance environment is preferred. * **Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:** * Advanced SQL skills, including complex query development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. * Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language for data transformation, automation, testing, and integration with AI services or model APIs. * Demonstrated ability to develop moderately complex to complex data profiling, data quality, and metadata analysis processes using industry\-standard tools. * Ability to manage technical deliverables across multiple medium\- to large\-scale projects, prioritize competing demands, and communicate dependencies and delivery risks promptly. * Strong understanding of data management and governance, including data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, and access controls. * Strong understanding of relational database theory, data modeling, and data warehouse design principles. * Working knowledge of AI and machine learning data requirements and practical AI integration patterns, including model inference APIs and, where applicable, embeddings and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Ability to evaluate AI\-enabled workflows using representative test data and defined quality measures; identify inaccurate or unsupported outputs, data leakage, and privacy risks, and implement appropriate validation and human review controls. * Proficiency with version control, code review, automated testing, deployment practices, and operational monitoring for data pipelines and AI integrations. * Ability to build effective working relationships with business and technology stakeholders at all organizational levels. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, sound technical judgment, and attention to detail. * Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including active listening, critical thinking, and the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical audiences. * Ability to prioritize and execute work independently while contributing effectively in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment. Customer\-focused approach with a commitment to reliable delivery, responsive support, and business value. * **Working Conditions:** * General office environment; may be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time **Compensation Range:** $94,100\.00 \- $164,800\.00 CareSource takes into consideration a combination of a candidate’s education, training, and experience as well as the position’s scope and complexity, the discretion and latitude required for the role, and other external and internal data when establishing a salary level. In addition to base compensation, you may qualify for a bonus tied to company and individual performance. We are highly invested in every employee’s total well\-being and offer a substantial and comprehensive total rewards package. **Compensation Type (hourly/salary):** Salary **Organization Level Competencies** * Fostering a Collaborative Workplace Culture * Cultivate Partnerships * Develop Self and Others * Drive Execution * Influence Others * Pursue Personal Excellence * Understand the Business **This job description is not all inclusive. CareSource reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. CareSource is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to fostering an environment of belonging that welcomes and supports individuals of all backgrounds.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- \#LI\-GM1 Brand\=CareSource

jobs.title: Manager, R&D Test Lab
jobs.description: **About Carlsmed** Our mission is to improve outcomes and decrease the cost of healthcare for spine surgery and beyond. The Carlsmed aprevo® personalized surgery platform is designed to improve the standard of care for spine surgery one patient at a time. **Position Description** As **Manager, R\&D Test Lab**, you will support the Product Development team’s goal of improving patient outcomes by developing new implants, instruments, and complementary surgical planning and quality production systems that integrate with our universal platform. You will be responsible for **leading the R\&D mechanical testing laboratory supporting development and verification of spinal implants,** instruments and associated technologies. You will own the lab capability, equipment, capacity, test method quality, scheduling, and technical execution while partnering closely with R\&D engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations. You will have autonomy and be expected to identify solutions to problems on your own. To be successful in this role, you must be a team\-player, **self\-motivated**, and **invested in improving patient lives.** **Responsibilities** * Establish and lead day\-to\-day operation of mechanical testing lab and test frames including capacity planning, prioritization, scheduling, maintenance, calibration coordination and equipment uptime. * Provide technical leadership for static, fatigue, torsion, compression, bending, pullout, subsidence, construct and instrument testing per the associated ASTM standards and as applicable to the product portfolio. * Oversee development, qualification, and execution of mechanical test methods, fixtures, protocols, and reports, and support formal design verification and validation activities in accordance with the company’s QMS and applicable regulatory requirements. * Support coordinating cadaveric and animal studies with external research laboratories. Develop study protocols in collaboration with engineers and scientists and manage external testing partnerships, study execution, and technical reporting. * Maintain awareness of applicable ASTM/ISO standards and FDA expectations relevant to spinal implants and instrumentation. * Provide best practices and reference guidance to ensure testing is technically sound, repeatable, traceable, and appropriately documented. * Partner with engineers to translate design questions and product requirements into meaningful mechanical experiments acting as a true research laboratory. * Lead or partner with engineers to investigate complaints or field issues, production issues, anomalous results, equipment issues, test failures, and method variability. * Drive improvements in fixtures, automation, data acquisition and aanalysis, test throughput, laboratory workflows, and documentation. * Strategically partner to establish equipment and capability roadmaps based on the R\&D and business pipeline. * Own or contribute to and maintain lab CAPEX planning and equipment selection. * Establish lab KPIs surrounding utilization, turnaround time, uptime, on\-time completion, OPEX savings, and capacity and clearly communicate to leadership. * May manage and develop test engineers, technicians, and/or lab specialists. * May coordinate with outside lab testing and equipment manufacturers to complement in\-house testing execution. * May require flexible scheduling to align with testing demands. **Qualifications** * Education: Bachelor’s degree in **Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Biomechanical Engineering**, or related field. * Experience: **7\-10** years of **relevant engineering/testing experience.** A MS may supplement years of experience depending on focus. * Experience collaborating with junior and senior engineers and providing technical guidance and support. * Experience with spine or orthopedics is highly desired. * Experience operating electromechanical test systems (or servo\-hydraulic systems) such Instron or MTS, load cells, fatigue testing, fixture design, and statistics/data analysis. * Extensive familiarity with standards and test approaches associated with interbody devices, spinal constructs, fixation systems, screws, rods, plates, and instruments. Experience with motion\-preservation, corpectomy, and other unique spinal constructs is also preferred. **Skills** * Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable creating presentations and delivering them to senior management. * Strong ability to write and review technical memos, protocols, and reports. * Operates with comprehensive understanding of product risk. * Thorough and detail\-oriented – able to execute complex technical work without errors or need for rework. * Willingness to wear multiple hats when needed to support Carlsmed’s mission. * Autonomous, self\-motivated, and driven to build a service department supporting cross\-functional teams. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Carlsmed is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Carlsmed is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know. **Compensation** The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 \- $170,000\. Individual compensation is determined based on factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in incentive compensation programs and receive a comprehensive benefits package. Our benefits reflect our commitment to the health and well\-being of our employees and their families and include 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums, a 401(k) plan with employer matching, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). Your recruiter can provide additional details about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Systems Engineer is responsible for the administration, maintenance, security, availability, and continued improvement of the Catawba Nation’s on\-premises and cloud\-based technology infrastructure. This position serves as a senior technical resource for Windows Server, virtualization, Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, backup and disaster recovery, and other core infrastructure services. The Systems Engineer works collaboratively with Information Security, Network, Applications, GIS, Help Desk, Gaming Commission, vendors, and departments throughout the Nation to maintain secure, reliable, and compliant technology services. The position also provides advanced technical support, assists with infrastructure projects, and provides technical guidance and mentoring to IT personnel. Due to access to sensitive government, law enforcement, healthcare, gaming, employee, citizen, and other regulated information and systems, the Systems Engineer must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with applicable security and regulatory requirements. **Essential Functions** An individual in this role must be able to perform the following functions with or without reasonable accommodation: * **Administer, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise server infrastructure** across on\-premises and cloud environments, including Windows Server, physical and virtual servers, domain controllers, file and application servers, GIS infrastructure, and other critical systems. * **Administer and maintain virtualization platforms** such as VMware and other approved technologies, including virtual machine provisioning, configuration, performance management, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle management. * **Manage Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, and related cloud services**, including Azure infrastructure and platform resources, Exchange/Outlook, Teams, and other assigned cloud\-based services. * **Administer enterprise identity and access services**, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity environments, user and service accounts, security groups, permissions, licensing, privileged access, and related access controls. * **Monitor and optimize infrastructure performance and availability**, including system health, capacity, storage, alerts, resource utilization, and service availability; identify and resolve infrastructure issues and failures. * **Perform infrastructure lifecycle management**, including server and service installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, modernization, replacement, and decommissioning in accordance with established IT standards. * **Administer and monitor enterprise backup and recovery systems**, including server, Microsoft 365, cloud, and other critical system backups; troubleshoot failures and conduct restoration testing to verify data recoverability. * **Develop, maintain, and test disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities** for critical infrastructure, participating in exercises, restoration activities, and corrective actions to support organizational resiliency. * **Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls**, including system hardening, security patches, encryption, certificates, service credentials, privileged access controls, and other security configurations in coordination with Information Security. * **Support infrastructure\-related cybersecurity activities**, including vulnerability remediation, security investigations, security assessments, and corrective actions affecting servers, cloud services, identity systems, and other infrastructure. * **Provide backup and specialized support for network and enterprise technology services**, including DNS, DHCP, VPN, switching, VLANs, wireless infrastructure, certificates, GIS servers, Gaming Commission systems, and other assigned technologies. * **Coordinate with vendors, service providers, departments, and IT personnel** regarding infrastructure solutions, licensing, maintenance, support, technical issues, requirements, and implementation activities. * **Participate in infrastructure projects and technology initiatives**, including implementations, upgrades, migrations, cloud modernization, system integrations, and other projects designed to improve organizational technology services. * **Provide advanced technical support and guidance** to IT personnel and authorized organizational users, including troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, mentoring Help Desk and other technical staff, and providing after\-hours support for critical 24/7 operations as required. * **Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and operational standards**, including system configurations, network and infrastructure diagrams, procedures, administrative records, knowledge\-base resources, and technical standards, while maintaining current professional knowledge through training and development. only be made by a member of the Human Resources team. federal and tribal laws, consistent with the sovereign authority of the Catawba Indian Nation. **Gaming Commission Positions** Native American (Indian) preference applies to this position pursuant to the Indian Gaming Regulatory Act, 25 U.S.C. § 2701 et seq.; applicable regulations of the National Indian Gaming Commission at 25 CFR Chapter III; the Indian Reorganization Act, 25 U.S.C. § 5116; and other applicable federal and tribal laws, consistent with the sovereign authority of the Catawba Indian Nation. **Background checks and drug screening are requirements for employment.** **Qualifications** ***Experience/ Education:*** * Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Administration, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible systems administration/engineering experience; or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, training, and professional experience. ***Licenses \& Certifications:*** * Possess a clean, valid state Driver’s License and be insurable under the Tribe’s insurance policy. * CJIS Certification (can be obtained on the job) * Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals Preferred **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Advanced knowledge of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Azure. * Knowledge of virtualization regulatory and security requirements, including CJIS/CHRI, HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIGC, and Gaming Commission requirements. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical personnel. * Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation and exercise appropriate judgment when working with sensitive systems and information. **Work Environment \& Physical Demands** * Must successfully complete applicable background screening due to access to law enforcement, Gaming Commission, governmental, and other sensitive systems. * Must obtain and jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer

Experience at a startup, on a small R\&D team, or on a project you launched yourself is especially valuable. * You’re comfortable using AI tools in your development work. * You bring strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * You communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * You manage your workload and priorities with minimal oversight. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain integrations across HRIS, payroll, ATS, notifications, and business intelligence platforms. * Build and extend the configuration\-driven integration system, including the functionality it needs. * Design APIs and data pipelines that connect reliably with third\-party systems. * Contribute to AI features in the ChartHop product. * Own the full development lifecycle: research API documentation, plan, write robust code, deploy, and monitor integration health. * Write tests, conduct code reviews, and follow best practices for code quality and maintainability. * Work with product, customer success, and external partners to meet business and technical requirements. * Improve how we build and manage integrations, including developer tooling, monitoring, and alerting. ### **How You’ll Be Measured** * Integration reliability: uptime, error rates, and data accuracy across third\-party connections. * Code quality and maintainability: measured through code reviews and long\-term sustainability. * Feature delivery: features delivered on time and within scope. * Customer impact: fewer support tickets and less friction in the integration experience, with better data quality. * Team contribution: impact on team productivity, collaboration, and innovation. * Continuous learning: learning new technologies and sharing knowledge with the team. ### **The Details** ***Tech stack:***Kotlin and MongoDB on the back end, TypeScript and React on the front end, and AWS for infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Chess Data Science
jobs.description: **About Us** Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the \#1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess. We are a team of 600\+ fully remote people in 60\+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M\+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community! We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission\-driven, flat, life\-celebrating, no\-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team. **About You** You are an experienced data science leader who translates strategy into objectives, grows the people around you, and works as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership. You are also a strong individual contributor who doesn't just manage the work but does it. You don't need glamorous problems to do great work — you find satisfaction in getting things right, shipping something that matters, and making the people around you better at their craft. You've worked in applied data science long enough to know when to push for a more rigorous model and when to ship the first version and iterate. You can walk stakeholders through your findings and turn around and give a member of the team support and feedback that helps them grow. You bring relevant data, graphs, and other evidence to group discussions and can continue to evolve your perspective as new evidence comes in. You think creatively about problems that don't have established solutions. You’re comfortable building from scratch, inventing new approaches, testing them quickly, and iterating to bring out the right idea. You understand that chess is a deeply data\-rich domain, and ideally, you love the game. Familiarity with how chess players develop and improve, how rating systems work, the challenge of catching cheaters, and what makes a chess feature feel right, is knowledge that will compound quickly in this role. **What you'll do** * Own high\-impact data science work across product data science and fair play. Create and build novel algorithms, models, and data\-powered features that directly shape the chess experience for our users, from systems that protect the integrity of the game to features that make Chess.com more engaging and useful for players at every level. * Partner across the company on product vision and execution. Work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and writers to translate new stats and algorithms into decisions that power our next generation of features. * Design and deploy creative heuristics, algorithms, and models that identify cheating at scale using the full depth of your statistical and data science toolkit. Raise the quality and sophistication of our approaches over time. * Manage a lean team of data scientists. Turn strategy into clear team objectives and results, not just execute direction from leadership. Set the quality bar through your own work and give feedback that inspires teammates to do great work, not just fix the issues of the day. Help data scientists grow into scientists who can operate with more speed and independence over time. * Communicate early and often. In a fully remote culture, proactive communication is how work actually gets done. Technical Skills * Python: Expert\-level proficiency; strong command of data engineering libraries (pandas, PySpark, SQLAlchemy), code quality practices, and packaging. * SQL: Expert\-level; able to write complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, and performance\-tune queries across multiple platforms. * Apache Spark / PySpark: Comfortable developing and debugging distributed data processing jobs; understands Spark execution model and optimization basics. * Databricks: Hands\-on experience with notebooks, Delta Lake, Jobs/Workflows, and cluster configuration. * Azure: Working experience with core Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, or equivalent). * SQL Server \& Synapse Analytics: Experience querying and loading data; understanding of schema design and indexing strategies. * Snowflake: Practical experience with Snowflake warehousing, data loading patterns, and role\-based access. * Windows: Comfortable working in a Windows\-based development environment. Education \& Experience * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * 2\-4 years of professional experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or software engineering role with a significant data focus. Soft Skills * Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present technical concepts to non\-technical business audiences. * Collaborative team player who engages proactively with data scientists, analysts, and business partners. * Detail\-oriented with a bias toward clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code. * Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced delivery environment. Nice To Have * CLI tools: Familiarity with shell scripting, command\-line data tools, and working in Linux environments. * Version control: Experience with Git\-based workflows in a team setting. * Orchestration: Exposure to workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory pipelines, Databricks Workflows). * Insurance / financial services domain: Prior experience in a regulated industry is a plus but not required. * CI/CD: Familiarity with automated testing and deployment pipelines for data assets. selection, deployment, configuration, policy tuning, operational support, and continuous improvement. * Develop and execute a phased rollout from monitor mode to warn and coach to targeted blocking, using observed AI traffic and risk metrics to establish baselines and control implementation. * Engineer and tune controls for GenAI prompts, file uploads, browser traffic, embedded copilots, and sanctioned and unsanctioned AI applications. * Implement inline remediation controls including redaction, quarantine, user coaching, warning, and blocking. * Establish instance aware controls that distinguish corporate from personal accounts and reduce data leakage risk. * Assess AI and agentic integration risks involving AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), non human identities, third party integrations, and emerging access paths. * Integrate AI Gateway telemetry with SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity platforms, data protection solutions, and evidence repositories. * Define and operationalize governance standards, policy lifecycle processes, exception handling procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models. * Measure and report program effectiveness through coverage, policy accuracy, false positive and false negative trends, remediation outcomes, audit evidence quality, and user experience metrics. * Partner with business leaders and AI platform owners to introduce coaching and enforcement controls with minimal disruption. * Stay current on AI security threats, GenAI data loss trends, agentic AI developments, MCP capabilities, and evolving security technologies. * Contribute to standards, procedures, training materials, and enterprise communications related to secure AI adoption. * Support risk, audit, and regulatory readiness through maintenance of defensible security evidence, policy decisions, exceptions, and enforcement outcomes. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security engineering, or related technical disciplines. * 2\+ years of hands on experience with Data Protection, SSE, SASE, CASB, DLP, AI Security, GenAI Security, or similar inline security technologies. * Direct AI Gateway experience strongly preferred. * Deep understanding of GenAI data flows and security risks across prompts, uploads, browser traffic, embedded copilots, APIs, AI agents, and third party integrations. * Experience implementing enterprise security controls capable of monitoring, coaching, redacting, quarantining, or blocking risky data movement in real time. * Strong knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity management, and security orchestration workflows. * Experience with identity and access management concepts including corporate versus personal instances, least privilege, non human identities, OAuth, OIDC, and service to service access. * Understanding of data protection, governance, risk management, and regulated industry control requirements. * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical risks into actionable business guidance. * Proven experience leading cross functional security platform rollouts and balancing risk, usability, and business objectives. Preferred Qualifications * CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or comparable security certifications. * Experience with AI Security, DLP, SSE, SASE, CASB, DSPM, or related data protection platforms. * Experience with Cyera Omni, Netskope AI Security, AISecOps, or similar technologies. * Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation, reporting, and workflow orchestration. * Experience working in financial services, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience developing governance standards, risk based enforcement models, exception management processes, and control evidence frameworks. * Experience securing agentic AI environments, MCP enabled integrations, AI agents, non human identities, prompt and upload workflows, and GenAI data leakage scenarios. **Pay Transparency** The salary range for this position is $130,000 \- $195,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn additional incentive earnings. jobs.title: Sr. Data Protection Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** Under the direction of the Data Protection Manager, the Sr. Data Protection Engineer is a senior technical role focused primarily on the engineering, operation, and optimization of Clayco’s Data discovery \& classification, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) solutions, while also supporting the broader integrations and complimentary solutions. The role is responsible for engineering effective, supportable, and sustainable control configurations to meet the design requirements and objectives of our security control solutions, including initial implementations, life\-cycle management changes, and necessary integrations. Operation, oversight, gap remediation, and change management of these solutions as a member of the Data Protection team will be included in the day\-to\-day responsibilities. This role will oversee the Data discovery \& classification, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), \& Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) solutions for Clayco’s enterprise environment to include configuration and administration of applicable policies, alerts, Data sources, and remediation of any misconfigurations. This role will also identify and remediate gaps across dependent integrations and services to include discovery integrations, agent deployments, configuration changes, and tuning activities. **The Specifics of the Role** * As a member of the Information Security Team, contributes however and whenever necessary to Incident Response efforts as circumstances dictate. * Operates the Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) solutions to include their administration, maintenance, support, troubleshooting, and optimization of the solutions such as: * Endpoint, Network, and Cloud/SaaS DLP Platforms * Host\-based DLP Agents and CASB Connectors * Required Integrations (CASB, SaaS APIs, Identity Provider, SIEM/SOAR) * Data classification \& Sensitive Data discovery Inputs * Detection and Alert logic and configurations * Conducts regularly scheduled and ad\-hoc Data discovery and policy scans across endpoints, network, and cloud/SaaS applications, ensuring that high\-fidelity DLP and CASB detection Data is successfully and reliably ingested into the Incident Management \& Workflow Platform in coordination with GRC. * Partners with GRC and business units to map Data flows, classify Sensitive Data, and address Data\-protection gaps by aligning DLP and CASB policies with regulatory and contractual requirements (e.g., CCPA, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS) and deploying specialized controls (encryption, tokenization, blocking, or quarantine) as needed. * Develops DLP and CASB incident reports, Data\-Risk ratings, and compliance scorecards that define the current state of Data exposure for Clayco’s environment. * Designs, tests, and tunes DLP detection rules and Data classification policies (e.g., PII, PCI, PHI, source code, financials, and confidential business Data) to balance Data protection with business productivity while minimizing false positives. * Administers CASB controls for sanctioned and unsanctioned cloud applications, including Shadow IT discovery, application Risk scoring, and enforcement of access, sharing, and Data\-residency policies. * Triages, investigates, and resolves DLP and CASB alerts, coordinating with Incident Response, HR, and Legal on potential Data exfiltration and insider\-Risk events. * Maintains DLP and CASB policy, exception, and runbook documentation, and produces KRI/KPI metrics on Data\-loss events, policy violations, and remediation timelines. * Understands and complies with Clayco’s Change Management process to ensure that change is justified, tested, approved, and communicated effectively. * Serves as a senior technical resource and mentor on DLP and CASB matters, providing guidance to InfoSec Analysts and Engineers and representing the Data\-protection program in cross\-functional initiatives. * Interfaces with vendor support teams to keep abreast of developments in product lines. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Requirements** * Bachelor’s Degree (Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or Information Technology) preferred, or equivalent work experience. * Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP, (ISC)²), Cloud Security Alliance Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CSA CCSK), or equivalent (current status or obtained within 6 months of assuming role). * 6\-8 years of technical work experience in Information Security. * 3\-5 years of direct work\-related Cybersecurity Operations experience, including hands\-on experience administering and engineering Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) solutions, as well as Security Control Engineering (firewalls, email security gateways, WAFs, etc.). * Experience with scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, BASH, etc.). * Understanding of malware, emerging threats, attacks, and vulnerability exploitation with a personal drive to continue learning. * Experience in Enterprise Client\-Server, Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), \& IoT Hybrid environments and knowledge of how various technologies and processes interact and behave. * Knowledge of secure network/systems configuration management as well as an understanding of networking protocols, concepts, and devices. * Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to document functional requirements, test and validation criteria, communication plans, KRI/KPI reports, and other relevant operational communications. * Ability to respond to incidents or outages 24/7, including holidays and weekends. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment. * Minimal travel required. **Some Things You Should Know** * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! * This position is classified as a safety\-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The Clayco Nationwide salary range for this position is approximately $125,000 \- $155,000 \+/\- annually (not adjusted for location).

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Title: Systems Engineer Location: Houston, Texas Type: Direct Hire Salary: $140,000 \- $145,000 Summary: The Systems Engineer will serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert responsible for the design, architecture, implementation, administration, operation, and ongoing support of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. This role will focus on leveraging Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and Okta to deliver secure, scalable, and effective identity and access management capabilities. Duties: * Demonstrate advanced knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID features and capabilities, including Conditional Access Policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Application Registrations. * Manage and maintain PIM configurations, including the assignment and administration of roles and IAM permissions across Azure Management Groups, Subscriptions, and individual Resources. * Manage Application Registrations, Enterprise Applications, Service Principal Names (SPNs), and Managed Identities, ensuring adherence to least\-privilege principles when assigning Microsoft Graph API permissions. * Maintain and support identity security capabilities, including Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Self\-Service Password Reset (SSPR), and Windows Hello for Business (WHfB). * Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to support administrative tasks, automate processes, and schedule data management activities within Azure. * Administer and maintain Microsoft Intune policies and Windows Autopilot configurations. * Monitor new Entra ID functionality, emerging security practices, and industry developments, recommending enhancements and improvements to existing solutions. * Administer and support large\-scale Active Directory environments spanning multiple geographic locations, numerous domain controllers, and 5,000\+ users. * Maintain expertise in Active Directory infrastructure, including DNS, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), user accounts, organizational units (OUs), and directory administration. * Apply Microsoft security tiering methodologies and demonstrate a solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) principles. * Configure and maintain delegated permissions throughout the Active Directory domain and OU hierarchy. * Create and manage PowerShell scripts, automation processes, and scheduled tasks to streamline administrative operations. * Understand and execute Active Directory disaster recovery procedures, including the steps required to restore domain services following a major outage or disaster. * Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of IAM standards and technologies, including identity federation, Single Sign\-On (SSO), SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), MFA, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), and least\-privilege access principles. * Serve as an Okta subject matter expert, ingestion architectures utilizing: + Dataflow + Apache Beam + Pub/Sub + Cloud Composer + Event\-Driven Architectures * Ensure data pipelines remain scalable, resilient, and cost\-efficient. * Support near real\-time updates across ontology and knowledge graph environments. ### **Data Governance, Quality \& Lineage** * Implement automated data quality controls and validation frameworks. * Support schema discovery and metadata catalog capabilities. * Capture and maintain end\-to\-end data lineage from source systems through graph and ontology representations. * Establish governance controls including: + IAM Policies + Encryption Standards + Metadata Tracking + Lineage Instrumentation * Partner with architecture and governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards. ### ingestion, metadata, and data management solutions. * Strong expertise in: + Python + SQL * Hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including: + BigQuery + Dataflow + Pub/Sub + Cloud Composer + Cloud SQL + Google Cloud Storage (GCS) * Experience implementing: + Data Profiling + Data Lineage + Metadata Management + Data Quality Frameworks * Experience with graph technologies, including one or more of: + Spanner Graph + Neo4j + Amazon Neptune + TigerGraph + JanusGraph + RDF/SPARQL Platforms * Experience writing graph queries using: + Cypher + Gremlin + SPARQL + Equivalent Graph Query Languages * Strong understanding of data governance and metadata management principles. * Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Spanner Graph. * Experience within telecommunications environments. * Knowledge of: + OSS/BSS Systems + TM Forum SID + eTOM Frameworks * Experience with Apigee or enterprise API management platforms. * Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer Certification. * Experience building semantic search, knowledge graph, or ontology\-based solutions. * Familiarity with vector search technologies and retrieval architectures. * Experience supporting AI, knowledge management, or graph\-powered analytics initiatives. ### **Technical Expertise** Candidates should demonstrate expertise in: * Google Cloud Platform (GCP) * BigQuery * Cloud SQL * Dataflow * Pub/Sub * Cloud Composer * Dataplex * Spanner Graph * Neo4j * Amazon Neptune * TigerGraph * RDF/SPARQL * Metadata Management * Data Lineage * Data Quality * Knowledge Graphs * Semantic Search * Vector Search * Python * SQL * API Integration * Data Governance ### **Salary and Other jobs.title: Product Manager - Patient Experience
jobs.description: **About Conduit Health** ------------------------ We're rebuilding how post\-acute care gets done in America — AI\-powered, vertically integrated, and relentlessly focused on getting patients what they need without the bureaucratic nightmare. $22M\+ raised, scaling fast, and what we build in the next 12 months will touch hundreds of thousands of patients. **The Role** ------------ This is not a supporting role. A big part of that is AI. Our SMS and Voice AI systems increasingly are the patient experience, and you'll own their quality — deciding where AI runs the interaction, where it assists a human, and where a human takes over, then proving it works through disciplined evaluation. You'll work across Patient Experience, Growth Marketing, and Clinical Operations with real autonomy and a high bar. We want someone who reaches for AI before reaching for headcount and is comfortable bridging business problems with technical solutions. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * **Retention \& LTV —** own the metrics and the roadmap that move them. * **The end\-to\-end patient experience —** ongoing telehealth, the DME order journey, and lifecycle comms, treated as one system, not a set of screens. * **AI\-powered support —** decide where AI handles patient interactions end\-to\-end, where it assists a human, and where a human stays in the loop. * **LLM evaluation \& quality —** define what “good” looks like for our SMS and Voice AI, build eval sets from real conversations, catch regressions before they ship, and monitor safety in production. * **Experiment velocity —** a prioritized backlog of retention experiments and enhancements, shipped and learned from fast. * **Metrics —** define what “working” means for both retention and AI quality, and prove it. **Who You Are** --------------- * **4\+ years in product —** with meaningful time owning retention, lifecycle, or growth in a D2C product. * **AI\-native and technically fluent:** you build, prototype, and debug with AI, can speak the language of engineers, and are comfortable reasoning through potential technical solutions and tradeoffs. * **You bring a strong technical foundation** — whether through a degree in computer science or engineering, previous experience as a software engineer, or deep hands\-on experience working with technical teams. * **You think in cohorts and behavioral data —** and high ownership and minimal guardrails —** you don't wait to be told what to prioritize. * **High\-trust judgment —** you care about clarity, trust, and safety in a healthcare context. * **Bonus:** jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Conduit Health** ------------------------ Conduit Health is transforming one of the hardest, most outdated corners of post\-acute care — getting essential medical equipment and supplies into patients’ homes. We’ve built the first vertically integrated, AI\-powered platform that unites ordering, telehealth, prescriptions, insurance, and fulfillment into one seamless experience. We're the easy button for one of the least\-easy parts of managing a chronic condition. We’ve raised $22M\+ from some of the best VCs across the country, growing fast, and building the team that will define the future of post\-acute care in the U.S. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for software engineers who are excited to build the next generation of Conduit Health’s patient experience. You’ll be responsible for owning and shipping high impact products that directly affect outcomes. You'll join a small (but quickly growing!) team of engineers building the platform that's transforming patients’ access to medical equipment. Our product\-market fit is proven and demand is growing every day. We are scaling up our engineering team to meet that demand. You'll implement major features end\-to\-end, make architectural decisions that affect the entire platform, and have the ability to directly influence the engineering culture and how we build software. You can expect to tackle a wide range of challenges: * **Streamlining fulfillment**: turning complex manual workflows into elegant automations, leveraging a combination of traditional deterministic approaches and modern AI/agentic tools. * **Enhancing our end\-user experience**: building high growth customer\-facing applications that directly impact our patients and their caretakers * **External integrations**: Building external facing APIs and other creative AI\-driven solutions to give our partners ways to automate their workflows * **Being scrappy**: Running experiments, proof of concepts, and being genuinely curious in ways that shape the product roadmap. All while elevating the bar of how Conduit Health approaches engineering. This role reports directly into the Head of Engineering. **You’re the right fit if:** ---------------------------- * You’re a builder who enjoys being hands on and excited about owning features from 0 to 1 * You're a product minded engineer who likes to be involved in the "what" and "why" of the features we build * You're a strong communicator, both technically and non\-technically. * You’ve worked in early stage, high growth startup environments where you’ve had a measurable, direct impact * You have a team\-oriented mindset: you are low\-ego, deeply value good communication, documenting your thought processes, giving/receiving constructive feedback, and embracing collaboration. * You’re comfortable working across the stack (although we understand when folks lean towards one side) * You have deep experience in at least some parts of our stack: Python, Typescript, React, Postgres, MongoDB, Kubernetes, AWS * Your workflow involves deep usage of LLMs/agentic tools, and you know how to use them most effectively * You know how to stay nimble, flexible, and deal with natural ambiguity in a growing startup environment **Bonus points if:** * You have experience in the healthcare industry * You’ve dealt with compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC2, etc) **Working with us** ------------------- Conduit Health is based in NYC, with an office in Union Square. jobs.title: Research Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About \[C]Worthy** -------------------- \[C]Worthy is a tightly coordinated team of scientists, developers, and leaders moving quickly to accelerate and de\-risk ocean\-based climate solutions. We are building C\-Star, an open\-source modeling platform that systematizes ocean modeling through automated, reproducible workflows, enabling reliable, high\-fidelity simulations of ocean circulation and biogeochemistry. We use this software to support a range of applications, including ocean\-based carbon dioxide removal (CDR), an emerging technology with the potential to make significant contributions to stabilizing the climate system. We are working with external partners to establish a broad user\-base within academia, industry, and the larger ecosystem of climate\-solutions actors. ### **Role Overview** We are seeking an experienced scientific software engineer to contribute to C\-Star, our open\-source modeling toolkit. C\-Star encompasses a wide range of tools and concepts that range from scientific algorithms, data processing pipelines, workflow management, schema and software lifecycle management, and more. The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in Python software development and scientific modeling applications, and the ability to learn quickly and contribute in areas outside their current expertise. As we are actively incorporating AI into our tools and development workflows, we are seeking a candidate who is eager to utilize the latest AI\-assisted tooling to move quickly, while also understanding the fundamentals of good coding practices and displaying a commitment to learning and improving an existing codebase. The primary impact of this position is the software that you will help design and build. While opportunities to author or co\-author scientific publications may present themselves, they are not a core focus of this position. \[C]Worthy is headquartered in Boulder, CO, and a candidate who can work in\-office three days per week is preferred. Relocation expenses or fully remote positions may be considered for exceptional candidates. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, \& maintain C\-Star software components alongside a multidisciplinary, scientifically\-oriented team. * Quickly generate working software prototypes to address emerging needs and user feedback. * Independently execute on projects, keeping a focus on high\-level goals while maintaining flexibility to diagnose and solve problems as they arise. * Assist fellow developers via code reviews, design discussions, and testing. * Support internal and external users via issue review, troubleshooting, tutorials, requirement\-gathering, and documentation. * Contribute to an organizational culture of cooperation, learning, and adaptation to a changing world. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s, Master’s, Doctorate degree, or equivalent work experience in a technical field (e.g., oceanography, atmospheric science, physical science, applied mathematics, computer science). * Understanding of computationally\-heavy scientific modeling workflows, their challenges, and typical user needs. jobs.description: We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did we ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Role Overview** As our **Staff Machine Learning Engineer for Coupang Media Group (CMG), Offsite Ads**, you will be responsible for defining and building the next generation of machine learning systems, optimization platforms, and AI\-native advertising products that power Coupang's rapidly growing offsite advertising business. The Coupang Media Group (CMG) provides advertisers with a comprehensive suite of marketing solutions designed to help brands reach customers and accelerate business growth. While CMG established a leading advertising marketplace within Coupang's ecosystem, Offsite Ads extends advertiser reach beyond Coupang\-owned properties, enabling brands to engage customers across the broader internet while leveraging Coupang's unique commerce signals, first\-party audience assets, and deep understanding of shopper intent. Since its inception in 2025, the Offsite Ads business has experienced exceptional growth, achieving more than 2x year\-over\-year revenue growth for consecutive years. As we continue to scale, we are investing heavily in world\-class machine learning, large\-scale AI infrastructure, and next\-generation advertising technologies to build one of the industry's most advanced commerce media platforms. This is a unique opportunity to join and shape a fast\-growing organization with significant revenue impact and strategic importance to Coupang. You will work on some of the most challenging problems in modern advertising, including large\-scale prediction systems, bidding optimization, auction dynamics modeling, generative retrieval, foundation models, LLM\-powered advertising solutions, and agentic AI systems. Our vision extends beyond traditional offsite advertising. We are building the foundational technology that will evolve into a comprehensive advertising ecosystem spanning demand\-side platforms (DSP), supply\-side platforms (SSP), ad exchanges, and jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Full-stack Engineer (React+Node)
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** We are looking for a full\-stack engineer with strong React, Node.js, and SQL experience to join a forward\-deployed team delivering a new AI product to enterprise clients. The core product is already built, and each client is served by a small pod made up of a product lead and two engineers working alongside the firm’s consultants. Expect messy, undocumented systems and a fast feedback loop with the people using what you build. **Tasks and Deliverables** * Integrate client data sources, including warehouses, ERP, CRM, operational systems, and APIs, into the product. * Write and tune SQL queries and data pipelines that turn raw client data into reliable metrics. * Extend the product’s frontend and backend to meet client\-specific needs. * Use the product’s agent and SDK tooling to configure and extend client workflows. * Debug data quality issues on site with client IT teams and data owners. * Collaborate closely with the product manager and consultants to deliver client customizations. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience with React and Node.js in production. * Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Redux. * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on data integration experience (ETL/ELT, APIs, data warehouses). * Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks, including prompting, tool use, and evaluation. * Experience working directly with customers or end users, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to join an unfamiliar codebase and ship within the first week. **Nice to Have** * Previous experience in a forward\-deployed, solutions, or consulting engineering role. * Experience with Snowflake, dbt, or a similar modern data stack. * Experience with healthcare or medical services data, such as EHR, claims, scheduling, or revenue cycle, is a strong plus. * Familiarity with HIPAA\-aware data handling. **Engagement Highlights** * 3 to 6 month engagement. * Start date beginning November. * On\-site work Monday through Thursday, with remote work on Fridays. * Location restricted: candidates must live in the Greater Boston area (Waltham, MA), Cincinnati, OH, or Dallas, TX. * Must be authorized to work in the US.

jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Product Manager to join our Agent Builder team in our NYC office. Working in a high\-growth scale\-up, you’ll have the unique opportunity to drive innovation at scale while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance. **About the role:** ------------------- Agent Builder is where firms turn their own methodology and knowledge into AI agents, and manage those agents for their whole life, from definition to retirement. A generic agent knows nothing about how a firm works. Its methodology, guidance, templates and past work are what make an agent behave like one of the firm's own people, and that knowledge and context layer is what sets our agents apart. You'll own the Agent Builder product in Alwin, our agentic platform for audit and finance. That means the definition model behind an agent, how firms test and publish agents they can trust, and how those agents are versioned, governed and retired at scale. There's no playbook for letting professionals build, run and govern production agents in a regulated domain. You'll help write it. This is a product role with a strong technical bent, and we welcome candidates from product or technical PM backgrounds. You'll work closely with a new engineering team in New York, with our Agent Runtime, Evals and Document Intelligence teams in Amsterdam, and with the customers and domain experts who define what a good agent looks like. **Why DataSnipper?** -------------------- *The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.* We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. **For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting.** In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than **600,000 professionals across 3,000\+ organizations in 175 countries** rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than **$1\.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers**. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, *this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.* **What you'll own** ------------------- * Knowledge and context: how a firm's methodology, guidance, templates and prior work are captured, kept current, permissioned and served to agents at the moment they need them * Definition: the authoring experience and the definition model that turn a procedure into a multi\-step agent: steps, tools, knowledge sources, thresholds and human\-in\-the\-loop gates * Test and publish: how builders evaluate an agent against real cases before it ships, and the review and approval it passes before it reaches the Agent Library * Run and observe: tracing what an agent did on a live engagement, which knowledge it used and why * Govern, version and retire: permissions, change history, approvals, rolling out new versions without breaking work in progress, and retiring agents and outdated knowledge cleanly **What You Will Do:** --------------------- * Set the product direction and roadmap for Agent Builder, and make the trade\-offs explicit * Get the abstraction right: decide how much power builders get and where the guardrails sit, so agents are flexible enough to encode real methodology and consistent enough to trust * Define how we prove an agent works, with evals on real cases and results reported with a stated method, not a headline accuracy number * Treat lifecycle as product: versioning, approvals, rollout and retirement designed in from day one * Keep confidentiality central: what an agent learns from one customer's work must never reach another * Prototype flows yourself before writing specs, then write short specs and decision memos engineers can build from * Work with forward\-deployed engineers, solutions architects and go\-to\-market teams, and turn what they learn on enterprise rollouts into platform capabilities rather than one\-offs * Run discovery with the people who govern agents at customer firms, and change the plan when the evidence says so **What You Bring:** ------------------- * Experience as a PM on platform or developer\-facing products that other people build on, from a product or a technical PM background * Experience shipping LLM or agent features in production. You understand context and retrieval, tool calling, evals, human review in the loop and non\-determinism, and why "it worked in the demo" isn't evidence * Comfort with data models and system design: definition schemas, versions, immutable records, permissions, and how objects relate to each other * Experience with products that have a lifecycle customers depend on: versioning, permissions, release and deprecation * Enough technical depth to make architecture trade\-offs with engineering leads and challenge designs credibly * Discovery discipline: you separate what customers said from what you hoped they said * Hands\-on use of AI tools in your own work, including prototyping * Clear, concise writing **What sets you apart** ----------------------- * Knowledge of audit or accounting, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other expert users in regulated fields * Familiarity with how firms validate and govern tools before relying on them, and with quality management standards such as ISQM 1 * Experience with knowledge management or enterprise search: ingestion, retrieval, document\-level permissions, keeping content fresh * Experience with low\-code or configuration products, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs * Agent evaluation in practice: datasets, offline and online experiments, failure classification, measuring the effect of context on quality * Running design\-partner programmes with large enterprise customers **What We Offer:** ------------------ * Be part of one of the fastest\-growing, profitable unicorn scale\-ups with a global impact * Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth * Flexible paid time off * Comprehensive medical and dental coverage * 401K match * Paid parental leave * Company\-sponsored lunch * Hybrid mode of work (at least 3 days onsite in our New York City office) * Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills * Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices * Access to the mental health and wellness platform * Multiple social activities for team building, including company\-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together **Recruitment Process** ----------------------- * Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online) * Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online) * Panel Presentation (60 minutes, online) * Leadership interview (30 minutes, on\-site) * Final Interview (30 minutes, online) *At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.* *Our hiring decisions are merit\-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.* *We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.* *What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper.* Compensation Range: $195K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - AI Accounts
jobs.description: As a Senior Sales Engineer on Datadog's AI Accounts team, you'll serve as the technical lead for a small portfolio of the world's leading AI labs — accounts that today represent a meaningful share of Datadog's revenue and are growing faster than any cohort in our business. You'll own the technical relationship end to end, work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customer engineering teams in production, and help define how Datadog shows up for a cohort whose buying behavior looks nothing like traditional enterprise. This team was piloted earlier this year and is now being formalized. You'll be joining early enough to shape the playbook rather than inherit one. **What You'll Do** * Own the technical relationship across a small portfolio of AI labs, go deep on how each customer trains, serves, and scales their models (and/or the downstream products and platforms), and become the person their engineers call first * Partner with your AE to drive expansion inside accounts that grow unpredictably and fast: identify new workloads and teams as they spin up, and get in front of them before a need becomes a ticket * Lead discovery inside flat, engineering\-led organizations where influence sits with individual contributors rather than titles, and where there are no formal scoping calls to rely on * Run full\-scale POVs in production rather than controlled pilots: instrument real workloads at real scale, prove value against the customer's own success criteria, and work through the operational realities of doing that safely * Act as an extension of the customer's engineering/observability team rather than an external operator \- this requires judgment about which standard gates serve the customer and which to break * Work Slack\-native and asynchronously as the default, with the responsiveness and proactive posture these accounts expect: flag new features, bugs, and incidents before they ask * Bring product and engineering in early and often, and close the loop fast — leadership needs near\-real\-time signal from this cohort, and you'll be a primary source of it * Deliver technical narratives that land with engineers who pay for capability first and rationalize cost second \- savings is a downstream conversation, not an opener * Build reusable assets and patterns from each engagement so the next lab onboards faster than the last * Keep activity, deal progress, and customer context documented and current **Who You Are** * 7\+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable technical customer\-facing role; equivalent depth gained inside an AI lab, AI infrastructure company, or ML platform team is equally welcome * Hands\-on depth in the AI/ML infrastructure stack: GPU fleet management, distributed training, inference serving, model and agent evaluation, and the observability challenges specific to each * Strong foundation in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM and distributed tracing, and modern, agentic observability practice and usage patterns (i.e. MCP) * Comfortable in flat organizations \- able to engage an IC and a founder in the same week and calibrate to both without reaching for hierarchy * Biased toward doing: you'd rather solve a customer's problem and explain the shortcut afterward than ask permission first, and you have the judgment to know where that line sits * Thrive in ambiguity and unpredictable growth \- scoping, timelines, and account trajectories will change under you, repeatedly * Actively coachable. The strongest people we hire ask for a dry run, take the feedback, and visibly change what they do on the next attempt * Persistent about access. Getting time with people operating at this pace is hard, and you treat that as an interesting problem rather than a demoralizing one * Demonstrated capability using AI tooling in your own workflow and scaling it to others — credibility with this cohort depends on being a practitioner, not an observer * Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement * Willing to travel for multi\-day onsites with customer engineering teams and for industry and research conferences *Datadog values people from all walks of life.
