jobs.title: Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
jobs.description: Do you have a strong background in machine learning and deep learning? Are you interested in utilizing your data science skills and leading a small team in a fast\-paced environment to achieve strategic mission goals? If so, Deloitte has an exciting opportunity for you! As a member of our GPS GSi group, you will play a crucial role in the development and maintenance of our data science and business intelligence solutions. This role will specialize in leading machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI initiatives that will be utilized by Enterprise Solutions professionals to enhance and expedite decision\-making. You will provide expertise within and across business teams, demonstrate the ability to manage ambiguity, and apply problem\-solving skills to anticipate and resolve complex issues. **Work you'll do** * Lead the development of data science products that meet the needs of our clients, with an emphasis on the ability to transform client needs into quantifiable data science solutions and track their outcomes. * Independently manage workstreams, using critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to devise effective solutions for unique challenges and proactively identify critical business problems. * Design, train, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models to various platforms (AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.). * Lead the design of, and advise on, Large Language Model (LLM) solutions for enterprise\-wide documentation (e.g., Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Continued Pre\-training (CPT), Supervised Fine\-tuning (SFT), etc.) * Utilize Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) pipelines, including knowledge of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD for training and deploying models. * Develop cleanly written code that is sufficiently commented and easily understood by others, and ensure the team's code meets the same standard for sharing and collaboration. * Maintain structured documentation of project development stages, including the utilization of GitHub for version control and project management, and track team progress against project scope and timeline. * Build clear narratives and translate analytics into business\-relevant insights, breaking down complex analytical solutions to explain to clients and internal stakeholders. * Remain current with latest industry trends and developments in data science and/or related fields, applying them to build leading practices and respectfully challenging existing approaches, with the ability to learn new skills and knowledge and coach team members to advance the skillset of our Data Science team. * Apply thorough attention to detail, and oversee the review of the team's data science solutions for accuracy and quality. * Coach and mentor team members, and contribute to Coach and project management responsibilities. * Proactively identify risks and dependencies, and escalate appropriately. **The Team** **Government Solutions and Innovation** builds and maintains AI\-powered platforms for the GPS Practice \- acting as the connective tissue between business stakeholders, end users, and the development team, and using data to continuously improve the product experience and drive realized value. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or other analytical field * 8\+ years of experience with data science \- including having a deep knowledge \& mastery of Python, machine learning \& deep learning, and associated data science packages (e.g., sklearn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) \- and demonstrated experience leading data science projects and teams from inception to deployment. * Strong knowledge of LLMs and RAG. * Working knowledge of AWS, Databricks, and/or Snowflake platforms. * Strong knowledge of MLOps, including familiarity with containerization (e.g., Docker). * Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to manage ambiguity and work independently. * Strong organizational skills, including clear documentation of projects and ability to write clean code. * Experience leading projects using agile project methodology and/or project development lifecycle. * Experience with GitHub for version control. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex data science concepts to non\-technical audiences and build narratives that influence internal and client stakeholders. * Ability to complete work in an acceptable timeframe and manage a variety of workstreams, team priorities, and responsibilities simultaneously and with accuracy to meet deadlines, goals, and objectives and satisfy internal and external customer needs related to the job. * Demonstrated experience coaching or mentoring other data scientists. * Ability to travel 15%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. **Preferred:** * Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or other analytical field, OR comparable direct work experience. * Significant experience with MLOps and associated serving frameworks (i.e., FastAPI, etc.) and orchestration pipelines (e.g., SageMaker Pipelines, Step Functions, etc.). * Significant experience working with open source LLMs (e.g., serving via TGI / vLLM, performing CPT and/or SFT, etc.). * Experience using various AWS Services (e.g., Eventbridge, EC2, Lambda, Textract, etc.). * Knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $118,700 to $197,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II- Marketing Measurement
jobs.description: Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in data and technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **Lead** **AI and Data Science Engineer II** **\- Marketing Measurement,** you will have the opportunity to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery. **Work you'll do/Responsibilities** As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer, you will provide technical and analytical leadership for marketing measurement initiatives. You will guide teams in designing rigorous measurement approaches, turning findings into investment recommendations, and improving the quality and consistency of analytics delivery. * Lead the design and evaluation of experimental and quasi\-experimental analyses to measure marketing effectiveness and incremental impact. * Set measurement approaches for geo\-based test\-and\-control studies, paid media, and platform ecosystems such as Google and YouTube. * Guide the application of causal inference, incrementality measurement, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and A/B testing. * Translate measurement results into clear recommendations on marketing strategy and investment allocation. * Establish and promote standards for data validation, analytical quality, documentation, and communicating assumptions and limitations. * Review analytical work and provide technical direction, coaching, and feedback to team members. * Lead client workstreams, coordinate across business and technical teams, and manage priorities and delivery risks. * Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in clear, business\-friendly language; escalate material issues to engagement management. * Identify opportunities to improve measurement processes, workflows, and outcomes. * Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management * Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated solutions across software, data, AI, networks, and cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission\-critical operations. AI \& Data teams help clients modernize technology and data platforms while delivering scalable, high\-value outcomes tailored to their business needs. **Qualifications** **Required** * 10\+ years of relevant experience in data science, marketing analytics, marketing measurement, or a related field. * Advanced SQL proficiency and substantial hands\-on experience using Python or R for analysis. * Demonstrated experience leading marketing measurement or analytics initiatives. * Strong experience with MMM, causal inference, incrementality measurement, geo\-based test\-and\-control design, experiment design, and A/B testing. * Ability to assess data quality and analytical methods, and to explain limitations and assumptions. * Proven ability to guide teams and communicate recommendations to senior business and technical stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Preferred * Experience with campaign effectiveness management. * Experience with customer segmentation. * Experience measuring promotions management and effectiveness. * Additional experience in marketing analytics. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $122,000 to $240,500\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. **Recruiting tips** From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters. **Our people and culture** Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. **Our purpose** Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more. **Professional development** From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Qualified applicants with criminal histories, including arrest or conviction records, will be considered for employment in accordance with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, City of Los Angeles's Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act. See notices of various fair chance hiring and ban\-the\-box laws where available. **Fair Chance Hiring and Ban\-the\-Box Notices \- Deloitte US Careers**

jobs.title: Manager, Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Manager, Cloud Data Engineer** Join our AI \& Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission\-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest /advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. Recruiting for this role ends on 11/13/26\. Work you'll do As a Lead Data Engineer II on the AI \& Data team, you will be responsible for leading the design and delivery of scalable technical solutions for client engagements. * Lead small engagements or key workstreams within larger technology transformation programs for clients * Manage cross\-functional distributed delivery teams and client relationships across the engagement lifecycle, while contributing to proposal and business development efforts * Oversee quality of team deliverables and recommendations while contributing to hands\-on solution delivery across distributed teams A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others The team Our AI \& Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively. **Qualifications** Required: * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering and distributed data platforms, including architecting and governing enterprise\-scale Big Data, cloud, and AI/ML platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP, and on\-premises environments, with deep Databricks Lakehouse expertise: Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, Auto Loader, PySpark, and Spark SQL. * 3\+ years of experience designing and developing Cloud based Azure and AWS\-based data engineering solutions, with hands\-on experience using services such as AWS Glue, EMR, EKS, S3, Lambda, RDS, OpenSearch and CloudWatch * 2\+ years of experience leading and delivering engagements with geographically distributed, cross\-functional teams * Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, information technology, or a related field * Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Preferred: * Master's degree * Experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, or MLflow * Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) * Experience designing batch and streaming data pipelines * Experience with data governance, data quality, or platform security controls * Experience supporting client presentations, proposals, or solution demonstrations The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. jobs.title: SAP AI Engineer III
jobs.description: **Role Overview:** As an Applied AI Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to building and enhancing high\-visibility, SAP full\-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte's product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across full\-stack software engineering and modern frameworks\-together with applied AI fluency that lets you build GenAI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver\-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high\-quality, outcome\-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Outcome\-Driven Accountability:** Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes\-and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high\-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build. * **Technical Leadership and Advocacy:** Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, testing, integrations, and support. * **Engineering Craftsmanship:** Maintain accountability for code\-design integrity, implementation fidelity to architecture and tech stack, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high\-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time. * **Incremental and Iterative Delivery:** Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Integration:** Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well\-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. * **Advanced Technical Proficiency:** Possess expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. * **Domain Expertise:** Quickly acquire domain\-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. * **Effective Communication and Influence:** Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well\-structured arguments and trade\-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. * **Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation:** Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co\-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. **The team:** US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. **Required Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. * 5\+ years of experience with most of the following: ABAP Cloud, RAP , CDS, S/4 HANA extensibility, Clean core, FIORI, ODATA, BTP, CPI , DEVOPS, Joule Studio, RAG, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, as well as unit testing frameworks. * 3\+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands\-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (using SAP's Business AI capabilities, generative AI hub, Joule, and Joule Studio), parameter mapping, Document grounding, Joule environment management, Prompt injection, data leakage, authorization boundaries, Responsible AI and AI agent orchestration. * 3\+ years of experience with building SAP\-connected applications and extensions using modern cloud engineering patterns, such as containers, Kubernetes, microservices, APIs, events, CI/CD, and managed cloud services, while running on infrastructure from Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI\-augmented spec\-driven development. * Prior experience using methodologies \& tools such as XP, Lean, SAP Activate \+ Agile product delivery \+ Fit\-to\-Standard \+ Clean Core \+ DevSecOps/CI\-CD \+ automated testing. etc. to deliver high\-quality products rapidly. **Other:** * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,500 \- $210,600\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. jobs.title: Associate Electrical Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Associate Electrical Engineering Manager** 11/06/2026 **Reports to:** Senior Electrical Engineering Manager **Direct Reports:** Electrical Engineer I and Electrical Engineer II positions (headcount as assigned, 8\-12 team members) **Position Type/Hours:** Full\-time, on\-site position. Core office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. **Position Purpose:** The Associate Electrical Engineering Manager is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing early\-career electrical engineering team members while supporting the successful execution of electrical engineering deliverables across custom automation and capital equipment projects. This role serves as a working manager who balances people leadership, technical guidance, project execution, and resource coordination. The Associate Electrical Engineering Manager focuses on building engineering capability, ensuring design quality, supporting project schedules, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where engineers can successfully grow their technical and professional skills. This leader works closely with the Senior Electrical Engineering Manager to implement department standards, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and support overall engineering excellence. This position should demonstrate a passion for serving others and a commitment to creating a people first, values\-based culture that supports Delta ModTech's purpose of serving people by solving problems. **Essential Functions:** **People Leadership \& Team Development** * Directly lead, mentor, coach, and develop Electrical Engineer I and Electrical Engineer II team members. * Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, performance discussions, and career development planning. * Identify strengths, development opportunities, and training needs within the team. * Assist in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and retaining engineering talent. * Provide day\-to\-day guidance and support to engineers working on customer projects. * Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, ownership, continuous learning, and problem solving. * Promote effective communication and teamwork across engineering and cross functional departments. * Support succession planning and development of future technical leaders. * Model, steward, make decisions upon, and expect to be held accountable to Delta ModTech's values: BELIEVE IN PEOPLE FEARLESS INNOVATION INTEGRITY PASSIONATE \& TENACIOUS SERVANT LEADERSHIP **Technical Leadership \& Engineering Support** * Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers on electrical designs, controls architecture, PLC and HMI programming, machine safety, and automation solutions. * Review electrical schematics, panel designs, bills of material, and software documentation for accuracy and completeness. * Support engineering teams in applying electrical standards, best practices, and approved design methodologies. * Escalate significant technical risks, roadblocks, or resource concerns to the Senior Electrical Engineering Manager. * Assist in maintaining and improving engineering standards, reusable design solutions, and documentation practices. * Support troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during design, commissioning, startup, and field support activities. * Encourage sound engineering decision making and application of first principles thinking. **Project Execution \& Resource Coordination** * Coordinate engineering assignments and workload balancing for Electrical Engineer I and II team members. * Monitor project progress and proactively address schedule or resource constraints. * Ensure assigned deliverables are completed accurately and on time. * Own day\-to\-day resource planning, work assignments, and priorities for assigned Electrical Engineer I and II team members, in alignment with department priorities established by the Senior Electrical Engineering Manager. * Assist with identifying project risks and implementing mitigation plans. * Ensure accountability for commitments, deadlines, and quality standards. * Support continuous improvement efforts focused on engineering efficiency and project execution. * Cross\-Functional team collaboration * Partner effectively with project management, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, assembly, , supply chain, and sales teams. * Partner with Service leadership to coordinate EE support for customer escalations, field issues, startup support, and technical troubleshooting while balancing project commitments. * Facilitate communication between engineering team members and stakeholders. * Support issue resolution and decision making to maintain project momentum. * Ensure a positive working relationship throughout the organization. * Continuous Improvement * Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, workflows, standards, and documentation. * Support implementation of department initiatives established by the Senior Electrical Engineering Manager. * Encourage a mindset of innovation, learning, and continuous improvement. **Education \& Experience** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related field. * 5\+ years of electrical engineering or automation engineering experience, preferably within custom machinery, converting equipment, industrial automation, or capital equipment manufacturing. * 2\+ years of leadership experience or demonstrated ability to lead project teams, mentor engineers, and influence others. * Strong knowledge of electrical controls systems, PLCs, HMIs, motion control, industrial networks, machine safety, and electrical design practices. * Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills. * Demonstrated ability to manage priorities and support multiple projects simultaneously. **Preferred** * Experience leading engineers in a custom machine building environment. * Experience with Yaskawa, Rockwell, or Siemens automation platforms. * Experience with AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or similar design software. * Familiarity with NFPA 70, NFPA 79, UL 508A, OSHA requirements, and machine safety standards. * Experience supporting project planning, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. **Position Type, Work Environment \& Travel** * Full time, exempt * Normal office environment * Travel less than 10%. **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit. The employee frequently is required to walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must frequently lift or move objects up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. **Salary Range:** $130,000 \- $170,000 per year (DOE \- Depending on Experience) **Benefits Offered:** * **Medical Insurance** * **Dental Insurance** * **Vision Insurance** * **Short\-Term Disability** * **Long\-Term Disability** * **Flexible Spending Account (FSA)** * **Life Insurance** * **Health Savings Account (HSA)** with up to $500 annual match (for High Deductible Health Plans) * **401(k)** \***match** * **Paid Time Off (PTO)** * **Discretionary Bonus**

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sutton** Sutton is an AI native operating system for growing companies. Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us. Sutton Studio is where anyone can build on top of the platform. You describe an app, dashboard or workflow in plain English, and it is built on live operational data, with Sutton's security and permissions underneath. We have raised $6\.3M from leading venture investors, and our customers run real operations on Sutton at scale, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company with more than 18,000 apartments, a top US research university and precision machine shops. The work you ship here has an impact you can see. We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days. **The role** We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders. There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. The work spans our core product, the apps we build with customers, and the platform that keeps all of it fast and safe. **What you will do** You will pick up whatever matters most that week, and the mix will change. Our stack is Node.js, GraphQL and Postgres with a React front end, and we use Claude Code and Cursor every day. Typical work: * Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit * Build the platform behind Studio and customer built apps: scoped per customer tokens, a permissions model where each app declares what it touches, server side validation and audit logging tagged by app * Own reliability for a multi tenant production system: monitoring, alerting, backups and restores, incident response and safe rollbacks * Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops * Extend our API and MCP server so AI assistants and apps can safely read and write operational data like inventory, production and orders * Work on real world features: barcode scanning, label printing and streams of machine sensor data * Turn customer feedback into product improvements, shipped in days instead of months **Who we are looking for** We are looking for driven builders who understand the business problem behind the code. You think in systems, move quickly, and use AI to multiply your own output. You do not need to be an expert in every layer or fit a single profile. What matters is that you are strong across the stack and committed to creating a customer outcome, with an open mind about how to get there. * You can design a GraphQL schema, fix a slow Postgres query and debug a React state issue in the same afternoon * You have built multi tenant SaaS and care about tenant isolation, safe migrations and per customer configuration * You have run production systems largely on your own, and you know how to monitor, back up, roll back and recover them * You have solid security fundamentals: authentication and authorization, scoped tokens, secrets handling and audit trails * You are comfortable reading vendor API docs and building integrations that hold up: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries and idempotency * You work AI native every day with Claude Code or similar, and have opinions on the tests, CI checks and review that make AI written code safe to ship * You own outcomes: you talk to the people who use what you build, act without being asked, do what it takes to figure things out, and explain tradeoffs clearly to non engineers Bonus points for experience with ERP, inventory or accounting systems, Cloudflare Workers, SOC 2, or hardware like scanners and sensors. **How we work** Speed and trust are not a tradeoff here, and everyone is expected to ship. * **Speed is a feature.** We ship small, ship often and learn from customers. * **Build fast, run safe.** We build on a platform that makes the safe way the easy way. * **Everyone ships.** Every role puts something real in front of a customer or teammate every week. * **Small team, big ownership.** You own outcomes, not tasks. * **Candor with care.** We say the hard thing early, directly and kindly. **Why Sutton** You will shape an AI native ERP that customers run real operations on every day, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company and a top research university. * Help define the product and its architecture, not inherit a pile of tickets * Direct access to the founders and to real customers * A small team where your work visibly changes what customers experience * Location: US based and flexible for the right person, with a bonus for being near our founders in Atlanta or Southern California * Base salary of $165,000 to $210,000 per year, plus meaningful equity * Unlimited PTO, 401(k), medical, dental and vision, and team onsites **How we hire** The process is short and practical: a short intro call with our Founding Engineer, a coding challenge, a follow up conversation to talk through it, and a meeting with the founders. You will get a real Sutton style app to harden and extend using the AI tools you already use. We look at your speed, your judgment and how you explain your decisions. Pay: $165,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Unlimited paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: ### **About Digital Dynamics Inc.** Digital Dynamics Inc. (DDI) is a 100% employee‑owned company (ESOP), where all employees share in the benefit of our continued growth. Our culture fosters accountability, collaboration, and long‑term thinking. DDI designs and builds reliable, high‑performance control hardware for semiconductor and industrial applications. As an ISO 9001 certified company with decades of design and manufacturing experience, we create advanced controllers and I/O solutions for mission‑critical environments. All products are designed and built at our facilities in beautiful Scotts Valley, CA. #### **Position Summary** Digital Dynamics, Inc. is seeking a motivated Software Engineer I to join our engineering team. This position is ideal for a near\-term graduate or early\-career software engineer who is looking to expand their technical skills while contributing to real\-world software applications and systems. The Software Engineer I will assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications that support our engineering and manufacturing operations. This role will work closely with experienced engineers and cross\-functional teams to develop reliable, efficient, and scalable software solutions. The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in software development, strong problem\-solving skills, and a willingness to learn and grow in a collaborative engineering environment. #### **Key Responsibilities** * Assist in the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications and backend services * Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrations between software systems * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, or JavaScript * Support database development, including SQL queries, data modeling, and database maintenance * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software issues with guidance from experienced engineers * Participate in software design discussions, code reviews, and technical planning * Assist in developing internal tools and applications that improve engineering and manufacturing workflows * Write and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications and testing procedures * Collaborate with software, hardware, test, and manufacturing engineering teams * Support software testing, validation, and continuous improvement initiatives * Apply software development best practices, including version control, automated testing, and CI/CD processes #### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field * 1–3 years of professional software development experience; candidates with as little as 1 year of post\-college experience are encouraged to apply * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, C\+\+, or JavaScript * Solid understanding of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms * Basic understanding of REST APIs and backend application development * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL * Experience using Git or other version control systems * Understanding of software development lifecycle principles and debugging techniques * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills * Ability to work collaboratively and learn new technologies #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Spring Boot, or Node.js * Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript * Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or other relational databases * Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command\-line tools * Exposure to Docker, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines * Experience with unit testing, integration testing, or automated testing frameworks * Familiarity with software architecture, API design, and system integration * Exposure to embedded systems, hardware/software integration, or manufacturing environments * Experience developing applications through professional work, internships, or academic projects #### **Our Total Rewards Philosophy** We believe rewarding employees extends beyond base compensation. Our total rewards approach is designed to recognize performance, support long\-term growth, and create shared success through competitive pay, bonus program eligibility, participation in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), which provides employees the opportunity to share in the company’s long\-term success, 401(k) match, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, paid time off, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a 100% employee\-owned company. #### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Digital Dynamics Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description: Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world's most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production\-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies. Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built. **Purpose** ----------- This Design Engineer role involves bridging design and production, creating and optimizing innovative product designs for manufacturability, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring compliance with internal and industry standards. This role works in collaboration with other integrated project team (IPT) members to produce, review and mature high quality technical documentation, including CAD models, drawings, PMI's, DFMEA's, bills of material, and engineering specifications. The role's expertise in CAD, GD\&T, and PLM systems ensures that engineering design intent is implemented in a manner that is accurate, functional, and manufacturable, meeting customer expectations and Divergent's standards for quality and consistency. **The Role** ------------ * Challenge existing design requirements and define new design standards for product functions and features, based on regulations, DFM/DFAM, and product attributes. * Act as SME for PLM, GD\&T, CAD\-design best practices and lesson learned. * Ensure all designs meet required engineering, manufacturability, and industry standards, addressing issues during the release phase. * Accountable and responsible for protecting the quality of the final engineering products (released designs, CAD, Drawings, \& PMI), ensuring the production team receives data that meets quality and usability standards. * Check technical documentation (incl. drawings, PMI, BOM's, DFMEA, specs, etc.) before being released into PLM, enforcing compliance to internal SOP and guidelines. * Analyze drawings, models, and documentation for GD\&T accuracy, completeness, manufacturability, assemble\-ability and inspectability. * Support active programs by creating and managing design engineering data, as requested by the IPT. * Manage ongoing production NCR's and dispositions, collaborating with ME's and RE's. * Support the implementation of ECR/ECO's for production parts, as required or needed. * Work cross\-functionally to implement cost reduction, methods and product improvements, and support prototype and production build activities. * Identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and process improvement in GD\&T and PMI practices. * Support the training of new personnel for the area of competence. * Maintain and organize design documentation and reference material, ensuring all revisions and updates are properly documented, stored, and disseminated to the broader team. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls. * BS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. * Aerospace or automotive design background. * 2\+ years of CAD experience creating detailed models. * 2\+ years of PLM/PDM experience. * Solid understanding of common manufacturing and assembly methods, GD\&T, and tolerance/stack\-up analysis. * Experience with PMI, DFMEA, control plans, PPAP and APQP. * Experience with ASME Y14\.100, Y14\.5, Y14\.41\. * Self\-motivated with strong multi\-tasking, organizational, communication and documentation skills. * Ability to work well in an integrated team including daily interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers. * Attention to detail and record keeping. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * MS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. * 2\+ years of Siemens NX experience. * 2\+ years of Teamcenter experience. * Experience interfacing with engineering, manufacturing and quality teams to understand system designs and the associated constraints. * Experience in CMM programming in a CNC machine shop (Mills, Lathes \& EDM). * Experience with fast iteration prototyping programs. * Demonstrated development and configuration management experience on technically complex hardware products. * Expertise in design for manufacturability and design for assembly including experience taking products from prototype design to production. * Solid understanding of common manufacturing materials and processes, including mills, lathes, welding, sheet\-metal bending, lifting/rigging, assembly, inspection, etc. Additive manufacturing is a plus. * Working knowledge of all chassis systems and vehicle dynamics fundamentals. * Proficiency in Atlassian tools (Confluence, JIRA). **Work Environment** -------------------- * Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards. **Compensation** ---------------- At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E03 \- E05 as evaluated through our interview process. * E03 / Engineer I: $105,980 \- $145,730 * E04 / Engineer II: $122,430 \- $168,340 * E05 / Senior Engineer: $141,380 \- $194,390 **What We Offer Our Regular, Full\-Time Employees:** * **Holistic Compensation Package:** Enjoy a world\-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results\-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions. * **Wellness and Time Off:** Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year\-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time. * **Comprehensive Health and Wellness:** Prioritize your well\-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company\-sponsored life insurance and short and long\-term disability coverage for peace of mind. * **Investment in Growth:** We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance. * **Collaborative and High\-Performing Environment:** Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high\-performing team within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint. ***Equal Employment Opportunity*** *Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.* *EEO Poster* *In order to adjust to changes in our business, it may become necessary to add, remove or modify certain duties and responsibilities, or to reassign you to another job position. From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.* ***E\-Verify: Right to Work*** *Our company participates in* *E\-Verify**. E\-Verify is a program that electronically confirms a candidate's eligibility to work in the United States after completing the Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I\-9\). The information provided on the Form I\-9 is compared to the records contained in the Social Security Administration and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) databases. This helps employers verify the identity and employment eligibility of newly hired employees.* *Eligibility to Work Poster (English)* *\|* *Eligibility to Work Poster (Spanish)* ***Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO)*** *Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO), we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* ***No agencies, no solicitations, and no calls please.***

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1\.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI\-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ As the Lead Assignment Engine Data Engineer, you will lead the data engineering design for an explainable, configurable engine that converts normalized cloud and operational data into actionable cost attribution. You will define how shared pools such as observability, storage, networking, SQL, and data platforms are assigned to the products and services that consume them. You will operate at the boundary of data engineering, FinOps, Finance, and platform architecture. The role requires strong technical judgment, the ability to turn ambiguous allocation questions into durable data products, and the leadership to establish patterns that other engineers can extend. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering. **Responsibility** * Build batch and/or streaming pipelines for Azure and GCP billing data, with an architecture that can extend to additional cloud providers * Normalize provider\-specific billing and usage data into a consistent, FOCUS\-aligned model * Ingest and join resource inventory, tagging, ownership, product, service, and environment metadata * Implement reconciliation checks between source billing systems, the normalized warehouse, and downstream reporting datasets * Establish data contracts, schemas, lineage, freshness checks, completeness checks, and failure\-handling patterns * Create reusable transformations that support executive dashboards, product\-level cost views, burn\-rate reporting, and anomaly detection * Build operational visibility for pipeline health, including freshness, latency, volume, schema drift, and failed\-record monitoring * Partner with platform, FinOps, Finance, and service\-owning teams to resolve data\-quality gaps and improve attribution coverage * Document pipeline behavior, ownership, runbooks, recovery procedures, and known data limitations * Improve automation, test coverage, deployment safety, and cost efficiency of the data platform * Build or integrate event\-driven ingestion patterns so new Cost Management exports trigger processing without manual refreshes * Participate in on\-call rotations and contribute to improving system reliability and incident response * Support Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake, Data Factory, and KQL\-based consumption patterns where they fit the target architecture **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * 12\+ years of professional experience designing and delivering production data platforms or data products, including experience leading technical design for complex data systems * Experience with SQL and Python or an equivalent data\-engineering language * Experience with data modeling, ELT/ETL architecture, orchestration, testing, observability, and operational ownership * Experience translating business rules into scalable, configurable, and auditable data\-processing systems * Experience leading technical decisions across multiple teams and stakeholders **Preferred** * FinOps, cloud\-cost allocation, showback/chargeback, cost\-to\-serve, or unit\-economics systems * Multi\-cloud billing normalization and FOCUS\-aligned data models * Shared\-cost allocation across observability, storage, networking, databases, or data platforms * Finance\-system and revenue\-data integration * Forecasting, anomaly detection, performance\-to\-cost analytics, or margin reporting * Technical leadership or mentoring responsibility for a data\-engineering team * Experience designing FinOps data products on Microsoft Fabric or a comparable eventhouse/warehouse architecture * Experience with repeatable infrastructure or deployment automation, pre\-flight validation, idempotent recovery, and verification reporting * Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain data lineage, assumptions, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical audiences **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: California: $188,300\.00 \- $266,000\.00 base salary Washington: $164,700\.00 \- $232,575\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Work Authorization Notice:** Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Structural Simulation
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash Labs is the hardware and autonomy innovation engine at DoorDash. We design, build, and deploy custom robotics and autonomous delivery systems designed to operate safely, efficiently, and reliably in urban environments. We are currently kicking off development on our clean\-sheet, next\-generation robot platform—rethinking the mobility foundation from first principles to dramatically improve efficiency, payload dynamics, and service lifetime. **About the Role** ------------------ As a **Senior Structural Simulation Engineer (Level IC5\)**, you will be the foundational structural analysis authority for DoorDash Labs. You will own structural finite element analysis (FEA) across our next\-generation robotic platform, working directly on core vehicle architecture—including chassis systems, suspension, closures, and sensor enclosures. This role will be heavily focused on future\-forward designs starting from the early concept phase. In your first 90 days, you will drive our architectural exploration, define early vehicle load cases, and make strategic software ecosystem decisions (including standardizing and driving our commercial commitments around simulation tools). As development advances, you will shift from rapid concept modeling to production\-intent structural refinement and physical test\-to\-simulation correlation. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will:** ----------------------------------------------------------- * **Build From Day Zero:** Lead structural concept validation for a ground\-up robotic platform, running high\-velocity trade studies alongside chassis, suspension, and closures engineers. * **Define Our Tooling \& Workflows:** Evaluate, select, and operationalize our primary CAE/FEA software tech stack (with an emphasis on ANSYS\-based suites), negotiating capabilities and technical fit directly with vendors. * **Establish Load Cases \& Criteria:** Formulate first\-principles structural load cases, fatigue histories, stiffness benchmarks, and failure criteria for dynamic ground vehicle environments where little historical data exists. * **Simulate Critical Vehicle Subsystems:** Execute complex static, dynamic, modal, durability, and fatigue analyses on structural enclosures, cast and sheet\-metal subframes, linkages, and moving mechanisms. * **Drive Test\-Simulation Correlation:** Partner with physical test teams to correlate strain gauge, modal shaker, and dynamic field testing data back into simulation models to maximize predictive accuracy. * **Influence Primary Architecture:** Act as the math\-first checkpoint for mechanical design decisions, steering CAD geometry toward optimized strength\-to\-weight ratios before parts hit prototype tooling. **We're excited about you because:** ------------------------------------ * **Deep Structural Domain Expertise:** You bring 7\+ years of hands\-on structural FEA and mechanical simulation experience (or an advanced degree—MS/PhD—with 4\+ years) focused on structural integrity, stiffness, fatigue life, and dynamic loading. * **Vehicle \& Robotics Systems Background:** You have a demonstrated track record analyzing moving vehicle architectures—such as automotive body\-in\-white (BIW), chassis frames, suspensions, structural battery enclosures, robotics, drones, or high\-performance mobility platforms. * **Software Mastery (ANSYS Preferred):** You are an advanced user of industry\-standard finite element solvers (ANSYS Mechanical/Workbench strongly preferred; Abaqus, OptiStruct/HyperMesh, or LS\-DYNA considered) and understand solver theory, element formulations, and convergence troubleshooting. * **First\-Principles Mechanical Rigor:** You possess strong mathematical and classical mechanics fundamentals; you don't just hit "solve," but can gut\-check stress distributions and shear loads with hand calculations. * **Ambiguity \& Green\-Field Ownership:** You thrive in early\-stage product definitions where requirements are fluid, documentation is sparse, and decisions must be made quickly with high technical conviction. * **Cross\-Functional Communication:** You clearly translate complex FEA stress tensors, fatigue curves, and deflection limits into actionable design guidance for mechanical design engineers and leadership. ### **Nice to Haves:** * Prior experience establishing or transitioning a company's CAE software stack from scratch. * Background in topology optimization, lightweighting cast/extruded aluminum structures, or composite material modeling. * Direct experience running durability and fatigue analysis on systems subject to rough\-road, curb\-strike, or cyclic vibrational abuse. * Working familiarity with CAD tools (e.g., NX, SolidWorks, or Creo) for rapid geometry defeature and design iteration. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** **Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools:** To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview. **How it works:** Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support \- rather than replace \- human decision\-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI\-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law. **Data Retention, Privacy \& Bias Audit:** Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en\-us/legal/article/ax\-privacy\-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden\-ai.com/metaview/application\-review.

jobs.title: Operations Research Scientist
jobs.description: Come help us build the world's most reliable on\-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're bringing on experienced scientists/engineers to help us create the real\-time logistics platform that powers DoorDash's three\-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. You will be reporting to an Operations Research manager and this will be a hybrid role. **About the Role** ------------------ Operations Research Scientists on the Assignment team have the opportunity to dive into a wealth of logistics data, and use advanced optimization and machine learning techniques to maximize the value for our consumers, dashers, merchants, and DoorDash. You will be reporting to an Operations Research manager and this will be a hybrid role. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will...** ------------------------------------------------------------- * Design and implement new algorithm components within our production dispatching system to meet emerging requirements * Integrate state\-of\-the\-art optimization and machine learning techniques to improve the efficiency and quality of our dispatching decisions * Extract insights from logistics system through analyzing data and modeling and translate those insights into production algorithm components * Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product managers, business operators, and more to develop cross\-cutting and scalable solutions to guide value for our consumers, dashers, and merchants **We're excited about you because you have...** ----------------------------------------------- * PhD in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science, or a related field * 2\+ years of post\-graduate research or industry experience in solving complex optimization problems using mathematical programming or metaheuristics * Programming fundamentals, experience in object\-oriented and functional programming languages, and an understanding of algorithms * Must be comfortable regularly exercising discretion and independent judgment in performing job duties, including evaluating options, making informed decisions, and determining appropriate courses of action within the scope of assigned responsibilities. Please ### **Your Zone** Check Read more about our Benefits. ### **Company Description** Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise\-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you. ### **Team Description** The Dropbox Finance Team creates the financial infrastructure that powers our growth and scales our business. We combine analytical precision with bold thinking to build sustainable value for our company and stakeholders. More than traditional accountants, auditors, and finance managers, we're strategic partners who craft the financial architecture that enables innovation. Working closely with internal teams and external partners, we continuously look for ways to drive business impact while maintaining trust, accuracy, and rigor in everything we do. If you're ready to own your impact on Dropbox’s financial future, join our Finance team. ### **Virtual First** Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in\-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on\-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location. This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5\-10% of the year or 2\-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process. ### **AI Fluency** AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others. We look for four key behaviors in candidates: * **Ownership**: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work. * **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices. * **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s. * **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

In your first three months, you'll ship at least one major EHR or health system integration from spec to go\-live, own a core platform service in production, and build reusable integration tooling that makes each new go\-live faster than the last.
