jobs.title: Staff UX Designer
jobs.description: ### **About Us** AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation. The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety \- AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours. AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets. The companies building AI trust us to secure it \- our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few. Endor Labs is the third company from Founder \& CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital. Software runs everything around our lives today \- banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us. ### **About the Role** AI agents now write a growing share of enterprise code, and the way people interact with security is changing with it. Developers increasingly work through agents rather than dashboards, and security teams need to govern what those agents do with evidence they can defend. Nobody has defined what great looks like here yet. Our users range from developers who want answers inside the tools they already use, to security leaders who manage risk across thousands of applications. Designing for both, in dense, technical and high\-stakes workflows, is the job. As a Staff UX Designer, you’ll set the design direction for our platform, define how people and AI work together in it, and raise the bar for design quality across the company. ### **How You'll Make an Impact** * Set the design vision and strategy for your products, and align product, engineering and leadership around it. * Define new interaction models for AI\- and agent\-driven experiences, beyond traditional GUIs. * Lead design for the most ambiguous, cross\-cutting problems, spanning web apps, developer tools and conversational interfaces. * Establish principles for trustworthy AI experiences: explainability, confidence, evidence and human control over automation. * Shape experiences for governing complex systems at scale: policy, auditability and reporting across large organizations. * Drive a research program with customers, and use it to influence the roadmap, not just the UI. * Own the evolution of our design system and design practices, and mentor designers across the team. * Partner with product marketing and sales on demos, launches and customer evaluations where the experience is the differentiator. ### **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of product or UX design experience, including senior or staff\-level ownership of complex products. * A portfolio that shows design strategy and shipped outcomes, not just polished screens. * Proven experience designing AI, LLM or agentic products, including novel interaction patterns. * A track record of influencing roadmap and strategy across product, engineering and executive stakeholders. * Experience building or scaling a design system and mentoring other designers. * Hands\-on craft: you still design and prototype, including in code or with AI tools. * Clear writing and communication with customers, engineers, and executives. **Nice to have**: experience designing security products; B2B or enterprise SaaS experience with complex workflows; a background in software engineering or developer experience; experience as a founding or early designer at a startup. ### **Why Join Endor Labs?** We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest\-growing spaces in software. Our dev\-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right. At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win. **Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one\-size\-fits\-all here. Compensation: For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the base salary is expected to be between $140,000 \- $200,000\. This may include incentives/variable compensations such as commissions, stock options and/or bonuses, depending on the position. Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

jobs.description: Hi! I'm Montana, the Technical Services Manager at EnsoData. The VP of Customer Success, Kelsey, and I are looking for a new team member who is passionate about making healthcare better and being a great teammate! EnsoData is seeking a Senior Technical Services Engineer (Healthcare and/or Software as a Medical Device \- SaMD) to contribute to our customer\-facing technical services team, ensuring the successful implementation, deployment, and support of our software solutions in the healthcare industry. This position offers a flexible work environment, competitive salary of $100,000 \- $105,000, stock options, plus benefits such as paid time off, healthcare insurance, and more. ### **About the Role** As the Senior Technical Services Engineer, you will be part of a technical support team while working closely with our Customer Success and Engineering teams. You will play a vital role in shaping the customer experience and ensuring that our SaMD offerings are effectively integrated into healthcare environments. Your work will help drive efficiency, effectiveness, and overall customer satisfaction. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Manage and prioritize multiple incoming customer issues, balancing urgency and impact to ensure timely resolution * Effectively troubleshoot complex technical issues within web\-based, mobile, and desktop applications * Document and follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for appropriate escalation of issues to internal teams as needed, develop documentation to assist other TSEs with processes * Responsible for driving internal projects, maintaining clear documentation and proactive communication with stakeholders to ensure alignment and follow\-through * Responsible for becoming a subject matter expert on complex technical areas and mentoring team members in these areas * Provide timely and appropriate communication with the customer to explain the steps required to solve their issue * Take ownership of escalated customers and independently make thoughtful yet impactful decisions that best suit the customer and company As EnsoData continues to grow across multiple teams, we may consider qualified candidates for other current or future opportunities that closely align with their experience, skills, and career interests. If another role appears to be a strong mutual fit, our team may reach out to discuss it with you. **Requirements** ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, engineering, or healthcare) * 7\+ years of experience in technical services, customer support, or related fields within the healthcare or software industries * 3\+ years in a healthcare or healthcare adjacent role * Experience troubleshooting and debugging code, ideally within web\-based applications hosted in cloud environments (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure), including performance issues, API failures, and infrastructure\-related problems * Exceptional communication and problem\-solving abilities, both technical and non\-technical * Ability to manage complex technical customer escalations and ensure communication and resolution in a timely manner. * Demonstrated experience with Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and a solid understanding of healthcare regulations such as HIPAA and FDA guidelines (preferred) * Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, including how to design, troubleshoot and integrate with them * Experience in Python, React, React Native, MongoDB, Postgres, and/or GCP ### **About EnsoData** EnsoData strives to make healthcare more accurate, efficient, and affordable through waveform artificial intelligence (AI) technology. Using AI and machine learning, our software analyzes billions of data points collected from sensors placed throughout the human body. Our first solution, EnsoSleep, reduces the time clinicians spend analyzing, scoring and managing sleep studies. This results in a simplified and accelerated patient testing, diagnosis, and treatment workflow. Our AI\-powered technology has the capability of informing health decisions beyond sleep medicine, from monitoring patient health in the ICU or through wearables, to detecting and capturing seizure data, to providing earlier detection of heart disease, diabetes, stroke, and Alzheimer’s. jobs.title: AI Engineer (CCC Auto / Agentic)
jobs.description: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we're making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We're pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** As an AI Engineer you will build and ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end. Salary range is: $170,000 \- 195,000 This position is bonus eligible. **Key Responsibilities:** * Ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against. * Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets. * Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request. * Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs. * Build and operate durable, event\-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re\-invoke a completed LLM step. * Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts. * Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores. * Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least\-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider. * Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy\-in from the team before you build. * Take part in a shared on\-call rotation for the services you build. **Requirements:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM\-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production. * Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one. * Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped. * A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work. * Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding\-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM. * Services built on message\- or event\-driven architectures, including long\-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event\-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one. * Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition\-key, consistency, and tenant\-isolation calls you made. * Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. * Technical design documents you have written to get feedback and buy\-in from a team before building, and that the team then built to. * Clear writing and discussion for technical and non\-technical audiences, and code review you can give as well as take. **Even Better if You Have:** * React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full\-stack feature end to end. Chat, streaming, and citation\-heavy AI experiences especially. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code such as Terraform or Bicep. * Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command\-line tools, and microservices. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry\-based tracing. * Experience designing A/B tests for AI features, or what\-if simulations that replay historical claims through a proposed change before it ships. * Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains. **What Success Looks Like:** * In your first six months you ship an LLM\-powered feature, its evals run in CI, and you can name the metric it moved. * When a model migration or prompt change causes a regression, the evals you wrote catch it before a customer does. * You take ownership from concept to production with light direction, asking the right questions early. * You care that things hold up: the services you build survive retries, partial failures, and model migrations without incidents a customer can see. * When something goes wrong in production, the trace tells you which step and which model call, and you can show an auditor the same thing. * Privacy and security reviews of your features find nothing that was not already designed in. * You enjoy the craft, and it shows: engineers pick up your patterns without being told to. * You enjoy the back\-and\-forth that gets a feature scoped, and you can argue a position without needing to win it. * You embrace our ambitious, collaborative, and empathetic values, and you like problems where the answer has to be measured rather than argued. **Interview Policy \& Privacy Notice:** A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE. **About CCC's Commitment to Employees:** CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer\-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion \& Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real\-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC's success. CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including: * 401K Match * Paid time off * Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus * Comprehensive health insurance * Adoption Assistance * Tuition Reimbursement * Wellness Programs * Stock Purchase Plan options * Employee Resource Groups For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site. jobs.title: Software Engineer III | Security
jobs.description: At ExtraHop, we're on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you'd like to spend the next chapter of your career, we'd love to hear from you. **Position Summary** An ideal candidate will have strong software engineering, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals. This position works with security researchers and developers, developing systems to make them more efficient and effective. You'll deliver impactful solutions that empower research and development, as well as working directly with network data to emulate adversary behavior. ExtraHop offers an exciting, high\-energy, and versatile environment in which people are encouraged and supported to collaborate on industry\-leading technology and create a world\-class engineering team while they develop and enrich their individual growth. And we're doing it with creativity, intellectual curiosity, and deep critical thinking. ExtraHop R\&D supports fully\-flexible work options that include full\-time onsite, hybrid, and fully remote working arrangements. Except for a few roles that require physical access, we believe in supporting you in making the choice that works best for you and makes the team successful. **Key Responsibilities** * Support Threat Research and Detection Engineering teams by providing tools and automation to accelerate Research \& Development. * Develop and support internal systems, including: * + Software deployment pipelines supporting continuous delivery + Pipelines for ingestion of new network identifiers to enable fingerprinting of device, software, and cloud services + Threat Intelligence acquisition and sharing + On\-demand threat research labs using modern Infrastructure\-as\-Code and Cloud\-based technologies + Continuous Testing and Validation pipelines * Work with a collaborative, dedicated and seasoned team of engineers * Actively participate in code review to ensure quality and uplevel other engineers **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering * Excellent engineering chops * Solid knowledge of Python * Experience developing and deploying code for enterprise software applications with emphasis on code quality and maintainability * In\-depth knowledge of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model and excellent working knowledge of the key protocols from Layer 2 through Layer 7 * Self\-starter with a strong problem\-solving track record and ability to grow and learn * Excellent teammate and collaborator who can iterate on problems quickly. * Proficient at communication in both spoken and written forms, including documentation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with network packet\-level data using tools like tshark, tcpdump, tcprewrite, and Scapy to directly interact with this data. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP and Layer 7 protocols **Compensation \& Benefits:** The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance\-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1\), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more. **ABOUT EXTRAHOP** ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet\-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud\-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in\-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. **OUR VALUES** Our culture is rooted in our five **Values**. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. **Lead with Purpose:** We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. **Act with Integrity:** We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. **Find a Way:** We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done. **Innovate:** We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo. **Share Success:** We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. **BENEFITS** **Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team.** Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits: * Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits * Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) \+ 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time * Non\-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan * FSA and Dependent Care Accounts \+ EAP, where applicable * Educational Reimbursement * 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable * Pet Insurance (US Only) * Parental Leave (US Only) * Hybrid and Remote Work Model Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today! **To learn more, visit** **our website** **or follow us on** **LinkedIn****.** **Create a Job Alert** Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Entry\-Level Mechanical Engineer — SolidWorks \& CNC **Company:** Falco Automation **Location:** Rancho Cordova, CA 95742 — Sacramento area **Job Type:** Full\-time, on\-site **Pay:** 60,000\.00\-85,000\.00 DOE About Falco Automation Falco Automation is an international engineering and manufacturing company with three locations across the United States and Europe: Rancho Cordova, California; Austin, Texas; China and Turin, Italy. We design, manufacture, and integrate custom machinery, robotic systems, automated production lines, and industrial equipment for customers across a range of industries. Our work brings together mechanical engineering, machining, manufacturing, controls, and robotics. Engineers work closely with the people building and testing the equipment, allowing them to see their designs become working machines. About the Position We are looking for an entry\-level Mechanical Engineer to join our Sacramento\-area facility. This position is a good fit for someone who enjoys designing in SolidWorks, working with machinery, and understanding how things are built. You should bring a working knowledge of SolidWorks and some practical exposure to mechanical design, machining, or CNC programming. **You do not need to be an expert in every area listed in this posting.** You will work alongside highly experienced engineers, machinists, and automation professionals who will help you develop your skills as you contribute to real projects. We are investing in someone who wants to grow with Falco. Curiosity, reliability, attention to detail, and a willingness to take feedback matter to us. We want someone who asks questions, takes initiative, and enjoys learning through hands\-on work. This position combines mechanical design and engineering with hands\-on machining. You will work with CNC mills, lathes, five\-axis machining centers, and wire EDM machines, with responsibilities that include CNC programming, setup, and operation as your skills develop. This is not exclusively a machining position your work will also include designing parts and assemblies in SolidWorks, developing mechanical solutions, and supporting equipment assembly and testing. We are looking for someone with some practical machining experience and an interest in both designing and building. You do not need to be proficient with every machine or process from day one; you will learn alongside experienced engineers and machinists as we invest in your development. What You Will Work On As your skills develop, your responsibilities will include: * Creating and updating SolidWorks parts, assemblies, and manufacturing drawings. * Helping design machine components, fixtures, tooling, and mechanical assemblies. * Preparing bills of materials and selecting mechanical components. * Creating and editing CNC programs and developing an understanding of toolpaths, tooling, and machining processes. * Assisting with CNC machine setup and operation under appropriate guidance. * Supporting equipment assembly, prototype builds, testing, and mechanical troubleshooting. * Working with engineers and machinists to improve designs based on how parts are manufactured, assembled, and used. * Following shop safety procedures and maintaining clear, accurate documentation. What We Are Looking For * A working knowledge of SolidWorks, including part modeling, assemblies, and drawings. * Some hands\-on experience with mechanical projects, machinery, tools, or manufacturing. * Familiarity with CNC machine operation, CNC programming, or CAM software is preferred; proficiency can develop on the job. * A basic understanding of mechanical drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and how components fit together. * An interest in both engineering design and practical shop work. * A dependable attitude, clear communication, and the ability to work well with others. * A strong desire to learn from experienced professionals and take on greater responsibility over time. Relevant experience may come from employment, internships, technical training, school projects, or personal builds. Recent graduates and candidates early in their engineering careers are encouraged to apply. Schedule and Work Environment This is a full\-time position at our Rancho Cordova facility, with time spent both at a workstation and on the shop floor. Occasional evening or weekend work may be needed to address equipment emergencies or critical project needs. We are looking for someone who can be flexible when these situations arise and is willing to support the team. Compensation and overtime eligibility will follow applicable law. Benefits and Development * **Medical insurance:** Falco pays 50% of the employee premium. * **Vision insurance:** Employee premium fully paid by Falco. * **Life insurance.** * **401(k) with company matching up to 5%.** * Direct guidance and mentorship from experienced engineers and manufacturing professionals. * Practical experience in machine design, CNC machining, robotics, and equipment assembly. * Opportunities to take on more advanced work as your skills and experience grow. How to Apply Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a short description of your experience with SolidWorks, machining, CNC programming, or hands\-on mechanical projects. Examples of drawings, models, parts, or projects you have worked on are welcome. We are looking for someone eager to build a career in mechanical engineering, and we are ready to invest in the right person. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Search & Consumer AI
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**About the Team** ------------------ Fanatics Core is the engineering organization building the shared capabilities, including search, AI, and customer intelligence, that every product across the Fanatics ecosystem builds on. We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that owns Search and Consumer AI. This leader will own some of the most leveraged surfaces we build: how fans find what they're looking for, how AI shows up inside our apps, and how AI powers an excellent customer experience. You will lead a team of software engineers spanning two closely connected charters: * **Consumer AI:** customer support AI, including LLM\-powered assistants, conversational analytics, sentiment analysis, predictive troubleshooting, and the tooling that lets customer success teams act on AI\-generated insights; and (2\) embedded AI experiences in the fan journey, such as AI commentary, recommendations, summaries, and in\-app assistance. * **Search:** native search, including query understanding, relevance and ranking, autocomplete, and personalization; and (2\) AI search, including natural\-language and conversational search that lets fans ask for what they want in their own words and get answers, not just results. Success in this role requires strong partnership with Product, Data Science, Customer Operations, and product teams across the ecosystem to shape the roadmap, make smart trade\-offs, and deliver outcomes fans feel. You'll work on complex, high\-scale challenges as part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence. ### **Responsibilities** **Delivery \& Ownership** * Lead the team to deliver against commitments across Search and Consumer AI, owning delivery plans end to end: scope and sequence work, remove blockers, and manage risk. * Set a high bar for reliability, performance, and relevance quality, with observability in place for AI and search services. * Ensure the team's work meets Fanatics standards for data governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI. * Own on\-call, incident response, and operational health for the team's systems. **Strategy \& Roadmap** * Partner with Product and engineering leadership on planning and roadmap building, using technical insight and fan impact to influence priorities. * Connect day\-to\-day execution to team strategy and Fanatics business goals so engineers understand why their work matters. * Partner with product teams across the ecosystem to embed AI experiences into their surfaces, agreeing on shared ownership, interfaces, and quality bars. * Guide how LLMs and ML models are evaluated, integrated, and rolled out in production. **Communication \& Collaboration** * Coordinate across engineers, adjacent teams, and cross\-functional partners to drive end\-to\-end delivery. * Represent the team's plans, progress, and risks in planning and review forums. * Keep the team informed on goals, trade\-offs, and decisions, and create space for two\-way feedback. **People \& Ways of Working** * Hire, onboard, and grow a high\-performing team; give candid, timely feedback and invite the same. * Mentor engineers on craft, ownership, and collaboration, and support their career growth. * Build team processes (planning, reviews, retros, experimentation) that help the team learn fast and ship reliably. *Must be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices and other locations for conferences, events, meetings, and team building.* ### **Qualifications** We value aptitude over experience, but here are some key skills that will make you successful on this team: * 1\-3\+ years managing a software engineering team, or significant tech\-lead experience with people\-leadership responsibilities, delivering complex, high\-scale systems. * Experience in a Java / AWS ecosystem; familiarity with AWS Bedrock or equivalent managed AI services preferred. * Experience shipping consumer\-facing AI/ML or NLP features to production, including integrating LLMs and building the pipelines and evaluation practices that keep them reliable. * Strong understanding of search, discovery, or relevance systems, including how traditional search and LLM\-based approaches complement each other. * Strong technical judgment and clear, confident communication with engineers, Product partners, and leadership. * Proven ability to mentor engineers and build a healthy, high\-performing team culture. ### **Preferred** * Background in customer support AI or embedded consumer AI experiences (assistants, conversational analytics, AI commentary, recommendations). * Familiarity with Kafka, Airflow, dbt, OpenSearch, Kotlin, and Salesforce. * Experience building shared platforms consumed by multiple product teams. Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. Balance and Ledger will be a shared ledger and a customer\-level balance that can be used across Sportsbook and Casino, Markets, and other LOBs. phases, including dual\-running, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback plans that avoid customer\-visible downtime. * **Architect event\-driven integration** using java and architectural patterns so that balance changes are published reliably and downstream consumers can depend on ordering and delivery. * **Carry responsible gaming protections with the balance**, working with the Responsible Gaming and Fraud teams so that limits, self\-exclusion, and other customer protections remain enforced as funds are used across businesses. * **Work with Finance, Legal, and Compliance** on how funds transaction histories, financial reporting feeds, and tooling that lets Operations and Finance verify balances independently. * **Lead technical initiatives** that span multiple teams, and run architectural reviews, design sessions, and incident postmortems. * **Mentor engineers** and raise the standard for security, observability, reliability, and testing across the platform. * **Partner transactional consistency, idempotency, concurrency control, and relational data modeling in systems that cannot lose or double\-count a transaction. * Experience building event\-driven systems and working with message streaming platforms such as Kafka. * Demonstrated success setting technical direction and driving alignment across multiple teams. * Experience migrating live, high\-traffic systems with minimal customer impact. * Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, finance, and leadership audiences. * Comfort working in a fast\-paced, regulated environment with changing priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in online gaming, sports betting, fintech, banking, or payments. * Experience with a shared platform used by several business units, including managing adoption, versioning, and ownership boundaries. * Experience with financial reconciliation, settlement, or accounting\-oriented data models. jobs.description: Flex is a growth\-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow. That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve. **About the Job** Flex is a growth\-stage, NYC\-headquartered FinTech company building the payment layer for life's financial obligations—giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By giving people greater choice over how and when they pay, and helping eligible on\-time payments build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow. Building on our roots in rent, we're expanding into a broader consumer bill management platform that helps people manage essential spend and align payments with their finances. Our Consumer engineering team within the New Verticals division is at the forefront of this expansion, building a new business line within Flex. We're looking for motivated leaders who thrive in ambiguity, turn new ideas into products, and help shape how millions of people manage their financial lives.**About the Role** We are looking for an experienced **Senior Engineering Manager** to own consumer engineering teams within the New Verticals division. These teams partner closely with the product and the business to deliver high quality and delightful user experiences and the systems that power them. You will own multiple workstreams that tie directly to critical business KPIs. You will work closely with product managers to drive delivery of their workstreams with your team of highly adaptable, AI\-enabled engineers who reside in the Consumer organization but range across the entire Flex system as necessary. You will serve as a key technical partner to Product, business leadership, and cross\-functional teams (such as Lifecycle Marketing (LCM), Legal \& Compliance, and Risk) to drive outcomes across your workstreams. You will also represent Consumer engineering and New Verticals in Flex\-wide architecture and quality initiatives, ensuring we build solutions that scale across Flex as a whole. **Our Engineering Teams** * Consumer Engineering: Builds the APIs and backend systems powering Flex's consumer\-facing mobile and web apps. This team focuses on delivering high quality, delightful and trustful customer experiences. * Partner Integrations Engineering: Owns the backend services and integrations that connect Flex to financial partners and payment networks, ensuring secure, reliable payment flows and partner\-facing experiences. * Core Platform Engineering: Maintains the backend services and infrastructure supporting all business features, including Payments, Ledger, Identity, and Settlement, providing the foundation for all of Flex's products. **What You'll Do** **Technical Leadership** * Define and execute the consumer architecture supporting New Verticals' expansion into essential spend. * Partner with engineering leaders across Flex to align technical decisions, reuse shared capabilities, and build systems that scale across business divisions. * Guide design reviews and make high\-impact technical decisions, balancing speed of experimentation with long\-term maintainability. * Ensure reliability, data integrity, and financial correctness across consumer workflows. **Execution \& Delivery** * Partner with Product and business leadership to shape initiatives and connect engineering investments to customer value and business outcomes. * Lead large, ambiguous projects from early exploration through launch and scale. * Coordinate cross\-team dependencies and resolve blockers regardless of team. * Establish feedback loops that help the team learn from customer behavior, iterate quickly, and scale successful products. **People Leadership** * Manage, mentor, and grow a team of engineers. * Establish strong ownership of customer outcomes, engineering quality, and operational excellence. * Hire and develop senior engineers and future technical lead * Elevate testing discipline and design rigor while helping the team navigate the uncertainty of building a new business line. **Operational Ownership** * Own the production health and reliability of the team's consumer services. * Improve observability, scalability, and incident response a * Partner with Risk, Compliance, and platform teams to build safeguards into customer\-facing financial workflows. * Ensure new capabilities launch with clear operational ownership, monitoring, and support readiness. **Who You Are** Beyond the qualifications below, you are a generalist, enabler, and problem solver who leads through engineering management. High ownership and drive are your default. When a problem falls between teams or disciplines, you help find a path forward. You pair strong customer empathy with deep technical knowledge. You translate business strategy into execution and contribute meaningfully in design reviews. You develop excellent engineers and build strong teams, but don't shy away from opening a PR yourself. * 8\+ years of software engineering experience spanning frontend and backend systems, and 3\+ years managing engineers. * Experience building and scaling consumer\-facing products and the APIs and backend systems that power them. * Strong product judgment and a track record of partnering with business and product leaders to delivery . * Experience leading ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives from early definition through launch and iteration. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, service architecture, reliability, and data integrity. * Experience owning production services with high standards for uptime, correctness, and operational readiness. * A track record of growing engineers, developing technical l with strong ownership and accountability. * Ability to influence technical direction across teams and balance the needs of a new business line with shared company\-wide capabilities. **Preferred** * Experience building or operating consumer fintech, payments, banking, or lending products. * Experience launching a new product or business line from early experimentation through adoption and scale. * Familiarity with customer onboarding, bill management, payment workflows, or other consumer financial experiences. * Experience using product analytics and experimentation to i, engagement, or retention. * Experience partnering with Risk and Compliance teams in a regulated environment. * Background scaling high\-growth consumer platforms. ### **Life at Flex** Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self\-aware people. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Stablecoin Payments
jobs.description: Flex is building **AI\-native financial services for business owners**. We’re re\-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.** Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine\-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **\~$1T\+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B\+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M\+ in equity and $300M\+ in debt. * **Mission\-critical problems**: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. * **High bar, low ego**: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. * **Speed over comfort**: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. * **Enduring impact**: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. **Team \& Locations** We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. **Flex Fuels Ambition.** ### **About the Role** Flex is building stablecoin products for business owners, and we need engineers who can ship them. The team is small and moving fast, and you’ll be one of the first engineers to join. You’ll build the services that move customer money on\-chain and connect them to the banking systems Flex already runs. That means real ownership, direct access to the engineering lead and product, and work that customers use. Crypto experience helps, but it isn’t required. Much of the work is strong fintech engineering: payments, onboarding, compliance, and reliability. If you’ve built that kind of system and want to learn the crypto side, we want to talk. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and run backend services for stablecoin payments, including deposits, withdrawals, and on and off ramps * Integrate with partners for wallets, virtual accounts, and stablecoin orchestration * Build business onboarding (KYB) and compliance flows that stand up to banking audits * Connect new stablecoin products to Flex’s existing banking, ledger, and payments systems * Own your work from design through launch and production support * Work closely with product, design, compliance, and business development * Help set technical direction of the team’s roadmap * Onboard and mentor new teammates ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of backend software engineering experience * Experience building and running production services in fintech, payments, or banking * Experience with compliance\-driven systems such as KYB, KYC, AML, or audit requirements, and comfort working with compliance stakeholders * Strong system design skills, especially for money movement: accuracy, reliability, and handling failures safely * Proficiency in a modern backend language * Comfortable owning problems end to end in a small, fast\-moving team * Clear communicator with technical and non\-technical partners ### **Nice to Haves** * Hands\-on crypto experience: stablecoins, wallets, custody, on\-chain transactions, etc. * Experience with on and off ramps, virtual accounts, or stablecoin orchestration * Smart contract development or auditing experience * Prior experience at a startup or high\-growth company Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.**Why Join Us** **Build something generational** — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners. **Work on real money, real risk** — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale. **Solve hard problems** — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles. **True ownership** — Small teams, high trust, real accountability. **Founder\-level exposure** — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors. **High bar, high taste** — Move fast without cutting corners. **Elite peers** — People here are builders, not tourists. **Real upside** — Meaningful equity if you help build something big. Flexbase Technologies Inc.

You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it. You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM\-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters. ### **What you'll do** * Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business\-validated backlog. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python and SQL. * You have built and shipped at least one LLM\-powered application or agent that real users depend on, using tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) or a comparable lakehouse, or deep enough data engineering experience to ramp quickly. * Experience integrating SaaS and internal systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth. * You test your work, instrument it, and care about cost. We're looking for an **AI Engineer** to own this system end to end: design, develop, test, and **deploy the graph layer to Production on a Google Cloud Platform–native stack**, and build the agent\-facing serving layer on top of it. You will turn raw industrial event data into a governed, traversable graph that powers Ford's next generation of engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply\-chain agents. **Graph Layer** * Design, develop, test, and deploy the ISDP knowledge graph from the domain event store to Production using cloud\-native data pipelines. * Model and evolve the graph's entities and relationships as new data sources are onboarded. **MCP serving layer** * Design, build, and operate the **MCP server** that exposes the ISDP graph layer and event store as tools to consumers — including GQL graph query, event\-store query, and schema/DDL discovery. * Define tool contracts, context, and guardrails so agents produce grounded, accurate, non\-hallucinated responses over the graph. * Ensure low\-latency, secure, and cost\-efficient serving for interactive and batch agent workloads. **Reliability, monitoring \& observability** * Own **monitoring and observability** of the graph layer and the MCP server — data freshness, pipeline health, query latency/cost, tool\-call success rates, and answer quality. * Instrument SLOs, dashboards, alerting, and tracing; drive incident response and continuous reliability improvements. **Collaboration \& data onboarding** * Partner with **Data Engineers** and **Application Data Source Owners** across Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to **ingest and validate their data into ISDP**. * Establish data contracts, schema validation, and quality checks; support source owners through onboarding, mapping to the ISDP logical model, and troubleshooting. * Contribute to data governance, cataloging, and lineage for the graph and its sources. **Required** * 5\+ years of experience with Strong software engineering in **Java**, **Python**, with production\-grade testing, CI/CD, and code quality practices. * 3\+ years of experience with Hands\-on experience deploying data/AI systems to Production on a **GCP\-native stack**: **Vertex AI,****BigQuery**, **Dataflow / Apache Beam**, **Pub/Sub**, **Cloud Run / GKE**, **Cloud Storage**, and **Cloud Build / Artifact Registry**. * 3\+ years of experience with **graph data modeling** and querying — property graphs and **GQL / graph query patterns** (BigQuery property graphs, or equivalent such as Neo4j/Spanner Graph). * 3\+ years of Hands\-on experience with **Vertex AI** (Agents, model serving, embeddings) and evaluation of agent answer quality. * 2\+ years of Experience building **LLM/agent** systems: tool\-use, RAG/grounding, and integrating models via APIs (e.g., Vertex AI or enterprise LLM gateways). Familiarity with **MCP** or comparable agent tool protocols. * **Observability** expertise: Cloud Monitoring/Logging, OpenTelemetry, SLOs, dashboards, and alerting for data pipelines and services. * 3\+ years of experience with **Infrastructure as Code** (Terraform) and secure\-by\-default engineering (IAM, least privilege, secrets management). * Ability to work directly with data producers to model and validate real\-world **industrial/enterprise data**. **Preferred** * Familiarity with **Dataplex / Data Catalog** for governance, lineage, and business glossaries. * Streaming/CDC and event\-driven architectures; append\-only/event\-sourced data modeling. * Design and build user\-facing applications and dashboards that surface Knowledge Graph data to end users. * Domain exposure to **PLM / product development, manufacturing execution, quality, or supply\-chain** systems and their data. * Data quality frameworks, schema evolution, and blue\-green/zero\-downtime data deployments. **Domain you'll master** Ford's Industrial Systems and the ISDP logical data model — how Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain applications describe programs, parts, ECUs, sites/plants, suppliers/organizations, requirements, verifications, quality problems, and warranty/returns — and how those entities interconnect in the knowledge graph. Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage * Paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * Generous vacation time, sick/personal time, and paid holidays, including between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day This position is a salary grade 7\-8 and ranges from $99,600\-$192,900\. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Foresight** Foresight's mission is to bring the world's critical infrastructure into service faster by better enabling teams to deliver complex capital projects. The AI buildout runs on physical things: data centers, power, and the supply chains behind them. A single hyperscale campus involves an owner, a general contractor, dozens of trades, long\-lead equipment suppliers, lenders and commissioning teams. Each works from its own schedule and its own spreadsheets. When a project slips, the people who could fix it usually find out last. For an AI data center, a month late can mean tens of millions in lost revenue. Foresight is the control tower for these projects. We connect schedules, field progress and execution data across every party, forecast where delivery is heading, and help teams act before a delay becomes a missed date. On one 15\-project portfolio, Foresight found a project 245 days behind, cut reporting overhead by 90%, and helped prevent more than $100M in lost revenue. We work with top data\-center owners, developers and general contractors across the world, including Crusoe, Applied Digital, and NTT. We raised a $25M Series A led by Macquarie Capital and are headquartered in New York. **The role** We're looking for an **Applied AI Engineer** to help build the core ML engine of the Foresight platform. You will build the systems that enhance the ability for efficient delivery of large scale construction projects. You will architect, train and deploy the models that perform Foresight's risk predictions and AI recommendations, to be used in interfaces that make 100k\-activity projects understandable at a glance. This is a hands\-on role on a new team, for someone who owns models and backend features from training to deployment and monitoring to build systems that are accurate, scalable and observable. At Foresight, machine learning is an integral part of the platform. You will be using complex, multimodal high stakes data to make predictions that will be used by teams to deliver major projects on time. This could translate to work on: * Risk prediction: Build, train and deploy models that predict if a project will be at risk and by how much. * Criticality prediction: Build models that use project plans to identify which of the tasks are the most critical to complete the project on time before the project even starts. * Project planning: Build models that accept blueprints and 3D Replit models to create project timelines and scaffolding as the starting point for human planners to make project planning a breeze. * Progress trackers: Build models that take in multi\-model data from static cameras or videos from humans/drones on\-site, voice notes, etc about a task to predict what percent of the task is complete. * Risk mitigation: Build, train and deploy models that can predict the best path forward for risk mitigation or timeline amelioration for major projects. * Continuous improvement: Evaluate models repeatedly and prototype methods and new models to improve the accuracy of current features, inspired by latest research publications. **What you'll do** * Own features from technical design through release and beyond: measure adoption, learn and keep improving. * Work alongside Full Stack engineers to help them turn new models into production features customers rely on. * Partner with product, design and customers to find the problems most worth solving. * Tune performance across the modelling stack, from accuracy to latency and reliability. * Raise the bar on architecture, testing, observability and how the team ships. * Help shape the product and technical roadmap. **Requirements** **You might be a fit if you** * Have 3\+ years of experience building and shipping Machine Learning models in production, with real ownership of the backend. * Have 1\+ years of experience building and shipping VLM/LLM based features to production. * Are strong in Python on the backend (FastAPI, Django or similar). * Are solid at relational data modelling in Postgres: schema design, indexes, query plans, migrations, and an ORM such as SQLAlchemy. * Have shipped agentic workflows, RAG systems and high\-volume data pipelines. * Have experience with async work: queues, background jobs, retries, idempotency, and what happens when a worker dies halfway. * Are hands\-on with AWS (S3, RDS, a managed queue or event service, containers or serverless). * Write tests and debug production issues from logs, metrics and traces, not guesses. * Are clear in written communication and comfortable making pragmatic trade\-offs in a small team that moves fast. **Bonus points** * Experience with workflow orchestration for multi\-step jobs (Temporal, Step Functions, Airflow or similar). * You've worked on a legacy\-to\-modern migration, or on products for regulated enterprise or public\-sector customers (SOC 2, data residency). * Early\-stage or founding\-team experience. None of these are required. If the core of this role excites you, apply. **Benefits** **Why join now** * **Real stakes, real customers**. Real stakes, real customers. You won't be building for a hypothetical buyer. Owners and contractors are building now, on deadlines measured in revenue per day. * **Blank canvas, solid ground**. You get first\-engineer level scope on a product that already has paying customers, real data and proven outcomes to tell. * **Defining a category**.Agentic software for physical infrastructure is a new category. What you build will become the standard. * **Small, senior team**. Flat, direct, low on process. We debate openly, decide quickly and ship. **Compensation and location** * **Total Comp**: $180,000\-230,000, based on experience, level, and location. * **Benefits**: Health, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO . * **Location**: New York, San Francisco, and Montreal are preferred. Occasional travel to may be required. Foresight is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on any protected basis.

A single hyperscale campus involves an owner, a general contractor, dozens of trades, long\-lead equipment suppliers, lenders and commissioning teams.
