jobs.title: Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** ============ **Forus is building an AI\-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients.** Our platform automates the complexity between a doctor prescribing a medicine and a patient starting treatment, including insurance coverage, financial assistance, and supply chain navigation. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life\-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder\-to\-treat conditions. **Forus has exceptional product\-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption:** * **Accelerating scale:** We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world. * **AI\-native, durable model:** Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable. * **Backing to build for the long term:** We raised $300M\+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity. **Our number one priority is scaling to market demand.** We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We move fast and need to move faster. **If we succeed, science will be the only limit to medicine.** *All full\-time roles are in person in New York.* **About the role** ================== As a Data \& Analytics Engineer at Forus, you will build the data foundation that powers how we operate, measure, and grow. You will design and maintain our core data models, pipelines, and reporting infrastructure, ensuring the right people have access to clean, trustworthy, decision\-grade data. This is a cross\-functional, impact\-heavy role in which you will work closely with product, ops, growth, and leadership to build the systems that enable better, faster decisions across the company. You will also help define our data \& analytics engineering practices: how we structure metrics, review code, manage pipelines, and build for scale. Your work will directly support everything from product usage visibility to operational performance to life sciences client reporting. This is a demanding role, with a high level of autonomy and responsibility. You will be expected to "act like an owner" and commit yourself to Forus' success. If you are low\-ego, hungry to learn, and excited about intense, impactful work that drives both company growth and accelerated career progression, we want to hear from you. **If you join, you will:** -------------------------- * Build and maintain the core data models that serve as the foundation for internal analytics and client\-facing insights * Design and operate the data pipelines that transform raw sources into clean, analytics\-ready tables * Create dashboards and reporting tools that drive performance visibility and decision\-making across product, ops, and GTM * Define and enforce metric consistency across teams — including core business KPIs and product usage definitions * Help improve and scale our analytics stack (we use GCP BigQuery and Dataform, Fivetran, Postgres, and dashboarding tools) * Collaborate with stakeholders across teams to understand data needs and translate them into reliable systems * Contribute to internal data culture through documentation, education, and code quality standards **We’re looking for you if you have:** -------------------------------------- * 3–6 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a technical data analyst role with production ownership * Expert\-level SQL and comfort working in a code\-first environment (versioning, testing, documentation) * Experience designing data models that balance usability, performance, and long\-term maintainability * Familiarity with the modern data stack — dbt, Fivetran, Airflow, GCP/AWS/Snowflake, Metabase (or equivalents) * Strong written and verbal communication that allows you to be an effective participant in both internal debates and external relationships * Track record of moving quickly, finding shortcuts, and going to unreasonable lengths to deliver on goals * High NPS with your former teammates This is a list of ideal qualifications for this position. If you don't meet every single one of them, you should still consider applying! We’re excited to work with people from underrepresented backgrounds, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. **Working with us** =================== Forus is based in New York, with our full team working out of a beautiful and spacious office in SoHo. We run as a high\-trust environment with high autonomy, which requires that everyone is fully competent and operates in line with our principles: * **Do the math.** Be rigorous, assume nothing. Break problems down and reason from the ground up. Stay open to changing your mind. * **Resourceful optimism.** Assume problems are solvable. Be audacious. Resist false constraints and push beyond the obvious before deciding. * **Spit it out.** Speak directly, invite critique, avoid equivocation. We want right answers, not comfortable ones. All killer, no filler. * **Raise the bar.** Hold a high standard for your pace and execution, and elevate the performance of the team around you. Mamba mentality. * **Fight for users.** Start with users’ realities, not ours. Resist optimizing for internal convenience over user outcomes. **We provide competitive compensation with meaningful equity** (for full\-time employees)**.** Everyone who joins will be a major contributor to our success, and we reflect this through ownership and pay. **We also provide rich benefits to ensure you can focus on creating impact** (for full\-time employees)**:** * Fully covered medical, vision, and dental insurance. * Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody. * Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and 16 weeks of parental leave. * 401K plan setup, FSA option, commuter benefits, and DashPass. * Lunch at the office every day and Dinner at the office after 6:30 pm. *Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Forus (for full\-time employees). Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity.* *Forus is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* Compensation Range: $170K \- $250K

jobs.title: Bridge Manager
jobs.description: **Bridge Manager** **Wall Township, NJ** French \& Parrello Associates (FPA) is seeking an experienced and motivated Bridge Department Managerto lead our growing Bridge Department at our headquarters in Wall Township, NJ. This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned transportation and bridge engineering professional who is ready to take on a leadership role overseeing complex infrastructure projects, developing and mentoring a talented team, strengthening client relationships, and helping shape the continued growth of FPA’s bridge practice. Recognized year after year as one of NJBIZ’s Best Places to Work in New Jersey, FPA is committed to creating a culture where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and lead. In 2026, FPA was ranked \#49 on Zweig’s Hot Firm List, recognizing the firm among the 100 fastest\-growing AEC firms in the United States and Canada. Our growth is driven by our investment in our people, technical excellence, and our commitment to delivering innovative solutions for the communities we serve. The successful candidate will provide leadership for FPA’s Bridge Department while serving as a Senior Project Manager on major transportation and bridge assignments throughout New Jersey and the Northeast. This individual will oversee project delivery, develop and mentor staff, cultivate relationships with NJDOT, transportation authorities, counties, municipalities, and other public\-sector clients, and play a key role in expanding the department’s project portfolio and market presence. This role offers the opportunity to combine department leadership, technical expertise, project management, client engagement, staff development, and business development. Unlike larger organizations where individual contributions can become diluted, FPA provides experienced professionals with the opportunity to directly influence the direction of a growing practice, build a high\-performing team, develop lasting client relationships, and contribute to the firm’s continued success. **Bridge Engineering Expertise \& Project Experience** FPA’s Bridge Department has a strong reputation for delivering innovative and technically challenging transportation infrastructure projects throughout New Jersey and the Northeast. Our team has successfully completed bridge design, rehabilitation, inspection, and construction support assignments for NJDOT, DRJTBC, NJ Turnpike Authority, Garden State Parkway, PennDOT, counties, municipalities, and other transportation agencies. The Bridge Department Manager will provide leadership across a diverse portfolio of bridge and transportation projects, including bridge replacements, deck replacements, structural rehabilitations, bridge widenings, load ratings, inspections, staged construction projects, and complex infrastructure improvements involving steel plate girders, rolled steel beams, prestressed concrete structures, culverts, pedestrian bridges, and specialty structures. In addition to overseeing project delivery, the Department Manager will help establish priorities, allocate resources, support staff development, and identify opportunities to expand FPA’s bridge capabilities and client base. The position will work closely with other FPA departments, including Highway, Traffic, Geotechnical, Environmental, Water Resources, and Construction Services, to deliver multidisciplinary solutions for complex transportation projects. **Responsibilities** * Lead and oversee the Bridge Department, including project delivery, staffing, resource allocation, technical quality, and overall department performance. * Serve as Senior Project Manager and/or Project Manager on complex bridge, transportation, and infrastructure projects from planning and concept development through final design, permitting, bidding, and construction support. * Provide technical leadership on bridge design, rehabilitation, replacement, inspection, load rating, and transportation infrastructure projects. * Lead multidisciplinary project teams and coordinate the efforts of bridge, roadway, traffic, geotechnical, environmental, water resources, and other technical professionals. * Develop, mentor, and manage bridge engineering staff, providing technical guidance, career development, performance feedback, and opportunities for professional growth. * Assist with recruiting and building the Bridge Department to support FPA’s continued growth. * Manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, quality control, risk, and client expectations to ensure successful project delivery. * Serve as a senior point of contact for key clients, including NJDOT, transportation authorities, counties, municipalities, and other public\-sector agencies. * Build and maintain strong, long\-term client relationships and identify opportunities for additional work. * Oversee the preparation and review of engineering plans, specifications, cost estimates, technical reports, calculations, and other project documentation. * Provid cellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with clients, agencies, staff, and multidisciplinary project teams. * Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to provide technical direction, mentor staff, and build high\-performing teams. * Strong organizational and decision\-making skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality and client satisfaction. * Experience with proposal development, client presentations, interviews, and business development initiatives. **Nice to Have Skills \& Experience** * Strong knowledge of NJDOT design standards, AASHTO requirements, and applicable transportation and structural engineering standards. * Established relationships with NJDOT, NJ Turnpike Authority, DRJTBC, Garden State Parkway, PennDOT, counties, municipalities, or other transportation agencies. * Experience growing a bridge or transportation engineering practice. * Experience with strategic planning, department budgeting, workload forecasting, and resource management. * Proven ability to recruit, retain, mentor, and develop engineering professionals. * Active involvement in professional engineering organizations and industry associations. * Experience with alternative delivery methods, including Design\-Build and other progressive project delivery approaches. **Additional Information** * Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is available for this position. * Relocation assistance is available for this position. Don't meet every qualification? At FPA, we recognize that great candidates bring diverse experiences and perspectives. If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience may be exactly what we need for this role or another opportunity within our growing team. **The FPA Difference** **Large firms offer scale. FPA offers opportunity.** For more than 50 years, French \& Parrello Associates (FPA) has been delivering innovative engineering solutions that shape communities, improve infrastructure, and support regional growth. As an employee\-owned, mid\-sized engineering and consulting firm, FPA combines the technical capabilities and expertise of a larger organization with the collaboration, accessibility, and personal investment of a close\-knit team. At FPA, experienced professionals are empowered to take ownership of their work, lead teams, collaborate across disciplines, and have a direct influence on the future of the organization. As a Bridge Department Manager, you will have the opportunity to shape a growing practice, mentor the next generation of engineers, strengthen client relationships, and help define the direction of FPA’s transportation and bridge capabilities. Our multidisciplinary approach allows team members to see the bigger picture, contribute to meaningful projects, and make an impact from concept through completion. We invest in our people through mentorship, professional development, and opportunities for growth because we believe the success of our employees drives the continued success of our firm. At FPA, you are not just managing projects. You are building teams, developing clients, growing a practice, and helping shape the future of a company. **Benefits** Benefit packages for this role will start on the 1st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement plans. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law. **Compensation** The projected compensation range for this position is $165,000 to $200,000\. Actual compensation will depend on factors including experience, education, qualifications, and skill set. FPA recognizes and rewards performance through an annual bonus program and offers a signing bonus for this particular position for qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer, Agentic Engineering
jobs.description: This role is hired to build agent\-first. The Senior Full\-Stack Developer, Agentic Engineer is a founding member of a small, new engineering squad building the next generation of staff\-facing applications, APIs, and data services for Catapult Learning and SESI Schools, the tools teachers, supervisors, and operations staff use every day. The squad starts with net\-new functionality and then rebuilds existing capabilities one at a time. It is not responsible for maintaining the current legacy systems. AI coding agents are the default way this engineer plans, implements, tests, and refactors, and they own features end to end, from requirements and technical design through prototype, production code, and deployment. Just as important, they help shape how the new squad works. FullBloom is moving its engineering teams from ad hoc AI\-assisted coding to a shared agentic build pipeline. That pipeline runs on agent\-ready specs, AI\-driven implementation and testing, automated quality gates, and human review of everything that ships. This engineer helps stand that pipeline up, codifies what works, and mentors the early\-career engineers who join as the squad grows. Because agents make code cheap to write, the hardest parts of this job are deciding what to build, defining it clearly, and judging whether what the agents produced is right. They work with product, design, QA, DevOps, and security partners, often directly from lightweight product briefs. They move faster without compromising student data protection, accessibility, or SOC 2 controls. **Agentic engineering and delivery*** **Agent\-first development:** Use AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) as theprimary way to plan, implement, test, and refactor code, while stayingaccountable for every line that ships * **Judging agent output:** Treat review and validation as the core of the job:catch defects in code that looks correct, decide which changes need closerhuman review, and own what merges * **Requirements to architecture:** Work directly with product partners andstakeholders to turn lightweight briefs into agent\-ready specs, technicaldesigns, data flows, and acceptance criteria * **Proof\-of\-concept development:** Prototype quickly to test feasibility, showvalue, and settle design questions before committing to a full build * **Short, experimental cycles:** Build end\-to\-end working skeletons first (Simple,Lovable, Complete), apply YAGNI to keep AI\-generated as code, and deploymentpipelines * **Integrations and data services:** Build and maintain integrations with identityproviders, rostering and student information systems, internal APIs, andshared data platforms * **Rebuilding legacy capabilities:** Use agents to read existing systems wellenough to extract their business rules, data, and edge cases, then rebuildthose capabilities one at a time on browser automation) so agents can work safelyin our repositories and environments * **Environments and DevOps:** Own the squad's DevOps alongside the code,including preview environments, safe test data with student informationremoved, and deployment pipelines, so agents can build and verify changeswithout touching production data * **Quality gates:** Strengthen automated tests, CI checks, and AI\-assisted codereview so agent output meets the same bar as human code before it merge * **Verification loops:** Build feedback loops that let agents check their own work,such as end\-to\-end tests and headless browser checks, while keepingindependently written tests for high\-risk areas * **Governance:** Apply guardrails for secrets, data access, and student data, andkeep agent\-driven work aligned with SOC 2 change\-management and SDLC controls **Growing the squad*** **Mentoring:** Mentor early\-career engineers who join the squad, with a focus onthe fundamentals and review habits that agents don't teach * **Codifying practice:** Turn what works into repeatable playbooks, templates,and skills that new squad members and FullBloom's other engineering teamscan reuse, and log friction points so the pipeline improves with each project * **Working across roles:** Work closely with product and design partners in amodel where roles blur, including designers submitting changes againstworking code * **Measuring outcomes:** Track delivery and quality signals such as lead time,rework, escaped defects, and change\-failure rate, not tool adoption alone **Quality, reliability, and collaboration*** Review human\- and agent\-written code for correctness, security,maintainability, and performance * Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues, and take part in practices * Other duties as assigned **Required Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field and 5\+ years of relevant work experience, or equivalent experience * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to build production software, with concrete examples of how it changed your workflow and results * Working knowledge of what makes agents effective: context management, task decomposition, clear specs and prompts, and rigorous verification of agent output * Demonstrated judgment reviewing agent output: you can find and explain problems in code that looks correct, and you know when a change needs closer human review * Strong product sense: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear, well\-scoped spec and push back on features that aren't needed * Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, React, HTML, and CSS * Experience designing and building REST APIs and back\-end services * Strong working knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), including data modeling, query writing, and performance tuning * Experience with cloud hosting, serverless technologies, and infrastructure as code (e.g., AWS jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: US \- Remote • Canada \- Remote Data Remote Full\-time ### **Company Overview** Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health. Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action. Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent. We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future. ### **Role** At Function, the person who best understands a piece of data is rarely the person who can safely change it. A data scientist knows exactly how a biomarker should be derived. A clinician knows which reference range is wrong. Today, both have to file a ticket and wait for an engineer. We think that's a platform failure, not a process problem. Our job is to build the paved road that lets the subject matter expert make the change themselves – and lets an agent make it too – without anyone lying awake wondering about the validity or stability of what just shipped. That means the guardrails have to be real: declarative contracts instead of hand\-rolled code, CI that diffs the *data* and not just the diff, validations that gate promotion, lineage that tells you who's downstream, and a rollback that takes one command. Get that right and both your humans and your agents get faster at the same time, for the same reason. That's the work. It's platform engineering, and the users are engineers. ### **Key Responsibilities** Three surfaces, all with the same goal – make the safe path the fast path: * **Tracking infrastructure.** The event pipeline behind product analytics, experimentation, and feature gates. Schemas that are enforced at the source, so a bad event never becomes a bad metric. * **Data processing infrastructure.** The Bronze Silver Gold layer in Databricks. Automated schema evolution, contract tests, backfills that aren't scary, freshness and volume monitors generated from the contract rather than bolted on after. * **ML infrastructure.** Feature computation and serving, training and eval pipelines, and the plumbing that gets model output back into the product — with the same testing and observability bar as everything else. * **Cutting across all three.** The self\-service story. Templates, local dev and preview environments, policy\-as\-code for PHI, ownership routing for alerts, and progressive gates so an exploratory model ships freely while a member\-facing one earns more scrutiny. ### **Qualifications/Skills** * Built internal platform or infrastructure that other engineers actually adopted. You've felt the difference between shipping a tool and getting it used. * Operated production data or ML systems, on call for them, and fixed them under pressure. * Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable in a lakehouse – we use Databricks; Snowflake or BigQuery translates fine. * Designed interfaces and schemas that other teams depend on, then evolved them without breaking those teams. * Thought hard about testing and CI for data or ML, where correctness is statistical and the failure is often silent. * 8\+ years of engineering experience gets you here, but we care about what you've built, not the number. ### **Nice\-to\-Have Skills and Experiences** While the core competencies are essential, the following qualifications will distinguish exceptional candidates: * Declarative pipeline frameworks (dbt, DLT, Dagster, Airflow) * Streaming (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming) * Data contracts, data diffing, or lineage tooling * Terraform * Feature stores * MLOps and eval tooling * Agentic coding workflows * Healthcare * PHI, or HIPAA experience ### **To be a strong fit, you embody our Core Values** * ***Ruthless Prioritization:*** + We don’t let perfect get in the way of progress. + We move quickly to drive value, not perfection. + We prioritize what drives impact. + We never compromise on standards of excellence. * ***Member\-First, Always:*** + We design and deliver like we’re caring for someone we love. + We create calendar, actionable, human experience. + We prioritize responsiveness, peace of mind, and outcomes. + We empower members with truth, clarity, and care. * ***One Team, Moving Fast:*** + We are aligned in purpose, prioritization, and speed. + We gather diverse perspectives to make informed decisions. + We clear paths for each other and move fast together. + We communicate clearly and respectfully, rallying around shared goals. * ***Radical Ownership, Relentless Execution:*** + We don’t just ship– we own outcomes and drive distinguish confirmed capabilities, limitations, gaps and items requiring validation. * Support AEs with technical and functional objections, evaluation committee presentations, scoped proofs of concept and occasional onsite city council or board presentations. * Contribute functional content to RFPs, RFIs and security questionnaires in partnership with the appropriate internal owners; help create champion presentations and business\-case materials for municipal approvals. * Document demo outcomes, meaningful next steps, workflow needs and gaps in HubSpot within one business day, enabling the AE to own follow\-up and deal progression. * Provide clear implementation handoffs on won deals, including what was demonstrated, validated, promised and unresolved. * Identify and communicate bugs, product gaps, competitor capabilities and state\-specific requirements; partner with Product and Development to validate issues, document customer and revenue impact, and track responses without owning technical support or the engineering backlog. * Build reusable demo scenarios, playbooks, objection\-handling resources and enablement materials; share market insights and help improve how the presales function operates. **What you’ll bring (Required Skills)*** Experience in customer\-facing software demonstrations, solutions consulting, presales, implementation consulting or comparable complex\-software presentations. * Excellent verbal communication, listening, storytelling and facilitation skills; jobs.title: Gameplay Tools Engineer
jobs.description: At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another. We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by ambiguity, enjoy solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you. As a Gameplay Tools Engineer, you will create custom Unreal Engine tools that support teams across the studio. You will partner with stakeholders to understand the unique needs of their iteration workflows and author bespoke tools using C\+\+ within the Unreal editor and in\-game environments that will accelerate those pipelines. You will be a force\-multipler for the team, enabling rapid exploration of new features and comprehensive analysis of and decision\-making regarding the breadth of content that powers the emergent interactions of our games. **A Day in the Life:** ====================== * Craft tools that support other disciplines (including art, audio, design) in efficient content creation, iteration and analysis. * Work with individual developers to build features that can reduce manual effort and accelerate workflows. * Playtest regularly with the team to understand the creative spaces our games are operating within in order to better support the team. **What You’ll Do:** =================== * Own the technical architecture and implementation of multiple tools and supporting systems across the game, partnering closely with stakeholders and the production team to improve iteration throughput. * Collaborate closely with audio, VFX and design stakeholders to understand the needs of their development pipelines and proactively create solutions that will allow content production at scale. * Act as a technical bridge between gameplay and backend engineering teams to aid in the development of analysis and diagnostics systems across all aspects of our games. * Contribute to the stability of the game by proactively assisting in the identification and triage of issues in game systems, collaborating on solutions, and reducing friction in the development process. **What You’ll Bring:** ====================== * 3\+ years of experience building game tools across one or more projects. * Experience building customized tools via the Unreal editor’s extension mechanisms. * Familiarity with Wwise or similar audio middleware. * Experience working closely with VFX systems and artists. * Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed. **Nice to Haves:** ================== * Previous experience on shipped multiplayer titles using Unreal Engine. * Prior experience owning the decision\-making and implementations of significant portions of the tools ecosystem of a game or engine. * Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay, engine or infrastructure systems for large\-scale content. **The Team:** ============= * You will report to the Lead Gameplay engineer. * You will join a team of gameplay engineers who work closely with other disciplines to champion the values that our games are centered on. **How We Work** We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day. We're looking for teammates who are excited to: * Stay curious and ask thoughtful questions. * Adapt when plans change. * Exercise good judgment rather than chase perfection. * Care for the success of the whole team, not just their own work. * Pursue ambitious goals while remaining humble enough to keep learning. * Commit fully to the shared adventure we're building together. **You'll Thrive Here If...** * You enjoy asking questions before jumping to conclusions. * You adapt comfortably when priorities evolve. * You balance ambition with pragmatism. * You communicate thoughtfully and seek feedback. * You care about helping your teammates succeed. * You embrace uncertainty as part of creating something new. **Please Note:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Gardens cannot assist with work authorizations or work visas. Applicants must also be willing to work within North American time zones (EST–PST). **Our Interview Process** (all interviews are 1 hour video calls on Google Meet unless otherwise noted) * Step 1: People Operations Introduction * Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview * Step 3: Panel Interview (3 \- 1 Hour Sections) * Step 4: Gardeners Debrief * Step 5: Offer **Life at Gardens** Gardens is a fully distributed game studio founded by creators behind titles including Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Blaseball, Dustforce, Ashen, Guild Wars 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, and more. We're developing our flagship project: a multiplayer fantasy adventure inspired by the friendships, discoveries, and unforgettable stories that emerge when people explore together. We believe the best ideas come from teams with diverse experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking. Every Gardener helps shape not only what we build, but how we build it. Each of us arrives by a different path, bringing unique experiences, perspectives, and ways of seeing the world. That range is part of what makes our games and our studio better than any one of us could build alone. **Gardens Offers:** * Competitive salaries and pay transparency * Stock options * Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% for individuals, 90% for dependents) * Life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability, and additional benefits * 401(k) contributions (U.S.) / RRSP \+ DPSP contributions (Canada) * Paid parental leave * A fully distributed remote studio across North American time zones Benefits and perks listed may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Gardens and the country in which you work. **Physical Requirements:** This is a primarily sedentary, remote role requiring the ability to remain stationary and perform computer\-based work for extended periods, including sustained use of monitors, keyboards, mice, and game controllers for a minimum of six hours per day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role. Gardens is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. **Encouragement:** We believe that diverse perspectives make our team stronger and our games better. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every single qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. Research consistently shows that talented people, particularly women, people of color, and those from historically underrepresented communities are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. We care far more about curiosity, growth, and a willingness to learn than checking every box. **Scam Note:** Unfortunately, scammers have impersonated Gardens Interactive by offering fake employment opportunities intended to collect financial information. Official communication from our team will always come from a @gardens.dev email address. We will never ask for financial information during the hiring process. If you're ever unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly through LinkedIn or careers@gardens.dev Compensation Range: $138K \- $155K

jobs.title: Senior AI Data Engineer - GPSC Insights Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description** **This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Austin, TX three times per week, at minimum \[or other frequency dictated by the business if more than 3 days].** **The Role** Join our GPSC Insights Engineering team, responsible for ideating, incubating, and delivering new data solutions for global purchasing supply chain (GPSC) and our partners. As a Senior AI Data Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize industrialized data assets, AI data products, and data platforms that support Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases. You will own solutions from discovery through production, ensuring that data used for training, evaluation, retrieval, inference, and decisioning is trusted, scalable, secure, observable, and fit for purpose. In this role within the GPSC Insights Engineering organization under the Data organization, you will independently lead complex initiatives with multiple moving parts and drive delivery across teams. You will apply deep data engineering and software engineering expertise to solve novel problems, shape architecture and technology strategy, influence partners through data and clear recommendations, and deliver solutions with significant impact across the function. **What You’ll Do** * Own the architecture, design, development, and production delivery of scalable data and AI engineering solutions across batch, streaming, and near\-real\-time workloads. * Assemble, curate, and transform large structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured datasets for model training, validation, evaluation, feature generation, embedding generation, retrieval, and inference. * Design and implement robust source\-system integrations from files, database extracts, APIs, event streams, external suppliers, and supply\-chain systems. * Build high\-quality data pipelines and reusable data products with strong data contracts, schema management, lineage, metadata, quality checks, and observability. * Develop and operationalize feature, embedding, and vector\-retrieval pipelines where appropriate for machine learning and generative AI applications. * Build AI\-enabled data and application workflows using appropriate AI development frameworks and services, applying retrieval, evaluation, and workflow orchestration patterns where appropriate. * Establish repeatable MLOps/LLMOps engineering patterns, including data and model versioning, experiment and evaluation workflows, CI/CD, deployment automation, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining triggers. * Design for functional and non\-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, reliability, resiliency, security, privacy, cost, and SLA/SLO attainment. * Lead architecture discussions and technology evaluations; identify tradeoffs, propose alternative approaches, and drive decisions for complex problems with limited precedent. * Identify and implement process improvements, automation, infrastructure redesign, and developer tooling that increase delivery speed and reduce operational risk. * Partner with data scientists, ML engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, platform teams, cybersecurity, and governance partners to translate customer needs into actionable technical plans. * Work with operations teams to resolve production issues, lead root\-cause analysis, and implement preventative improvements across data and AI platforms. * Communicate recommendations, risks, progress, and results to technical and non\-technical audiences, using data to demonstrate value and address concerns. * Mentor peers and junior engineers, provide guidance on difficult technical issues, and raise engineering standards through design reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Model GM behaviors by speaking candidly about risks, protecting sensitive information, experimenting responsibly, moving with urgency, collaborating inclusively, and owning outcomes. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 6\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related discipline, including production delivery of scalable data solutions. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with Scala or another production programming language is a plus. * Hands\-on experience engineering data pipelines or platforms that support machine learning, advanced analytics, or generative AI workloads, including data preparation, feature or embedding generation, evaluation, or inference data delivery. * Experience with distributed data processing such as Apache Spark and container orchestration such as Kubernetes. * Proficiency with streaming and event\-driven data solutions using Kafka or comparable technologies, including operation in Kubernetes\-based environments. * Experienc ewed at critical points and outcomes measured by business and platform impact. * You improve the reliability, scalability, quality, and usability of data products that enable AI and analytics across GPSC. * You build trusted relationships with senior partners, make technically sound recommendations, and use data and persuasion to align stakeholders. You mentor engineers, elevate engineering practices, and help teams adopt innovative solutions safely and effectively. * This job may be eligible for relocation benefits. Compensation: * The expected base compensation for this role is: $134,000 \- $188,600\. Actual base compensation within the identified range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. * **Bonus Potential:** An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. * **Benefits** : GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more. GM DOES NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION\-RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE. DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU WILL NEED GM IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. THIS INCLUDES DIRECT COMPANY SPONSORSHIP, ENTRY OF GM AS THE IMMIGRATION EMPLOYER OF RECORD ON A GOVERNMENT FORM, AND ANY WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIRING A WRITTEN SUBMISSION OR OTHER IMMIGRATION SUPPORT FROM THE COMPANY (e.g., H\-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc.) \#LI\-CC1 \&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Benefits Overview** From day one, we're looking out for your well\-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting **Total Rewards resources** . **Non\-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role\-related assessment(s) and/or a pre\-employment screening prior to beginning employment. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Austin Technical Center three times per week, at minimum \[or other frequency dictated by the business if more than 3 days].** **The Role** We are looking for a hands\-on Machine Learning Engineer with at least seven years of experience to productionize machine learning for manufacturing and to build the data engineering that those models depend on. This person will design, train, validate, and deploy models, and will design and operate the ETL/ELT pipelines, feature data, and governed Bronze, Silver, and Gold products those models run on. jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: The GitHub Secret Scanning team is on a mission to secure the world’s software. We build tools that help millions of developers find, fix, and prevent credential leaks. Every day, developers unintentionally commit secrets to their repositories. Without intervention, these leaks can lead to data breaches and financial losses. We’re solving that. As a software engineer at GitHub, you will enhance the collaboration experience at GitHub by working closely with a community of engineers and designers with a distributed, diverse and passionate team delivering the services that millions of developers depend on. In this role you will design, prototype, implement, ship and support highly performant and inspiring user experiences with your team. We are looking for creative problem solvers and diverse thinkers, people who care about culture as well as customers and features. We believe that how we do things is as important as what we do. Big vision, a common purpose, passion for quality, curiosity, dedication, and investment in fun and collaboration are what lead to great results. Great products reflect the teams that build them. Responsibilities: * Design, develop, test and ship high\-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple GitHub services. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define and implement innovative solutions. * Provide technical leadership, mentorship, pairing opportunities, and code reviews to encourage the growth of others. * Own and advocate for the health and quality of the systems that the team builds, including participating in on\-call and first responder rotations * Write architecture briefs and proposals, carry out code experiments, and build prototypes to learn how we can achieve planetary scale with our systems. * Design and implement APIs to facilitate seamless integration between software components. * Utilize CI/CD tools to set up automated pipelines for continuous integration and delivery. * Become intimately familiar with the systems you build and take pride in writing maintainable code. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications*** 6\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, years experience using general purpose programming languages (e.g., Go, Ruby, or a similar language). * 3\+ years experience with cloud environments and/or Cloud Native Compute Foundation (CNCF) concepts Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $127,800\.00 \- USD $339,000\.00 /Yr. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non\-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300\+ colleges, universities, and K\-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition\-free. GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we're also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we've made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies each of the last five years and we've been profitable nine of the last 10\. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. Our purpose\-driven team of 130\+ is located in 30\+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet\-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. While we operate at meaningful scale, we're still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company, you'll fit right in. **Location:** This is a remote\-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in\-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company\-wide and team\-specific onsites throughout the year. **The role** ------------ GiveCampus has spent the last 18 months getting good at using AI. People use it every day, and we've shipped agents and apps that changed how work gets done: a codebase agent that answers questions no doc can, an RFP agent, a support knowledge bot, a feature request agent, and a data integrations assistant for our Partners. Now, we are ready to take it to the next level. You'll design, build, and operate the next generation of AI Infrastructure at GiveCampus, including sources of company and Partner context, a clear model for who and what can access which data, a registry of what's already been built, memory that carries across agents, and the guardrails that let us move fast without losing track of what our agents are doing. This is a platform role. You'll work alongside a product partner and co\-builder (the AI Transformation Lead) who owns prioritization, stakeholder management, and adoption, so you can spend your time on architecture and engineering. **What we're driving** ---------------------- The AI Transformation team exists to change how GiveCampus operates, so that every team runs on connected workflows and agents by default, and output grows without headcount growing alongside it. Over the next year, that means: * Field teams spend most of their time with customers instead of on meeting prep, research, CRM updates, and follow ups * Every customer interaction is backed by context (school data, usage, relationship history, and peer benchmarks) delivered before the conversation starts * Managers act on AI generated briefings and alerts instead of assembling reports by hand * Finance, People, and Ops teams manage agents that run their recurring processes, stepping in only on exceptions and approvals * The enablement infrastructure and operating model that make the change last: standard toolkits, a governed agent lifecycle, and measurement of impact by department You'll contribute directly to every one of these outcomes by owning the platform that makes them possible. The agents doing this work are only as good as the context, access, and controls underneath them, and that's what you'll build. **What you'll own** ------------------- You'll start by building the foundation that makes the outcomes above possible. After that, the role grows with the company and with AI itself, so treat the later stages as direction, not a fixed scope. ### **First 6 months: build the foundation** * **Shared context and memory**: one source of company and Partner knowledge that every agent reads from, so a change is made once and reaches every tool * **Identity and access**: auditable permissions for agents, one view of credentials and MCP connections, and a registry of what's already built * **Governance**: an evaluation gate before production, an audit trail, monitoring, and protection against prompt injection and data leaks, with build versus buy calls made alongside Infrastructure * **A paved road for builders**: templates and guardrails for Taskforce builders, plus measurement of impact by de ring** ------------------ ### **Must have** * Six or more years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or backend systems in production * Hands on experience shipping LLM systems with real users: retrieval, tool use, evaluations, and MCP or similar integration patterns * Strong Python, plus experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), authentication, and observability * A security mindset: you think about access, data boundaries, and failure modes before something ships * A record of building internal platforms or shared services that other people adopted * Experience growing a system from an early version into something a whole company depends on * Appetite to grow into the technical lead for AI across the company * Real excitement about AI and a drive to keep learning: you follow what's new, try things early, and stay current. You don't need to know everything yet, but AI moves fast enough that this role only works if you're engaged with it * You judge your work by business results (hours given back to teams, faster cycle times, tools people use every day), not by what shipped * Comfort working from requirements set with a product partner, and the judgment to push back when the technical answer is different * Clear written communication with technical and non technical teammates ### **Nice to have** * Experience with agent orchestration, multi agent systems, or agent governance tooling * Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, or a semantic layer * Experience with Salesforce data and APIs * Time at a startup or small team where you were the first person to own a system **How we work** --------------- You'll report to the AI Transformation Lead. Together you form a small pod: they act as product lead and build for adoption, and you own the platform. You'll partner closely with Engineering and Product through AI Plumbers, our cross team working group for AI architecture, agent orchestration, data access, and governance. You'll also work with our AI Taskforce, the builders in each department who will use what you build. GiveCampus has a strong written culture built on Notion, Slack, and async work. We move quickly, document what we do, and give people real autonomy and direct access to leadership. We're remote first, and this role can be based anywhere in the US. **Why this role** ----------------- * **The groundwork is done.** People already use AI every day and we have working agents in production. You're building the layer that makes them work together. * **Clear ownership.** You own the platform, with a product partner who owns prioritization and adoption. * **Room to grow.** You'll start with the foundation and grow into the technical lead for AI at GiveCampus as the work and the field change. * **Leadership investment.** AI is a company priority, with executive sponsorship behind this work. * **A mission that matters.** GiveCampus helps schools raise money to advance education. **Ready to apply?** ------------------- Be sure to keep an eye on your spam and promotions boxes in case our emails end up there! *At GiveCampus, we value diversity and we pledge to foster an environment of support, inclusivity, and learning, both on the job and throughout the application process. In this spirit, we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.* *GiveCampus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are not discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.* *If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, please apply anyways. We know confidence gaps and imposter syndrome often get in the way of connecting with incredible people, and we don't want them to prevent us from meeting you.*

jobs.description: **Who We Are** For over 70 years, Glatfelter Insurance Group has believed in doing the right thing for our clients, agents, communities and associates. This founding principle has enabled Glatfelter to grow from the kitchen\-table, one\-man\-operation as it began, to one of the largest managing general agencies in the U.S. with nearly 500 associates across the country, a distribution network of over 4,500 independent brokers and more than 30,000 clients. It is what drives us to innovate—the desire to deliver the best for our clients. Founded as The Glatfelter Agency, which is still in operation, the program basis of Glatfelter Insurance Group, Volunteer Firemen’s Insurance Services (VFIS), was founded in 1969\. Throughout the years, Glatfelter has expanded to include specialized program business inclusive of public entities, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and religious organizations. Glatfelter provides their insureds with comprehensive insurance solutions including property, casualty, life insurance, and more. jobs.title: Security Platform Engineer – AWS/Kubernetes
jobs.description: The Security Platform Engineer supports the sustainment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting of AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes environments hosting enterprise Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capabilities supporting Department of Defense Defensive Cyber Operations. The engineer focuses primarily on the application\-specific infrastructure supporting SIEM/SOAR platforms, ensuring availability, reliability, performance, security, and operational continuity. The position requires strong hands\-on AWS and Kubernetes experience, along with a working understanding of SIEM/SOAR applications, their architecture, and supporting infrastructure dependencies. Key Responsibilities * AWS Platform Support: Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot AWS resources and services supporting SIEM/SOAR applications. * Kubernetes Administration: Support Kubernetes application environments, including deployments, pods, services, configurations, persistent storage, resource utilization, and workload troubleshooting. * Application Infrastructure Sustainment: Maintain the infrastructure components and services required for reliable operation of Elastic SIEM and Cortex XSOAR environments. * Platform Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve infrastructure\-related issues affecting application availability, performance, connectivity, and data processing. * Application Integration Support: Troubleshoot infrastructure dependencies and connectivity between SIEM/SOAR platforms, AWS services, and external systems. * System Monitoring: Monitor platform health, resource utilization, logs, and infrastructure performance; proactively identify and remediate issues. * Lifecycle Management: Support infrastructure updates, configuration changes, patching, vulnerability remediation, and application infrastructure deployments. * Security \& Compliance: Maintain secure configurations and support applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements, including STIG compliance, vulnerability management, and RMF/ATO activities. * Technical Collaboration: Coordinate with Cloud Engineering, application vendors, cybersecurity analysts, and government stakeholders to resolve platform issues and support operational requirements. * Documentation: Develop and maintain platform configurations, architecture diagrams, troubleshooting procedures, and operational documentation. Required Qualifications * Hands\-on experience administering and troubleshooting AWS cloud infrastructure and services. * Hands\-on experience supporting Kubernetes environments, including workloads, deployments, pods, services, and application connectivity. * Working knowledge of Linux operating systems and system administration. * Understanding of SIEM/SOAR platforms, their operational functions, and supporting infrastructure dependencies. * Experience troubleshooting distributed applications, network connectivity, system performance, and resource utilization. * Understanding of cloud networking, IAM permissions, storage, and infrastructure security concepts. * Experience supporting production enterprise applications and coordinating with infrastructure and application support teams. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting Elastic SIEM, Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, or comparable security platforms. * Experience with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). * Experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls. * Familiarity with AWS SQS, SNS, Lambda, and Python scripting. * Experience with Docker, Helm, Kubernetes troubleshooting, and containerized application deployments. * Familiarity with AWS CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and other infrastructure monitoring services. * Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, or infrastructure as code. * Experience supporting DoD cybersecurity environments, DISA STIG requirements, and RMF processes. Specialized Integration Engineering Capability At least one engineer may require additional proficiency with AWS SQS, SNS, Lambda, and Python to support application\-specific integrations, message processing, and automation. This specialization supplements the core AWS/Kubernetes platform engineering responsibilities and is not necessarily required for every position. Team Integration The Platform Engineer works closely with the Cloud Engineering team responsible for deploying and maintaining general AWS/Kubernetes infrastructure. Platform Engineering focuses on sustaining the application\-specific infrastructure and workloads supporting SIEM/SOAR capabilities, coordinating with Cloud Engineering and vendor support personnel on shared infrastructure dependencies and application\-related issues.

jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience programming in C\+\+, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go. * 5 years of experience in a people management or technical leadership role. * Experience building and deploying Machine Learning models. * Experience with Generative AI. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 7 years of experience deploying Machine Learning models in production environments. * Experience with Deep Learning, Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, OCR), and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. * Experience with large\-scale data processing systems. * Ability to lead complex technical projects and collaborate with different stakeholders. **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. As an Engineering Manager, you will oversee a team handling complex technical challenges in extracting vital information like speed limits and road signs from massive datasets. Your team leverages Machine Learning (ML) and Computer Vision techniques to directly impact the safety and reliability of mapping and in\-car systems used by millions worldwide. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of ML, geospatial data, and the automotive industry, contributing to systems that have real\-world impact on how people navigate. jobs.title: Product Engineer, Full-Stack
jobs.description: **Mission** ----------- The US healthcare system is complex, error\-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn't be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we're building the one solution every American can turn to for help. Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate bills, and make coverage easier to understand, saving people time, money, and energy. Our goal is simple: to be the platform that empowers all Americans to take charge of their healthcare. **About Us** ------------ Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we're a seed\-stage company with $17M in funding. We're lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well\-funded and have solid runway. Bill lowering is the hook. People come to us when they have a bill they can't afford or don't understand. Granted checks it, catches errors, overcharges and denials, secures financial assistance, and negotiates with providers. That earns us the right to be connected to their insurance and their patient data, and from there Granted runs in the background, proactively monitoring every bill to help patients lower and pay what they owe. **About the Role** ------------------ Our Growth \& Engagement pod builds the experience people have when they first meet Granted and the reasons they keep coming back. We're building a consumer\-first product that makes navigating bills and benefits intuitive, transparent, and even delightful. As a product engineer on this team, you'll ship across the stack with a lean toward the frontend (roughly 70% frontend, 30% backend). You’ll use new AI\-native software paradigms, leveraging the frontier of software development tooling to build a world class application. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and senior engineers on the pod, owning features from idea to production, with plenty of room to grow your scope as you ramp. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and ship user\-facing experiences across web and mobile, from onboarding and activation flows to core engagement loops * Own features end\-to\-end: shape the UX with Product and Design, build the APIs and data models behind them, and ship to production * Turn AI capabilities into clear, intuitive product surfaces that help users understand and resolve their healthcare bills * Run fast experiments, measure what works, and iterate on what moves activation and retention * Raise the quality bar on our frontend: performance, accessibility, and consistency with our design system **What You Might Work On** -------------------------- * Onboarding and account\-linking flows that get users from sign\-up to their first savings faster * The in\-app AI chat experience, including richer, visual responses and smoother streaming UX * Home and case views that show users exactly where their bills stand and what Granted is doing for them * Re\-engagement surfaces and notifications that bring users back when there's something new to act on * Coverage and plan pages that make benefits easier to understand **Tech Stack** -------------- * TypeScript frontend \& backend * React Native, NextJS, NestJS, GraphQL * Postgres, amplitude, sentry, datadog * Temporal, Pulumi, Docker, AWS Read more about our stack and Eng culture here **You'll Bring** ---------------- ### **Must\-haves** * 2\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience shipping consumer\-facing products * Strong TypeScript and React skills, with a real eye for UX and product detail * Solid backend experience: you've built your own APIs and worked with relational databases (we're not fixated on GraphQL or a specific DB) * Product instinct: you think in user journeys, not just tickets, and can push back on requirements when something doesn't make sense * Curiosity about building with AI and LLMs, whether or not you've done it professionally yet * Comfort in fast\-paced, high\-autonomy environments, with clear communication and a hunger to grow into more scope ### **Nice\-to\-haves** * React Native or other mobile experience * Experience with NestJS/Node, GraphQL, or NextJS * Experience running growth experiments (A/B tests, funnels, analytics instrumentation) * Exposure to AWS or infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. Pulumi) * Background in healthcare, fintech, or other regulated consumer products You don't need to check every single box. If you're passionate, driven, and excited about the impact AI can make on the healthcare system, we'd love to hear from you! Compensation Range: $140K \- $200K

jobs.description: **Group 1001** is a consumer\-centric, technology\-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can\-do culture. Group1001’s culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, communication, core business focus, risk management, and striving for outcomes. This goal extends to how we hire and onboard our most valuable assets – our employees. **Why This Role Matters:** As a Product Security Engineer at Group 1001, you will lead efforts to integrate security best practices into the full product development lifecycle, ensuring the security and integrity of our revenue\-generating applications and systems from design to deployment. This role requires experience across a number of security disciplines, including application security, cloud security, platform engineering, software engineering, and process improvement. This is an exciting opportunity to exert significant positive change by driving secure development practices and delivering security features to our end\-user and internet\-facing applications/systems in partnership with highly successful development teams for profitable businesses. **How You'll Contribute:** * Collaborate with development teams to employ, improve, and customize automated security analysis tooling. * Contribute security improvements and features to production applications and supporting infrastructure. * Commoditize developed security features and integrations to be leveraged across disparate engineering teams and their respective applications. * Conduct security reviews and provide guidance on architectural designs to address security requirements. * Lead efforts to design security features into product applications and systems (avoiding bolt\-on security implementations). * Stay up to date on emerging threats and industry best practices in product security. **What We're Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in product security, application security, software development, or related fields. Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerabilities (e.g. OWASP Top 10\). * Experience with application security testing tools and technologies (e.g. SAST, DAST, SCA). Proficiency in one or more software programming languages (e.g. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Golang). * Proficiency in one or more infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g. Terraform, Ansible). Familiarity with modern platform, API, and application frameworks (e.g. Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Apollo GraphQL). * Familiarity with major cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP). * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. **Compensation:** Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The total compensation for this position ranges from $145,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $215,000/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **Benefits Highlights:** Employees who meet benefit eligibility guidelines and work 30 hours or more weekly, have the ability to enroll in Group 1001’s benefits package. All employees (regardless of hours worked) have immediate access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program and wellness programs—no enrollment is required. Employees may also participate in the Company’s 401K plan, with matching contributions by the Company. **Group 1001** , and its affiliated companies, is strongly committed to providing a supportive work environment where employee differences are valued. Diversity is an essential ingredient in making Group 1001 a welcoming place to work and is fundamental in building a high\-performance team. Diversity embodies all the differences that make us unique individuals. All employees share the responsibility for maintaining a workplace culture of dignity, respect, understanding and appreciation of individual and group differences. \#LI\-AS1 \#LI\-REMOTE
