jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Platform Engineer** ===================== **About Us** ------------ Guardify helps criminal justice ecosystems with technology that accelerates justice and healing for survivors of crime. We are a mission\-driven, rapidly growing startup and a sustainable social enterprise. We got our start working with Child Advocacy Centers to protect sensitive child forensic interview evidence. Today we offer a cloud\-based platform for digital evidence management, case management, and capture, giving our customers one place to secure evidence, run cases, and record what matters. We are driven by a passion for leveraging technology to improve the public sector and by our commitment to the ethical use of AI, advanced video technologies, privacy, security, and social impact. Join us to do meaningful work: protect vulnerable populations, advance how justice and advocacy work gets done, and be part of a team that puts customers and the communities they serve first. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Platform Engineer, you will own the foundation Guardify runs on: our cloud infrastructure, how code gets to production, how we know when something is wrong, and how we keep our customers’ data secure. That covers Cases, Evidence, and Capture. This is a hands\-on role. You write the infrastructure, fix the pipeline, tune the alarm, and work the incident. You also set the standard for how the team builds, ships, and operates software, and you are accountable for the numbers that show whether the platform is healthy. Our customers trust us with some of the most sensitive records there are: forensic interviews, case files, and evidence used in prosecution. Security and reliability are not a phase of the work here. They are the work. You are the engineering owner of our security and compliance posture, and the person our compliance and security officers turn to when an auditor or penetration tester needs an answer. You are not only an infrastructure engineer. When the problem is in application code, you read it, debug it, and fix it. When it belongs on the roadmap, you bring it to the team with the evidence behind it. You work alongside product managers, engineers, and our customer operations team. This is an individual contributor role with a path to leading platform work as the team grows. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Infrastructure** * Own our cloud infrastructure end to end: how it is defined in code, how it scales, and how it is secured. * Keep environments consistent and reproducible, so what works in development works in production. * Keep the cost of running the platform in check as we grow, and know where every dollar of it goes. ### **Delivery** * Make shipping safe and routine: fast checks on every change, gated releases, and a clear way back when something goes wrong. * Remove the friction that slows the team down between a finished change and a running one. ### **Reliability and observability** * Build monitoring the team can act on, so the right person learns about a problem before a customer does. * Lead incidents to resolution, and make sure the same incident does not happen twice. * Keep our video and media processing fast and reliable as volume grows. ### **Security and compliance** * Own the engineering side of our compliance program. Partner with our compliance and security officers through HIPAA, CJIS, SOC 2, and ISO 42001, and be accountable for the technical controls, evidence, and remediation each one requires. * Lead security work for a platform that holds highly sensitive records: access control, encryption, audit trails, and dependency and secret hygiene. * Own our annual penetration tests, from scoping through remediation and retest. * Make the secure way the easy way for the rest of the engineering team. ### **Migrations** * Help move customers onto our current platform from older and acquired systems, without losing or exposing anything along the way. * Build the checks that prove a migration is complete, not just finished running. ### **Standards and documentation** * Write the runbooks, decisions, and docs the team operates from, and keep them current. * Build the tooling and automation that let a small team run a growing platform. **How We Will Measure This Role** --------------------------------- * Delivery: how often we ship to production, how long a change takes to get there, and how often a release has to be rolled back. * Reliability: uptime, time to detect and time to restore, and the share of problems we find before a customer reports them. * Signal quality: alarms that lead to action, and alarms that do not. * Security and compliance: audits completed without findings in engineering\-owned controls, and time to close findings from scans, penetration tests, and audits. * Cost: cost to serve per customer as we grow. Several of these are not measured today. Setting the baseline is part of your first 30 days. **A Note on Fit** ----------------- We are a lean team. We value momentum over ceremony, clarity over process for its own sake, and real\-world impact over perfect plans. This role is for someone who wants to own the platform and stay close to the code that runs on it. It is not a great fit if you would rather work only on infrastructure and never touch application code, or would rather have a dedicated operations team behind you. Unsure if you meet every qualification but excited about the role? We hire based on impact, curiosity, and a passion for building products that serve people and communities. If Guardify sounds like the place for you, we encourage you to apply. **Our Vibe: Mission, Vision, \& Values** ---------------------------------------- Guardify builds a culture of trust by being incredibly intentional about its vision, mission, values, behaviors, and the experiences we deliver. Our vision is to connect communities to digital evidence management solutions through our mission to create digital evidence management solutions enabling seamless access to, organization, and utilization of digital evidence for justice, security, and a path to restoration. Things we value and use to make decisions: * Our Customers and the Communities we/they serve; come first. * We are Excellent to One Another. * We’re committed to building a profitable enterprise that has life\-changing social impact. * We Create Intentional Experiences. * We Don’t Get to Do Today Again. **Salary and Benefits** ----------------------- Compensation for this role will be based on experience, scope, and level of accountability. In addition to compensation, Guardify offers benefits and flexibility consistent with a mission\-driven, remote\-friendly team. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, site reliability, or backend engineering with production ownership. * You have owned production systems in the cloud, including being responsible when they broke, and can point to what you changed afterward. * You have defined infrastructure in code and built or rebuilt a deployment pipeline. * You are comfortable in application code. You can read, debug, and fix the services you run. * Experience running relational databases in production: performance, migrations, and operations. * Security instincts. You treat access, encryption, and auditability as part of the design, not a review at the end. * You have been the engineering owner through compliance audits (such as SOC 2, HIPAA, CJIS, or ISO) and penetration tests, and can walk us through what you remediated. * You pick up new tools quickly, including AI tools, and use them to get more done while still understanding what you ship. * You write clearly, and you stay steady when production is down and people are waiting on you. * Mission\-driven. You want your work to matter for the communities we serve. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive environment: justice, govtech, public sector, healthcare, or finance. * Experience with video or media processing at scale. * Experience leading a large data migration with sensitive records. * Experience supporting software that runs alongside hardware, such as recording equipment or connected devices.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologySecurity **Compensation** ---------------- * $182,750 – $215,000 • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2\.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About the role** ------------------ The Security team at Headway is responsible for the security and privacy of all of Headway's customers — therapists, patients, and payer partners (insurance companies and health systems). As a Security Engineer on our Detection \& Response team, you'll help build the capabilities we use to identify, respond to, and contain potential threats across our production and corporate environments — ensuring our logging is adequate and accessible, our detections cover real\-time monitoring and alerting, and our incident response is well\-documented and well\-rehearsed. This role scales alongside the volume of data our business generates and consumes, and alongside our ambition to work smarter — not just harder — by applying automation and AI where it genuinely helps, and knowing when it doesn't. **What you'll do at Headway:** * Detection engineering: Build and refine detections, logging/telemetry coverage, and tooling (SIEM/ETL pipeline refinement) so we have real\-time visibility into anomalous and malicious activity across cloud, corporate, and SaaS environments. * Incident response engineering: Run incident response activities, threat hunting, and threat modeling — and continuously improve our processes and documentation so the team gets faster and sharper after every incident. * AI security tooling and automation: Implement automation and AI where it's the right tool for the job — and push back when it isn't. You'll help define what "AI\-forward" detection and response looks like at Headway without over\-rotating on it. * Security alert triage: Triage security alerts and build deep familiarity with our environment so you can separate signal from noise quickly. * Team contributions: Participate in the security on\-call rotation, author runbooks, contribute to security education and partnership across engineering, and mentor peers. * Documentation: Keep detections, logging capabilities, runbooks, response processes, and threat intel well\-documented so knowledge compounds across the team. **Tools we use:** * Languages: Python 3, TypeScript * Infrastructure: AWS (Fargate, ECS, S3, and more) * Datastores: PostgreSQL, Snowflake * Monitoring \& Response: Datadog, PagerDuty * Version Control: GitHub * Security Tooling: Anthropic, Wiz, Semgrep, Datadog, Tines **You’ll be great for this role if you have:** * Dedicated experience of 1\-2\+ years with responsibilities related to security response and automation OR a security\-adjacent engineering background * 4\-5\+ years in related areas — DevOps, IT, software engineering, or similar with concrete security responsibilities or overlap. Comfortable scripting/coding to build and automate your own tooling. * SIEM/observability experience: You've worked with logging, detection, or observability platforms in a cloud or distributed environment. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Cloud Engineer **Location:** Hybrid / Indianapolis, IN **Starting Pay for position:** $130k JOIN OUR TEAM! **About Herff Jones:** Indianapolis\-based Herff Jones is the leading provider of graduation and educational products and services designed to inspire achievement and create memorable experiences for students. Herff Jones’ products include class rings and jewelry, caps and gowns, diplomas and announcements as well as motivation and recognition programs. Focused on building long\-term relationships through a nationwide network of over 1,400 employees and sales partners, the professionals at Herff Jones have been helping elevate the student experience throughout the lifelong journey of education for more than 100 years. For more information about Herff Jones, please visit www.herffjones.com. **Position Summary:** The Herff Jones IT Team is seeking a Cloud Engineer to join our Infrastructure Services team. This role is the technical owner of our AWS and Azure environments and the bridge between our on\-premises datacenter and the cloud: the person who builds the foundation, keeps it secure, well\-governed, and resilient, and drives it forward. The Cloud Engineer provides and governs the cloud environment that implementation partners build in during a major infrastructure modernization initiative, supports the systems hosted there, and builds and maintains the cloud resources for work outside that initiative. In the near term, the role also shares support of our Windows and Linux server infrastructure. The Cloud Engineer is one of six engineers on our Infrastructure Services team, each with a complementary specialty, who share support, cross\-coverage, and an on\-call rotation, and partners closely with the Security and Application teams. **Key Responsibilities:** Cloud Architecture \& Engineering * Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable infrastructure in AWS and Azure, including compute, storage, networking, serverless, and container services. * Establish and maintain cloud landing zones, including account and subscription structure, guardrails, tagging, and governance aligned with the AWS Well\-Architected Framework and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework. * Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Bicep) with source control and CI/CD pipelines, and automate routine tasks using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. * Develop and maintain cloud standards, reference architectures, and documentation, including diagrams and configuration baselines. * Contribute to the multi\-year infrastructure roadmap for the cloud and hybrid domain. Hybrid Infrastructure \& Partner Support * Design and maintain secure hybrid connectivity and DNS between on\-premises sites and AWS and Azure (e.g., site\-to\-site VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), in partnership with network engineering. * Provide and govern the cloud environment that implementation partners build in, ensuring the underlying infrastructure aligns with our security and governance standards and best practices. * Troubleshoot and support partner\-built systems hosted in our environment, and build and maintain cloud resources for initiatives outside the partner engagement. * Share support of on\-premises Windows and Linux server infrastructure with other Infrastructure engineers in the near term, including patching, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting. * Support workload migrations and the operational handoff of partner\-delivered infrastructure, including runbooks, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. Cloud Security \& Governance * Implement cloud security controls, including IAM, least\-privilege access, encryption, logging, and policy enforcement, in partnership with the Security team. * Integrate cloud platforms with enterprise identity (Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM Identity Center) in partnership with other Infrastructure engineers. * Monitor and optimize cloud spend through rightsizing, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, and support budget planning and forecasting. * Support PCI DSS requirements, audit readiness, and vulnerability remediation for cloud and server infrastructure. Cloud Operations \& Incident Response * Implement and tune monitoring, alerting, and logging for cloud and hybrid workloads (e.g., Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor). * Serve as an escalation point for cloud and hybrid infrastructure incidents; lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for Priority 1–2 issues. * Plan and execute changes and maintenance windows, with rollback plans, following the Change Management process. * Participate in a shared on\-call rotation with the Infrastructure team for after\-hours support. * Mentor engineers and support staff, and contribute to cross\-training and knowledge sharing. Additional Responsibilities * Other duties as assigned. **Qualifications \& Skills:** Required * Hands\-on production experience with core AWS and Azure services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring; strong AWS experience is highly preferred. * Working knowledge of cloud landing zones and multi\-account or multi\-subscription governance, and of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework or Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework. * Experience with hybrid connectivity and cloud networking (VPC/VNet design, VPN, AWS Direct Connect or Azure ExpressRoute, DNS, and routing) and with serverless services (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions). * Solid Windows Server and Linux administration experience in enterprise environments. * Scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for infrastructure automation. * Disciplined approach to documentation and change management. Preferred * Industry cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\), Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\), or equivalent. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation or CDK, Bicep, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and with containers and Kubernetes (e.g., Docker, Amazon EKS, AKS). * Multi\-cloud experience across AWS and Azure, including migrating workloads from on\-premises datacenters. * Experience with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity. * Experience supporting consultants, managed service providers, or implementation partners working in a shared cloud environment, including during large\-scale infrastructure transformation programs. * Familiarity with PCI DSS requirements and with NIST or CIS frameworks. Soft Skills * Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Composure and sound judgment under pressure during outages and periods of major change. * Collaborative and proactive attitude with a focus on continuous improvement. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. **Education \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). * 5\+ years of systems engineering experience in multi\-site enterprise environments, including at least 3 years designing and operating production workloads in AWS or Azure. **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment:** * Hybrid position based in Indianapolis, IN, with a mix of on\-site and remote work. * Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use; occasional work in datacenter environments, including lifting equipment up to 50 lbs. * Participation in a shared after\-hours on\-call rotation and scheduled maintenance windows. * Occasional travel to Herff Jones facilities may be required. Herff Jones, Inc. and its affiliates are equal opportunity employers and maintain affirmative action plans to recruit, retain, develop, and promote qualified individuals without unlawful consideration of race, gender, gender identity, color, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, citizenship status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Herff Jones strives to maintain a work environment free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, where associates are treated with respect and dignity. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits a résumé into this career site or to a hiring manager does so with the understanding that the applicant's résumé will become the property of Herff Jones. Herff Jones will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Why work at Higgsfield AI?** Higgsfield AI is the fastest\-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M\+ users worldwide, 6M\+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI\-powered video creation and next\-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high\-impact team shaping the future of AI\-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like. **About the role:** We're looking for a **Data Engineer, B2B \& GTM** to build and scale the data infrastructure powering Higgsfield's enterprise business and go\-to\-market operations. This role will own the development of reliable data pipelines, integrations, and data models that connect our product usage, customer, sales, and revenue data. You'll work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Product to establish a trusted foundation for reporting, forecasting, customer intelligence, and strategic decision\-making. This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant ownership and the opportunity to build scalable data systems in a rapidly growing B2B business. **What you'll do:** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines integrating CRM, billing, product analytics, and other business\-critical systems. * Connect product usage, account activity, sales pipeline, contracts, and revenue data to create a consistent view of B2B customers. * Build reliable, well\-documented data models supporting pipeline analytics, revenue reporting, customer segmentation, retention, and expansion. * Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Finance to support forecasting, territory planning, account prioritization, sales performance, and revenue attribution. * Establish visibility into how enterprise customers adopt and use Higgsfield's products, enabling insights into conversion, engagement, and expansion opportunities. * Implement automated validation, monitoring, documentation, and governance to ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems. * Identify opportunities to improve pipeline performance, automation, and infrastructure as the business grows. **Requirements:** * 6\-8\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or a closely related technical role. * Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines. * Experience working with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift. * Hands\-on experience with data transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar technologies. * Experience integrating data from business systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, or other CRM and billing platforms. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data architecture, and data quality best practices. * Familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics, including ARR, pipeline, conversion, retention, churn, and expansion. * Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Strong communication skills and experience partnering directly with nontechnical stakeholders. **Compensation \& Benefits** * We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long\-term growth. * **Base Salary:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$200,000 \- $260,000**, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location. * **Bonus:** This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program. * **Equity:** In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long\-term growth. * **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks. * The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast\-moving, and international team. * Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales. This is a **hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area**. Team members are expected to work from our San Francisco office **three full days per week**, with the remaining days worked remotely and are expected to be available during agreed working hours and to maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. We value in\-person collaboration, active communication, responsiveness, and close partnership across teams. *Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

jobs.description: **Transform Your Career** We deliver unparalleled opportunities for growth and career advancement. Our dynamic, entrepreneurial culture supports your journey every step of the way. Embrace new challenges and deliver real value to some of the world's most influential Fortune 100 brands, growth companies transforming their industries, and mid\-market firms that need help navigating the defining moments of their lifecycle. Work side by side with business leaders to solve complex client challenges and make a true impact. Love what you do as part of a diverse organization committed to collaboration and continuous learning. **The Team – Digital** Our Digital practice brings application development, engineering, cloud, and modernization together to solve complex technology challenges. We build and evolve digital solutions that work for businesses today. This includes: * Application Modernization \& Migration * Custom Application Development * Product Design \& Experience * Cloud \& Infrastructure Engineering * API \& Systems Integration * DevOps \& Platform Engineering. **You Are** You are a team\-builder and problem\-solver. You stay updated on new products and technologies. You have hands\-on experience using automation, and AI/ML tools and applications to creatively design, prototype, and implement solutions for your clients. You know that collaboration is key, so you look for ways to share and source best practices. If there's a new way to do something that improves outcomes for clients, you'll find it. **Your Impact** * Modernize legacy applications and architectures to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability. * Design and build digital applications that solve real business needs and deliver better user experiences. * Turn business ideas into scalable digital products with the engineering expertise to take them from concept through delivery. * Design, migrate, and optimize cloud environments to improve agility, scalability, and operational performance. * Connect applications, data, and systems to create more seamless digital experiences and workflows. * Automate development and delivery processes to improve reliability, speed, and the ability to scale. * Design and build modern data warehouses and analytics\-ready data models * Develop scalable, reliable data pipelines using cloud\-based data platforms * Implement analytics, reporting, and visualization solutions that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for client stakeholders * Partner with client teams to understand business objectives, data challenges, and success metrics through interviews and working sessions * Manage discrete project workstreams, balancing technical execution with client communication and delivery timelines * Present findings, recommendations, and solution designs to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Leverage AI\-assisted development environments to design, generate, test, and iterate on production\-quality analytics and data engineering code * Support broader data transformation initiatives, including system implementations, migrations, and modernization efforts * Actively participate in internal knowledge sharing, mentoring, and career development activities * Perform in a leadership and Solution Architect role, helping with shaping the strategic direction of our growing AI/ML, automation, and Data Analytics functions. * Deliver on projects in the areas of data management, data governance, dashboard monitoring, DQ dashboards, data controls, data lineage, and data mapping. * Support data transformation initiatives across a range of service lines, including: + M\&A Lifecycle (integrations, divestitures, and carveouts) + Finance Transformation + Enterprise Data Strategy / Governance Standup + Process Improvement and Automation + System Implementations / Migrations + Data and Automation Strategy and Road mapping (including how companies can leverage AI, ML, and other advanced data modeling concepts) * Identify insights through use of statistical, algorithmic, mining and visualization techniques. * Conduct interviews with client stakeholders to identify process and data challenges. * Document and present findings to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Develop analytical proof\-of\-concept prototypes and/ or deliver large\-scale analytical platform implementations to fulfill clients' tactical and strategic requirements. * Develop business procedures and data management policies for ensuring data accuracy and control. * Create model documentation, develop implementation roadmaps, and perform knowledge transfers. **At a minimum, you will have:** * 5\+ years of data and product development experience * Experience architecting and developing AI/ML solutions. * Ability to lead workshops, including the gathering/documenting of requirements and use\-cases and recommendation of envisioned processes. * Experience presenting to C\-suite. * Industry experience within Financial Services/FinTech/Banking and/or Technology/SaaS. * Understanding of typical software development lifecycles (Waterfall and Agile) and their associated lifecycle artifacts. * Experience with identifying and correcting problems in imperfect data and processes. * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field or equivalent number of years of experience * Flexibility to accommodate travel up to 25%. **Preferably, you will have:** * Experience programming in Python, SQL, and/or R. * Experience using GitHub (e.g., source code management). * Experience with any of the following commercial analytics, automation, and AI/ML tools: Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, AI/ML/GenAI platforms, Informatica, Oracle EDMC, etc. * Proven ability to lead, motivate and build teams that deliver * Strong business skills and experience in accounting, corporate finance, and FP\&A. * Familiarity with the M\&A transaction lifecycle. * Master's degree in Business or related field. * Experience managing technical development by acting as a liaison between the technical team and the user community. **EEO Notice** jobs.title: Director, Applied AI Engineering
jobs.description: Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible. Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P\&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here! **PURPOSE OF THE JOB** The Director of Applied AI Engineering is a senior leader responsible for the delivery and operation of generative and agentic AI solutions across the enterprise. This role leads a team of engineers who design, build, deploy, and support generative and agentic AI capabilities that address business needs in underwriting, claims, distribution, finance, and corporate operations. The Director owns AI Platforms, the shared enterprise capability through which these solutions reach and remain in production, comprising managed foundation model services, agent runtime and orchestration, and machine learning operations. The Director sets engineering standards for generative and agentic AI development and establishes the operating model by which this work is delivered and supported. The Director collaborates closely with data services, cloud and infrastructure engineering, product management, and enterprise risk and governance functions to ensure solutions are well\-founded, responsibly deployed, and sustainable in production. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Leads the design, development, and production delivery of generative and agentic AI solutions across the enterprise, including generative AI applications, intelligent document processing, conversational interfaces, and agentic and multi\-agent workflows. * Owns AI Platforms, including managed foundation model services (Amazon Bedrock), agent runtime and orchestration (Bedrock AgentCore), and machine learning operations — model registry, feature engineering, deployment pipelines, model serving, versioning, evaluation, and production monitoring. * Operates AI Platforms as a shared enterprise capability, onboarding and supporting engineering, analytics, and data science teams as platform tenants and defining the standards and guardrails under which they build. * Establishes and maintains engineering standards for generative and agentic AI development, including prompt and context management, evaluation frameworks, testing practices, documentation, and release management. * Directs the delivery model for generative and agentic AI work, including team structure, capacity planning, and management of commitments to business stakeholders. * Partners with data and AI product management, who own intake and prioritization, to convert the prioritized portfolio into achievable delivery commitments. * Oversees production support for generative and agentic AI solutions, ensuring reliability, performance, and issue resolution within established service levels. * Maintains capacity for applied research and evaluation of emerging generative and agentic AI capabilities, balancing exploratory work against production delivery commitments. * Evaluates emerging generative and agentic AI technologies, foundation models, platforms, and vendors; makes build\-versus\-buy recommendations and recommends adoption when appropriate. * Partners with enterprise risk and governance functions to ensure generative, agentic, and machine learning solutions complete required review and approval prior to production deployment. * Collaborates with data services teams to define and secure the data products, semantic models, and pipelines required to support generative and agentic AI solutions. * Partners with cloud and infrastructure engineering teams, who own on\-premise and cloud hosting, to define the compute, hosting, security, and scaling requirements on which AI Platforms depends. * Partners with financial operations on cost transparency and unit economics for AI Platforms consumption, including token, inference, agent execution, and model cost management. * Translates complex, cross\-functional business and integration needs into actionable development requirements, designs, and plans for engineering teams. * Directs the team utilizing KPIs and data to inform decision making. * Monitors and evaluates the performance of generati services environment with model governance requirements preferred. * Master's degree in a technical or quantitative discipline preferred. **LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS** * Cloud and machine learning certifications including but not limited to AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified Azure AI Engineer, or other relevant certifications preferred. * Agile certifications including but not limited to Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified SAFe practitioner, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP), or other relevant certifications preferred. **KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS** * Strong working knowledge of generative and agentic AI architectures, foundation model selection, model lifecycle management, and evaluation methods. * Working knowledge of managed foundation model and agent runtime services, including Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore or comparable platforms, and of the data engineering practices that support retrieval and grounding. * Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex engineering initiatives with multiple teams, stakeholders, and dependencies. * Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineering team members, with a focus on improving team dynamics and performance. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present technical information to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to operate effectively where critical dependencies are owned by other teams, working through published commitments and shared prioritization. * Proven ability to manage cross\-functional teams and drive change in complex environments. * Strong analytical skills to assess business and technical requirements and develop effective solutions. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The employee may need to sit in front of a computer for a period of time. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may occasionally need to reach, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may need to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment. *This description is a general statement of essential job functions and responsibilities. It does not exclude other duties as assigned.* The current range for this position is $160,745\.90 \- $287,738\.43 This range is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. If hired at ICW Group, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors unique to each candidate, including experience, education and the location of the role and considers employees performing substantially similar work. **WHY JOIN ICW GROUP?** * Challenging work and the ability to make a difference * You will have a voice and feel a sense of belonging * We offer a competitive benefits package, with generous medical, dental, and vision plans as well as 401K retirement plans and company match * Bonus potential for all positions * Paid Time Off * Paid holidays throughout the calendar year * Want to continue learning? We’ll support you 100% *ICW Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. ICW Group will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, age, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.* **Job Category** At ICW Group we offer a work environment that encourages entrepreneurialism and celebrates success. Our team members are hands\-on contributors who are given the opportunity to make an impact. It's our people who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. **Job Type:** Full time **Req ID:** JR101722

jobs.title: Engineer Systems III
jobs.description: Location: Las Vegas, NV, US, 89113 Requisition ID: 19647 ***IGT****, where innovation meets entertainment on a global scale!* *From the casino floor to your mobile screen,* ***we deliver thrilling, responsible, and unforgettable gaming experiences****—powered by world‑class* ***content****, strong technical and* ***commercial capabilities*** *and nurtured by a* ***culture*** *of collaboration, accountability, and ownership.* *Whether it’s spinning reels, placing bets, or enabling secure payments, we turn innovation into impact through disciplined execution and long‑term value creation. With a team of over* ***6,000 employees across 30\+ countries*** *and products delivered in* ***more than 100 jurisdictions worldwide****, we operate at scale while staying closely connected to customers we serve. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here \-* ***www.igt.com****.* **Overview** ============ The Engineer Systems III oversees the architecture, development, testing, documentation, and engineering support of key production systems. The role designs scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure, improves application and network performance, and supports strategic IT planning. Working with internal teams and other departments, the position resolves critical incidents, maintains regulatory compliance, and simplifies and consolidates systems in line with long\-term organizational goals. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Exercise discretion and independent judgment in overseeing the architecture, development, testing, documentation, and engineering support of key production systems. * Lead strategic planning for IT infrastructure development and upgrades, validating that changes and new systems align with future\-state goals. * Design and architect complex systems with scalability, reliability, and security in mind. * Provide technology leadership and vision, focusing on simplifying and consolidating systems while supporting the department’s long\-term goals. * Work with internal teams to troubleshoot and tune in\-house applications, enhance system and network uptime, and provide engineering\-level support. * Conduct performance analysis to identify and address system bottlenecks and improve efficiency. * Lead cross\-functional collaboration to identify, design, and implement strategic IT solutions and data services. * Design data verification methods, disaster recovery solutions, and archive solutions. * Collaborate with security teams to implement advanced security strategies aligned with organizational goals. * Maintain knowledge of developments in data security, secure delivery services, databases, networks, system architecture, and software development, considering new technologies in future infrastructure planning. * Support development by ensuring a segregated test environment is in place before promoting new products and services to production. * Monitor and maintain compliance with PCI, PII, SOX, and other jurisdictional standards; develop and enforce IT policies, standards, and procedures that support regulatory requirements and industry best practices. * Lead the resolution of critical IT incidents, enabling rapid recovery and minimizing business impact. Provide root cause analysis documentation to management for communication by leadership. * Assist with equipment maintenance and procurement. * Provide training, guidance, and mentoring to less experienced team members to support their professional development. * Perform other related duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ================== **Education and Certifications** -------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Information Management or a related field, or a combination of education and equivalent work experience required. * VMware and Microsoft certifications preferred. **Experience** -------------- * 5–8 years of experience in an engineering role; IT experience preferred. * Solid experience with networks, systems, security, relational databases, and architecture processing functions. * Proven success troubleshooting computer and server hardware, software, and operating systems. **Technical Skills** -------------------- * Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and servers, including Office 365\. * In\-depth understanding of the operational dependencies of applications, networks, systems, security, and policy. * Proficient knowledge of VMware, ESXi, vSphere, vCenter, and Site Recovery Manager (SRM). * Proficient understanding of cloud technologies, including platform as a service (PaaS), infrastructure as a service (IaaS), and software as a service (SaaS). * Proven success maintaining and modifying infrastructure and schema. * Proven success with automation and scripting tools. * Understanding of three\-tier application architecture. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server\-based applications. **Core Competencies and Professional Skills** --------------------------------------------- * Communication, decisiveness, strategic thinking, creativity and innovation, analytical thinking, adaptability, and continuous learning. * Ability to work accurately and efficiently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, maintain attention to detail, and meet deadlines. * High integrity, trustworthiness, and strict confidentiality, with a positive, respectful, and professional approach to clients, colleagues, management, and external organizations. * Ability to adapt to changing processes, performance standards, goals, and budget requirements; balance competing priorities; and make sound decisions within and outside established policy. * Ability to understand technical issues, track vendor and customer inquiries, and work through issues to resolution. * Ability to work autonomously under general direction, draw on available resources, and adhere to and enforce department and company policies and procedures. **Travel and Physical Requirements** ------------------------------------ * Ability to travel approximately 0–10%, or as business needs require, with valid travel documentation and reliable transportation. * Ability to work at the assigned location to support direct communication and collaboration, except when traveling for business. * Ability to remain seated at a computer for extended periods in a limited workspace, perform repetitive keyboard, mouse, and telephone tasks, and sit, stand, or walk for extended periods. * Ability to bend, reach, twist, squat, and occasionally lift up to 30 pounds. * Ability to work primarily in a smoke\-free office with low to moderate noise. IGT is committed to sustaining a workforce that reflects the diversity of the global customers and communities we serve and to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and engaged. IGT is an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We thank all applicants for their for applying; however, only those selected to interview will be contacted. Base pay is one component of IGT’s total rewards program. Depending on the role, employees may be eligible for bonus or commission opportunities. IGT also offers a comprehensive benefits package, which may include a 401(k) savings plan with company contributions, medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and other wellness programs, subject to eligibility requirements. IGT is the global leader in gaming. For more information, please visit www.igt.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
jobs.description: Experienced Technology Chicago The Development Platform organization at IMC Trading is focused on accelerating tech team workflows by providing self\-service tools, services, documentation, and support. We design, build, and maintain the platforms that IMC's software development lifecycle depends on, establishing a consistent technical foundation across regions and empowering teams to innovate efficiently. IMC is embedding agentic AI directly into the developer workflow for our production\-critical systems. The Development Platform team operates the infrastructure that makes this possible: the environments where AI agents run, the integrations that connect them to our systems, and the safety and security controls that keep them reliable and auditable. We are seeking a Software Engineer based in Chicago to build the software behind IMC’s AI\-powered engineering workflows. Your work will span agent harnesses, developer workspaces, context delivery, and tooling that connects AI agents to internal services. This is a highly collaborative role with substantial ownership. You will engage directly with engineers to understand their needs, connect those needs to the team’s broader priorities, and turn open\-ended problems into practical solutions. You will help define what we build and carry it through design, implementation, delivery, and ongoing improvement. You will bring strong software engineering fundamentals and an eagerness to learn. Prior experience building AI tooling is welcome but not required **Your Core Responsibilities:** * Partner directly with engineering teams to understand their workflows, clarify needs, and shape solutions aligned with the team’s broader priorities. * Own software projects from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and ongoing improvement. * Develop and extend the agent harnesses and workspace capabilities that bring AI coding tools into IMC's engineering workflows, so engineers get a consistent, high\-quality experience wherever they work * Improve how agent workflows access relevant context from internal systems, working with stakeholders to define and evolve these capabilities. * Develop shared tooling to make MCP servers easier to build and maintain, including standardized authentication patterns, reusable components, and project templates. * Contribute to in\-house agents for IMC\-specific workflows, and to the evaluation and benchmarking tooling to measure quality * Embed security, reliability, and observability into the software and integrations you build. * Collaborate with global Development Platform colleagues to support adoption, gather feedback, and improve the developer experience. **Your Skills \& Experience:** * 3\+ years of work experience in a relevant role. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent. * Strong programming experience in a high\-level language; Python or Java preferred. * Experience building developer\-facing tools, APIs, or production systems. * Understanding of security principles and best practices, including authentication and authorization patterns and secrets management. * Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Curiosity and eagerness to learn about AI/LLM application patterns, even if you haven’t worked closely with them yet; exposure to agentic AI tools and workflows, such as coding agents or MCP servers, is a plus. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with stakeholders to understand their needs and connect them to broader team priorities. * Ability to take ownership of open\-ended problems, shape solutions, and carry them through delivery in a fast, collaborative environment. **About Us** *IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.* The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full\-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits \- US \| IMC Trading for more comprehensive information. ##### **Salary Range** $175,000 \- $225,000 USD Get Notified about the latest career opportunitiesSign up to receive weekly updates on vacancies at IMC.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview** As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and ship software spanning internal business applications, integrations, MarTech, and beyond. Reporting directly to the Director of Enterprise Intelligence, you will help lead the next stage of our Engineering function. You will build, maintain, and extend our proprietary applications and services, keeping them reliable, secure, performant, and scalable as the business grows. The ideal candidate has direct experience using AI platforms, including Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, and Jev for software development, prototyping, design, and workflow automation. This experience also includes building custom AI harnesses and integrations. You will apply these capabilities in a technologically progressive company. You will be part of a very collaborative, very agile team working collectively to fulfill our mission of saving our communities from unscrupulous contractors. We promise an open and transparent environment where you’ll be surrounded by highly intelligent people all working together towards a common goal. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain features across our proprietary web applications, from back\-end services to user\-facing interfaces. * Develop and maintain API integrations with enterprise systems such as Zoho, AccuLynx, Vena, Workday, and Acumatica. * Write clean, tested, maintainable code in Elixir and Python, following sound design patterns and code review practices. * Partner with stakeholders across finance, operations, marketing, HR, and leadership to turn business needs into well\-scoped technical solutions. * Build responsive, intuitive user interfaces that apply solid UI/UX principles. * Design and evolve the data models and database schemas behind application features, writing efficient SQL where needed. * Build and maintain background jobs, scheduled workflows, and service orchestration. * Own the quality of what you ship: automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation, and production support. * Improve the performance, scalability, security, and maintainability of our systems. * Help retire legacy tools and dependencies by moving the business onto more flexible, in\-house software. * Use Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI tools to accelerate development, prototype ideas quickly, and build AI\-powered features and custom harnesses into our products. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ideally building web applications or internal business But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world\-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. In the U.S., co\-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades\-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world\-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. **About the Role** ------------------ As Lead Product Manager for Agentic Commerce, you'll define what agentic payments and rewards look like at Imprint, then go build it. This is a zero\-to\-one role: you'll run a small skunkworks team that ships in tight increments, puts new products in front of real users fast, and lets the market tell us what works. We're looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply fluent in payments, and genuinely obsessed with AI agents. You don't just follow the space; you use agents every day and build with them yourself. Agentic Commerce is a small, high\-autonomy team inside Imprint's payments organization. It operates like a startup within the company: few dependencies, short cycles, and a bias toward shipping something real over polishing a plan. You'll report to the product leader for Payments, Risk and Customer Operations, and partner day to day with engineers on our payments and messaging platform. You'll also work closely with partnerships, risk, compliance and our brand partners to turn experiments into products that can run at scale. **The Opportunity** ------------------- * Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for agentic commerce at Imprint, from how agents initiate and authorize payments to how cardholders use agents to earn and redeem rewards. * Run a fast build\-measure\-learn loop: frame a bet, ship the smallest version that tests it, read the signal, and decide whether to scale, pivot or kill it. * Prototype hands\-on with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor and similar) to get from idea to something users can touch in days, not quarters. * Get close to the power users who already use agents to optimize their spending and rewards, and turn what you learn into products they'd pay attention to. * Track the agentic payments ecosystem (network and wallet agent programs, agent payment protocols, tokenization) and decide where Imprint should build, partner or wait. * Work with risk, compliance and our bank partners to design agent\-initiated payment flows that are safe and auditable from day one. * Make the case for what's working to leadership and brand partners, and help shape how Imprint takes agentic products to market. ### **What Success Looks Like** * **First 90 days:** you've talked to dozens of power users and partners, picked the first two or three bets, and shipped at least one experiment to real users. * **First 6 months:** a repeatable cadence of small releases, with clear evidence on which agentic use cases drive engagement, spend or rewards value. * **First 12 months:** at least one agentic product live with brand partners, and a point of view on agentic commerce that shapes Imprint's broader product strategy. **Your Profile** ---------------- * 8\+ years building products, as a product manager, founder or both, with a track record of taking something from zero to real usage. * Strong payments experience: card networks, issuing, acquiring, tokenization, wallets or money movement. You understand how a transaction actually flows and where the hard problems live. * Demonstrated high agency in ambiguous environments. You've been handed a blank page with no team, playbook or clear owner and delivered measurable impact anyway. * A genuine, hands\-on passion for AI agents, shown through what you've built, shipped or tinkered with, not just what you've read. * Fluency with core LLM and agent concepts (tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails) and the judgment to turn them into reliable products that handle real money. * Comfort prototyping with modern AI\-native tools and working directly in code alongside engineers. * Clear, concise communication. You can explain a complex system to an engineer, a bank partner and an executive in the same afternoon. We care more about what you've done than how your resume is titled. If you meet most of these and are excited by the role, we encourage you to apply. ### **Bonus Points** * You've founded a company, ideally after starting your career as a PM, and spent time building in payments along the way. * You were the first PM at an early\-stage startup. * You've built or shipped an agent, agent integration or agentic payments product. * Experience with credit cards, rewards or loyalty programs. * You're a rewards optimizer yourself, and you already have agents doing some of that work for you. **Learn More** -------------- Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog: https://tech.imprint.co/ **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Leading configured work computers of your choice * Flexible paid time off * Fully covered, high\-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage * Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA * 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents * Access to industry\-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity *Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.* Compensation Range: $190K \- $210K

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers. (\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026\)**Day to Day** -------------- As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer in our Staffing Technology Marketplace group, you'll own the source data, the models and the business impact behind Indeed's AI\-first staffing platform, which agencies, employers and the MSPs that coordinate them use every day to take orders, book workers and manage shifts. Through Indeed and our own Indeed Flex agency, we see labor\-market activity at a scale no single agency can: workers looking for work, employers creating demand, shifts being worked. You'll set the technical direction for turning that into models that predict whether a booked worker will turn up, whether and how fully an order will fill, and which orders are at risk early enough for someone to act. You'll then turn those predictions into decisions customers act on and increasingly trust the platform to make for them: how many backups to book, which agencies an MSP should release an order to and in what sequence within contracted volume splits, and what pay rate will achieve the fill and quality a client asked for without overspending. On a typical day you'll work with customers and our business, product and engineering teams to define, build and evaluate production models per market in the US and UK. You'll keep them healthy and catch a model degrading for a single customer before they notice. You'll design ranking and reliability scoring that balances today's fill against the long\-term health of the worker pool, so the same few workers aren't overused while everyone else drifts away. You'll make models work from day one for a new agency with no history, and hold up on the thin data most agencies have. Every recommendation needs to be explainable to the person acting on it and configurable to each agency's risk appetite. You'll use what the models show to shape the roadmap with product, engineering and design, and work with legal and engineering partners on foundational questions, such as what can be learned across agencies and what must stay separate.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Partner with cross\-functional teams to enhance and optimize search algorithms for improved accuracy, relevance, and overall user experience. * Experiment with Proof of Concept Machine Learning model improvements, scale them to production, and run iterative A/B experiments to improve our matching technology while partnering with other teams * Define and clarify project priorities, deliverables, and success criteria in partnership with cross\-functional teams. * Act as a bridge between technical and non\-technical collaborators, facilitating effective communication and comprehension of project goals and outcomes. * Mentor and grow other software engineers and Machine Learning Engineers across teams * Break down larger Machine Learning initiatives into pieces that deliver incremental business value and guide the team through implementing them * Represent Indeed at major Machine Learning conferences, such as Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), and the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR). **Skills/Competencies** ----------------------- * Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field and a minimum of 8 years of related experience; jobs.title: Responsible AI Engineer Manager/Senior Manager
jobs.description: Posted Date 7/19/2026 Description **We are:** Accenture’s Global Responsible AI team within the Global Data \& AI Practice. AI is becoming more pervasive, more powerful and more accessible. With these new opportunities come increased risks. We work with leading organizations to ensure AI is designed, built and deployed in a manner that engenders trust and adheres to laws, regulations and ethical norms. Our Responsible AI strategy will enable us to embed responsibility into all of Accenture’s data and AI activities. We’re developing and deploying differentiated IP and Responsible AI solutions with our ecosystem partners. We’ll be engaging regulators to help shape the policy agenda, conducting pioneering research with academia and offer training and resources to our clients through the Responsible AI Academy. The risks of AI are real and well\- known. Let’s help our clients turn those risks into opportunities. **You are:** We’re looking to grow our Responsible AI team and if you’re an experienced RAI Engineer with a Responsible AI background, we’d love to hear from you. As a Responsible AI Engineer, you’ll be experienced in building state of the art models to solve difficult business challenges. But you’ll also have at least a year’s experience looking at responsible aspects such as AI model Fairness, Transparency, Explainability, Robustness, Soundness and Privacy – preferably gained in a client\-facing environment. You’ll be a problem solver who is passionate about all things data. You’ll be excited by difficult modelling challenges, and you’ll enjoy working with like\-minded people who thrive on pushing the boundaries of the possible. You’ll be an outstanding technical specialist with the strong communication skills needed to liaise with your clients and your colleagues. At the forefront of the industry, you’ll help make our Responsible AI vision a reality for clients looking to better serve their customers and operate always\-on enterprises. We’re not just focused on increasing revenues – our technologies and innovations are making millions of lives easier and more comfortable. But above all, we’re doing this responsibly and inclusively – to make sure AI technology is used equitably and in a way that is both ethically and technically sound. **The work:** You’ll be a key player, helping to deliver outstanding work for our Responsible AI clients. Some of the areas you’ll be working in include: * Developing and implementing AI models and solutions, focusing on ethical and responsible practices. * Detecting, evaluating, and applying relevant RAI dimensions (bias, fairness, robustness explainability etc.) in AI systems; work on mitigating the identified risks. Supporting client sales conversations and proposal preparation * Optimizing and maintaining existing AI systems for enhanced performance and adherence to ethical standards. * Participating in the full AI development lifecycle, including data preparation, design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. * Contributing to the development of internal guidelines, best practices for responsible AI development and technical training. * Staying updated with current AI trends, ethical considerations, and technological advancements. * Assisting in the identification and correction of biases in datasets and AI models. * Documenting AI development processes and maintaining a transparent record of decisions and methodologies used. Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. **Here’s What You Need:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related technical fields OR equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience) * Minimum of 5 years of experience in developing and evaluating machine learning models and AI solutions. At least 2 from the following: + Statistics and Probability Theory, Regression Modelling, Clustering Methods, Time Series Forecasting, Tree Ensembles + Deep Learning, Neural Networks, Generative AI + Natural Language Processing, Text Mining, Computer Vision, Image Recognition + Machine Learning Visualization Tools * Minimum of 5 years of experience in the following: + Proficiency in programming languages like Python, R, or Java. + Familiarity with AI and machine learning frameworks (e.g., Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch). + Rapid API development with standard frameworks and tools (E.g. Django, Flask, or FastAPI) + Fundamental version control practices and proficiency in version control platforms (e.g. GitHub, Bitbucket, etc) + Experience with database management and data processing. + Understanding and working knowledge of cloud services and platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) related to AI. + Demonstrated ability to work with complex datasets and perform data preprocessing and analysis. **Professional Skills Requirement** * Strong problem\ tion process. Preferred Qualifications * Hands\-on experience building or integrating **Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, RAG solutions, or vector databases**. * Experience taking emerging technology solutions from proof of concept through production deployment. * Experience with AWS, Azure, or other enterprise cloud platforms. * Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless architecture, and event\-driven systems. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, API management, and application performance monitoring. * Knowledge of responsible AI, model evaluation, data privacy, cybersecurity, and enterprise governance. * Experience leading distributed engineering teams and establishing reusable frameworks or engineering standards. * Relevant cloud, software architecture, or AI/ML certifications.
