jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Intellibus Consulting is a boutique engineering and AI transformation firm that builds mission\-critical platforms for global financial institutions. We operate at the intersection of engineering excellence, business outcomes, and executive\-level delivery. At Intellibus, our leaders are hands\-on builders who understand technology deeply, engage confidently with senior executives, and take ownership of client success. We believe successful technology transformation requires leaders who can connect business strategy, architecture, engineering, and execution **Job Description** We are looking for exceptional **Forward Deployed Engineers** with deep hands\-on software engineering expertise, particularly in Java, backend engineering, full\-stack development, microservices, and distributed systems. This is a highly technical, client\-facing engineering role that requires someone who can move seamlessly between architecture, software development, solution delivery, and executive\-level client engagement. You will work directly with client engineering teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders to understand complex challenges, design technical solutions, and lead the development and implementation of enterprise\-grade platforms. Beyond engineering delivery, you will play an important role in expanding strategic client relationships by identifying technology opportunities, recommending solutions, demonstrating technical capabilities, and helping grow existing accounts. We are specifically looking for engineers who have worked in technology consulting or professional services environments and are comfortable taking ownership of both technical delivery and client relationships. **Key ResponsibilitiesHands\-on Software Engineering \& Architecture** * Design, develop, and deliver scalable enterprise applications using Java and modern software engineering technologies. * Demonstrate deep hands\-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, REST APIs, and backend application development. * Build complex microservices\-based architectures, distributed systems, and event\-driven applications. * Develop full\-stack solutions with strong backend capabilities and practical frontend development experience. * Work across the entire software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through coding, testing, deployment, and production support. * Lead technical implementation while remaining actively involved in writing and reviewing code. * Develop reusable components, APIs, integrations, and enterprise application frameworks. * Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges, concurrency issues, and complex production defects. **Backend, Frontend \& Full\-Stack Development** * Build backend services using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and related technologies. * Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations. * Develop frontend applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Integrate frontend applications with backend services and enterprise platforms. * Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, or similar technologies. * Implement authentication, authorization, security, and API integration patterns. * Ensure application performance, maintainability, reliability, and scalability. **Microservices \& Cloud\-Native Engineering** * Design and implement microservices architectures and distributed application platforms. * Work with messaging and event\-streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka. * Build asynchronous processing, event\-driven integrations, and resilient distributed services. * Apply design patterns for service discovery, fault tolerance, circuit breakers, and distributed transactions. * Deploy and operate applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Work with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation. * Apply observability practices using logging, monitoring, tracing, and performance management tools. * Understand cloud\-native architecture, scalability, availability, and system reliability. **AI \& Agentic Engineering** * Explore and implement AI\-powered enterprise applications and intelligent workflows. * Integrate LLMs and AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications and platforms. * Develop AI agents, tool\-calling workflows, and agent orchestration capabilities. * Work with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and enterprise data integrations. * Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to solve client business and technology challenges. * Build practical prototypes and take successful AI solutions through production implementation. **Client Consulting \& Strategic Account Growth** * Work directly with client CTOs, CIOs, engineering leaders, architects, and business stakeholders. * Understand client technology environments, business priorities, and strategic challenges. * Translate business problems into technical solutions ading, concurrency, collections, JVM fundamentals, and performance optimization. * Experience with REST APIs, Hibernate, JPA, and enterprise application development. * Strong knowledge of backend architecture and enterprise integration patterns. **Full\-Stack Development** * Experience building frontend applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Ability to independently work across backend and frontend components. * Strong understanding of API integration and application architecture. **Microservices \& Distributed Systems** * Deep experience designing and implementing microservices architectures. * Strong knowledge of Kafka, event\-driven systems, messaging, and distributed computing. * Understanding of scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and high\-availability architecture. **Cloud \& DevOps** * Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud\-native deployments. * Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure\-as\-code tools is preferred. **AI \& Modern Engineering** * Exposure to LLM integrations, generative AI, AI agents, and agentic workflows. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise software is highly desirable. **Required Consulting \& Client Engagement Experience** * Previous experience working for a technology consulting firm, systems integrator, or professional services organization is mandatory. * Demonstrated experience delivering technology solutions for external enterprise clients. * Ability to manage multiple technical stakeholders and work across different client environments. * Strong executive communication and presentation skills. * Ability to identify additional technology opportunities and contribute to account expansion. * Comfortable operating in fast\-paced consulting environments where priorities and client requirements can evolve. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Significant professional software engineering experience, ideally 8\+ years. * Extensive hands\-on Java and backend engineering experience. * Proven experience building enterprise\-grade microservices and distributed systems. * Full\-stack development experience with modern frontend frameworks. * microservices. * You can engage with client engineering teams and senior executives with equal confidence. * You identify opportunities to solve broader client challenges beyond the immediate jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Event-Driven Architecture
jobs.description: Intellibus designs and engineers platforms trusted by some of the most established FinTech and financial trading firms in the world. Our engineering teams build systems that power high\-volume trading, real\-time financial data, and mission\-critical infrastructure. We expect our engineers to operate at a level where technical depth, sound judgment, and clear communication all carry weight — the problems are complex, the systems are production\-critical, and the people you work with will hold you to a high standard. **The Staff Engineer Role** We are hiring a Staff Engineer to design, build, and own full\-stack systems powering financial platforms — from frontend architecture to backend services to distributed event\-driven infrastructure. This is not a role where you pick up tickets and ship features. You will be expected to think end\-to\-end: to understand the business problem, design the system, make the trade\-offs, and deliver production\-grade software that performs reliably under heavy load.You will work directly with senior stakeholders across technical and non\-technical functions, often navigating competing priorities, ambiguity, and high\-pressure timelines. The ability to communicate clearly, manage complexity across people and systems, and maintain a high quality bar when things get difficult is essential. If you have built and shipped systems that mattered — at a startup, at a large company, or somewhere in between — and you are looking for a role where you will be challenged technically while also growing your ability to operate in complex, high\-stakes environments, we want to hear from you. **What You Will Do**Frontend Architecture * Build scalable frontend platforms using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Design modern UI architectures: server\-side rendering, component\-driven design, performance optimization, and state management patterns. * Develop reusable component systems and scalable frontend frameworks. Backend Engineering * Build backend services using Node.js and NestJS. * Design and implement REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous workflows, and high\-performance data processing systems. * Work with SQL and NoSQL databases using TypeORM, and optimize for throughput and reliability. Event\-Driven \& Distributed Systems * Design distributed systems built on event\-driven architecture using Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and messaging/queue systems. * Build services that process high\-volume financial events and real\-time trading data. Cloud \& Infrastructure * Deploy and operate systems on Microsoft Azure, including Azure App Services, Azure Data Fabric, messaging platforms, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux environments. * Design infrastructure that supports resilient, scalable distributed systems. **What Sets You Apart** We are looking for engineers who demonstrate several of the following: * You have designed and operated event\-driven distributed systems that process high\-volume real\-time data. * You have a deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and time complexity — and you apply that understanding to build systems, not just pass interviews. * You have built full\-stack platforms using React/Next.js and Node.js/NestJS that run reliably in production. * You have hands\-on experience with message queues, streaming platforms, and asynchronous workflows — Kafka, Azure Service Bus, BullMQ, or similar. * You reason clearly about system trade\-offs: latency vs. throughput, consistency vs. availability, speed vs. reliability. * You have operated systems in cloud environments like Microsoft Azure, including debugging production incidents and improving performance under pressure. * You design systems end\-to\-end and take ownership of architecture and production outcomes — not just the code you wrote. * You have mentored other engineers and contributed to architecture reviews, engineering standards, and technical decision\-making. * You communicate well under pressure. You can hold your ground in a room full of stakeholders, explain a technical decision to a non\-technical audience, and navigate situations where the right path forward is not obvious. **Technology Ecosystem** **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, HTML5, CSS3 **Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Microservices, BullMQ, TypeORM **Event\-Driven:** Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid **Infrastructure:** Microsoft Azure, Azure Data Fabric, Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Linux **Data:** SQL, NoSQL, Azure Data Fabric **Our Process** * 15\-minute video call with someone from our team * 4 Proctored GQ Tests (under 2 hours) * 30–45 minute final video interview * Job offer If this sounds like the kind of work you want to be doing, apply now. Our team will be in touch within the hour. Pay: $75\.00 \- $85\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Have you built and shipped production systems using React/Next.js and Node.js/NestJS, and were you responsible for architectural decisions — not just implementation? * Have you designed or operated event\-driven systems using messaging platforms like Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or similar technologies to process high\-volume data? * Have you worked directly with senior stakeholders or clients in high\-pressure environments where you had to balance technical trade\-offs against competing business priorities? * Have you deployed, operated, and debugged production systems in Microsoft Azure or a comparable cloud environment? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Release Engineering
jobs.description: Job Description: At ICE, we are driven by a shared mission and a commitment to continuous progress. Our team comprises dedicated problem\-solvers who begin with our customers’ needs, address their challenges, and turn them into valuable opportunities. With a start\-up mindset, we remain agile, adaptable, and ready to act quickly. The Senior Engineer is a full\-stack engineer with strong AI and large language model (LLM) expertise, embedded within the Release Engineering Development team. This team designs and maintains processes that improve infrastructure delivery through application development, data management, and automation. In this role, you will build and continuously evolve an internal, AI\-powered developer platform. Central to this work is a genuine drive to advance the application of agentic AI frameworks by designing reliable agents, prompts, MCP integrations, and building our AIDLC (AI Development Life Cycle) while staying ahead of emerging LLM capabilities. You will build and operate the agentic AI platform that is the core of our AIDLC which automates development, release, and operational workflows across engineering. This includes agents, skills, and MCP integrations that act across CI/CD, source control, ticketing, and deployment systems, with the security, evaluation, and auditability required for privileged access. **Responsibilities** * Agent Platform + Design, build, and maintain the platform \- including the agent API, MCP integrations, and intent\-routing logic. + Build MCP integrations that connect agents to CI/CD, source control, ticketing, and deployment tools, with clear schemas, robust error handling and logging, and defined scope boundaries. + Build and maintain the skill and agent registry that matches user intent with the appropriate agent and context at runtime. + Maintain a modular architecture so new agents, skills, and MCP integrations can be added without disrupting existing capabilities. * AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) \- Agentic Workflows + Design multi\-step, tool\-using agents that select tools, reason across context, and produce reliable, structured output. + Author, test, and iterate on prompts, skill definitions, and context structures while managing context windows and token budgets. + Design for failure by anticipating how agents fail, context degrades, and prompts drift \- and by defining how the system recovers. + Build release and CI/CD agents for pipeline triage, release\-readiness checks, change documentation, and rollback assistance in partnership with release and development teams. + Curate and maintain the AIDLC, outlining best practices, and championing the process across the company. * Security, Governance, and Human Oversight + Enforce least\-privilege, zero trust, access for agentic automation, with clearly defined identities (user or service account) and per\-tool permissions. + Design human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows for high\-risk actions such as deployments, promotions, and rollbacks. + Protect against prompt injection, data leakage, and overprivileged agents. + Ensure audit logging, compliance, and data\-handling controls for all agent actions and model inputs. * Evaluation, Reliability, and Cost + Build and operate evaluation frameworks, including evaluation sets, prompt regression tests, and quality metrics for agents and skills. + Evaluate and select models while managing routing, caching, token budgets, and cost attribution. + Instrument agent runs with tracing and structured logging so incorrect decisions can be diagnosed after the fact. + Own platform reliability through health checks, runbooks, and explicit failure modes \- support release tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and AI workflows in production. * Adoption and Collaboration + Contribute to developer\-facing interfaces, including chat integrations within existing communication tools and the skills catalog. + Drive adoption by mentoring teams, documenting reusable patterns, and gathering feedback from both skeptical users and early adopters. + Translate workflow needs from Engineering, Infrastructure, and release teams into effective agents and skills. + Track emerging models, agentic use cases, and prototype the technologies that matter. + Write clean, tested, and secure code. Participate in code and design reviews. Document agent designs, prompt strategies, and platform decisions. **Knowledge and Experience** * Engineering + Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience. + 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, DevOps, or release engineering, including platform or internal tooling work. + Hands\-on experience with CI/CD and Git\-based source control platforms such as GitHub or Bitbucket (GitHub preferred). * AI, Agents, and LLMs + Understanding of agentic patterns, including planning, tool selection, multi\-step tasks, agent\-loop design, and failure modes. + Strong prompt\-engineering and context\-window management skills, including experience with skill definitions or scoped system prompts. + Working knowledge of AI security risks, including prompt injection. + Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, or similar products. **Preferred Knowledge and Experience** * Experience with agentic technologies such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or AutoGen, along with the judgment to determine when a leaner custom approach is more appropriate. * Experience in Node.js/TypeScript, Go, and/or Python * Demonstrated experience building and delivering at least one production or near\-production agentic automation/process that uses LLM APIs, such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and LiteLLM, with tool calling and structured output. * Practical experience with MCP or equivalent tool\-calling frameworks, including schema design, agent\-tool integration, and scope management. * Experience evaluating LLM outputs by using evaluation sets, regression testing, and quality metrics. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases. * Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. * Experience with internal developer platforms or platform\-as\-a\-product models. * Frontend development experience with React or Angular. * Relational database design experience. * Experience with LLM observability tools. * Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or Chef. * Experience working in regulated or audited environments. * Experience with Agile practices and automated testing. * Experience with containers and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift, along with proficiency in Linux environments. * Experience troubleshooting distributed systems (e.g., Kubernetes workloads, CI/CD pipelines, message queues). **What We Look For** * An engineer who treats agentic AI as a design discipline and has a demonstrated record of applying emerging LLM and agent capabilities in practice. * A platform thinker who views agents, skills, MCP integrations, and the registry as one cohesive developer product. * Someone who takes ownership of reliability, security, and quality, and makes failure modes explicit. * A collaborative partner who reduces friction across the broader engineering organization and can build trust with skeptical teams. \#LI\-SH3 \#LI\-ONSITE \-: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior software engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Join the Data Capabilities team as a Senior Software Engineer on Intuit's Data Platform. We're using data in groundbreaking ways to uncover customer insights, personalize customer experiences through AI/ML, and provide a unified customer view across all Intuit products. As a Senior engineer, you'll operate as a technical leader — setting the direction for how we build event\-driven, real\-time data services at scale, mentoring engineers across teams, and partnering with data architects and senior leadership to shape our technology roadmap. You'll be hands\-on with core technologies like Kubernetes, Kafka, DynamoDB, and S3, while driving engineering excellence across testing, CI/CD, performance, and reliability practices. **Responsibilities** Develop web services that make big data available in real\-time for in\-product applications. Work with data architects to ensure that Event Driven solutions are aligned with company\-wide technology directions. Lead fast moving development teams using agile methodologies. Lead by example, demonstrating best practices for unit testing, CI/CD, performance testing, capacity planning, documentation, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Communicate progress across organizations and levels from individual contributor to senior executive. Identify and clarify the critical few issues that need action and drive appropriate decisions and actions. Communicate results clearly and in actionable form. Serve as technical “go to” person for our core technologies – Kubernetes, Kafka, DynamoDB, S3, and springboot. Demonstrate strong implementation aptitude to translate objectives into a scalable solution to meet the needs of the end customer while meeting deadlines. Demonstrate commitment to your professional development by attending conferences, taking classes, giving technical presentations, and participating in developer communities inside and outside of Intuit. **Qualifications** BS in Computer Science. MS Preferred. Strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms and distributed systems. Strong database fundamentals including SQL, performance and schema design. 5\+ years of strong Object Oriented Programming (Java, Scala, or Python) 5\+ years of hands\-on Software Engineering experience. 5\+ years of experience integrating technical processes and business outcomes – specifically: data and process analysis, data quality metrics/monitoring, data architecture, developing policies/standards \& supporting processes. Strong project leadership experience, including being a technical lead for multiple complex software development projects using agile methodologies. Experience with Kafka, Spark, Kafka, DynamoDB and AWS is a plus. 3\+ years working with Cloud Technologies. Experience with various offerings from AWS, including S3, EMR, Dynamo, Networking is a plus. History of contributing to open source projects is a plus. 5\+ years DevOps experience including configuration, optimization, backup, high reliability, monitoring and systems version control. Track record working with data from multiple sources – willingness to dig\-in and understand the data and to leverage creative thinking and problem\-solving. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including business writing and presentations. Ability to communicate objectives, plans, status and results clearly, focusing on critical few key points. Demonstrated ability to work in a matrix environment, ability to influence at all levels, and build strong relationships. Knowledge of enacting service level agreements and the appropriate escalation and communication plans to maintain them. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $171,000 \- $231,500

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer - Platform Software
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB218860 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** Our team designs and builds the embedded platform software infrastructure that supports critical performance, safety and user\-facing features of the da Vinci™ Surgical System, Intuitive’s flagship product. We’re looking for a high energy, experienced embedded software engineer to take technical ownership across our embedded platform software stack. In this role, you will lead board bring\-up initiatives, drive architectural decision for our next\-generation platforms, and serve as a technical anchor for the team – mentoring junior engineers and collaborating cross\-functionally with hardware, system software, and FPGA teams. or 6 years experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience; or equivalent experience * Expert\-level proficiency in C or C\+\+ for embedded systems development, including memory management, real\-time constraints, and performance\-critical code * Experience in bare\-metal, embedded Linux, including kernel internals, custom device driver development, BSP bring\-up, and user space application development * Proficiency with embedded development and debugging tools including GDB, JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and cross\-compilation toolchains * Proven hands\-on experience with hardware interfaces and protocols (I2C, I2S, T1S, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, CAN) – including bring\-up debugging, and driver development for each * Debugging and root\-cause analysis skills, with a track record of resolving complex, multi\-layer Hardware\-FPGA\-software integration failures in time\-critical environments * Demonstrated ability to mentor and technically develop junior and mid\-level engineers * Effective written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross\-functional team collaboration **Preferred Skills \& Experience** * Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms (TX2/Xavier/Orin or similar) or comparable ARM\-based SOCs in a production embedded environment * Hands\-on exper ns. * Proficiency in Python and bash scripting for test automation, bootup design, and build system integration * Demonstrated ability to root cause complex hardware\-software interactions * Demonstrated experience in and comfort with all phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, validation, and transfer to manufacturing * Experience designing software products in an FDA or other regulated industry or for mission critical applications; comfortable with concepts of design input, design output, traceability, risk analysis, and mitigations ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee. This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Agentic Evals and Self-Improvement (Nova)
jobs.description: Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data from any source, design seamless cross\-channel experiences, and optimize engagement with Nova Intelligence, the AI layer of our platform, all with enterprise\-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50\+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences. Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values to life every day: Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, and Transparency. And the market has noticed: G2 recognizes Iterable as a Leader globally, spanning the Americas, EMEA, APAC, ANZ, and Latin America, with category leadership in Personalization, Marketing Automation, Push Notifications, and Mobile Marketing, and a 4\.5/5\-star rating from hundreds of users. Gartner named Iterable a Challenger in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing in both 2024 and 2025\. We’ve also earned TrustRadius Top Rated honors in 2024 and 2025, were named a TrustRadius Buyer’s Choice for 2026, and were featured in Snowflake’s Modern Marketing Data Stack 2026\. With a global presence that includes offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together! **Location:** US **About the role** ------------------ As a high\-tech marketing platform, Iterable works with thousands of large\-scale and diverse enterprise customers. Iterable Nova is our intelligence layer. It helps customer experience teams adapt in real time and improve every interaction. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on Nova, you'll lead evaluation and automatic optimization for Nova's models and agents. That means measuring how they perform, finding where they fail, and using those findings to automatically improve prompts, context, tools, and agent harnesses. You'll work with the Nova retrieval and product teams to connect real interactions to measurable improvements. You will have real autonomy: from research and experimentation through to systems running reliably in production, you'll own this work and help shape the direction of AI at Iterable. One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply — we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond a job description. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build evaluation systems for models and agents: benchmarks, LLM judges, simulations, trajectory analysis, and regression tests. * Create a loop that takes failures from diagnosis to fix to measured improvement. * Turn evaluation results into automatic optimization of prompts, context, tools, rubrics, and agent harnesses. * Build synthetic data pipelines for evaluation and post\-training, with attention to quality, privacy, and reproducibility. * Apply recent research (LLM\-as\-judge, reward modeling, test\-time search, post\-training) to production. * Mentor engineers on the team and help set the technical direction for Nova. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of hands\-on MLE experience putting complex ML systems into production at scale, such as production ML pipelines or large\-scale experimentation platforms. * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field. * You keep up with the latest research and focus on applying it: shipping reliable changes that measurably improve the product experience for customers. * Strong Python skills with an emphasis on readable, modular, and maintainable code, plus experience with modern ML frameworks. * Deep experience evaluating LLMs or agents, including multi\-turn behavior, tool use, and reasoning. * Experience building automated evaluation, such as LLM judges, reward models, or benchmark infrastructure. * Experience with at least one of: prompt or context optimization, post\-training, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning. * Strong communication and cross\-team collaboration. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience with LLM APIs from multiple providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google), including tool calling and prompt caching. * Experience with automatic prompt optimization and error analysis \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Recruitment Disclaimer:** Please be aware that Iterable, Inc. (“Iterable”) and our official professional recruiting agencies and platforms do not: * Send job offers from free email services like Gmail, Yahoo mail, Hotmail, etc. * Request money, fees, or payment of any kind from prospective candidates to apply to Iterable, for employment, or for the recruitment process (e.g. for home office supplies, or training, etc.). * Request or require personal documents like bank account details, tax forms, or credit card information as part of the recruitment process prior to the candidate signing an engagement letter or an employment contract with Iterable. You may see all job vacancies on our official Iterable channels: * Official Iterable website, Careers page: https://iterable.com/careers/ * Official LinkedIn Jobs page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/iterable/jobs/ Iterable is not affiliated in any way to these impostors and we hereby confirm that such individuals/entities are not authorized, encouraged, or sponsored to act on behalf of Iterable. Such job opportunities are entirely fake and not valid. Therefore, please disregard any written or oral request for a job offer or an interview that you believe is or might be fraudulent or suspicious and immediately reach out to us via email at **talent\-ops@iterable.com**upon receiving a suspicious job offer. Criminal and/or civil liabilities may arise from such actions, and Iterable expressly reserves the right to take legal action, including criminal action, against such individuals/entities whenever such phenomena occur. In any case, please note that under no circumstances shall Iterable and any of its affiliates be held liable or responsible for any claims, losses, damages, expenses or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to the actions of these impostors. Iterable is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Iterable does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender\-identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. Iterable also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and other similar state laws and local ordinances, and its internal policy, Iterable will also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.description: Director of Artificial Intelligence \& Innovation Jeff Wyler Automotive Family On Site in Cincinnati, Ohio Compensation: Competitive executive level compensation based on experience Position Overview Jeff Wyler Automotive Family is seeking an exceptional technology leader to help shape the future of our organization through artificial intelligence. We are looking for someone who understands where AI technology is today, where it is heading, and how to turn that knowledge into meaningful business results. This is not a traditional IT leadership position. We are looking for an innovative thinker, an accomplished technical expert, and a proven leader who can identify opportunities, develop solutions, and build the capabilities necessary to transform how we operate. The successful candidate will lead our AI strategy, evaluate emerging technologies, develop and implement AI solutions, and establish an AI function capable of supporting our continued growth. This individual will have the opportunity to build something from the ground up, with the resources, executive support, and organizational commitment necessary to make a significant impact. Key Responsibilities AI Strategy \& Innovation * Develop and execute a comprehensive AI strategy aligned with organizational objectives. * Identify opportunities to leverage AI across sales, service, customer experience, marketing, finance, human resources, and dealership operations. * Stay at the forefront of developments in artificial intelligence, including advancements from OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic, Google, and other leading technology organizations. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their potential applications within our business. * Partner directly with executive leadership to establish priorities, recommend investments, and drive innovation throughout the organization. AI Development \& Implementation * Lead the design, development, integration, and deployment of AI solutions across the organization. * Develop and implement AI powered customer communication systems, including intelligent voice agents capable of answering calls, responding to inquiries, scheduling appointments, and supporting customer interactions. * Evaluate existing AI platforms and determine when to purchase, customize, integrate, or develop proprietary solutions. * Identify opportunities to automate business processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer engagement. * Integrate AI capabilities with existing enterprise systems, customer relationship management platforms, and dealership technologies. * Establish appropriate standards for AI performance, reliability, data security, privacy, and responsible implementation. Leadership \& Organizational Development * Establish and lead the organization's artificial intelligence function. * Determine the technical resources, talent, and infrastructure required to support the company's AI objectives. * Recruit, develop, and lead a team of AI engineers, developers, and other technical specialists as business needs evolve. * Collaborate with business leaders to identify challenges and implement practical solutions. * Establish measurable performance indicators to evaluate the effectiveness and financial impact of AI initiatives. * Promote an organizational culture that embraces innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement. What Makes This Opportunity Different This is an opportunity to lead a significant technological transformation within an established automotive organization. Rather than inheriting an existing AI department or simply maintaining established systems, you will have the opportunity to develop the strategy, establish the capabilities, assemble the team, and influence how artificial intelligence is deployed throughout the business. You will work closely with executive leadership, have meaningful influence over technology investments, and help establish the foundation for the organization's future. We are seeking someone who is not simply interested in following developments in artificial intelligence, but someone who wants to help define what comes next. If you have the technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and vision to turn emerging technology into a competitive advantage, we want to hear from you. * Significant professional experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, or related technology disciplines. * Demonstrated success developing and deploying AI solutions in a production business environment. * Strong technical understanding of large language models, generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, natural language processing, and intelligent automation. * Experience with AI application development, APIs, enterprise integrations, and cloud technologies. * Experience designing, implementing, or integrating conversational AI and voice automation technologies is highly desirable. * Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into practical business solutions. * Experience leading technical teams, managing complex projects, and influencing executive leadership. * Strong understanding of emerging AI technologies, industry developments, and the competitive technology landscape. * Ability to evaluate commercial AI platforms while also directing the development of proprietary solutions. * Exceptional strategic thinking, problem solving, communication, and leadership skills. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field preferred. healthcare RCM workflows (e.g., eligibility, authorizations, claims, denials), or of a similarly complex business domain. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and jobs.title: Systems Engineer 1
jobs.description: **Systems Engineer I** ---------------------- **Managed IT Solutions \| Full\-Time** **Role Overview** The Systems Engineer I supports customer accounts by helping keep technical systems running smoothly. Working with guidance from senior engineers, this role analyzes service tickets, troubleshoots and investigates issues to maintain and improve system performance, responds to customer requests and concerns, and installs and updates hardware and software components. This position is an entry point into the engineering team, with a focus on building hands\-on technical skills and strong customer service habits. **Core Functions** Project Support: Assist senior engineers with project tasks from kickoff through completion, delivering assigned work with quality and on time. Customer Relations: Act as a professional, responsive point of contact on assigned tickets and tasks, building trust and keeping customers updated on progress. Technical Ownership: Take ownership of assigned duties, seek feedback, and look for ways to improve while building skills with guidance from senior staff. Success Driver: Contribute to customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by combining growing technical expertise, dependable project support, and clear teamwork. **Key Responsibilities** Support new project deployments, both onsite and remotely, under the direction of a project lead or senior engineer. Work alongside project team members to complete assigned tasks and meet project expectations. Implement system upgrades and updates for customers following established procedures. Troubleshoot customer issues thoroughly, complete customer\-facing tasks with guidance from senior engineers, and escalate complex or unresolved problems when needed. Investigate and resolve problems within customer networks and IT systems using established troubleshooting methods. Communicate proactively with team members regarding task status, availability, and blockers. Identify potential upsell opportunities during the lifecycle of a service ticket and pass them to the appropriate account or sales contact. **Qualifications** Foundational knowledge of computer systems, hardware, and software, with the ability to apply that knowledge to routine support tasks. Security Solutions: Foundational familiarity with EDR and XDR; SentinelOne exposure preferred. Cloud Productivity: Foundational familiarity with cloud administration tools; Intune, Entra ID, and Azure exposure preferred. VoIP and Communication Systems: Basic familiarity with phone system support; 3CX and/or RingCentral exposure preferred. 2\+ years of helpdesk or technical support experience preferred. We value demonstrated skills over time served. Ability to use established troubleshooting methods to investigate routine technical issues, document findings, and resolve problems within assigned responsibilities. Recognizes when an issue requires senior engineer support and escalates it with relevant details. Ability to work collaboratively in cross\-functional teams and communicate technical information effectively to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Ability to organize assigned deployment and support tasks, meet agreed deadlines, and communicate progress or blockers. Works with the project lead or senior engineer to prioritize competing requests. A relentless focus on providing excellent customer service. **About K Group Companies** K Group Companies is a locally owned and operated technology service provider established in Grand Rapids, Michigan, in 1980\. As a local, third\-generation family\-owned business, we value reliable, intentional, and committed relationships with our customers and with one another. Whether we are helping customers secure their environment, competing in the Team Zone arcade, or sharing lunch together, we believe we are better together. **Compensation and Benefits** Competitive base salary based on experience Bonus and commission programs Paid Time Off (PTO) Volunteer Paid Time Off (VTO) 100% employer\-paid family health insurance premium 100% employer\-paid disability insurance 100% employer\-paid dental and vision insurance 401(k) with annual Safe Harbor contributions from the company Profit\-sharing opportunities

jobs.title: Associate Director, Full Stack Clinical Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Kardigan is a heart health company working to make cardiovascular disease preventable, curable and no longer the leading cause of death in the world. It is Kardigan's mission to develop multiple targeted treatments in parallel that bring people with cardiovascular diseases to the cures they deserve. Led by Tassos Gianakakos, Jay Edelberg, M.D., Ph.D., and Bob McDowell, Ph.D., Kardigan's co\-founders have reunited after leading MyoKardia to discover and develop mavacamten, the first cardiac myosin inhibitor, resulting in an acquisition by Bristol Myers Squibb in 2020\. We have a cutting\-edge discovery and translational research platform, a pipeline of late\-stage candidates, and an industry\-leading team that is driven to improve the lives of patients. At Kardigan, we are motivated by our values which guide how we work, interact, and achieve our goals. **Driven by patients and their families**, we are deeply committed to improving the lives of patients and prioritizing their needs above all else. We believe in **being authentic**—leading with truth to bring out the best in others by creating an environment where every person knows they will be fully accepted. With an **eagerness to learn**, we encourage the highest levels of curiosity and are open to changing our minds. We are committed to **winning as a team** with urgency, excellence, and intention, and support each other no matter what role we play or where we sit. Lastly, we strive to **enable the impossible** because patients are counting on us. We are not afraid to take risks to unlock innovation and advance scientific discoveries. These values are the foundation of our work, empowering us to make a real difference, every day. **Job Overview** The Full Stack Clinical Platform Engineer will design, implement, and operate production\-grade Generative AI and Machine Learning solutions that power Kardigan's Global Development Digital Transformation initiative. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and applied AI—partnering closely with Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory, and IT to design, build, and maintain the modern data platforms and AI\-enabled pipelines that underpin the transformation program. **Candidates must have experience in Biotech/Pharma/Healthcare** The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Biotech/Pharma or Healthcare clinical data infrastructure and modern data engineering, combined with hands\-on experience deploying machine learning solutions in regulated life sciences environments. This role will act as both a technical authority and strategic liaison between transformation projects and enterprise IT, ensuring that solutions are scalable, compliant, and aligned with evolving regulatory and data standards. **Key Responsibilities** * Translate ambiguous clinical and operational problems into well\-scoped AI solutions, from problem framing and data assessment through prototype, validation, and production deployment. * Design and implement MLOps/LLMOps pipelines to deploy, monitor, and manage large language models in production environments, following software engineering best practices * Collaborate with data scientists to deploy and/or fine\-tune high\-performing Generative AI models, and apply modern techniques from relevant published work where appropriate. * Develop scalable and robust data and ML pipelines for ingestion, preprocessing, validation, training, evaluation, and model deployment across the clinical development ecosystem. * Evaluate and recommend AI tools and frameworks to meet clinical and operational requirements, including decisions around retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, embedding models, and LLM providers, balancing compliance, performance, and cost. * Develop, deploy, and maintain robust data pipelines for structured and unstructured clinical data, integrating internal systems with CRO and external partner data sources, and ensuring end\-to\-end data integrity and traceability. * Identify and implement opportunities to increase data interoperability and standardization across Global Development systems and other business units, reducing manual effort and accelerating data availability for clinical programs. * Develop and implement automated quality monitoring pipelines for both internal and CRO\-sourced clinical data, surfacing quality metrics and triggering corrective workflows in alignment with the study's Medical Monitoring Plan. * Ensure all data solutions comply with applicable regulatory frameworks including HIPAA, GDPR, and 21 CFR Part 11, and contribute to data governance strategy, data lineage documentation, and audit\-readiness. * Maintain and manage code repositories (e.g., Bitbucket, GitHub) with clean, well\-documented, version\-controlled code; uphold engineering best practices including code review, testing, and CI/CD pipelines. **Qualifications** * Advanced degree in computer science, biomedical informatics, statistics, or a closely related field required; PhD with 6\+ years of relevant experience or MS with 10\+ years of relevant experience strongly preferred. * Minimum of 5–7 years of experience designing, implementing, and leading data engineering solutions in **life sciences or healthcare**, with demonstrated accountability for end\-to\-end delivery is required. * Demonstrated expertise in designing and maintaining clinical or biomedical data infrastructure, including data lake and warehouse architectures optimized for regulatory\-grade clinical data. * Expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery) and proficiency in Python, SQL, R, and related programming languages. * Proficiency in cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and DevOps practices including CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure\-as\-code; relevant certifications a plus. * Demonstrated experience building, scaling, and maintaining pipelines for structured and unstructured data, with the ability to integrate pipelines across the enterprise. * Deep knowledge of regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, 21 CFR Part 11\) and clinical data standards (CDISC, HL7, FHIR), with experience applying them in regulated development environments. * Hands\-on experience developing or integrating machine learning pipelines and working with clinical AI/ML applications such as natural language processing, anomaly detection, or predictive modeling. * Strong scientific communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical architectures and outputs into clear strategic recommendations for non\-technical clinical and executive stakeholders. * Experience with data governance frameworks, data quality tooling, and metadata management practices in clinical or regulated settings. **Ideal Candidate Trail** * A builder at heart — someone who moves fluidly from whiteboard to working solution, comfortable owning the full arc from idea through deployed product. * Able to assess a clinical or operational challenge and independently determine whether and how AI can meaningfully solve it — not just implement what's handed to them. * A natural cross\-functional collaborator who earns the trust of clinical, operations, regulatory, and IT stakeholders alike—comfortable operating as both a technical lead and a strategic partner. * Solutions\-oriented and innovation\-driven, with the confidence to constructively challenge legacy thinking and the pragmatism to deliver within the constraints of a regulated environment. * Thrives in ambiguity and fast\-moving environments, able to balance long\-horizon architectural thinking with near\-term delivery commitments across multiple concurrent transformation workstreams. * A proactive learner who actively monitors advances in AI/ML, data engineering, and clinical informatics and brings external insights back to accelerate the program's evolution.

The ideal candidate has experience in manual testing, automated testing, API validation, and software quality assurance processes. The successful candidate will collaborate with software developers, product managers, and engineering teams to identify defects, improve testing coverage, and deliver high\-quality software solutions. Key Responsibilities * Develop and execute manual and automated test cases. * Analyze software requirements and prepare test plans. * Perform functional, regression, integration, and performance testing. * Identify, document, and track software defects. * Validate REST APIs and database operations. * Build and maintain automated testing frameworks. * Collaborate with developers to investigate and resolve software issues. * Participate in code reviews and Agile development activities. * Monitor application quality throughout the development lifecycle. * Maintain test documentation and quality reports. Preferred Skills * Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter. * Knowledge of Postman and API automation. * Familiarity with Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Experience testing web and mobile applications. * Understanding of cloud\-based software environments. * Knowledge of test automation frameworks and quality engineering practices. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the company provides custom software development, quality engineering, test automation, application modernization, cloud engineering, and AI solutions. KMS works with businesses across healthcare, financial services, retail, logistics, and technology industries. jobs.title: Data Engineer - Snowflake & DBT
jobs.description: Attention: Kapitus is aware that individuals posing as recruiters may be communicating with job seekers about supposed positions with Kapitus. Kapitus has received reports that the content and method of communication can vary, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive financial information. Kapitus will **never** ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information during the initial application or interview process. All open positions are posted in location specific employment portals available at www.kapitus.com/careersAll legitimate Kapitus job postings on employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application through these portals before completion of the hiring process. Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus' recruiting process in general should email **recruiting@kapitus.com** Kapitus is building a next\-generation enterprise data and AI capability for our financial services organization. This is a multi\-year modernization program that replaces hundreds of legacy analytics workflows with governed, reusable business data products on a modern cloud data platform, stands up an AI/ML platform, and moves the organization from producing reports to producing decisions. We are hiring Data Engineers to build that platform and the products on it. The core stack is Snowflake and dbt, organized around a layered medallion architecture bronze/silver/gold\-style layers extended with governed conformed entities, certified semantic definitions, and reusable serving structures. You will build ingestion and transformation pipelines, model data across layers, migrate legacy workflows onto the platform, and ship data products through evidence\-based acceptance gates. You report to the Director of Data Engineering, who owns the platform architecture and engineering standards. This is a delivery role on a program that runs to tight timelines and real acceptance criteria: your work is done when it is validated, evidenced, and accepted code complete is not product complete. You will work alongside internal engineers and consulting\-partner teams across onshore and offshore locations, all held to the same engineering bar. Senior Data Engineers additionally own complex workstreams or product slices, lead technical design within the approved architecture, review other engineers' work, mentor team members, and drive difficult migrations or production issues to closure. **What you will do:** **Build** * Develop ELT pipelines on Snowflake and dbt: source ingestion, layered transformations through the medallion zones, and governed serving structures for BI, API, ML, and AI consumption. * Model data within the platform's layered architecture — staging, conformed core entities, dimensional and product\-level models — following approved modeling standards for grain, keys, and naming. * Implement approved data contracts, conformed entity definitions, keys, relationships, and certified semantic definitions consistently across models; do not create local definitions when a governed one exists. * Migrate legacy analytics workflows (e.g., Alteryx) onto the modern stack: analyze the existing logic, implement it correctly in dbt and Snowflake, prove parity where required, and support retirement of the legacy asset. * Implement data quality as code: dbt tests, source freshness checks, reconciliation and validation queries, and pipeline observability — quality controls ship with the pipeline, not after it. * Build for reuse: contribute to shared ingestion frameworks, certified transformation patterns, and common serving structures rather than one\-off solutions. **Engineer** * Work software\-engineering style: Git\-based workflows, peer code review, CI/CD, environment promotion, and documentation that lets someone else operate what you built. * Follow and help improve the platform's engineering standards — repository structure, dbt project conventions, testing requirements, and performance and cost discipline (warehouse sizing, query efficiency, clustering choices). * Tune what you ship: profile query performance, manage Snowflake compute cost consciously, and treat efficiency as part of correctness. * Support what you ship in production: use observability to diagnose failures, participate in incident and root\-cause analysis, implement durable corrective actions, and prevent recurring defects rather than repeatedly patching symptoms. * Surface risks and ambiguity early — resolving a problem before build is cheaper than discovering it during validation or production. **Deliver** * Deliver against the program's acceptance gates: build to approved designs and acceptance criteria, produce developer verification evidence for your work, and support independent acceptance validation — engineers test their own work thoroughly but do not independently approve it for acceptance. * Work from design speci bility** –Up to 10% annually * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and employer\-paid vision plans through UnitedHealthcare (UHC), with various coverage levels available to meet the needs of our employees and their families. Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life. * **Flexible Spending Account:** Set aside pre\-tax dollars from your paycheck to pay for qualified out\-of\-pocket medical, dental, vision, pharmacy or dependent care expenses. * **Lifestyle Spending Account:** Employer sponsored post\-tax benefits that allow reimbursement for expenses related to physical, mental and financial well\-being. * **100% Company Paid Insurances:** Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense. * **Voluntary Insurance:** Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short\- and long\-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events. * **Paid Maternity and Parental Leave:** Beyond state\-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company\-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones. * **Commuter Benefits:** We offer pre\-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work. * **LifeBalance Program:** Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include: + Pet and car insurance discounts. + Financial services such as LegalShield. + Relaxation and stress management tools. * **Plum Benefits Discount Program:** Access exclusive discounts on shows, travel, car rentals, and more, enriching your personal and family life. * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Pursue further education with up to $5,000 annually in tuition reimbursement, plus opportunities to attend relevant conferences and career development events. Managed through our LSA plan, Kapitus Academy. * **Travel Reimbursement:** We also offer travel reimbursement for all work\-related travel, supporting your involvement in career and personal development activities. * **Paid Time Off and Sick Time.** * **Retirement Benefits**: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long\-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary. **About Kapitus:** Kapitus is one of the most reliable and respected names in small business financing. As both a direct lender and a marketplace built with a trusted network of lending partners, we can provide small businesses with the financing they need when, and how it is needed. We have spent our entire existence building a culture that makes us excited to come to work in the morning. Our company is fast paced, teammates need to be self\-directed and have an internal motivation to do the right thing, even when the right thing takes a lot of hard work. We show our teammates our appreciation by offering great benefits, competitive pay and solid opportunity for growth. **Company Mission:** At Kapitus, our mission is to help small business owners grow their organizations by providing tailored, transparent, and ethical financing solutions. We invest in every business owner's story and we are dedicated to building lasting relationships to champion their goals. We promise to keep the best interests of our clients at the center of the financing process by operating with transparency, fairness, and integrity. **Consideration will be given to qualified remote candidates residing in states where Kapitus and/or one of its subsidiaries has an established physical presence.**

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer - Tolling Delivery
jobs.description: Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range of application areas. As a family\-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. To learn more about our solutions and innovations, visit our website here. **Role Purpose** As Lead Systems Engineer, you'll hold the highest level of technical ownership on our Systems Engineering track, joining a dispersed, cross\-disciplinary team of hardware, software, and electrical engineers. You'll lead the technical delivery of complex, integrated tolling systems, bringing together roadside hardware, embedded devices, applications, and back\-office software into a fully operational solution. This role requires someone with demonstrated experience delivering tolling systems in real\-world environments, ideally having led major system delivery activities over multiple years. You'll take ownership from the bid and solution development phases through engineering, installation, integration, commissioning, and operational handoff. You'll be accountable for ensuring the technical solution is delivered to customer requirements, contractual commitments, quality expectations, and operational objectives. You'll be the technical face of the client relationship, building trust with customer stakeholders throughout the life of a program while leading the engineering teams responsible for successful delivery. You'll own the requirements baseline, manage technical scope, coordinate complex hardware and software dependencies, and provide the technical direction needed to move programs forward. This is an opportunity for an experienced systems engineering leader who understands what it takes to deliver tolling infrastructure—not just design it—and who can translate complex technical requirements into successful, operational systems. **How You'll Make an Impact** * Lead end\-to\-end tolling system delivery — Take technical ownership of tolling system implementations from bid\-phase sales support and solution development through engineering, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff. Ensure the system is delivered efficiently, meets contractual and technical requirements, and achieves the intended operational outcomes. * Bring proven tolling delivery experience — Apply practical experience delivering tolling systems and roadside infrastructure programs, anticipating the technical, operational, integration, and implementation challenges that arise throughout the project lifecycle. * Serve as the primary technical point of contact — Lead technical discussions with customers, understand their business and operational objectives, communicate tradeoffs clearly, manage expectations, and navigate difficult technical or scope conversations with professionalism and sound judgment. * Own the requirements baseline end\-to\-end — Lead requirements elicitation, analysis, decomposition, specification, validation, traceability, and change control from the first customer conversation through final acceptance. jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: Keeper is hiring a driven, Implementation Engineer to join our B2B Support team. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates who live near our global headquarters in Chicago, Illinois. Keeper's cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while onboarding and supporting our customers as they integrate our platform into their business processes. **About Keeper** Keeper Security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero\-knowledge and zero\-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI\-enabled, cloud\-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role\-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just\-in\-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com. **About the Role** As the SaaS Implementation Engineer you are responsible for guiding customers through the process of integrating and implementing Keeper within our customer's environment, ensuring a seamless transition from onboarding to full utilization. This role involves understanding customers' business needs, configuring our Keeper software to meet those requirements, providing technical support, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams. **Responsibilities** * Collaborate with customers to understand their specific business needs and objectives for using our services, conducting thorough needs assessments to gather requirements and tailor the implementation plan accordingly * Configure Keeper to meet the unique requirements of each customer, ensuring optimal system performance and usability while customizing features, workflows, and integrations based on customer specifications * Develop and deliver training sessions to educate customers on using Keeper effectively and efficiently * Create comprehensive documentation, user guides, and knowledge resources to support customers in using the software * Offer continuous level 2 related technical support to customers, adeptly troubleshooting issues and efficiently resolving any concerns as they arise while proactively recognizing and rectifying project\-related risks and issues, promptly escalating them when required * Maintain accurate records of customer configurations, customizations, and communication to ensure a comprehensive understanding of each implementation * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product development, sales, and customer success, to ensure alignment and successful customer implementations * Participate in internal meetings to provide insights into customer needs and help improve Keeper based on feedback * Effectively oversee multiple implementation projects concurrently, ensuring their timely delivery within predefined scope while maintaining consistent and transparent communication of project status and progress to internal stakeholders and customers, promptly addressing any arising issues or concerns **Requirements** * 5\+ years of progressive experience in SaaS implementation, technical support, or a related role * Experience in SaaS deployment with security software experience preferred * Working knowledge and hands on experience with Salesforce preferred * Experience with Google docs and MS\-office tools * Mac OSX, Windows \& Linux administration and troubleshooting experience * Must have strong command for Linux Shell and PowerShell * Advanced knowledge in Firewalls, AD environments, DNS Servers, Authentication protocols, LDAP * Advanced knowledge in on prem/cloud/hybrid environments * Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud technologies, and software integration * Proficiency in programming languages, APIs, and data manipulation * Proficiency in leading external customer engagements * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively manage client relationships * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical issues effectively * Ability to work independently and as part of a team, across global regions and time zones * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) **Preferred** * PMP Certification and/or other Certifications related to SaaS or cloud technologies are a plus * IT experience * Versed in Python * The ability to communicate in both French and E e explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan). 1\. **Data We Collect** Information You provide: * Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter * Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility * Application responses and uploaded documents Information We generate: * Interview notes, assessments, communications * Scheduling information Information From Others: * Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile * References (with your consent, before final offer) * Public professional profiles * Background verification (post offer) Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information * We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements 2\. **How We Use Your Data** * Assess your application and suitability * Manage interviews and recruitment workflow * Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified) * Comply with employment law obligations 3\. **Legal Basis** * Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process) * Contracting steps (for progressed candidates) * Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required 4\. **Who We Share Information With** Internal: * HR, hiring managers, interviewers\*, IT support for system administration * Note \- diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers. Third Parties: Service providers who assist with: * Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers * Background verification vendors (post offer) * Recruitment agencies (where applicable) * Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place. 5\. **International Transfers** Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws. 6\. **Security** We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards. 7\. **Retention** We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it. Exceptions: * You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention) * You're hired (transfers to employee records) 8\. **Your Rights** You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them: * Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements * Object to or restrict processing * Withdraw consent (where applicable) * Request data portability * Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law. When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights. 9\. **Automated Decisions** Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing. 10\. **Contact** \- Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com
