jobs.title: Lead Strategic Finance & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: *At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you're a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you'll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit* *klaviyo.com/careers* *to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.* **About the Team** ------------------ Klaviyo's Strategic Finance \& Analytics team helps leaders understand, measure, and plan for business performance. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Go\-to\-Market, and Finance partners to turn complex data into financial insight that informs investment decisions, planning, and long\-term growth. As Klaviyo expands its platform and launches new AI\-powered products, more of our business is becoming consumption\-based. That makes it increasingly important to connect what customers do on our platform to what we earn and what it costs us to deliver. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Lead Strategic Finance \& Analytics Engineer to build and maintain the models that forecast Klaviyo's recognized revenue and cost of goods sold (COGS). This role blends data science, finance, and data engineering. You'll build scalable, production\-quality forecasting systems, and you'll understand the financial mechanics well enough to make them useful for planning. The role starts with a focus on recognized revenue forecasting. From there, you'll build out COGS forecasts, beginning with consumption\-aligned infrastructure costs such as message sending and LLM usage, and extending to the rest of our cost base. As more of our products move to consumption models, the systems you build will be the foundation for how we plan, price, and understand margin. You'll report into Strategic Finance \& Analytics and partner closely with FP\&A, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Go\-to\-Market teams. This is a hands\-on technical role. You'll own models end to end, set standards for how forecasts are built and evaluated, and help the team grow its capabilities. **How You'll Make a Difference** -------------------------------- * **Build and maintain forecasting models for recognized revenue and COGS.** Start with overall recognized revenue, then extend to consumption\-aligned infrastructure costs (message sending and LLM usage first) and, over time, the full COGS base, including cloud infrastructure, SMS and email carrier and vendor costs, AI inference, and support. * **Connect product workloads to unit economics.** Work with Engineering, Product, and Finance to link usage drivers (such as message volume, profile growth, channel mix, and AI feature usage) to both revenue and delivery costs. * **Build forecasts that scale with the business** across multiple time horizons and levels of granularity, designed to extend to new consumption\-based products as they launch. * **Partner with Finance and FP\&A** to understand planning mechanics and modeling assumptions, and translate them into robust, well\-documented frameworks that feed budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long\-range planning. * **Monitor model performance over time**, tracking accuracy and bias, detecting drift, and building challenger models to keep forecasts resilient. * **Lead variance investigations** when actuals diverge from forecast, separating data issues, model limitations, customer behavior, pricing or product changes, and external factors. * **Run scenario and sensitivity analyses** to evaluate pricing changes, product launches, vendor and infrastructure decisions, and cost\-efficiency initiatives. * **Partner with Analytics Engineering** on reliable pipelines and dbt models that give forecasting a clean, trusted foundation. * **Establish technical standards** for forecasting methodology, evaluation, and code quality. * **Communicate clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences**, from Finance and Product partners to executive leadership, through visualizations, narratives, and presentations. * **Evaluate emerging techniques**, including time series foundation models and AI\-assisted workflows, where they improve accuracy or speed. **Who You Are** --------------- * You have 8\+ years of experience in data science, analytics engineering, strategic finance, or a related quantitative field, with hands\-on experience building and deploying forecasting models in production. * You combine technical depth with finance context. You understand how revenue recognition, usage, pricing, and cost drivers translate into financial outcomes. * You have strong foundations in statistics and time series forecasting, and experience applying methods such as hierarchical, probabilistic, or machine learning approaches to business problems. * You're highly proficient in SQL and Pyth and non\-technical audiences, including senior executives. * You bring an AI\-first mindset and are curious about how LLMs and agentic tools can improve forecasting and analytical workflows. * You have a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or another quantitative field, or an advanced degree with a quantitative emphasis. Equivalent hands\-on experience is equally valued. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience forecasting COGS, cloud or infrastructure costs, or other unit\-cost drivers. * Experience with consumption\-based or usage\-based pricing models. * Experience supporting FP\&A, strategic finance, or investor\-facing analysis. * Experience building self\-service dashboards or forecasting tools used by Finance and Product partners. * Experience establishing forecast evaluation frameworks or governance practices. * Hands\-on exposure to time series foundation models, LLMs, or agentic AI for forecasting and decision support. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- Accurate revenue and COGS forecasts are the foundation for how Klaviyo plans investments, prices new products, and manages margin. As our portfolio adds consumption\-based products, the ability to connect customer usage to revenue and delivery cost will become one of the most important inputs to our decisions. jobs.title: Client Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. **Where you'll fit in:** Work directly with clients. Seek to understand. Be an expert on our platform. Know where to configure vs build to close a gap. Own the build and delivery of the outcome. See it through from end to end. We’re building a small team in New York to close the gap between the needs of our clients and delivering their needs. This is a hands\-on engineering role, not a coordination role. You’ll have the ownership and responsibilities of a software engineer, alongside ownership of a client relationship. You have the ability to work confidently with clients and guide them through unfamiliar territory. That means leading discovery sessions, asking open questions and seeking to understand. You will build a deep platform knowledge in order to make sound technical decisions, build and ship those solutions, triage and fix issues and following through to make sure it delivered the outcome the client needed. You own this from end to end. Expect a high pace environment, evolving approaches and problems without solutions. We’re looking for people who enjoy ambiguity and making progress in that environment. **What you’ll own:** * **Build client relationships.** You will understand how clients actually work, working directly with operational teams and stakeholders to uncover friction, question assumptions and distinguish symptoms from root causes. * **Lead the client conversation.** Build trust, demonstrate ideas early and challenge requests constructively. Help clients adopt Kraken’s capabilities and ways of working, recognising when changing a process is a better answer than building custom software. * **Turn unclear problems into buildable solutions.** Investigate workflows, systems and data. Develop options, explain trade\-offs and establish a practical path forward. * **Build and ship.** Start with Kraken’s existing capabilities and configuration, and design, implement, test and release production software where changes are needed. Build solutions that fit the platform rather than create unnecessary client\-specific complexity. * **Work agent\-first.** Use agents as a core part of investigation, development and testing. Give them useful context, direct their work and critically assess the results. You remain accountable for what ships. * **Own the outcome beyond deployment.** Make sure the solution works in practice, support adoption and verify that it addresses the original problem. * **Work across Kraken.** Partner with client engineering, delivery and product teams to decide whether a problem is best addressed through existing capabilities, a targeted change or the broader product roadmap. Bring in specialist expertise and balance immediate client needs with the long\-term direction of the platform. * **Extend the impact.** Recognise when a solution can benefit other clients, and help turn successful approaches into reusable capabilities and ways of working. **What you’ll bring to the party:** * **Strong software engineering experience.** You’ve independently delivered and maintained production software, and can navigate unfamiliar codebases, review changes and make sound technical decisions. * **Demonstrated client\-facing skills.** You’ve worked directly with clients, led discovery or solution discussions, and explained technical choices to both engineering and non\-technical audiences. * **Practical problem\-solving ability.** You can take a messy operational problem, investigate what matters and build an effective solution without waiting for a complete specification. * **An agent\-first approach to building.** You can use coding agents and AI\-enabled tools effectively while applying your own engineering judgement to their outputs. * **Ownership and follow\-through.** You take responsibility for whether your work solves the problem, not just whether the code is merged. * **Comfort with ambiguity and pace.** You make progress with incomplete information, test assumptions early and know when to move quickly or investigate further. * **A collaborative engineering mindset.** You work constructively with existing teams and build solutions others can understand, operate and maintain. * **Patience and an ability to explain complex things in a simple way.** **The focus of this team** Its focus is significant operational problems where investigation, inventive thinking and hands\-on engin ay work across different workstreams as priorities evolve. Owning the solution does not mean doing everything yourself, but it does mean staying accountable through to a working result. **Bonus points:** We'd be particularly excited if you bring one or more of the following: * Experience in energy, utilities, or billing and switching in regulated markets. * Experience with incident response or on\-call for production systems. * A prior forward deployed engineer or customer\-facing engineering role. * A track record of building internal tools or integrations that teams adopted. * Evidence of cutting handoffs or rework in a delivery process. **️ Why you'll love it here:** * Great **medical**, **dental**, and **vision insurance** options including FSAs. * **Paid time off** — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need. * **401(k)** plan with employer match. * **Parental leave.** Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible. * **Pre\-tax** commuter benefits. * **Flexible working environment**: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance. * **Equity Options**: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such. * **Modern office** or co\-working spaces depending on location. * The **salary range** for this role in NYC ranges on average from $140,000\-$220,000 depending on relevant experience, role alignment, and technical/client management expertise demonstrated throughout the interview process. While the broad salary range is listed, not all candidates will be placed at the top of the range—this will be determined by the overall fit for the position. jobs.title: DAP Infra Engineer
jobs.description: **This is a hybrid role that requires the selected candidate to be onsite (Greenville, SC) three days per week.** **1\. Role Overview** As a **Infrastructure Engineer** supporting DAP, you will operate, evolve, and continuously improve infrastructure services that enable reliable business operations and digital transformation. You will help ensure high levels of availability, performance, security, resilience, and scalability across the infrastructure lifecycle. You will provide recognized technical expertise, influence architecture and operational decisions, and lead complex infrastructure changes from planning through production. The role requires strong ownership, sound judgment, and close collaboration with cross\-functional teams, service partners, security stakeholders, and operational support groups. **2\. What You Will Do** Infrastructure Design, Engineering \& Lifecycle Management **•** Operate, and continuously improve infrastructure components, including servers, storage, virtualization platforms, network\-connected services, middleware, and supporting technologies. **•** Lead complex infrastructure transformations, deployments, upgrades, migrations, and lifecycle activities while managing risks, dependencies, quality, and delivery commitments. **•** Define and promote infrastructure architecture choices, technical standards, and operational practices that support consistency, scalability, resilience, and long\-term maintainability. **•** Perform capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and obsolescence remediation to support business growth and platform stability. **•** Maintain accurate architecture references, technical procedures, operating standards, and knowledge articles. Virtualization, Backup \& Recovery **•** Administer, troubleshoot, and optimize VMware virtualization environments and the supporting compute, storage, and network integrations. **•** Operate and improve enterprise backup software and recovery services, including backup policy administration, job monitoring, failure remediation, restore validation, retention, and reporting. **•** Strengthen backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies to improve service robustness, recoverability, and business continuity. **•** Execute infrastructure recovery tests and use the results to close technical or operational gaps. **•** Coordinate with vendors and service partners on platform support, defects, patches, upgrades, capacity, and product lifecycle requirements. Service Management \& Production Support **•** Manage infrastructure Incidents, Problems, and Requests from intake through resolution, ensuring clear ownership, timely communication, accurate records, and alignment with service\-level expectations. **•** Lead response to major incidents and complex technical issues, coordinate technical recovery activities, and communicate status and business impact to stakeholders. **•** Perform root cause analysis for significant or recurring issues and drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions through completion. **•** Provide Level 3 technical support to internal teams, resolve escalated issues, and deliver practical guidance for complex infrastructure problems. **•** Contribute to change management, release readiness, maintenance planning, operational handoffs, and production validation. **•** Participate in on\-call or after\-hours support when required for critical incidents, maintenance, deployments, or recovery activities. Security, Risk \& Operational Excellence **•** Embed security compliance and technical risk management into infrastructure operations through hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, control implementation, and adherence to internal policies. **•** Monitor platform health, availability, capacity, backup status, alerts, and service trends to identify risks before they affect the business. **•** Identify and implement opportunities for automation, standardization, and modernization that reduce operational complexity and improve service quality. **•** Use Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and GitOps practices where appropriate to improve repeatability, control, and traceability. **•** Create meaningful operational measures and service reports that support prioritization, decision\-making, and continuous improvement. Collaboration \& Technical Leadership **•** Collaborate across infrastructure, security, application, architecture, service management, and business teams to translate needs into supportable technical solutions. **•** Provide technical input on feasibility, risk, dependencies, tradeoffs, support requirements, and implementation approaches. **•** Mentor less\-experienced engineers through technical guidance, structured troubleshooting, reviews, and knowledge transfer. **•** Communicate complex infrastructure topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **3\. What You Will Bring** Experience \& Technical SkillsTechnolog porting Lenovo, Dell, and HP server infrastructure, including out\-of\-band (OOB) management, hardware health monitoring, and firmware updates. **• Remote Administration:** Working knowledge of SSH and PuTTY for secure remote administration, troubleshooting, and infrastructure support. **• Firewall Fundamentals:** General understanding of firewall concepts, network flows, ports, protocols, access rules, and troubleshooting connectivity issues. **• Certificate Management and Requests:** Basic knowledge of SSL/TLS certificates and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including certificate requests, issuance, renewal, deployment, validation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management across on\-premises and cloud infrastructure. **•** 5\+ years of professional infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or enterprise operations experience, including ownership of complex production services. **•** Strong hands\-on experience with enterprise servers, storage, virtualization, and operating system technologies. **•** Advanced experience administering and troubleshooting VMware environments, including platform availability, performance, capacity, lifecycle, and recovery considerations. **•** Hands\-on experience with enterprise backup software, backup job operations, restore execution, retention management, recovery validation, and disaster recovery planning. **•** Practical experience managing Incidents, Problems, and Requests in a structured IT service management environment. **•** Demonstrated ability to lead major incident response, root cause analysis, recurring\-issue elimination, and durable remediation. **•** Experience with infrastructure security practices, including hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, access controls, and operational risk management. **•** Working knowledge of network protocols, infrastructure architecture, systems integration, and deployment practices. **•** Experience with automation and modern engineering practices such as Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, GitOps, scripting, and configuration automation. **•** Ability to performance. * Support engineering change management activities including evaluation, implementation, validation, and approval of design and process changes. **Program Management (4%)** * Supports the jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Overview:** ============================= * Designs, develops, implements and operates highly complex data pipelines, data products and data management solutions across modern cloud, warehouse and lakehouse platforms. Applies strong software\-engineering, data\-modeling and distributed\-processing practices to deliver solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, observable and cost efficient. Independently resolves ambiguous engineering problems, contributes to technical direction and reusable standards, and mentors other engineers while partnering across product, architecture, governance, cybersecurity and platform teams. **Primary Responsibilities:** ============================= * Lead the detailed engineering design, development, testing, deployment and production support of complex data pipelines and reusable data products. * Develop maintainable data\-processing and transformation solutions using advanced SQL and programming languages such as Python. * Engineer solutions using Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and comparable modern data platforms; select appropriate warehouse, lakehouse or hybrid patterns based on workload needs. * Design analytical storage solutions using relational databases, cloud object storage, columnar formats and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg. * Implement batch, micro\-batch, change data capture (CDC), event\-driven and streaming patterns using technologies such as Apache Kafka or comparable platforms. * Integrate data from relational and mainframe systems, APIs, event streams, SaaS platforms, files and object storage with appropriate security and operational controls. * Apply normalized, dimensional, denormalized and data\-product\-oriented modeling approaches based on access, performance and lifecycle requirements. * Optimize Snowflake, Databricks/Spark and SQL workloads for performance, scalability, reliability and cost, including partitioning, parallelism, data movement and compute utilization. * Build data quality, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, observability, alerting and service\-level controls into production solutions. * Design for restartability, idempotency, retry, replay, recovery and failure isolation; lead diagnosis and root\-cause analysis for complex production incidents. * Apply source control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, environment promotion and infrastructure/configuration automation to data engineering delivery. * Create reusable libraries, templates, implementation patterns and reference solutions that improve consistency and engineering velocity. * Evaluate design alternatives and clearly document tradeoffs involving security, privacy, resiliency, maintainability, performance, cost and operational complexity. * Contribute to technical standards, identify technical debt and recommend pragmatic modernization or remediation approaches. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing and technical problem solving; influence engineering practices across the team and adjacent teams. * Partner with product owners, architects, governance, cybersecurity, platform and consuming teams to translate business and data requirements into scalable solutions. * Develop technical epics and stories, estimate complex work, surface dependencies and risks, and support iterative delivery through Agile practices. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship without direct people\-management responsibility. * Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. * Design, implement, maintain and enhance internal controls to mitigate risk on an ongoing basis. Identify risk\-related issues requiring escalation to management. * Maintain internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points and issues raised by external regulators, as applicable. * Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the Company brand. Complete other related duties as assigned. * **Education and Experience Required:** ====================================== * Associate’s degree and a minimum of 7 years’ systems analysis and/or application development work experience or Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years' systems analysis and/or application development work experience. In lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 9 year’s education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 5 years’ system analysis and/or application development work experience. * Expert proficiency in a minimum of 1 relevant programming language and professional proficiency in a minimum of 1 additional relevant programming language. * Advanced SQL skills, including complex transformations, analytical queries and workload optimization. * Experience with Python or another general\-purpose programming language used for production data engineering. * Hands\-on engineering experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks. * Experience with modern ELT/ETL and transformation practices, including dbt or a comparable framework. * Experience with data modeling for warehouse, lakehouse and data\-product use cases. * Experience with distributed data processing using Apache Spark/PySpark or a comparable framework. * Experience with Git\-based development, automated testing, code review and CI/CD. * Experience with batch and streaming architectures, orchestration and production operations. * Knowledge of cloud computing and object\-storage concepts, preferably in Microsoft Azure. * Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data using formats such as Parquet, JSON, Avro, CSV and XML. * Demonstrated ability to independently design and deliver complex data solutions spanning ingestion, processing, persistence, quality and consumption. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex distributed\-processing, data\-quality and production reliability issues. * Demonstrated ability to balance performance, cost, scalability, resiliency, security and maintainability in technical decisions. * Demonstrated ability to review and improve technical designs and code developed by other engineers. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex designs and tradeoffs to engineering, architecture, product and business audiences. * **Education and Experience Preferred:** ======================================= * Advanced production experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark/PySpark and dbt. * Experience implementing Apache Iceberg or another open table format, including schema evolution, partitioning, snapshots and table maintenance. * Experience with Apache Kafka, CDC and event\-driven architectures. * Experience with orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows or dbt orchestration. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration automation, including Terraform or comparable tooling. * Experience with data catalogs, metadata management, lineage, data observability and automated data\-quality frameworks. * Experience building governed enterprise data products or domain\-oriented data solutions. * Experience working in a highly regulated environment such as financial services. * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical field. M\&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market\-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $116,400\.00 \- $194,000\.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. **Location** ============ Buffalo, New York, United States of America

Works independently on defined outcomes, collaborates across technology and data teams, and contributes to reusable engineering patterns and continuous improvement. **Primary Responsibilities:** ============================= * Design, develop, test, deploy and support complex production data pipelines and data products with guidance on broader architecture where needed. * Develop maintainable data\-processing and transformation solutions using SQL and programming languages such as Python. * Implement solutions using Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and comparable modern data platforms and frameworks. * Build data solutions across relational databases, cloud object storage, warehouse and lakehouse architectures, including open table formats such as Apache Iceberg where applicable. * Develop batch, micro\-batch, CDC and streaming pipelines using approved enterprise patterns and technologies such as Apache Kafka or comparable platforms. * Integrate data from relational and mainframe systems, APIs, event streams, SaaS platforms, files and object storage. * Apply normalized, dimensional and denormalized data\-modeling techniques appropriate to analytical and data\-product requirements. * Tune SQL, Snowflake and Databricks/Spark workloads for performance and cost using appropriate partitioning, parallelism and compute practices. * Implement data quality, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, logging, monitoring and alerting controls. * Build pipelines that support error handling, restartability, idempotency, retry, replay and recovery using established patterns. * Participate in production support, incident resolution and root\-cause analysis; implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. * Use Git, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD and environment promotion practices for data engineering delivery. * Develop and reuse shared components, templates and patterns; contribute improvements to engineering standards and documentation. * Participate in technical design and code reviews, identify implementation risks and escalate architectural concerns appropriately. * Partner with product owners, architects, governance, cybersecurity, platform and consuming teams to clarify requirements and deliver supported solutions. * Contribute to technical epics and stories, estimate assigned work, identify dependencies and deliver through Agile practices. * Provide day\-to\-day technical assistance and informal mentoring to less\-experienced engineers. Complete other related duties as assigned. * **Education and Experience Required:** ====================================== * Associate’s degree and a minimum of 5 years’ systems analysis and/ or application development work experience or Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years’ systems analysis and/ or application development work experience. In lieu of degree, a combined minimum of 7 years’ education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 3 years’ systems analysis and/or application development work experience * Strong SQL skills, including development of complex transformations and analytical queries. * Experience with Python or another general\-purpose programming language used for data engineering. * Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks or a comparable cloud data platform. * Experience with ELT/ETL and transformation practices, including dbt or a comparable framework. * Experience with relational data stores and warehouse or lakehouse data\-modeling concepts. * Experience with distributed processing using Apache Spark/PySpark or a comparable framework. * Experience with Git\-based source control, automated testing and CI/CD fundamentals. * Experience with batch data processing and working knowledge of streaming or event\-driven concepts. * Knowledge of cloud and object\-storage concepts, preferably in Microsoft Azure. * Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data using formats such as Parquet, JSON, CSV, Avro and XML. * Experience with Linux/Unix environments and scripting. * Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex data pipeline components and data products within an established architecture. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data\-processing, data\-quality and production issues across multiple technologies. * Demonstrated ability to apply established engineering patterns while identifying opportunities for improvement. * Demonstrated ability to communicate implementation choices, risks and dependencies to technical and product partners. Demonstrated ability to manage assigned work from design through production support with limited day\-to\-day supervision. * **Education and Experience Preferred:** ======================================= * Production experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark/PySpark and dbt. * Experience with Apache Iceberg or another open table format. * Experience with Apache Kafka, CDC or event\-driven data processing. * Experience with orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows or dbt orchestration. * Experience with Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code technology. * Experience with data catalogs, metadata, lineage, observability or automated data\-quality tooling. * Experience delivering governed enterprise data products. * Experience working in a regulated environment such as financial services. M\&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market\-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $97,100\.00 \- $161,800\.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. **Location** ============ Buffalo, New York, United States of America

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: At MCG, we lead the healthcare community to deliver patient\-focused care. We have a mission\-driven team of talented physicians and technical experts developing our evidence\-based content and innovating our products to accelerate improvements in healthcare. If you are driven to enhance the US healthcare system, MCG is eager to have you join our team. We cultivate a work environment that nurtures personal and professional growth, and this is a thrilling time to become a part of our organization. With dynamic roles that offer meaningful impact, you'll be able to fully realize your potential. Plus, you'll enjoy world\-class benefits and the security, stability, and resources of our parent company, Hearst, with over 100 years of experience. The **Staff Machine Learning Engineer** is a senior individual contributor responsible for building and evolving the machine learning engineering capabilities that enable continuous improvement of MCG's AI\-powered clinical solutions. The role focuses on developing tooling and infrastructure for automated prompt tuning, content feedback loops, model benchmarking, and related ML experimentation and evaluation capabilities. Working with Data Scientists, Clinicians, Software Engineers, and Product, this role translates model\-quality and operational improvement opportunities into scalable technical solutions. The Staff ML Engineer operates with significant independence, serves as a technical authority within ML engineering, and influences how MCG evaluates, improves, and operationalizes AI\-enabled clinical solutions. **You Will:** * Design, build, and evolve ML engineering tooling that accelerates continuous improvement of MCG's AI\-powered clinical solutions, including automated prompt tuning, content feedback loops, and model benchmarking. * Develop scalable experimentation and evaluation infrastructure that enables rapid, reproducible comparison and optimization of models, prompts, and AI approaches. * Partner with Data Science, Clinical Prompt Engineering, Software Engineering, and Product teams to translate model improvement opportunities into reliable technical solutions. * Translate ambiguous ML and clinical AI requirements into technical approaches, defining appropriate methodologies, interfaces, and implementation plans. * Investigate complex ML engineering problems and develop practical solutions when established approaches or frameworks are insufficient. * Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, and best practices that improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of ML experimentation and continuous improvement. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering and cross\-functional partners, influencing outcomes through technical expertise and judgment without direct people\-management responsibility. **What We're Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least 6 years of relevant professional experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, data science engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. * Experience designing and implementing production\-quality machine learning systems, tooling, or infrastructure is required. * Experience with Python and modern software engineering practices. * Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex technical problems and determine effective approaches within an ambiguous problem space. * Demonstrated experience collaborating with Data Science, Engineering, Product, or other cross\-functional technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing automated prompt optimization or prompt evaluation systems * Experience building model benchmarking frameworks or evaluation infrastructure for large language models * Experience developing feedback loops that incorporate human or expert evaluation into ML systems * Experience with model observability, experimentation platforms, or ML operations * Experience developing reusable ML engineering frameworks or standards adopted across multiple team * Strong technical communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence decisions through expertise rather than positional authority * Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments while balancing technical rigor with delivery **Pay Range:**$154,000 \- $216,000 **Other compensation:** Bonus Eligible **Location: Seattle Preferred** **Perks \& Benefits:** Remote Work/Hybrid Work ✈️ Travel expected 1–3 times per year for company\-sponsored events Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance 401K retirement plan; flexible spending and health savings account ️ 15 days of paid time off \+ additional front\-loaded personal days ️ 14 company\-recognized holidays \+ paid volunteer days up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave \+ 10 weeks of paid bonding leave LGBTQ\+ Health Services Pet insurance Check out more of our benefits here: https://www.mcg.com/about/careers/benefits/ All roles at MCG are expected to engage in occasional travel to participate in team or company\-sponsored events for the purposes of connection and collaboration. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Note on interviews**:** We may use AI tools to audio\-record and transcribe interviews for note\-taking purposes. These are used only by our hiring team and do not make decisions on their own. Let us know if you prefer an alternative. MCG is a leading healthcare organization dedicated to patient\-focused care. We value our employees' unique differences and are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. Our diverse workforce helps us achieve our goal of providing the right care to everyone. We welcome all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, or political affiliation. jobs.description: ### **About MD Integrations** At **MD Integrations**, we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful. **MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time. **Backend Engineer (PHP / Laravel)** The Backend Engineer (PHP / Laravel) designs, develops, and maintains scalable and reliable server\-side applications to ensure the highest standard of system performance and stability. As a Backend Engineer, you will take ownership of features and services, troubleshoot complex issues, optimize existing code, and contribute to architectural decisions. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including front\-end dev, product, QA, and DevOps, collaborating both synchronously and asynchronously to deliver high\-quality software, efficiently. We are looking for a skilled, detail\-oriented engineer who is comfortable with full\-stack collaboration, enjoys solving challenging problems, and thrives in a remote\-first, fast\-paced environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and optimize high\-throughput RESTful APIs in PHP using the Laravel framework, writing efficient PostgreSQL queries and schema designs to support data\-intensive clinical workflows. Contribute to new feature development and platform improvements within an Agile/Scrum process. * Build and maintain integrations with third\-party APIs and internal services, deploying and running services in Docker containers across AWS (or comparable cloud) environments to ensure secure, reliable data exchange. * Write automated tests (unit, integration, and API\-level) for PHP/Laravel back\-end functionality and critical clinical workflows, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines using Git/GitHub\-based workflows and Docker to enable continuous testing and faster, more reliable releases. * Write and maintain clear technical documentation for troubleshooting guides, fixes, API integrations, and support processes, version\-controlled through Git/GitHub for easy team access and updates. * Monitor application health, performance, and error logs using tools such as Rollbar and AWS CloudWatch to proactively identify and address potential issues before they affect patients or providers. * Identify, document, and track software defects, analyzing logs and debugging to pinpoint root causes, and work with the development team within Agile/Scrum sprints to prioritize and ensure timely resolution. * Actively participate in code reviews to uphold coding standards and engineering best practices. Continuously evaluate and improve our development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling (Docker, monitoring/logging systems, cloud infrastructure) to enhance team efficiency, code quality, and release velocity. * Identify opportunities to formalize and document internal processes, workflows, and troubleshooting playbooks, building a knowledge base that supports faster onboarding and more consistent support. **Your Qualifications*** 5\+ years of professional experience with PHP and Laravel framework. * Experience working with AWS services like Lambdas, SES, Workers, etc. * Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, with ability to write automated API tests. * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Deep experience with SQL databases (preferably PostgreSQL), including schema design, queries, and performance optimization. * Ability to use AI tools to boost productivity but does not rely on it to be able to perform. * Experience working with version control systems (Git) and collaborative workflows (GitHub), including CI/CD pipelines and ability to integrate automated tests into the deployment process. * Experience with Docker * Knowledge of monitoring tools (e.g., Rollbar, CloudWatch, etc.) * Located in the US and able to work full\-time for a US employer without requiring visa sponsorship. E\-Verify is used during new hire onboarding to confirm work authorization status. **Your Work DNA*** **User\-Centric:** A genuine passion for helping customers succeed and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service. * **Proactive and Solution\-Oriented:** A proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential issues before they escalate. * **Team Player:** Ability to work effectively as part of a team and collaborate with team members across different departments. * **Passion for Learning:** A strong desire to learn and stay up\-to\-date on the latest trends and developments in telehealth and healthcare technology. **What We Offer*** **Competitive Salary:** The targeted range for this role is $105,000 to $140,000 per year commensurate with qualifications and experience. * **Comprehensive Benefits Package:** Our benefits package includes 75% subsidized health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan with company match. * **Professional Development Opportunities:** We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and development opportunities. * **Flexible Work Arrangements:** We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes. * **Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment:** We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success. **The pay range for this role is:** 105,000 \- 140,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.description: **About Miso** MISO develops technology that elevates human lives in the commercial kitchen. We’re engineering production\-ready robotic systems that tightly integrate perception, real\-time decision making, and electromechanical controls to automate the most dangerous, least desirable tasks in food preparation. That means building software that understands the physical world as it actually behaves, and hardware that can execute precisely in the face of chaos. Success is measured in uptime, throughput, and trust from our customers, not demos. Our flagship platform, Flippy, is already operating in high\-volume restaurant kitchens across seven states. Zippy, our Kitchen Intelligence software centralizes all operational data in our broader ecosystem, expanding the role of AI enabled autonomy in real\-world operations. Backed by industry leaders, including Ecolab (NYSE: ECL), Miso combines the stability of a proven commercial product with the technical depth and ambition of a company passionately innovating to solve foundational problems in robotics and restaurant operations. If you’re excited by hard constraints, real customers, and the challenge of making software and machines perform reliably where failure isn’t an option, you’ll find meaningful problems to work on here. ### **The Role** As an SQA Engineer – Automation \& AI at Miso Robotics, you'll help ensure the quality and reliability of software powering restaurant operations, AI applications, and kitchen robotics. This is an early\-career engineering role focused on building automated testing solutions and leveraging AI tools to improve software quality, accelerate development, and reduce manual effort. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain automated tests for web applications, APIs, backend services, and system integrations. * Build Python\-based test automation for functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing. * Leverage AI coding assistants and testing tools to accelerate test development, expand coverage, and improve efficiency. * Diagnose software defects, analyze test results, and collaborate with engineering teams to identify root causes and validate fixes. * Integrate automated testing into CI/CD workflows and continuously improve test coverage, reliability, and scalability. ### **Qualifications** * 0–3 years of experience in software development, QA automation, or related technical work, including internships or academic projects. * Programming proficiency in Python or a similar language, with a strong interest in developing automated testing solutions. * Understanding of software testing fundamentals, REST APIs, JSON, and modern web applications. * Familiarity with Git, debugging, and modern software development practices, including AI\-assisted coding tools. * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Must be able to work on\-site in Pasadena, CA, five days per week. ### **Desired Multipliers** * Experience with Python testing frameworks such as PyTest and browser automation tools like Playwright or Selenium. * Experience with AI\-powered testing platforms, coding assistants, or autonomous AI agents. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms (AWS), and modern web architectures. * Exposure to AI/ML applications, robotics software, microservices, or complex integrated software systems. **Compensation** $90,000–$120,000 per year \+ Benefits *The stated compensation range reflects the targeted base salary range for candidates residing in the Los Angeles Metro area and does not include additional compensation or benefits. If your salary requirements fall outside this range, we still encourage you to apply.* **The pay range for this role is:** 90,000 \- 120,000 USD per year(91101\)

jobs.title: Embodied AI Real2Sim Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Job Description:** **Core Objective:** Build the digital pipeline from the real world to simulation space. Reconstruct and calibrate visual and physical properties of robots, objects and scenes, and deliver SimReady interactive assets to reduce the sim\-to\-real gap, supporting algorithm training, simulation evaluation and policy transfer to real hardware. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own the end\-to\-end Real2Sim workflow based on Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis, Blender and other simulation platforms, including 3D reconstruction, appearance reconstruction, dynamic identification, calibration of contact, friction and inertia parameters, to align dynamic and perceptual behaviors between simulation and real robots. * Create, validate and iterate SimReady assets following USD / URDF / MJCF standards. Configure joints, collision shapes, mass/inertia, joint limits, semantic labels and affordance properties for robots and interactive objects, to achieve physical parameter calibration of simulation assets, ensuring stable usability in simulation training. * Process multi\-modal real\-world captured data: camera calibration, point cloud \& mesh processing, texture and PBR material calibration. Leverage 3DGS / NeRF and related reconstruction methods to digitize real scenes and export assets compatible with simulation engines. * Develop automated tools for calibration, data processing and asset quality inspection. Document asset specifications, calibration workflows and evaluation metrics to improve pipeline throughput and sim\-real alignment accuracy. * Collaborate with perception, robot learning, simulation engine and hardware teams, design quantitative sim\-real benchmark experiments, identify simulation bias, and continuously improve calibration protocols and asset standards for closed\-loop data iteration. * Design excitation trajectories for robot system identification, collect time\-series dynamic data from physical robots, calibrate and reproduce non\-ideal dynamic behaviors including nonlinear joint friction and transmission backlash. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Must\-have** * Proficiency in at least one simulation/graphics tool such as Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis or Blender, with solid understanding of computer graphics and rigid\-body dynamics. Familiar with physics simulation engines such as PhysX and Newton. * Hands\-on experience with Real2Sim pipelines and SimReady asset standards; capable of independently building, configuring and validating robot or object assets including joint setup and physical property tuning. * Knowledge of 3D reconstruction, camera imaging, point cloud processing and camera calibration; fundamental understanding of system identification, parameter calibration and contact/friction models for physical simulation. Familiar with PBR rendering and material creation. * Ability to decompose requirements, implement technical solutions, run comparative experiments and root\-cause sim\-real mismatches from visual reconstruction or physical simulation. * Capable of designing dynamic system identification experiments, analyzing measured hardware data, and quantifying sim\-real errors introduced by nonlinear dynamics. **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Proven track record delivering Real2Sim projects, especially for robotic arms, dexterous hands or humanoid robots. * Deep familiarity with USD / URDF / MJCF, experience building asset libraries and automated asset validation pipelines. * Skilled in Python / C\+\+ for calibration scripts, engine extensions and data processing tools. * Experience with 3DGS, NeRF, PBR reconstruction and photogrammetry. * Background in system identification, excitation trajectory design, dynamic parameter estimation and contact model tuning. * Understanding of Sim2Real, reinforcement learning and embodied AI closed\-loop systems. * Experience with motion capture, multi\-sensor calibration and real robot hardware experiments. * Familiar with nonlinear friction models such as LuGre and Stribeck, with experience modeling and tuning joint hysteresis and backlash. **Default Benefits:** ===================== * Health insurance * Vision care * Dental coverage * 401(k) * Paid holidays * PTO (Paid Time Off) * Sick leave

jobs.title: VDC AI Engineer
jobs.description: #### **POSITION SUMMARY** Metcon, Inc., one of the nation's leading Native American\-owned commercial general contractors, is seeking an innovative and technically skilled VDC AI Engineer – Agentic Modeling and Coordination to help advance our Virtual Design and Construction capabilities through the integration of artificial intelligence, automation, and constructible building information modeling. This is a unique opportunity for a construction professional who understands how buildings are actually constructed and possesses the technical expertise to develop intelligent workflows that improve project coordination, model accuracy, and field execution. The ideal candidate will combine hands\-on trade knowledge, advanced BIM/VDC capabilities, and practical experience developing AI\-assisted automation solutions. This individual will work directly with project teams, trade partners, and construction leadership to identify coordination challenges, develop solutions, and implement AI\-driven processes that improve efficiency while maintaining the highest standards of constructability and quality. This is a construction\-first position. We are not seeking a traditional software developer with limited construction exposure or someone whose AI experience is limited to writing prompts. We are looking for a professional who can recognize complex trade coordination challenges, develop controlled technical solutions, and validate that the resulting models and recommendations are accurate, practical, and field\-ready. #### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES** Virtual Design and Construction / BIM Coordination * Develop, manage, and coordinate accurate, constructible, tradespecific 3D models for complex commercial construction projects. * Utilize Autodesk Revit, Navisworks Manage, and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) to facilitate multidisciplinary coordination. * Perform detailed clash detection, issue tracking, and model quality assurance to identify conflicts before construction. * Evaluate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, structural, and architectural systems for spatial coordination and constructability. * Lead or support BIM/VDC coordination meetings with project teams, designers, engineers, and specialty subcontractors. * Translate model coordination findings into practical solutions that support fabrication, installation, and field execution. * Support construction sequencing, prefabrication planning, and installation logistics through coordinated digital models. * Maintain model accuracy and alignment with project specifications, design intent, and approved construction documentation. Artificial Intelligence and Agentic Workflow Development * Design, develop, and implement AIassisted workflows using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and approved AI platforms. * Develop intelligent automation solutions for model QA/QC, clash analysis, document review, issue prioritization, and coordination reporting. * Build agentic workflows capable of interacting with BIM software, structured project data, and construction documentation through approved integrations. * Utilize Model Context Protocol (MCP), application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation tools to connect AI capabilities with existing construction technology platforms. * Develop repeatable workflows that improve coordination efficiency, reduce manual processing, and enhance the quality of project information. * Automate repetitive VDC activities such as issue classification, coordination summaries, model checks, and document comparisons. * Collaborate with internal technology and operations teams to evaluate emerging AI applications and identify practical construction use cases. * Document workflows, establish repeatable procedures, and support adoption across Metcon project teams. Model Validation, Quality Control and Risk Management * Independently validate AIgenerated recommendations, model modifications, and coordination outputs before implementation. * Maintain appropriate human review and approval requirements for all production model changes. * Establish quality control procedures to identify inaccurate, incomplete, or potentially unsafe AIgenerated results. * Ensure automated processes do not compromise design intent, contractual requirements, constructability, or project quality. * Coordinate with design professionals and project leadership regarding changes requiring formal design review or approval. * Maintain traceability of AIassisted model reviews, coordination decisions, and approved modifications. * Protect confidential project information and ensure AI workflows comply with companyapproved data security practices. Project Team and Trade Partner Collaboration * Work closely with Project Executives, Project Managers, Superintendents, Preconstruction teams, and trade partners to support project delivery. * Engage directly with specialty subcontractors to understand installation requirements, fabrication constraints, a assisted workflows involving construction software, structured data, project documentation, or automated processes. * Working knowledge of Python, Dynamo, C\#, or comparable automation and scripting technologies. * Understanding of construction documents, specifications, installation sequencing, and field coordination. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problemsolving abilities. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with construction professionals across multiple disciplines. * Ability to independently evaluate technical outputs and verify constructability before implementation. Important: The five\-year minimum experience requirement applies to construction and trade experience, not years of experience using artificial intelligence tools. #### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience working with Revit APIs, Navisworks APIs, Autodesk Platform Services, or Autodesk Construction Cloud integrations. * Experience configuring MCP integrations, Claude Code, reusable AI skills, or OpenAI API workflows. * Advanced experience developing automated BIM quality control or clash management solutions. * Experience with fabricationlevel modeling, prefabrication, modular construction, and installation sequencing. * Experience integrating AI with project management platforms, document management systems, or construction databases. * Familiarity with Procore and other construction management technologies. * Experience coordinating largescale commercial construction projects in healthcare, education, aviation, entertainment, hospitality, or industrial markets. * Demonstrated improvements in coordination turnaround time, model accuracy, issue resolution, or reduction of field rework. * Experience developing standardized VDC processes, training materials, or technology implementation programs. * Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent handson construction and technical experience will be considered. #### **KEY COMPETENCIES** Construction and Trade Expertise: Understands how building systems are fabricated, installed, coordinated, and constructed in the field. Advanced BIM/VDC Capabilities: Possesses hands\-on modeling, clash detection, and multidisciplinary coordination experience. Applied AI and Automation: Can develop functional, repeatable AI\-assisted workflows that solve real construction challenges. Technical Judgment: Understands the limitations of AI\-generated information and maintains appropriate human oversight. Problem Solving and Innovation: Identifies opportunities to improve construction processes through technology without compromising quality or constructability. Collaboration and Communication: Works effectively with designers, engineers, project teams, specialty contractors, and executive leadership. Accountability and Integrity: Maintains high standards for accuracy, data protection, documentation, and approved production changes. #### **About METCON INC** Metcon is a Native American\-owned business (Lumbee) founded in 1999 in Pembroke, North Carolina. Metcon, which stands for (Metal and Construction), was conceived as a General Contractor specializing in panelized metal studs and truss. As a young company, Metcon worked primarily on housing and related panelized projects throughout North Carolina. The firm quickly transitioned into a full\-service commercial general contracting operation still incorporating metal\-framed systems whenever possible. The UNC system higher education bonds of the 2000’s was a catalyst to Metcon’s growth as a primary contractor for the UNC\-Pembroke campus. Expanding their focus in Education, the company quickly became a leader, in not only University construction, but also K\-12 facilities across the Carolinas. Metcon remains headquartered in Pembroke, North Carolina, with offices in Raleigh, Charlotte, Fayetteville, North Carolina and Columbia, \& Myrtle Beach South Carolina.

The Offensive Security AI Engineer will plan and implement adversary\-informed security testing across Micron's technology environment. The role is intentionally broader than AI security: the engineer will assess web and mobile applications, APIs, cloud services, identity platforms, enterprise infrastructure, endpoints, wireless environments, security controls, and emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled systems. AI will be used as a force multiplier throughout the testing lifecycle. The engineer will apply AI\-assisted techniques to accelerate reconnaissance, analyze attack paths, develop and debug tooling, generate and refine test cases, support evidence analysis, and improve reporting quality. The engineer evaluates AI and machine learning systems when applicable. This covers their models, applications, data flows, integrations, guardrails, and infrastructure. This position will partner with security, engineering, technology, and business teams to communicate risk, validate mitigations, transfer offensive security knowledge, and improve defensive readiness. The successful candidate will balance deep technical execution with sound judgment, responsible use of AI, clear documentation, and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Responsibilities**: * Plan, implement, lead, and report on internal and external penetration tests, red team operations, purple team exercises, and targeted security assessments. * Discover, validate, and safely exploit vulnerabilities end to end across web applications, APIs, cloud platforms, identity systems, networks, endpoints, mobile applications, wireless environments, products, and security controls. * Use AI\-assisted workflows to improve reconnaissance, attack\-path analysis, test\-case development, code review, exploit research, tooling, evidence analysis, and reporting while independently validating AI\-generated output. * Develop, customize, and maintain offensive security tooling, scripts, automation, and proof\-of\-concept code that increase the scale, mentor, and grow a team of high\-performing platform engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. * Own the product vision and roadmap for the Developer Enablement Platform, ensuring it meets the evolving needs of application development teams. * Validate and drive self\-service platform solutions, standard CI/CD pipelines, and automated infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). * Champion cloud\-native standards and golden paths for containerized (Kubernetes/EKS) and serverless deployment environments. * Partner closely with Product Development and InfoSec leadership to reduce developer friction and accelerate time\-to\-market. * Establish enterprise\-wide observability, monitoring, and reliability standards (DataDog, OpenTelemetry) to guarantee platform resilience. * Manage cloud resource governance, security compliance, performance tuning, and cost optimization across multi\-account cloud environments. * Define and track key metrics (DORA metrics, developer satisfaction, platform adoption) to evaluate and communicate platform impact. **What We’re Looking For** * 3\+ years of experience in engineering management or technical leadership, managing software or platform engineering teams. * 8\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Architecture. * Proven track record of building and delivering internal developer platforms or developer enablement tools. * Deep technical expertise in at least one of the following areas: + Cloud ecosystems (AWS preferred), container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) + Building applications atop AWS, EKS, and Terraform\-based internal developer platforms. * Strong background in CI/CD automation, GitOps principles, and modern deployment methodologies. * Solid understanding of enterprise observability, operational excellence, and SRE best practices. * Exceptional leadership, coaching, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with a focus on product\-minded engineering. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. This role is hybrid. On\-call participation may be required to support production systems. If you're passionate about leading teams, driving developer productivity, and building world\-class platform capabilities, we'd love to hear from you. ***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: **United States** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, * 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep. * Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs, * Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs, * Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed, * Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, * Global presence and in\-person collaboration opportunities; dog\-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office\-based roles and remote availability for some roles, * Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters. **PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus\-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence. **Responsibilities:** If you are passionate about spacecraft design, we invite you to join the **Flight Software \& Systems Engineering Section**. Our work spans spacecraft systems engineering, flight software, fault protection and autonomy design, and landing systems design. The **Instrument Flight Software Group** is the lab\-wide leader in embedded real\-time software systems definition and implementation, responsible for the design, development, testing and delivery of embedded flight software for instruments needed by JPL/NASA to enable missions in astrophysics, and planetary, Earth and remote sensing experiments and observations with highly complex or specialized operations and science requirements. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Safety Evaluations
jobs.description: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. **What You Will Be Doing:** * Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics. * Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. * Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. * Automated Red\-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. * Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision\-makers. * **What We Need To See:** ------------------------ * Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6\+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. * Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. * Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment\-tracking workflows. * Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. * **Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:** ------------------------------------- * Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red\-teaming. * Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. * Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. * Human\-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model\-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation workflows. * Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .
