jobs.title: Software Engineer - Front-End Web Applications
jobs.description: **Position Description:** Position Summary The National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) is a prestigious research and development organization that plays a vital role in the study of the universe. Associated Universities, Inc. (AUI) is a nonprofit organization that manages and operates the NRAO under a cooperative agreement with the National Science Foundation. The Observatory is a hub for technological and scientific collaboration, operating state\-of\-the\-art radio telescope facilities for use by the international scientific community. The Observatory has been instrumental in the study of black holes, galaxies, and the early universe. The NRAO develops and maintains software used by the astronomy community for proposing, planning, scheduling, and analyzing observations made with these telescopes. We are seeking a mid\-level Software Engineer with strong front\-end web development skills to join the Archive Team, part of the Science User Applications Group (SUA). The Archive Team develops and maintains the NRAO Science Archive, one of the Observatory’s most visible user\-facing applications. You will help shape the interfaces that astronomers around the world use every day. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the next generation of tools critical to the Observatory, for both current telescopes and the next generation Very Large Array (ngVLA). This position will be based in Albuquerque, NM; Socorro, NM; Charlottesville, VA; or Green Bank, WV. For well\-qualified candidates, a remote work arrangement may be considered. **What You Will be Doing:** Your initial focus will be on the NRAO Science Archive web application. There are many opportunities for improvement, including: * Modernizing and streamlining the user interface for a better user experience * Building new front\-end features and components that help scientists find and work with radio astronomy data * Improving front\-end performance, accessibility, and test coverage * Collaborating with backend developers to design and consume APIs and to improve overall system performance You will design and deliver key components of the system, working closely with teammates and with scientific users to understand their needs. Team members also maintain and upgrade existing software and develop new tools that support the Observatory’s evolving observing methods, helping keep the Observatory at the forefront of science and technology. Work Environment You will join a team of professionals engaged in research and development in science, engineering, software development, and education. Work is typically performed in a research or development environment. **Who You Are:****You have:** * A bachelor's degree in computer science or related field; highly relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree. An advanced degree is not required but is welcome. * A minimum of one year experience in the development of software applications. * At least three years of professional experience developing web applications is preferred, with a significant portion focused on the front end. * Familiarity with standard software engineering concepts, practices and procedures through academic training or internship experience(s). Competencies * Professional experience building front\-end web applications with Angular and TypeScript * Solid command of HTML, CSS/Sass, and JavaScript, and experience with Bootstrap or similar frameworks * Experience with build and bundling tools such as webpack * Experience consuming and designing RESTful APIs and an understanding of HTTP * Experience with version control, front\-end testing methodologies (unit and end\-to\-end), and CI/CD * Experience debugging and profiling web applications, including browser performance * Understanding of object\-oriented design and the ability to build maintainable, well\-structured software * Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new languages and frameworks * Strong interpersonal and communication skills – both verbally and in writing * The ability and interest to work as part of a team in a Scrum environment. **While not required, you may have:** * Experience with Python or Java and with backend development, sufficient to work effectively across the stack * Familiarity with relational databases and object\-relational mapping (for example, SQLAlchemy) * Familiarity with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ * Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker, Docker Compose, Docker Swarm, or Kubernetes * Experience with accessibility standards and responsive design * Familiarity with basic astronomical principles and data reduction Additional Requirement Observatory employees must be authorized to work in the United States. The Observatory presently cannot sponsor new H\-1B Visas for this position. **Total Rewards:** Compensation The starting salary of this position is between $96,588 and $120,000\. Factors which may affect starting pay may include; education, experience, skills, competencies, other qualifications of the successful candidate, as well as internal equity and labor market conditions. **Benefits:** Associated Universities, Inc (AUI) offers a comprehensive benefits package addressing the needs of employees and their families with most benefits beginning on the first day of employment, subject to eligibility requirements. AUI provides: * Excellent paid time off (13 holidays, annual accrual of up to 24 vacation days) * Medical, dental and vision plans are effective on the first day of employment. * AUI’s retirement benefit contributes an amount equal to 10 percent of a qualified participant’s base pay with no required employee contribution. * Click Total Rewards for more information. **Application Instructions:** For consideration, select the “Apply” button above. Please be prepared upload a cover letter describing your interest in this position along with a current resume. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the listed expiration date above based on the volume and/or quality of the applicant pool. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:** AUI is an equal opportunity employer. To view our complete statement, please visit https://public.nrao.edu/careers/. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, you may submit your request by sending an email to resumes@nrao.edu. PM20

jobs.title: Software Engineer 4 - TV & Web Player
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Our team powers the player client engine behind Netflix streaming across hundreds of millions of living room CE devices (such as Smart TVs, STBs, and streaming sticks) and web browsers via www.netflix.com . In this role, you will work across the entire player client stack including developing player UX interfaces, managing streaming media download, Digital Rights management, enabling support for advanced media formats (such as AV1 HDR10\+, DV8\.1\) and optimizing QoE to enable best in class streaming experience across SVOD, Live, Ads, and cloud game streaming. Trace problems to their root cause across the player, device, network, and backend. * Extend reach across the device ecosystem by bringing features to memory\-constrained and low\-power TV devices and to the range of browsers that run the Web Player. * Partner with UI, Encoding, Streaming Algorithms, Security, Open Connect, and device partner teams on feature development and experimentation. * Contribute to continuous integration, test automation, and release management for the video player. * Rethink and rebuild existing designs where the data shows a better approach. Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values. * What Sets You Apart * You have 3\+ years of software development experience with streaming media playback or with software that manages audio and video playback on devices. * You have strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js with a track record of writing clean, readable, and maintainable code. Experience with C\+\+ is a plus. * You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * You have a good understanding of adaptive streaming technologies such as MPEG\-DASH, HTML5 MSE, and EME. * Familiarity on networking protocols HTTP, TCP, UDP and WebSockets is nice to have. * You have designed experiments to test hypotheses and analyzed the data to improve streaming quality, and you make decisions from that data. * You have experience with developing software for embedded devices (such as Smart TVs, set\-top boxes, or streaming sticks) and optimizing performance for memory\-constrained hardware. * You are curious, self\-motivated, selfless, and willing to help colleagues when they need it. * Proven ability to communicate complex technical issues cross\-functionally. If you are a candidate in need of assistance or an accommodation in the application process, please contact talent@nextech.com . #### **Job Summary** The Senior Data Engineer will be part of a six\-person Data Services team supporting mission\-critical healthcare applications, including real\-time clinical workflows, patient data analytics, and regulatory reporting. The team has deep SQL Server expertise, and this position represents an intentional step toward expanding its capabilities in modern data engineering, lakehouse architecture, and agentic AI. This individual will help build and enhance the enterprise lakehouse, curate the semantic layer needed to make AI\-driven analytics reliable, and partner closely with Product Engineering, FP\&A, and other teams that depend on accurate and accessible data. During the first year, the Senior Data Engineer is expected to drive meaningful technical debt reduction within the enterprise lakehouse, become a trusted technical partner across product roadmaps, and strengthen the capabilities of junior engineers through active mentorship. This role is well suited for a data engineer who is energized by the intersection of lakehouse architecture and emerging agentic AI patterns and wants to develop these capabilities within a healthcare environment where data quality has meaningful consequences. All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA, and other regulations, as appropriate. ### **Essential Functions:** * In addition to working in accordance with appropriate conduct and behavioral standards, specific responsibilities of this role include: + Design and build robust data pipelines and lakehouse solutions using Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, PySpark, and Python. + Design AI\-ready schemas, semantic layers, and metadata structures that allow AI agents to query data accurately and reliably. + Build automated validation processes for agent\-generated queries. + Pilot agentic automation for data quality and reconciliation workflows while measuring accuracy and maintaining clear rollback plans. + Curate and maintain the semantic layer that grounds AI agents and reduces incorrect responses caused by ambiguous or poorly defined data. + Catalog and steward enterprise data assets to support internal analytics, financial planning, and product engineering needs. + Partner proactively with Product Engineering, FP\&A, and other stakeholders to identify and understand data requirements. + Troubleshoot performance issues and support SQL Server and Azure SQL environments while continuing to develop operational expertise. + Mentor junior engineers on data engineering best practices, architecture patterns, and technical standards. + Contribute to data protection, security, and compliance reviews to ensure that tools and processes meet applicable standards, including HIPAA requirements where relevant. + Carry out additional responsibilities assigned based on business needs. ### **Minimum Requirements:** * 7\+ years of production experience in data engineering roles, including hands\-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines at scale. * Advanced proficiency with Python and PySpark or Apache Spark in production data engineering environments. * Hands\-on production experience with Databricks, Microsoft jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99\.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI\-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. **About the Role** You’ll join a small infrastructure team with broad, shared ownership — the engineers who keep Niantic Spatial running. The team covers the cloud platform, the developer tooling every engineer depends on, and the edge services our customers’ requests pass through. You’ll work across SRE, infrastructure, and developer platform alongside teammates who know the stack well, and you’ll grow into owning parts of it yourself. Because every engineer here builds on what this team provides, your work will also shape how the whole engineering org builds, ships, and operates. **What You'll Do** * **Cloud and SRE:** Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code, and help improve reliability through monitoring, alerting, and service\-level objectives. * **Developer Platform:** Help run our source control, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure so engineers can ship quickly and safely. * **Production Operations:** Share on\-call, take part in incident response and follow\-up, and automate away repetitive operational work. * **Edge and Delivery:** Help run the edge API gateway, CDN, and authentication and authorization systems with the rest of the team. * **Compute and GPU Management:** Help provision and monitor compute and GPU capacity across teams. * **AI\-Assisted Operations:** Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. **What You'll Bring** * **Years of Experience:** 3\+ years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. * **Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with GCP, AWS, or another major cloud provider in production. * **CI/CD:** Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or similar. * **Containers:** Production experience with containers and container orchestration, such as Kubernetes. * **Core Technical Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C\+\+, plus shell scripting and Linux systems. * **AI in Your Workflow:** Comfort using AI\-assisted tools in your engineering work, or a strong interest in building that habit. We’ll help you ramp up on how we use AI here. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with API gateways, load balancers, or CDNs. * Familiarity with modern authentication and authorization, such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, or cloud IAM. * Experience with GPU workloads or ML infrastructure. * Experience with message queuing systems. **Location \& Work Model** This role is based in our San Francisco or Sunnyvale, CA office, or in Bellevue, WA. We work in a high\-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on\-site a minimum of 3 days per week. **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $230,000 for Bay Area candidates and $162,500 \- $218,500 for Seattle/Bellevue candidates. Actual salary is based on assessed skills, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity, bonus, and benefits. Your recruiter can answer questions about total compensation during the hiring process. **Inclusive Application** We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for. **Equal Opportunity** Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process. **Candidate Privacy** I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice. jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description: ***Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.*** Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution. We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving. Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home. With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs. **Job Summary** The Quality Manager is responsible for leading quality strategy, culture, and execution for Nortek Data Center Cooling's Dyersburg manufacturing facility. This role serves as a key business partner to Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Quality, ensuring products consistently meet customer expectations while driving operational excellence throughout the organization. The Quality Manager will champion a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, process capability, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence cross\-functional teams to solve problems, improve performance, and eliminate recurring quality issues. This leader will balance customer requirements, manufacturing realities, and business objectives while developing sustainable systems that support growth, improve product quality, and strengthen customer confidence. **Key Outcomes** Within the first 12\-24 months, the Quality Manager will: * Build and sustain a "Right First Time" culture where quality ownership exists throughout the organization. * Improve first\-pass yield and reduce defects, rework, scrap, and cost of poor quality. * Strengthen process capability through effective controls, standard work, and preventive quality practices. * Improve responsiveness and effectiveness of containment, root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Reduce customer defects, warranty issues, and quality escapes. * Improve supplier performance and incoming material quality. * Develop a high\-performing quality organization capable of supporting ongoing business growth and manufacturing scale. * Increase visibility to quality risks, trends, and performance metrics that enable faster and more effective business decisions. Responsibilities Quality Management System \& Compliance * Lead implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the facility Quality Management System in alignment with company requirements and the intent of ISO 9001:2015\. * Ensure required procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and document controls are current, accessible, and followed. * Plan and support internal, customer, and third\-party audits; document findings, assign actions, and verify sustainable closure. * Monitor compliance obligations applicable to the products and processes manufactured at the site and escalate gaps or risks promptly. * Promote disciplined change control so engineering, process, material, and supplier changes are reviewed and implemented with appropriate quality controls. Manufacturing Quality \& Process Control * Provide visible floor leadership for incoming, in\-process, final inspection, end\-of\-line testing, packaging, and shipment release activities. * Ensure inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, check sheets, control plans, and workmanship standards are defined and consistently applied. * Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify process weaknesses, implement preventive controls, and reduce defects, rework, scrap, and disruption. * Establish appropriate hold, quarantine, disposition, and release controls for nonconforming material and product. * Confirm measuring and test equipment is suitable, controlled, calibrated, and used correctly. * Assess manufacturing, shipping, packaging, installation, and service feedback and provide actionable recommendations to the responsible functions. Corrective Action, Problem Solving \& Improvement * Lead or facilitate containment, root\-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification using structured problem\-solving methods. * Maintain strong governance of nonconformance, MRB, CAPA, deviation, and quality\-improvement actions through closure. * Analyze recurring defects and process trends; prioritize improvement work based on customer impact, risk, and business performance. * Capture and communicate lessons learned and ensure applicable improvements are incorporat cess improvement, implementing quality management systems, and delivering measurable improvements in product quality, process capability, customer satisfaction, and operational performance. * Demonstrated success leading teams and driving measurable improvements in product quality, process capability, customer satisfaction, and operational performance. * Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems. * Experience leading root\-cause analysis, CAPA programs, nonconformance management, audit readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, bills of material, test procedures, and manufacturing documentation. * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Demonstrated ability to think independently, challenge assumptions constructively, and make fact\-based business decisions. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in HVAC, data\-center cooling, air\-handling, refrigeration, electrical\-mechanical equipment, or other complex configured\-to\-order manufacturing. * Formal auditor training or certification; ASQ certifications such as Certified Quality Engineer or Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence are beneficial. * Experience with Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, 8D, 5\-Why, fishbone analysis, PFMEA, control plans, statistical process control, and layered process audits. * Experience supporting customer factory witness testing, commissioning, installation, warranty, or field\-service quality activities. * Experience using Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360 or similar platforms for project documentation and issue tracking. * Prior experience working in a regulated or customer\-controlled project\-delivery environment. Leadership Competencies * Independent thinker who exercises sound judgment and applies practical decision\-making in complex situations. * Courage to challenge assumptions and escalate risks when product quality, customer satisfaction, or compliance is at stake. * Strong business acumen with the ability to balance quality, cost, delivery, and customer requirements. * Data\-driven problem solver with expertise in root\-cause analysis and continuous improvement. * High degree of accountability with a demonstrated bias toward action and execution. * Collaborative leader who builds trust and credibility across all levels of the organization. * Continuous improvement mindset focused on prevention, process capability, and sustainable results. * Effective coach and developer of people who creates strong teams and future leaders. Work Environment \& Position Requirements * Primarily based at the Dyersburg manufacturing facility with regular presence on the production floor. * Ability to work safely in an active manufacturing environment and use required personal protective equipment. * Ability to inspect equipment and work areas, which may require standing, walking, bending, reaching, or accessing production and test locations. * Occasional travel may be required for customer, supplier, field, audit, training, or other company needs. * Work schedule flexibility may be required to support production priorities, customer events, containment activity, or critical quality issues. **Why Join Nortek Data Center Cooling?** * Help shape and scale quality systems within a rapidly growing business serving the expanding AI, cloud computing, and hyperscale data center markets. * Lead quality initiatives that directly impact customer success, operational performance, and business growth. * Work alongside experienced leaders in engineering, operations, and manufacturing who value accountability, ownership, and practical problem solving. * Help shape the future of quality within a growing organization backed by Madison Air and supported by significant manufacturing scale and resources. * Influence products that power mission\-critical infrastructure relied upon by some of the world's largest technology companies.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Cloud AI Infrastructure, Sr
jobs.description: Summary The Senior Platform Engineer, Cloud \& AI Infrastructure designs, builds, automates, and operates the secure cloud platforms that enable OnPoint’s AI, data, analytics, and automation capabilities in Azure and M365\. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role responsible for translating complex requirements into reliable, reusable, and production\-ready platform services. The position provides technical leadership for assigned Azure and AI infrastructure capabilities, including architecture, infrastructure automation, identity and networking integration, observability, resiliency, and cost optimization. It establishes engineering patterns that help teams move from experimentation to production without compromising security, supportability, or enterprise standards. Working with Technology Operations, Architecture, Information Security, Data, Solution Engineering, and the Innovation Center of Excellence, this role resolves complex platform challenges, mentors engineers, and enables approved self\-service capabilities. The position leads through technical expertise and cross\-team influence rather than people management. Primary outcomes, first 12 months * Establish reusable, automated deployment patterns for priority cloud, AI, and data workloads. * Reduce provisioning lead time and manual configuration through infrastructure as code and standardized platform services. * Act as the Microsoft ecosystem (365, Azure, etc.) evangelist of new and existing capabilities – the first to be informed, the first to use, the first to teach others to use, and always with energy and commitment to ensuring this platform’s return on investment. * Implement production\-readiness standards covering security, monitoring, support ownership, recovery, and cost. * Improve reliability and operational visibility through service health measures, actionable alerts, and tested recovery procedures. * Establish platform cost and capacity baselines and deliver prioritized optimization improvements. * Enable safe experimentation and repeatable promotion into production through approved environments and controls. Key responsibilities Cloud architecture and platform engineering * Independently lead the design and implementation of complex Azure infrastructure spanning compute, storage, networking, identity, security, and shared platform services. * Develop and maintain reference architectures, reusable deployment patterns, and documented technical decisions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. * Translate business and workload requirements into designs that balance reliability, security, performance, cost, and operational complexity. * Identify platform dependencies and constraints, recommend improvements, and contribute to platform roadmaps and lifecycle planning. Infrastructure automation and delivery * Engineer version\-controlled infrastructure using Terraform and/or Bicep, supported by PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python. * Utilize Microsoft 365 and other platforms to automate corporate functions for IT Operations and advise on how other teams can do the same. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated validation, controlled promotion, secure configuration, and recovery or rollback procedures. * Establish reusable modules and approved self\-service provisioning patterns that reduce manual work and configuration drift. * Apply code review, testing, documentation, and change\-management practices to infrastructure engineering. AI and data platform enablement * Engineer the infrastructure foundations for AI services, agent workloads, Databricks, and related enterprise data and automation platforms. * Implement secure connectivity, workload identities, secrets management, environment separation, capacity controls, and platform telemetry. * Partner with application, AI, and data engineers to establish scalable deployment and operational patterns for inference, retrieval, and agent workloads. * Support infrastructure dependencies and integrations for Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Power Platform in partnership with their platform owners. * Clearly define infrastructure ownership, application responsibilities, and support boundaries before production release. Security, governance, and operational resilience * Implement approved identity, access, networking, encryption, policy, and monitoring controls in partnership with Information Security. * Define and monitor service\-level indicators and objectives for assigned platform services. * Maintain operational runbooks, configuration evidence, recovery\-test results, and technical documentation supporting audit and operational readiness. Technical leadership and collaboration * Lead technical delivery for complex platform initiatives and coordinate dependencies across teams. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing. * Explain technical options, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Evaluate emerging capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, security, maintainability, and total cost – particularly but not limited to the Microsoft ecosystem. Required qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Seven or more years of progressively responsible infrastructure, systems, cloud, or platform engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on Azure engineering experience. * Demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, and operate complex production cloud solutions. * Advanced knowledge of Azure networking, private connectivity, DNS, identity, role\-based access, managed identities, secrets management, and cloud governance. * Demonstrated experience building reusable infrastructure as code and automated deployment pipelines using Git\-based engineering practices. * Strong scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, Python, and/or Azure CLI. * Experience implementing observability, performance tuning, capacity management, high availability, and tested disaster recovery. * Hands\-on experience supporting production AI or data platform infrastructure, with the ability to explain its security, connectivity, scaling, and operational requirements. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, cross\-platform issues and lead corrective action. * Experience leading technical implementations, mentoring engineers, and communicating architectural trade\-offs. Certifications Required * An active Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification, or the ability to obtain it within 12 months of hire, supported by demonstrated equivalent architecture and engineering experience. Preferred * Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, particularly for candidates with strong infrastructure automation and delivery\-pipeline responsibilities. Preferred qualifications * Experience with Azure\-hosted AI services, agent infrastructure, retrieval architectures, and secure model\-service connectivity. * Experience with Databricks infrastructure, workspace deployment, private networking, identity integration, and platform monitoring. * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Copilot, or Power Platform integrations and environment governance. * Experience in financial services or another regulated enterprise environment. * Experience developing shared platform services, self\-service engineering capabilities, and cloud cost\-management practices. jobs.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook\-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault\-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on\-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers. **Key Responsibilities** **System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:** Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. Optimizes code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing in large\-scale systems. Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. Implements performance and load testing. **System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design:** Collaborates with team to build fault\-tolerant components capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. **System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance:** Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. **System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability:** Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness. Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. **Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management:** Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. **Compliance \& Security:** Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up\-to\-date **Automation \& Change Management:** Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. **Responsibilities** As a Core Infrastructure Software Engineer, you will: * Design, develop, and operate highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant microservices across control plane, connectivity, distributed\-systems data plane, and Linux daemon technologies. * Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from conceptualization and product definition through design, development, launch, and operational maturity. * Identify opportunities to automate engineering workflows across development, testing, troubleshooting, operations, and documentation, leveraging AI\-assisted and agentic approaches where appropriate. * Measure and improve reliability, delivery velocity, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and engineering productivity, while sharing effective practices across the team. * You should be a hands\-on, adaptable, and self\-motivated engineer who learns quickly, applies new tools thoughtfully, and enjoys solving challenging high\-availability and scalability problems. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience with systems or application development. * 3\+ years of experience with distributed systems or backend development. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field. * Proficiency with data structures, algorithms, and operating systems. * Experience with distributed systems, including familiarity with CAP theorem, consensus, messaging, and high availability. * Demonstrated willingness to learn and responsibly apply AI/LLM tools, skills, and automation to improve engineering workflows.

jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, with the scale and customer\-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world. Values are OCI’s foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. JoinOCI\-SDE As a member of the software engineering division, you will take an active role in the definition and evolution of standard practices and procedures. You will be responsible for defining and developing software for tasks associated with the developing, designing and debugging of software applications or operating systems. **Required Qualifications** * BS or MS degree in Computer Science or relevant technical field involving coding or equivalent practical experience * 6\-8 years of total experience in software development * Demonstrated ability to write great code using Java, GoLang, C\#, or similar OO languages * Proven ability to deliver products and experience with the full software development lifecycle * Experience working on large\-scale, highly distributed services infrastructure * Experience working in an operational environment with mission\-critical tier\-one livesite servicing * Systematic problem\-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive * Experience designing architectures that demonstrate deep technical depth in one area, or span many products, to enable high availability, scalability, market\-leading features and flexibility to meet future business demands **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with networking and data plane development. * Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining services on a public cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Oracle) * Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) languages, preferably Terraform * Experience with DDOS/WAF or other network security products

jobs.title: AI Ops Engineer (GTM)
jobs.description: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades\-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo\-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. **A bit about us:** We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250\+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose\-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal\-grade precision. We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. We're trusted by 5,000\+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M\&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. **The Role** We're rebuilding Orbital's go\-to\-market around AI. Not by adding another tool to the stack, but by rethinking how we find, win and grow customers from first principles. As an AI Ops Engineer (GTM) on our Revenue team, you'll sit with the people doing the work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Finance. You'll question how we work today, reimagine it from first principles with AI, and build what replaces it. You're essentially an internal forward deployed engineer. Over time, you'll help join up the whole business so every team works off the same data and foundations. The technology is changing every month. We want someone who finds new and unusual ways of doing things, and builds them so they keep working as the tools change. You'll report to the VP of RevOps. This role is for someone early in their career with exceptional raw ability: we care far more about how fast you learn and what you've built than about years of experience or job titles. **What you'll do** * Embed with revenue teams to understand how they work, and spot where AI and automation could change the outcome * Build AI agents, workflows and integrations that remove manual work and help teams make better decisions * Connect our systems (CRM, marketing, CS, product and finance data) so teams work from one trusted picture of the customer * Try new approaches, test them quickly with real users, and keep what works * Ship in short cycles and prove impact. Build the measures that show pipeline created, conversion lift and time saved * Build things to last: documented, maintainable and easy to adapt as models and tools change * Share what you learn and help colleagues get more out of AI **What you'll bring** * A strong academic background in a quantitative or technical subject (for example computer science, engineering, maths, physics or economics), or equivalent evidence of exceptional ability * Clear evidence that you build: side projects, tools, automations, a GitHub, a startup, hackathons, or things you've shipped at work * Hands\-on experience building with AI, such as LLM APIs, agents or AI coding tools * Some coding ability (for example Python, JavaScript or SQL) and comfort working with APIs * Exceptional problem\-solving: you break messy problems down, learn new things quickly and explain your thinking simply * Commercial instincts. You understand how pipeline is created, speak the language of AEs and marketers, and prioritise what moves revenue * Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership in a lean, fast\-moving team **Nice to have** * Time in a customer\-facing, sales or consulting role * Experience with a CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or Make * Experience at an early\-stage or fast\-growing startup **Salary:** $100,000 – $120,000 \+ equity \+ benefits (New York) **Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital.** We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on. **At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.** We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you. **This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting**. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements. *Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.*

jobs.description: **About Ozlo** -------------- Ozlo is a health tech company transforming how the world sleeps. We design and manufacture an ecosystem of sleep solutions, including the Ozlo Sleepbuds®, that use sophisticated technology and sound to unlock restorative sleep. Founded in 2022 by former Bose leaders, we have sold hundreds of thousands of units, are fully backed, and are now scaling our next generation of products as we expand from consumer wellness into clinical sleep and neuro health. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Vice President of Engineering to lead engineering and technical program management across the company. You will manage teams across software, mobile, cloud, firmware, electrical, mechanical and systems, and guide our hardware from concept through commercial manufacturing. Our engineering leads are highly senior and have launched dozens of products between them. This role is about management, program management and coordination, more than individual engineering work (with some expectation to be able to help make senior\-level engineering calls). Your job is to make these teams work as one, work with product leadership and senior management to track and deliver engineering priorities, keep every program moving, and work closely with product, design, operations and clinical to get products built and shipped. Communication and coordination are the core of the role. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead Ozlo's engineering teams across software, mobile, cloud, firmware, electrical, mechanical and systems, including in\-house engineers and outside partners * Own engineering program management across all departments, with clear plans, milestones, budgets and risk tracking * Guide hardware from concept through EVT, DVT, PVT and mass production with global contract manufacturers * Coordinate across product, design, operations, supply chain, quality and regulatory, clinical and marketing so every team is aligned on priorities, dependencies and dates * Work with product leadership and senior management to set, track and deliver engineering priorities, turning the product roadmap into a realistic engineering plan and balancing support for current products with next\-generation development * Put the right level of process in place, including design reviews, release management, documentation and design controls for regulated products, without slowing the team down * Use AI tools to speed up engineering and program management, and help the team do the same * Keep leadership and stakeholders informed with clear, regular updates on status, risks and decisions **What You Bring** ------------------ * 15\+ years of experience in engineering, including 5\+ years leading multidisciplinary engineering teams * Experience developing connected audio devices * Working knowledge across software, firmware, electrical and mechanical engineering, and how they come together in one product * Proven experience taking hardware from concept to mass production with contract manufacturers * Experience running engineering program management across multiple teams and functions * Excellent communication and coordination skills, with a track record of aligning senior engineers and cross\-functional leaders * Sound judgment on cost, schedule and quality tradeoffs * Comfortable in a fast\-paced startup environment **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with regulated medical devices or SaMD (FDA 510(k), ISO 13485, IEC 60601, ISO 14971\) * Experience with biometric sensing or on\-device machine learning * Previous startup experience, as a founder or early employee **Location \& Travel** ---------------------- This role is based near one of our hubs: Dublin, Ireland or Greater Boston (Marlborough) with Dublin preferred. Strong candidates elsewhere will be considered. Regular travel between our hubs and to manufacturing partners is expected. **Why Ozlo** ------------ Join a collaborative, fast\-paced, global team focused on helping millions of people sleep better. You will shape how Ozlo builds products as we grow from consumer wellness into clinical health. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- The base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $225,000 per year. Actual compensation offered will depend on a candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Ozlo offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including: * Competitive base salary ($175,000 \- $225,000\) plus stock options * Flexible vacation * Full medical/dental/vision coverage (company pays premiums in full for employees and qualified dependents) * Matching 401(k) * Disability and group life insurance * FSA coverage * Wellness reimbursement * Flexible (and balanced) hours * Employee discounts, and more US benefits listed; competitive local pension and health benefits provided for Dublin hires. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Ozlo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Ozlo are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require a reasonable accommodation at any point in the interview process, please contact legal@ozlosleep.com. **How to Apply** ---------------- To apply, please submit your resume and a brief cover note summarizing your relevant experience and interest in Ozlo.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
jobs.description: **A World\-Changing Company** Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data\-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. **The Role** The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real\-time events and user\-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP. You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first\-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software. A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share. ### **Technologies We Use** * Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs * Open\-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg * Industry\-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub * Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms ### **Core Responsibilities** * Build and maintain Foundry’s first\-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve. * Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo. * Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain. * Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms. * Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on. * Develop reusable security frameworks and tooling that make secure connectivity a consistent part of connector development and execution. * Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability. * Establish shared testing frameworks, compatibility checks, and release practices that keep a large connector portfolio reliable and maintainable. * Help prepare and maintain Palantir connectivity software for open\-source use, including its APIs, packaging, documentation, and contributor experience. ### **What We Value** * An ownership mindset and a high bar for correctness, security, and automated testing, including responsibility for how software behaves in production. * Pride in building and maintaining integrations over time, including the detailed work required to keep them reliable as upstream systems change. * Engineering judgment that balances delivering new capabilities with simplifying existing systems and reducing operational burden. * Empathy for developers and end users, reflected in usable SDKs, clear configuration, actionable errors, and useful diagnostics. * Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and persistence in debugging problems across languages, APIs, services, networks, and execution environments. ### **What We Require** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience developing external system connectors, with depth in areas such as developing batch and streaming data ingestion systems, third\-party integration development, or monorepo and asset distribution frameworks. Operating on top of these technologies alone does not qualify. * Deep expertise in Gradle, including developing custom plugins, managing multi\-project builds, and optimizing build performance. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex reliability and performance problems and improve systems through measured, incremental changes. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, incorporate feedback, and hold a high bar for quality. **Salary** The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000 \- $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign\-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign\-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. ### **Life at Palantir** We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well\-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in\-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade\-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process*,* please reach out and let us know how we can help. *Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US* *FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3\)**.*

vision models, generative AI, agentic AI, digital twins, and decision\-support applications. * Ensure analytics, ML, computer vision, and agentic AI solutions are practical, explainable, secure, governed, and integrated into business and operational workflows. * Establish clear goals, delivery standards, governance, and performance measures for the Analytics \& AI portfolio. * Partner with scalable deployment. * Provide concise portfolio updates to senior leadership, including progress, value delivered, risks, resource needs, and decisions required. * Lead change management, training, and communication needed to support adoption and long\-term ownership. * Manage relationships with technology providers, consultants, systems integrators, and other external partners. * Develop team capability and repeatable approaches that allow successful solutions to scale across Nevada and Kansas. **Supervisory Responsibilities** * Provides direct leadership and day\-to\-day oversight f k leave, volunteer, and parental \& caregiver leave. * **Educational Assistance** – Tuition reimbursement for job\-related courses after six months of service. * **Health Management and Wellbeing Available to eligible employees starting the first day of the month following your start date. Eligibility for each benefit may vary based on employment status, location, and length of service. * **Employee Recognition Program** \- High5 employee recognition and awards platform, quarterly and annual employee recognition * **Annual Bonus Program** \- Opportunity for an annual performance\-based bonus. * **On\-site Food Options**: Several on\-site cafes, plentiful snack and beverage kitchens, revolving on\-site vendor visits and employee events. **Where You'll Be:** For our onsite roles, Panasonic Energy is committed to fostering an ideal working environment that goes beyond the conventional. We understand the significance of moments that matter in your onsite experience, and we prioritize creating a workspace that not only promotes productivity but also ensures a fulfilling and positive work atmosphere. Join us at Panasonic Energy, where your onsite presence is valued, and we strive to make each moment count in your professional journey. **Who We Are:** Meet Panasonic Energy! At Panasonic Energy, you'll do work that matters as we are dedicated to transforming the world through the acceleration of sustainable energy. By producing safe, high\-quality lithium\-ion batteries, you become part of a team that plays a crucial role in creating technologies that move us. Our journey began in 2017, and now, as the world's largest lithium\-ion battery factory, we are expanding operations to De Soto, Kansas, providing you with the opportunity to experience career growth in more ways than one. As an innovative thinker, you'll thrive here, as we continually push the boundaries of lithium\-ion battery technology and production capabilities to enhance efficiency and performance in EVs. Being part of Panasonic Energy means positively contributing to society, aligning with our commitment to building a better world through sustainable energy solutions. We care about what you care about, fostering an environment where your contributions make a meaningful impact on the future of energy and transportation. Join us and be part of a team that values your work, encourages innovation, and actively contributes to a positive societal impact. In addition to an environment that is as innovative as our products, we offer competitive salaries and benefits. **We Take Opportunity Seriously:** At Panasonic Energy, we are committed to a workplace that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. Fairness and Honesty have been part of our core values for more than 100 years and we are proud of our diverse culture as an equal opportunity employer. We understand that your career search may look different than others and embrace the professional, personal, educational, and volunteer opportunities through which people gain experience. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, submit your application! **Supplemental Information:** Pre\-employment drug testing is required. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. All qualified individuals are required to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. *Due to the high volume of responses, we will only be able to respond to candidates of interest. All candidates must have valid authorization to work in the U.S. without restriction.* Thank you for your interest in Panasonic Energy Corporation of North America. \#LI\-PG1

jobs.title: Engineering Lead, US
jobs.description: **At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.** Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system\-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have **800\+ customers** and a team of 30\+ people. We are backed by top\-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. **The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!** **The role** ============ As our Engineering Lead for the US market, you will own Parallel's technical roadmap for the US and be the first engineering leader in our New York office. You will make our product work for US hospitals, ship it into our first pilots, and build the New York engineering team around you. Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in the US in 2027\. * **Reports to:** Chris Rydhal, CTO and co\-founder. You work every day with Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co\-founder, who leads the US launch, and with our Head of Coding, US. * **Location:** New York. Regular trips to pilot hospitals, plus 2 to 4 weeks of onboarding in Paris. * **Team:** a Forward Deployed Engineer and an AI engineer joining from Paris in 2027, then the engineers you hire as we grow. **Your mission for 2027:** make our product ready for US hospitals, live in our first pilots, and build an engineering team in New York that strong engineers want to join. **What you will own** ===================== * **The US technical roadmap** + Decide what we build for the US, in what order, and with whom, in line with Paris. + Our core engine and architecture stay shared with Paris: you own the US layer on top of it. * **The US pack of our engine** + With our Head of Coding and AI engineers, adapt the engine to US coding (ICD\-10\-CM/PCS, MS\-DRG, APR\-DRG), build the US test sets and measure accuracy. * **US integrations and data** + Get our agents running on US EHRs (Meditech, Oracle Health, Altera) through ScreenFlow, our computer\-use technology. + Handle US data formats: 837I claims, HL7, C\-CDA. * **US infrastructure and security** + Set up and run our US environment: hosting, access controls, logging, HIPAA technical safeguards, the technical side of SOC 2\. + Lead the security reviews with hospital IT teams. * **Pilots** + With our Forward Deployed Engineer, deploy Parallel at our first US pilot hospitals and keep it running. * **The New York team** + Hire and lead our New York engineers, and set the bar, the pace and the culture of the office. **Who you are** =============== **Experience** * 4 to 8 years in software engineering, including at least 2 years leading a small team or as tech lead. * Hands\-on: you still read and write code, and you get into the codebase when something needs unblocking. * You have shipped a product that handles US patient data: HIPAA, BAAs, security reviews with hospital IT. * You have built EHR integrations (HL7, FHIR), ideally on Meditech, Oracle Health (Cerner) or Altera. * LLMs or ML in production are a plus. **Mindset** * **Builder:** you have taken something from zero to real and want to do it again. * **Owner:** you care about the product outcome, not just the engineering process. * **Bridge builder:** you work well with a team in Paris, 6 hours ahead, and keep one product, not two. * **Low ego, hands\-on:** you take on whatever the US launch needs. **Our values** * **Play to Win:** we want to win. That means caring about results, moving fast and bringing the right intensity when it matters. * **High Trust, High Standards:** trust is our starting point, and the more freedom you have, the higher the bar. * **Low Ego, Hands\-On:** no one is above the work. Leading means taking responsibility, not distancing yourself from execution. * **Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously:** we take our mission very seriously, not ourselves. **Hiring process** ================== * Intro call with Paul (30 min). * Technical deep dive with Chris (60 min): a system you built and the hard calls you made. * Design session (90 min, in person in New York or by video): design our first US pilot, end to end (see Case study). * Meet the team: Head of Coding, US and one of our AI engineers in Paris. * References. **We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.** If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Remote (US) or Hybrid – Boston, MA (2 days per week in office) PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI\-powered pathology. Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis are critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes. **The Opportunity** ------------------- PathAI is hiring its first dedicated Developer Operations Engineer to own the systems that let our engineers ship: release automation, CI/CD, build and deployment infrastructure, and developer environments across our products. That includes AISight, our digital pathology platform used by hospitals and labs and deployed both in the cloud and on\-premises, as well as the software behind our biopharma clinical trial services. Today this work is spread across product engineers and is constantly weighed against feature delivery. You will change that. You'll own your own backlog and OKRs, set technical direction for how we build, test, and release software, and partner closely with our product and integration engineering teams, embedding with them when a project calls for it. Because our clinical software is regulated as a medical device, you'll design automation that makes releases faster and safer while meeting our quality system requirements. This is a high\-leverage senior role with a clear path to growing into a team. Your work will directly return engineering capacity to the organization and make frequent, low\-risk releases routine. * You will own our release process end to end for both cloud and on\-premises deployments, automating manual steps such as versioning, localization, and zero\-downtime (blue\-green) cutovers * You will partner with our quality and regulatory teams to design compliant release and rollback processes, so we can ship changes and revert them quickly and safely * You will design and maintain fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines, with sensible container image build strategies and consistent configuration across repositories, using DORA metrics to measure and improve delivery performance * You will bring all of our product lines onto a common release and infrastructure model, including zero\-downtime deployments, repository consolidation, and faster pipeline feedback for developers * You will standardize deployment tooling, monitoring, and observability across cloud, on\-premises, production, and test environments, including packaging and upgrade paths for customer\-hosted installations * You will build the product performance metrics we report as part of ongoing regulatory monitoring * You will automate the release documentation our quality system requires as a regulated medical device company * You will find and fix the root causes of recurring operational issues, tightening feedback loops between support and engineering * You will set long\-term direction for how every PathAI service is built, deployed, and operated **Who You Are (Required)** -------------------------- * You have 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, platform, build/release, or site reliability engineering * You have deep expertise designing and maintaining CI/CD systems (e.g. GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Kargo) * You have strong experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) * You have hands\-on experience with a major cloud provider, preferably AWS, as well as deploying and supporting software in customer\-hosted, on\-premises environments * You are proficient in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python or Go * You have experience implementing zero\-downtime deployment strategies such as blue\-green or canary releases * You are familiar with monitoring and observability tooling (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) * You have the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar codebases and reason through operational problems in systems you didn't write * You can self\-direct: you can define a roadmap, prioritize your own backlog, and communicate progress to engineering leadership ### **Preferred** * You have experience in a regulated environment (FDA, IVDR, ISO 13485, or IEC 62304\) * You have experience consolidating repositories into a monorepo or standardizing build tooling across many services * You have a background in healthcare, life sciences, or medical imaging, especially deploying into hospital IT environments with restricted or air\-gapped networks This is a hybrid position based in Boston, MA. Relocation benefits are not available for this position. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $127,500 \- $195,500\. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. *PathAI is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.*
