jobs.description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** The Payments Risk Engineering team owns fraud detection and risk management at PayPal. We build and support the services called on every money movement transaction between PayPal and its users and partners, scaling across millions of interactions, integrating with APIs in real time, and delivering high availability and configurability to the business. We're looking for strong technologists who love solving large\-scale, complex engineering problems in a repeatable, maintainable way. You'll build deep skills in software design, API design, data structures, and algorithms, along with a solid grasp of business processes. You'll work directly with Product Owners and Domain Technical Leads to protect customers while keeping payments seamless, alongside some of the strongest engineering talent in the industry. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. * Advises immediate management on project\-level issues * Guides junior engineers * Operates with little day\-to\-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices * Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions **Minimum Qualifications:** * 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience of 4\-6 years). * Strong applied experience. You’ve built, broken, and rebuilt software applications. We’re looking for creative thinkers who also know how to create real\-world products. * Proficient in back\-end development using Java EE technologies (e.g. Java language, application servers, servlet containers, JMS, JPA, etc.). * Strong Object\-Oriented Programming skills, with ability to analyze requirements and transform into scalable software designs. * Experience with HTTP, REST API's and competent designing and building web services/microservices in a commercial setting. * Experience with Design Patterns, MVC and frameworks (e.g. Spring). * Experience with Service Oriented Architectures. * Experience with development of scalable and distributed Java services. * Competent in design/implementation for reliability, availability, scalability and performance. * Competent in software engineering tools (e.g. Java build tools) and best practices (e.g. unit testing, test automation, continuous integration, etc.). **Subsidiary:** PayPal **Travel Percent:** 0 * The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is: **Primary Location \| Pay Range:** San Jose, California: ($143,500\.00 \- $212,850\.00 Annually) **Additional Location(s) \| Pay Range:** No other locations are assigned to this requisition currently. Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable. PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. **Who We Are:** **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

jobs.description: At **PEARCE**, **we've got a career for you!** Pearce is a leading technology\-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission\-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. applicable regulations. * Identify construction conflicts and recommend engineering solutions. * Review field findings, redlines, and as\-built documentation. * Support field inspections and resolve engineering issues during construction. ### **Permitting, Right\-of\-Way \& Joint Use** * Develop and review engineering documentation for municipal, county, state, and utility permits. * Coordinate right\-of\-way (ROW), easement, and access requirements. * Support pole attachment applications, pole loading analysis, make\-ready engineering, and joint\-use coordination. * Work with utilities, permitting agencies, and construction teams to resolve design conflicts. * Ensure permit documentation aligns with Frontier requirements. ### **Project Tracking, Quality Assurance \& Coordination** * jobs.title: Sr. PLM Architect
jobs.description: **Job Description:** ==================== At Pentair, you will work alongside passionate problem\-solvers who are committed to the future of our planet. We put our mission into practice, helping the world sustainably move, improve and enjoy water, life's most essential resource. From our residential water filtration to industrial water management to pool products and more, our 9,000 global employees serve customers in more than 150 countries, working to help create a better world for people and the planet through smart, sustainable water solutions. We have an opportunity for a Senior PLM Architectto join our Apex, NC team. This is the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) data architecture and integrations subject\-matter expert at Pentair Pool — a senior individual\-contributor role that owns the engineering data model, the platform configuration strategy, and the integration architecture that will make our next\-generation PLM the authoritative source of truth for engineering data. The Senior PLM Architect leads to the definition and implementation of Pentair Pool's next generation of engineering data management, then remains the permanent internal architect for the platform's lifetime. This role has direct authority for Pentair Pool engineering data architecture and provides consultative influence on Pentair Flow and Pentair Filtration segments adoption of the same architectural patterns, ensuring the data model, taxonomies, and integrations we establish scale beyond Pool over time. This role has no direct reports; it leads through technical authority, mentorship, and cross\-functional influence. **You will:** * **PLM Data Architecture \& Standards** + Define and own the engineering data model in PLM — item structures, part classifications, attribute libraries, engineering BOM (eBOM), manufacturing BOM (mBOM), service BOM (sBOM), document types, and lifecycle states — as the single source of truth for Pentair Pool product data. + Establish and govern engineering change management architecture: Engineering Change Request (ECR), Engineering Change Order (ECO), effectivity and revision control, and configuration management across mechanical, electrical, firmware, and chemistry disciplines. + Establish taxonomies, naming conventions, and metadata standards that unify data currently fragmented across 20\+ legacy tools, and design them to scale to Flow and Filtration segments. + Author and maintain the PLM data governance framework, including data ownership, stewardship roles, quality metrics, and change\-control disciplines for master data. * **Platform Configuration \& Deep Technical Ownership** + Serve as Pentair Pool's deepest internal expert on the selected PLM platform (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter, Dassault 3DExperience, PTC Windchill or equivalent), including data model configuration, workflow and lifecycle design, access control, CAD data management (electrical and mechanical), and BOM management. + Configure, extend, and optimize the PLM platform directly — building object types, attributes, lifecycles, workflows, reports, and queries to support engineering, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, and service use cases. + Lead technical platform design reviews, performance tuning, and platform administration strategy in partnership with IT operations. + Evaluate and pilot new PLM capabilities and modules as the platform and the business evolve. * **Integration Architecture** + Own the integration architecture between PLM and enterprise systems, including SAP S/4HANA (ERP), SolidWorks EPDM, Altium 365, AutoCAD, CADAM Drafting, QMS, and Salesforce. + Design bi\-directional data flows, API contracts, and schema mappings that preserve data integrity across systems and remove manual handoffs. + Partner with IT architecture, integration engineering, and external implementation partners to deliver jobs.title: Design Verification Engineer, New Grad (AI-Driven)
jobs.description: Who we are: Persimmons is building the infrastructure that will power the next decade of AI. Founded in 2023 by veteran technologists from the worlds of semiconductors, AI systems, and software innovation, We're on a mission to enable smarter devices, more sustainable data centers, and entirely new applications the world hasn't imagined yet. Why join us: We're growing fast and looking for bold thinkers, builders, and curious problem\-solvers who want to push the limits of AI hardware and software. If you're ready to join a world\-class team and play a critical role in making a global impact \- we want to talk to you. What you'll do: As a Design Verification Engineer, New Grad (AI\-Driven), you will be responsible for running and sharpening the tools that check our RTL designs against physical implementation, catching issues early and helping the team move with confidence. Your primary duties and responsibilities include: * Run daily RTL\-to\-physical\-design verification checks using our design tool suite, flagging discrepancies before they become costly problems downstream. * Leverage AI\-powered tools to speed up error detection, root\-cause analysis, and iteration cycles across design checks. * Partner with senior RTL and physical design engineers to understand what correct looks like for each block, building judgment that goes beyond a checklist. * Investigate unfamiliar problems by pulling together documentation, team knowledge, and AI tooling to find the fastest path to a working answer. * Build lightweight scripts and automations that make the next design check faster and more reliable than the last one. * Communicate clearly with the design and verification teams about what you found, why it matters, and what should happen next. * Grow into broader RTL and verification responsibilities as you build hands\-on fluency with our toolchain and design flow. **Requirements** What You Bring To The Table: * + Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Math, or a related technical field, and a track record of picking up new tools or subjects quickly and running with them. + Problem\-Solving Mindset: A track record of picking up new tools or subjects quickly and running with them, whether that came from coursework, personal projects, research, or somewhere else entirely. You like testing yourself on new kinds of problems, whether they turn out to be electrical, algorithmic, or software. We care much less about which specific tool or language you’ve already used and much more about how fast you can get up to speed on the next one. + AI Tool Fluency: Genuine comfort and curiosity using AI\-assisted tools to work through unfamiliar problems; you don’t just use AI, you know how to get real answers out of it. + Technical Foundation: Exposure to digital logic design, computer architecture, or hardware description languages. + Systems Comfort: Working familiarity with SystemVerilog. Nice\-to\-have experience with Linux/bash environments and basic scripting. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and benefits package * Flexible PTO * 401k Please note: Our organization does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from external recruiters or agencies. jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Help Build a New AI\-Native Operating Model** At Pfizer, we're investing in the future of AI\-enabled drug discovery. This role is about more than using AI to improve existing ways of working. We are building a new operating model in which small, highly capable teams combine human expertise with AI to achieve outcomes and move at a pace that previously required much larger organizations. We are looking for people who want to help invent and champion that model: individuals willing to rethink how work is organized, how problems are decomposed, what can be delegated to intelligent systems, and how humans and AI work together most effectively. Successful candidates will use AI not simply as a productivity tool, but as a means to fundamentally transform how scientific and technical work gets done—and will help others across R\&D adopt these new ways of working. **Why This Role Is Different** **Own Meaningful Problems** You'll own critical AI capabilities from architecture through production deployment. Rather than contributing to isolated components, you'll lead the design and delivery of end\-to\-end systems that directly enable scientific discovery. **Work Where AI Meets Real\-World Impact** The systems you build will support researchers tackling some of the toughest challenges in medicine, helping accelerate insights across discovery, development, and translational science. **Operate at the Frontier of AI** You will work across technologies and domains including: * Large Language Models (LLMs) * Agentic AI Systems * Multimodal Learning * Scientific Machine Learning * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Knowledge Graphs * Distributed Training and Inference * AI Platforms and MLOps * AI Evaluation and Benchmarking **Accelerate Your Growth** You'll work alongside experts in AI, engineering, computational biology, and drug discovery while taking on increasing technical ownership and influence. **Build, Ship, Learn, Repeat** We value engineers who can move from ambiguity to execution, convert ideas into working systems, measure outcomes, and continuously improve based on real\-world feedback. **The Opportunity** As a Senior AI Research Engineer, you will build the machine learning systems that transform innovative models into secure, reliable, and scalable capabilities for scientists across Pfizer. You will: * Own an end\-to\-end subsystem, platform capability, or workflow * Make sound architecture and design tradeoff decisions * Deliver production\-quality software and AI solutions * Drive technical execution for complex projects * Influence engineering standards and best practices * Help less\-experienced engineers grow through collaboration, code reviews, and technical coaching Success in this role requires strong engineering fundamentals, demonstrated experience delivering production systems, and the ability to operate effectively in an environment where science, technology, and business impact intersect. **What You'll Do** **Build the AI Systems Behind Tomorrow's Scientific Breakthroughs** * Design, develop, and deploy production\-grade AI systems supporting multimodal biomedical models and intelligent agents * Engineer data pipelines, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, knowledge systems, inference services, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Create scalable software that enables AI capabilities to move beyond experimentation and into everyday scientific use **Own End\-to\-End Technical Delivery** * Translate scientific and business needs into technical solutions * Lead architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement for your area of ownership * Drive projects from concept through production and operational support **Turn Research Into Impact** * Partner closely with AI scientists, computational biologists, data engineers, and platform teams * Transform promising prototypes into reusable, reliable, and maintainable systems * Develop solutions with clear interfaces, measurable performance, and long\-term sustainability **Make Thoughtful Engineering Tradeoffs** * Balance performance, scalability, cost, reliability, security, privacy, maintainability, and speed of delivery * Apply sound engineering judgment when evaluating technical approaches and system architecture decisions **Build Trusted and Responsible AI** * Strengthen model evaluation, observability, reproducibility, lineage, security, and operational resilience * Implement practices that support responsible and trustworthy AI deployment within scientific environments **Raise the Engineering Bar** * Contribute to architecture reviews, code reviews, engineering standards, and reusable technical patterns * Troubleshoot complex problems and improve engineering quality across the organization * Provide guidance and support to less\-experienced engineers through collaboration and mentorship **Deliver Measurable Outcomes** * Define success metrics and operational indicators * Continuously improve pe fizer location and work on\-site an average of 2\.5 days per week. The annual base salary for this position ranges from $106,000\.00 to $176,600\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 15\.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. jobs.title: Senior Production Support Engineer (8 am - 5 pm ET)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. We are hiring a **Senior Production Support Engineer** to serve as a technical expert across Pindrop's platform, with a strong focus on **API integrations, complex troubleshooting, and production reliability**. You'll own the resolution of critical production issues, lead high\-severity incident investigations, and collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver reliable solutions and exceptional customer experiences. This role is ideal for a hands\-on problem\-solver who thrives in customer\-facing environments, enjoys working with complex systems, and is passionate about technical excellence and continuous improvement. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Serve as a subject matter expert for Pindrop's platform, APIs, integrations, and customer environments. * Troubleshoot complex production issues and API integration challenges, including authentication, connectivity, and configuration. * Own critical escalations and lead technical investigations during Sev1 incidents. * Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to resolve issues and support successful deployments. * Conduct root cause analysis, identify recurring issues, and drive long\-term improvements. * Monitor production health and recommend improvements to tooling, automation, and support processes. * Mentor engineers and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. * Participate in on\-call rotations, including after\-hours support as needed. **Who You Are** --------------- * A technically curious problem\-solver with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Calm under pressure and confident in handling critical production incidents. * Customer\-focused, collaborative, and comfortable communicating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Proactive, accountable, and committed to improving system reliability. * Passionate about mentoring, knowledge sharing, and learning new technologies. **Your Skill Set** ------------------ * 7\+ years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, Technical Support Engineering, or a related role. * **Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, API integrations, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, and troubleshooting tools such as Postman or cURL.** * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. * Working knowledge of Linux, SQL, relational databases, and scripting. * Experience investigating application logs, production issues, and complex system behavior. * Familiarity with monitoring, ticketing, and incident management tools. * Proven ability to independently troubleshoot complex issues and manage technical escalations. * Strong communication, documentation, and mentoring skills. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Understanding of VoIP technologies and SIP. * Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS/SSL. * Experience with monitoring, observability, or automation tools. **What's in It for You** ------------------------ As a Pindropper, you'll join a growing, remote\-first company using innovative voice technology to make security more human. You'll work with talented teams, solve meaningful technical challenges, and help shape the reliability and support experience of Pindrop's platform. **Your First 90 Days** ---------------------- **Within 30 Days** * Complete onboarding and develop an understanding of Pindrop's platform, APIs, and support processes. * Begin contributing to technical investigations alongside experienced engineers. **Within 60 Days** * Independently manage customer cases, API integration issues, and production incidents. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to drive technical resolutions. **Within 90 Days** * Become a trusted technical resource for complex escalations. * Contribute improvements to troubleshooting practices, documentation, and support processes. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation, including equity for all employees. * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO). * Company\-wide rest days. * Generous health and welfare plans, including an employer\-paid employee\-only option. * Employer HSA contributions. * Vision and dental coverage for you and your family. * Employer\-provided life and disability insurance. * Paid parental leave (equal for all parents). * One year of diaper delivery for new parents. * Identity protection through Norton LifeLock. * Monthly phone and internet allowance. * One\-time home office allowance. * Remote\-first work environment. * Company holidays. * Annual professional development and learning stipend. * Choice of Apple MacBook Pro. * 401(k) with competitive company match. * Wellness program, including EAP and 24/7 telemedicine. \#LI\-Remote **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed. ### **Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

jobs.title: Performance & Debug Software Engineer – AI Inference
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** ===================== Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Our first\-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting\-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway. **Role Overview** ================= This engineer will improve end\-to\-end large language model (LLM) inference performance on Positron's custom AI accelerators, including our FPGA\-based Atlas systems and our Titan systems built on the Asimov ASIC. The work spans hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, distributed KV cache, and scalable inference serving architectures. It covers profiling, algorithms, GPU\-side data preparation, host\-to\-device data movement, runtime behavior, and measurement on production\-relevant models. You will join a small, performance\-focused team that is expected to optimize the whole stack, and not merely tune isolated kernel interfaces. The goal is to sustain a repeatable path from observing workload symptoms to identifying root causes and creating measured improvements. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Performance Profiling and Optimization** * Profile and optimize latency, throughput, utilization, and efficiency across hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator configuration, the device runtime, host software, and on\-device execution. * Use performance counters, hardware and software traces, telemetry, and simulation to isolate regressions and validate fixes. ### **Distributed Inference and KV Cache** * Develop and optimize distributed inference capabilities, including efficient KV cache management and data movement across heterogeneous hardware. ### **Benchmarking and Test Infrastructure** * Build representative benchmarks and workload traces that expose bottlenecks in compute, memory, chip\-to\-chip interconnect, networking, scheduling, and model loading. * Partner with test engineers embedded in the team to turn performance findings into durable regression tests and release gates. ### **Architecture Influence** * Influence hardware and software architecture and interfaces where measured performance reveals a structural limitation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Strong C\+\+ and Python skills, with hands\-on experience profiling and optimizing complex systems that exercise Linux VFIO interfaces.. * Deep understanding of memory hierarchy, concurrency, data movement, batching, scheduling, and performance measurement. * Hands\-on experience using profilers, counters, traces, and statistical methods to distinguish signal from noise. * Demonstrated ability to debug across application, runtime, driver, firmware, and hardware boundaries. * Experience bringing up software on new silicon, and debugging and analyzing performance optimizations in customer production deployments. * Enthusiasm for AI\-accelerated software development, including using coding agents and orchestrating subagents to move faster without compromising engineering outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with CUDA, HIP, Triton, GPU kernel development, distributed inference, or KV cache systems. * Familiarity with transformer inference, mixture\-of\-experts (MoE) models, model serving, FPGA or ASIC accelerators. * Working knowledge of Perfetto, Linux perf, eBPF, simulation, or hardware performance counters. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Within the first 12 months: * A baseline performance scorecard exists for priority workloads, with repeatable measurement and clearly identified bottlenecks. * At least one major bottleneck in hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, or distributed inference has been removed, with an automated regression guard in place. * A key distributed inference data path has a working implementation with quantified end\-to\-end cost. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Work on a small, high\-leverage performance team with the mandate to debug and improve the full stack, from application code down to firmware and hardware, rather than being confined to a single layer. * Help shape the distributed inference architecture and KV cache strategy for a custom inference accelerator at a formative stage, with direct influence over interfaces and system design. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $300,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future. **Health and wellness** * Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents. * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more. * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available. **Time off and flexibility** * Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge. * 13 paid company holidays. * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup. **Compensation and future** * Competitive salary and equity. * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one. **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: Provn is helping Envorso Sports recruit a Founding AI Engineer. Please apply on our home page on Provn and take the challenge to stand\-out from competition. **About Envorso Sports** ------------------------ Envorso Sports is building the platform that runs a professional sports team's entire fan\-facing business: ticketing, website, mobile app, and increasingly commerce, CRM, and marketing, from one system instead of six disconnected vendors. Today, most teams run a fragmented stack: a website vendor, a ticketing provider, a separate mobile app, CRM tools, marketing automation, and game\-day engagement solutions bolted together. Teams don't want to pay five vendors and contractors to stitch the data together. That creates a disconnected fan journey and leaves revenue on the table. Our platform is live today with the Seattle Seawolves of Major League Rugby, and the league itself is now on the platform, with individual teams onboarding through the season. Ticketing, website, and mobile app are shipped and in production with paying customers. CRM, marketing automation, personalization, and revenue operations are what we build next, AI\-native from the start. We want candidates to know exactly where the product stands before they join. **About the Founding Engineer Role** ------------------------------------ You'll be our first in\-house engineer. This is a founding role: you'll own the fan data platform for the long term and help shape how we grow engineering, not ship one feature and move on. The problem is simple to state. Our teams and the league sit on a large fan database: ticket transactions, web and app activity, shop purchases, and email engagement. Today almost none of it is used. One salesperson calls season\-pass holders; one marketer sends a broadcast email and sees who bites. Your job is to turn that data into revenue: unify what we know about each fan across ticketing, web, app, shop, and email; decide which fans should get which offer; and deliver it through email and in\-app offers or push. Offers are concrete: a promo code for an abandoned cart, a season pass or match pass, a merch bundle, a seat upgrade. Getting the wrong offer to the wrong fan costs real money and real trust with a small, loyal fan base. You'll build for a three\-to\-five\-year horizon, not just this quarter. We need someone who thinks like an architect (data model, scale, failure handling, consent, cost) while still shipping something a team can use in weeks. You'll also be the engineer closest to our customers' front offices. Part of the job is understanding how a team's revenue and marketing operations actually work, and helping decide what we build first based on impact and effort. You'll report to Gopal Rao and work alongside our five\-engineer team in Argentina as one small group. Expect real overlap\-hours collaboration, and expect to take a problem, make the call, and ship without waiting on someone else. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the fan data platform end to end: a unified fan record across ticketing, web, app, and email, designed to hold up as we grow from one team's list to a whole league's * Ship fan segmentation and a targeted offers engine that decides which fans get which offer, and delivers it by email reactivation and in\-app offers or push * Build marketing ops and revenue ops driven by agentic AI: fan identity, segments, campaign builder and automation, and propensity, churn, and pricing models * Bring commerce into the fan record: shop purchases alongside tickets, so offers can cross\-sell merch, passes, and seat upgrades * Build the surfaces people use, in TypeScript and Next.js on web and in our mobile app, so offers are something a marketer reviews and a fan acts on, not just an API response * Design for production from day one: consent and opt\-in enforcement, no duplicate sends, failures that are visible instead of silent, and costs you can explain * Work with team front offices to understand their revenue goals, and sequence the roadmap by impact and effort * Make AI how we ship: build an AI\-native product where models change the outcome for a marketer or a fan, and run an agentic development process (AI\-SDLC) with coding agents, specs and tests as guardrails, and human review before anything reaches a fan * Help decide how engineering grows: how we scale with our Argentina team, what we build in\-house, and who we hire next **How We Hire** --------------- Apply through Provn by completing a short challenge and video walkthrough. If your submission clears the bar, you'll move straight to a conversation with our team. We don't wait to batch candidates. The process: a screen with Gopal, a technical interview, then a panel with engineering and product leaders. **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Must be authorized to work in the US. No employer\-sponsored visas for this role.

Technicians work to the client's SOPs, cGMP and Good Documentation Practices, and to current regulations and industry practice. Our mission is to provide cost\-effective solutions by providing intelligent, driven resources to our clients, with superior quality and integrity. **The Role** The Facilities Technician operates, monitors and maintains the utility and facility systems of a GMP biopharmaceutical manufacturing facility that runs 24\-7\. The Technician works within a shift team under a Lead Facilities Technician, resolves alarms and routine issues independently, and documents all work to GMP standards. The role carries no supervisory responsibility. **Responsibilities** ***Operate and maintain the utilities*** * Operate and monitor purified water and WFI generation, storage and distribution systems (RO/EDI, distillation, storage tanks, hot loops, ozone and UV sanitization), and clean steam generators including steam quality parameters. * Maintain compressed air and process gas systems (nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide), including dryers, filters, manifolds and point\-of\-use assemblies. * Monitor and maintain cleanroom HVAC: air handling units, HEPA filtration, differential pressure, temperature and humidity control. * Operate the building management and environmental monitoring systems: respond to alarms, review data and record the actions taken. * Maintain the chillers, boilers, plant steam, heating hot water, glycol and other plant utilities that supply the clean systems, and support the UPS, normal and emergency power systems. * Perform rounds of mechanical rooms, utility spaces, cleanrooms, rooftops and cold storage to identify abnormal conditions before they become alarms. * Perform routine sanitization, passivation support and filter changes per approved procedures. * Respond to alarms and excursions, troubleshoot mechanical, electrical and controls faults, restore service and initiate deviations as required. ***Keep the records and stay compliant*** * Complete work orders, logbooks and preventive maintenance records in the site CMMS accurately and at the time of the work, following cGMP, SOPs and Good Documentation Practices. * Support requalification, calibration and periodic review of utility systems, and the commissioning of utility changes. * Take part in deviation investigations, root cause analysis and CAPA implementation. * Draft and revise SOPs, preventive maintenance tasks and work instructions, and support change controls for utility modifications. * Coordinate contractor work in GMP areas with proper gowning, permitting and oversight. * Follow EHS policies including lockout/tagout, confined space, hot work, permit\-to\-work and chemical handling, and keep a clean, organized and safe work area. * Comply with all applicable Quality Agents and client policies on health, safety and the environment. **What Good Looks Like** * Utility systems run within their limits; alarms are answered quickly, resolved and recorded. * Work orders, logbooks and PM records are complete, accurate and right first time. * Procedures are followed, and anything outside them is raised as a deviation, not worked around. * Dependable on shift, on weekends and holidays, and on call. * Works well with the shift team, the client's engineering staff and contractors. **Skills** * Hands\-on experience with GMP mechanical, electrical and HVAC systems. Experience with clean utilities (purified water, WFI, clean steam, compressed air, process gases) is strongly desired. * Ability to read P\&IDs, electrical schematics and equipment manuals. * Working knowledge of CMMS and building management or environmental monitoring platforms. * Troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical and controls systems. * Familiarity with cGMP (21 CFR Parts 210 and 211\), Good Documentation Practices and USP \<1231\> water quality requirements, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Clear written and verbal communication, including complete and legible records. **Minimum Requirements** * High school diploma or GED. * Able to work a rotating shift schedule including nights, weekends and holidays, and to take part in scheduled on\-call rotations. * Current driver's license and auto insurance, or other dependable means of transportation that allows you to reach the site within about two hours when on call. * Able to stand and walk for long periods, climb ladders and stairs, lift up to 50 pounds, and work in varying temperatures and noise levels while wearing PPE, including cleanroom gowning. **Preferred** * Technical trade school, military training or an associate degree in mechanical, electrical, HVAC or a related field. * Maryland Stationary Engineer license, boiler operator license, EPA Section 608 certification, Maryland journeyman electrician or HVAC license, or OSHA 10 or 30\. * Experience with deviations, change control or regulated investigations. **Typical Experience** Typically, 2 to 7 years of hands\-on facilities or utilities maintenance, with time in a GMP pharmaceutical, biotechnology or other regulated manufacturing site preferred. jobs.description: ### **About Re:Build** At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We operate an advanced, end\-to\-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full\-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)* ### **About Re:Build Applied Logix** Re:Build AppliedLogix provides product OEMs with leading\-edge embedded systems design services and product commercialization expertise. Our senior team of electronics, software, and mechanical engineers are fluent in a broad range of applications including fuel cell control and battery management systems, precision agriculture, medical devices, automotive and transportation components, and imaging systems with machine vision and AI processing integration. The Re:Build AppliedLogix Team provides design expertise for all facets of modern digital product development \- with custom analog and digital embedded electronics; VHDL and Verilog targeting FPGAs, embedded software on bare\-metal, RTOS or Linux; full\-stack application development (Linux and Windows). Our mechanical design capabilities include the packaging of embedded systems, tooling design, and manufacturing process development.\| **Who We Are Looking For** -------------------------- Re:Build is seeking a **Mechanical Engineer II** to join our AppliedLogix team in Rochester, NY. We're looking for someone with 3–5 years of mechanical design experience who enjoys solving technical challenges and developing products from concept through prototyping and testing. problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with SolidWorks FEA, thermal analysis, or CFD tools. * efficiency. * Ability to support defense\-related projects. * Ability to travel up to 20% as needed. Analyze large datasets from wafer inspection, metrology, and MOCVD processes to identify trends, correlations, anomalies, and root causes. * Develop automated analysis and visualization workflows process, equipment, and wafer\-level data to improve understanding of defect mechanisms and yield drivers. * Partner with process, equipment, and development engineers to correlate defect excursions with process changes and equipment events. * Improve inspection methodologies, algorithms, calibrations, statistical metrics, and defect classification strategies. * Ensure the accuracy, repeatability, and integrity of defect metrology systems and associated data. * Apply DOE, SPC, statistical modeling, and data visualization to support process improvement. * Communicate technical findings and actionable recommendations to engineering teams, management, vendors, and customers. **Qualifications** **Required** * BS with 5\+ years, MS with 3\+ years, or PhD in Engineering, Science, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field. * Experience in semiconductor defect inspection, metrology, yield engineering, manufacturing analytics, image analysis, or a related area. * Strong data analysis and programming skills, preferably with Python and SQL. * Experience applying AI/ML, computer vision, statistical learning, or advanced analytics to engineering problems. * Experience working with large datasets, including data extraction, manipulation, statistical analysis, visualization, and correlation. * Familiarity with tools/libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, OpenCV, PyTorch, or TensorFlow is desirable. * Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving capabilities. * Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across process, equipment, manufacturing, development, and data/IT functions. **Preferred** * Experience with AI/ML\-based wafer defect detection or classification. * Experience developing automated data pipelines, dashboards, or manufacturing analytics tools. * Experience with optical wafer inspection systems such as KLA Candela or Nanotronics. * Knowledge of semiconductor materials, epitaxial growth, and materials characterization. * Experience with DOE, SPC, process capability, and statistical modeling. * Familiarity with As a Senior Privacy Engineer on the Security and Privacy GRC team, you will shepherd and grow Roblox's Privacy Review Program, the technical and process backbone that ensures privacy is engineered into every product before it ships. You will join the Security and Privacy GRC team, reporting to the Sr Engineering Manager for Privacy Governance and Operations. This is a hands\-on privacy engineering role: you'll set standards for privacy\-enhancing technologies, act as the go\-to SME for policy\-as\-code, and partner closely with Product teams, Trust \& Safety, Legal, and Regulatory Compliance as part of Roblox's broader cross\-functional privacy program. **You will:** ------------- * Shepherd and evolve the Privacy Review Program, designing consistent intake workflows, evaluation criteria, and documentation to systematically assess privacy risk across new products, features, and infrastructure changes. * Develop standards and guidelines that enable product teams to adopt privacy\-enhancing technologies (PETs) such as differential privacy, k\-anonymity, data minimization, and secure computation, with clear guidance on trade\-offs and implementation patterns. * Act as the Privacy SME for policy\-as\-code, translating privacy requirements and regulatory obligations into automated, enforceable controls embedded directly into engineering workflows and infrastructure. * Partner cross\-functionally with Regulatory Compliance, Trust \& Safety, and Legal to align Privacy Review Program outcomes with broader compliance obligations and evolving global privacy frameworks. * Drive privacy\-by\-design adoption across product and engineering organizations through self\-service tooling, consultation, and scalable enablement programs. * Communicate privacy risk posture and program health to product stakeholders and cross\-functional partners, turning complex technical findings into clear, actionable guidance. **You have:** ------------- * 5\+ years of relevant professional experience in privacy engineering, privacy program management, or a related security/compliance discipline. * Experience owning or significantly shaping a privacy review process, privacy governance function, or equivalent, including designing review workflows, managing stakeholder intake, and driving decisions to closure. * Deep expertise in privacy\-enhancing technologies (PETs), such as differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, k\-anonymity, federated learning, and secure multi\-party computation; and sound judgment about their real\-world trade\-offs in production environments. * Experience identifying and mitigating privacy vulnerabilities in data systems, including identifiability risks such as inference, linkage, and homogeneity attacks, and other privacy risks more broadly. * Hands\-on experience with policy\-as\-code tooling for automating compliance enforcement in engineering pipelines (e.g., OPA/Rego, Cedar, or similar policy engines). * Strong understanding of global data protection regulations, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, COPPA, and LGPD; and the technical implications of each for product and infrastructure design. * Demonstrated ability to drive alignment across engineering, legal, policy, and compliance stakeholders without direct management authority. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Security, or a similar technical field. **You are:** ------------ * + A skilled translator: You articulate technical privacy trade\-offs to legal and compliance audiences, and unpack regulatory requirements clearly for engineering teams. + Organized and process\-oriented: You manage multiple concurrent program tracks with precision and accountability in a fast\-moving environment. + Comfortable with ambiguity: You build structure and rigor where little exists, take ownership of outcomes, and know when to drive autonomously versus escalate. + Collaborative: You move work forward across teams you don't directly manage and build trust quickly with diverse stakeholders. + Genuinely invested in user privacy: You see it as a core product and platform value, not a compliance formality, and you make the case for it compellingly. jobs.title: Core Research Software Engineer I - Integrated Genomics Core
jobs.description: **New Posting Format:** **Job Summary** The Salk Institute Core Facilities drive data\-heavy biological research at the Salk Institute in multiple disciplines. The Core Facilities generate, manage and compute against large\-scale datasets from genome sequencing, gene expression profiling, microscopy, spatial imaging, flow cytometry and mass spectrometry, using cloud and on\-premise infrastructures. The Salk Institute Core Facilities are looking for a Research Software Engineer to assist in daily systems administration and operational support for the technology infrastructure that underpins Salk’s data\- and compute\-intensive resource facilites, as well as core administrative services. This includes managing servers, storage, and instruments that enable biological research. Your focus will be on the configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of Core systems and user services, ensuring they are secure, reliable, and optimized for performance. Working under the general supervision of the Director of the Integrative Genomics Core, you will work in partnership with Salk Institute IT and the Center for AI and Research Computing (AIRC) personnel in assisting Core staff in implementing hardware and software solutions and supporting complex systems. The role sits at the interface of research and software engineering, but it is grounded in the research side: unlike a conventional software engineer who builds to fixed product specifications, a Research Software Engineer works shoulder\-to\-shoulder with scientists to turn their evolving needs into working tools. This position offers an opportunity to contribute directly to Salk’s scientific mission by maintaining robust Core Facilities services in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment. **Who We Are** The Salk Institute is an internationally renowned research institution that values all (https://www.salk.edu/about/our\-community/) members of our scientific community. We seek bold and interactive leaders passionate about exploring new frontiers in science. Our collaborative community embraces perspectives across discipline, professional acumen, and unique life experiences, fostering innovation, and a sense of belonging. Together, we strive to improve the wellbeing of humanity through groundbreaking research. Founded by Jonas Salk, developer of the first safe and effective polio vaccine, the Institute is an independent, nonprofit research organization and architectural landmark: small by choice, intimate by nature, and fearless in the face of any challenge. Salk's vibrant community has many talented individuals from varied backgrounds, each playing a crucial role in driving our mission forward. From visionary leaders (https://www.salk.edu/about/management\-team/) to dedicated administrators (https://www.salk.edu/administration/) and brilliant faculty members (https://www.salk.edu/science/directory/faculty/), the Institute is united by a shared passion for scientific exploration and innovation. **What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be** **Systems Installations, Integrations, and Operations** * Develop, maintain, and release open\-source scientific packages for core research purposes, following professional software engineering practices including version control (Git), code review, testing, type checking, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD). * Support and make use of shared high\-performance computing resources, including GPU cluster scheduling and containerized job workflows (e.g., Kubernetes\-based schedulers, SLURM). * Rapidly prototype, build, and iterate on internal applications, command\-line tools, and utilities in response to evolving scientific needs. * Integrate systems and services through APIs, authentication, and automation to create seamless workflows for end users. * Work directly with biologists and other scientists to understand their experimental goals and translate them into technical solutions. * Prepare and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials that enable researchers to use the tools and pipelines independently. * Contribute to the lab’s open\-source software community, including reviewing external contributions and responding to user issues. * Participate in project planning and status discussions, and coordinate with other Salk labs, Core facilities, and programs. * **Systems Monitoring \& Maintenance:** Monitor and maintain core facilities system health and capacity, and ensuring service reliability and uptime. * **OS Installation \& Patching:** Install and configure operating systems (primarily Linux/\*NIX and Windows) on servers, workstations, and other Core Facility devices. Apply patches and updates to maintain security and optimize performance. * **Backups \& Disaster Recovery****:** Execute backup and restore procedures for Core Facilty data, monitor backup jobs (on\-premises and cloud) and remediate failures. * **Storage Management:** Monitor Core Facility on premis and cloud storage usage. Ad research experience, or demonstrated interest in plant science, biology, neuroscience, or another life\-science domain. * A track record of shipping small tools or projects quickly and independently, and of picking up new languages, frameworks, and systems with minimal ramp\-up. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with scientists to translate their needs into technical solutions. * A public code portfolio (e.g., GitHub) that demonstrates initiative beyond coursework, such as personal projects or contributions to open\-source software. **What We Can Offer** **The expected pay range for this position is $33\.00\-$38\.00 hourly.** Salk Institute provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the institute reasonably expects to pay for a position. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, and external market pay for comparable jobs. **Benefits** Salk Institute offers competitive benefits (https://www.salk.edu/about/careers/benefits/), including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, patient advocacy services, and transit/parking program. **Salk Values** The Salk Community, both scientists and administrators, worked together to define values that we believe support Salk’s pursuit of excellence. To be truly the best scientific institution requires not only incredible discoveries, but a common understanding of how we should work together to enable those discoveries. The acronym “I CARE” (https://www.salk.edu/about/careers/values/) provides a simple way to remember each of the values and reminds each of us of the importance of what we do each day. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** The Salk Institute for Biological Studies is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal access to opportunities for students, employees, applicants for employment and other visitors. Salk has also adopted and maintains a policy to encourage professional and respectful workplace behavior and prevent discriminatory and harassing conduct in our workplace. Accordingly, the Institute prohibits harassment and discrimination in employment on the basis of, and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to, actual or perceived race (race is inclusive of traits associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles. Protective hairstyles include, but not limited to, such hairstyles as braids, and twists), color, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, marital status, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), reproductive health decision making, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status (disabled veteran, veteran of the Vietnam era, other covered veteran status), political affiliation, and any other status protected by state or federal law. Discrimination is prohibited with any intersectionality of the above\-mentioned characteristics, including: * Any combination of characteristics. * A perception that the person has any of the characteristics or any combination of those characteristics. * A perception that the person is associated with a person who has, or is perceived to have, any of those characteristics or any combination of those characteristics. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About this role:** Samsara's cloud\-connected sensor platform collects observations about the world in near real\-time. Samsara builds an extensive set of products, including battery\-powered, wireless sensors, Linux\-based IoT gateways, and Internet\-connected dashcams. These devices are the building blocks Samsara uses to construct enterprise solutions for a wide range of verticals, including commercial fleet management and industrial monitoring. Through a unique integration of sensor data such as GPS, acceleration, temperature, video, and more, we enable our customers to gain greater insights into operations, identify and eliminate inefficiencies, and react to alerts all in near real\-time. As a Firmware Engineer at Samsara, you will develop software that runs on millions of devices, deployed by our industrial and enterprise customers. You'll tackle challenges including evaluating and selecting hardware components, bringing up new hardware platforms and sensors, building systems to gather data and detect meaningful events, and structuring recorded data to allow efficient analysis across thousands of devices while providing deep insights into individual events. We use C for our MCU\-based platforms, Golang for embedded applications on Linux\-based gateways and backend services, Google protocol buffers to structure data, and various AWS technologies to process and store data. Experience with these exact technologies is not required. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. *Click here**to learn more about Samsara's cultural philosophy.* **In this role, you will:** * **Shape the hardware, not just the code that runs on it.** Sit in reviews with our electrical engineers and help choose the right SoC, amount of flash/RAM, and combination of sensors, then prove those choices out on prototypes that reach real customers in months, not years. * **Be the first person to make a new board do anything at all.** Bring up new platforms and prototypes from virgin silicon: configure I/O, get SPI, I2C, UART, BLE talking, debug system init, validate the design, and turn unproven hardware into a product. * **Build the layers everything else depends on.** Peripheral drivers, secure bootloaders, device firmware updates, as well as the core management layers like power and connectivity, that determine whether a device in the field quietly recovers on its own or becomes an RMA. * **Chase every microamp.** Design protocols and hardware management for battery\-powered sensors and gateways where the gap between good firmware and great firmware is measured in years of device life. * **Work with the people who ship the whole product.** Partner with product, full\-stack, mobile and quality engineers so the data your firmware produces arrives intact and useful as it lands in the hands of dispatchers, fleet managers, and technicians who depend on it every shift. * **Raise the bar for the engineers around you.** Your designs, reviews, and instincts help raise the ceiling for the whole tea  **OTA and device firmware update at fleet scale** \- A/B partitions, rollback, and the discipline of never bricking a device you cannot physically reach. * **Embedded Linux on the gateway side** \- Yocto or Buildroot, kernel drivers, device trees. * **CAN and J1939 work on commercial vehicles**, including reverse\-engineering data bus parameters across makes and models. * **Python and Bash for tooling**, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test automation. * **You've been on the factory floor** \- You have an understanding of the processes behind the mass production and quality assurance of electronics. You have a track record of fixing production show stoppers. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
