Salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.* Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture. **Purpose:** We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and operate AI and agentic solutions supporting Canadian Banking, International Banking, Global Banking and Markets (GBM), Global Wealth Management (GWM), Fraud, and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML). This is a hands\-on engineering role spanning AI applications, data pipelines, software services, and MLOps. You will work with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, and platform teams to translate business workflows into secure, reliable production solutions using Databricks, MLflow, Kubernetes, and the Azure\-native stack. You will own the design and delivery of assigned components and workflows, contribute to technical decisions with Principal Engineers and architects, and support solutions throughout their production lifecycle. The role requires sound judgment in choosing between deterministic automation, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic approaches. **What You'll Do** Business Discovery and Solution Design * Participate in discovery sessions with business stakeholders to understand workflows, data sources, pain points, and opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement. * Translate requirements into technical designs, implementation tasks, estimates, and testable acceptance criteria in partnership with product owners and technical leads. * Assess data readiness, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility; build focused prototypes to validate assumptions before production implementation. * Identify appropriate boundaries for agent autonomy, human review, approvals, and deterministic business rules. AI and Agentic Application Engineering * Build LLM\-powered applications and agentic workflows using tool calling, enterprise APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, and state management. * Implement document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, and reranking to provide relevant, permission\-aware context. * Integrate predictive models and business rules with AI workflows in collaboration with data scientists and domain experts. * Implement validation, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and fallback paths to make workflows dependable and prevent unintended repeated actions. * Compare model and orchestration options against task quality, latency, cost, and operational requirements. Data and Software Engineering * Develop and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Python, and SQL. * Implement data quality checks, schema validation, lineage, and access controls using enterprise standards and Unity Catalog where applicable. * Build tested APIs and services that connect AI applications to enterprise data, business systems, and approved tools. * Write maintainable code with clear interfaces, unit and integration tests, documentation, and peer review; troubleshoot complex issues across application and data layers. Evaluation MLOps and Production Delivery * Use MLflow and supporting tools to track experiments, register models, version prompts and configurations, and retain evaluation results and deployment evidence. * Build representative evaluation datasets and automated checks for model performance, retrieval relevance, grounded responses, tool execution, and end\-to\-end task completion. * Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated regression testing, environment configuration, and controlled releases with rollback support. * Containerize services with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), using approved infrastructure\-as\-code patterns. * Instrument applications for tracing, logs, and metrics; monitor AI quality, data and model drift where applicable, latency, availability, and consumption costs. * Investigate production incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, maintain runbooks, and contribute to operational support under the team’s agreed support model. Security and responsible AI * Implement least\-privilege access, secure secrets management, data protection, and audit logging using enterprise security and Azure identity standards. * Apply safeguards for prompt injection, sensitive data disclosure, unsafe tool execution, and unauthorized agent actions. * Implement human approval and escalation steps for sensitive decisions or actions, preserving traceability of inputs, outputs, and tool activity. * Work with cybersecurity, model risk, compliance, and data governance partners to address required controls and remediation items. Collaboration and Engineering Contribution * Work with Principal Engineers and architects to align component designs  iment tracking, model registration, versioning, deployment, and monitoring. * Practical experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud application security, identity, networking, and observability. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code, with the ability to deploy and troubleshoot services. * Ability to independently deliver well\-defined engineering work, investigate ambiguous problems, and collaborate across business and technical teams. * Understanding of AI evaluation, data privacy, secure tool use, human oversight, and the limitations of probabilistic model outputs. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in financial services, particularly banking, capital markets, wealth management, fraud detection, or AML. * Experience implementing retrieval and vector search, document processing, semantic models, or knowledge graph integrations. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), event\-driven architectures, and agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience working in regulated environments with model risk, audit, and data governance requirements. * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Technology Environment * Data engineering: Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Event Hubs. * AI and machine learning: Azure\-hosted AI models and services, MLflow, machine learning frameworks, agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval, and vector search. * Software and cloud: Python, SQL, REST APIs, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, Azure Functions, and Azure API Management. * Engineering operations: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Terraform or Bicep, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID. **Hiring Manager:** Prabhu Gururaj **Interested?** If your experience is closely related but doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we do encourage you to apply \- you might be the right candidate for this or other roles at Scotiabank! Salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.* Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture. **Purpose** We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams delivering AI and agentic solutions across Canadian Banking, International Banking, Global Banking and Markets (GBM), Global Wealth Management (GWM), Fraud, and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML). This management role combines people leadership, business partnership, and end\-to\-end delivery accountability across data engineering, AI engineering, software engineering, and MLOps. You will translate business priorities into executable roadmaps, build capable teams, and oversee solutions from discovery through production adoption and ongoing operation. You will partner with Principal Engineers, architects, product owners, and platform teams to make sound technical decisions, manage delivery dependencies, and ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for security, quality, reliability, and measurable business value. **What You'll Do** **People leadership and team development** * Lead and develop engineers across data, AI, software, and MLOps disciplines, establishing clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and individual development plans. * Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and succession planning; build a collaborative, accountable, and inclusive team culture. * Plan team capacity and skills coverage, balance priorities across initiatives, and address staffing gaps through recruitment, development, and partner support. * Empower technical leads and Principal Engineers to guide architecture and engineering practices while maintaining clear accountability for team outcomes. **Business partnership and use case discovery** * Partner with line\-of\-business leaders, product owners, and domain experts to identify opportunities for AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic workflows. * Lead discovery and prioritization based on business value, data readiness, technical feasibility, risk, cost, and operational impact. * Agree on scope, success measures, business ownership, and adoption plans; ensure teams select an appropriate mix of automation, predictive models, and AI agents. * Communicate roadmaps, progress, trade\-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to business stakeholders and senior leadership. **Delivery planning and execution** * Own delivery roadmaps, milestones, resource plans, and execution across multiple AI and data initiatives, from proof of concept through production rollout. * Partner with product owners to maintain prioritized backlogs, define acceptance criteria, and establish release readiness and production handover requirements. * Manage cross\-team dependencies, delivery risks, scope changes, and escalations across business, platform engineering, cybersecurity, governance, and operations. * Manage assigned budgets, cloud consumption, vendor commitments, and delivery costs; report forecasts and make resource trade\-offs within delegated authority. * Track business outcomes, adoption, delivery predictability, engineering quality, and operational performance; use evidence to improve execution. **Engineering oversight and technical direction** * Provide technical management oversight across data pipelines, machine learning models, retrieval services, agent orchestration, APIs, and enterprise application integration. * Partner with Principal Engineers and architects to review solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and reusable platform capabilities. * Oversee delivery using Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, MLflow, and Azure\-native services, with appropriate data quality, lineage, and access controls. * Ensure AI and agentic solutions have defined evaluation criteria covering predictive performance, retrieval quality, response accuracy, tool execution, and task completion. * Champion code reviews, automated testing, documentation, reusable components, and disciplined software engineering practices across teams. **MLOps DevOps and operational accountability** * Ensure teams implement lifecycle controls for data, models, prompts, agents, and evaluation datasets, including versioning, deployment approvals, and rollback. * Oversee CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization, and Kubernetes delivery, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), in partnership with platform teams. * Establish service ownership, support readiness, observability, incident response, and agreed service\-level objectives for production solutions. * Monitor model and data drift, AI quality, availability, latency, and cost; prioritize remediation and operational improvements. **Responsible AI and governanc generation, tool integration, evaluation, and human oversight. * Experience overseeing MLOps and MLflow\-based lifecycle practices, including experiment tracking, model registration, deployment, and monitoring. * Experience managing delivery on Microsoft Azure, including cloud security, identity, networking, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. * Demonstrated ownership of roadmaps, capacity planning, delivery risks, budgets or cost forecasts, and cross\-team dependencies. * Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to align business priorities and engineering execution. **What You'll Bring** * Experience in banking or financial services, particularly banking operations, capital markets, wealth management, fraud detection, or AML. * Experience managing delivery in regulated environments and working with model risk management, compliance, and enterprise governance functions. * Familiarity with Unity Catalog, enterprise metadata, vector search, semantic models, knowledge graphs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience managing geographically distributed teams, delivery partners, and vendors. * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Technology Environment** * Data engineering: Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Event Hubs. * AI and machine learning: Azure\-hosted AI models and services, MLflow, agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval, and vector search. * Software and cloud: Python, SQL, REST APIs, microservices, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, Azure Functions, and Azure API Management. * Engineering operations: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Terraform or Bicep, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID. **Interested?** If your experience is closely related but doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we do encourage you to apply \- you might be the right candidate for this or other roles at Scotiabank! At Scotiabank, every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are and, embraced for their differences. That’s why we work to grow and diversify talent and engage employees in a performance\-oriented culture. **What's in it for you?** Scotiabank wants you to be able to bring your best self to work – and life, every day. With a focus on holistic well\-being, our many flexible benefit programs are designed to help support your unique family, financial, physical, mental, and social health needs. \#Dallas Location(s): United States : Texas : Dallas Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets. At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Seamless** Seamless is building the future of AI\-powered revenue generation. Sales professionals use our platform to identify prospective buyers, improve contact and company data, and create pipeline more efficiently. By combining proprietary data, artificial intelligence, and modern go\-to\-market technology, Seamless helps organizations connect with the right people and accelerate revenue growth. We are continuing to invest in our platform, our AI capabilities, and the team required to define the next generation of sales technology. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Seamless is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Visa sponsorship is not included in our hiring package. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. **Why Seamless** ---------------- Seamless is building the future of AI\-powered sales and revenue technology. Our platform brings together real\-time B2B data, artificial intelligence, sales engagement, enrichment, automation, buyer signals, AI agents, APIs, integrations, and workflow capabilities to help revenue teams find the right buyers, improve contact and company data, personalize outreach, create pipeline, and convert more opportunities into revenue. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Seamless, you will have the opportunity to: * Own meaningful features from concept through production, with a direct impact on the experience of our users. * Build scalable, high\-performing applications and services that support our data search engine and social profiling platform. * Work across our web application, Chrome extension, and connected services rather than being limited to one part of the stack. * Shape technical solutions with autonomy, collaborating closely with product managers and a lean remote engineering team. * Ship quality code iteratively, solve customer problems, and help evolve a platform that handles large volumes of data and concurrent requests. At Seamless, you’ll work with a team that values simple solutions, thoughtful engineering, strong ownership, and the ability to deliver meaningful results. **The Opportunity** You’ll join Seamless’s Technology organization as part of a lean, full stack engineering team. Your work will help advance our data search engine and social profiling platform, supporting the tools customers use to find and connect with the right buyers. You’ll take ownership of features from early requirements through deployment and post\-launch improvement. Our architecture includes a customer\-facing web application, a Chrome extension, and connected services, giving you the opportunity to contribute across the product and its underlying systems. You’ll build responsive interfaces with React and modern JavaScript while designing scalable backend services that handle large datasets and concurrent requests. You’ll collaborate with product and engineering partners, make sound technical decisions, and ship practical solutions without unnecessary complexity. **What You’ll Own** * Own full stack projects and deliverables from concept through production. * Build scalable, performant user interfaces using React, ES6/7 JavaScript, Webpack, HTML, CSS, and related modern tools. * Design, develop, and implement microservices that handle large volumes of concurrent requests and data. * Create JSON schemas and user experience workflows that support business processes involving hundreds of millions of records. * Translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions that address user needs. * Ship high\-quality, finished code frequently through iterative development and MVP delivery. * Develop complete features with substantial autonomy while communicating clearly with remote teammates. * Drive end\-to\-end development from initial brief through post\-launch analysis in partnership with product managers and technical stakeholders. * Support and improve experiences across web applications, browser extensions, and mobile platforms. **What You’ll Bring** Required Qualifications: * Ideally 5\+ years of experience building high\-quality, cloud\-based web applications. * 5\+ years of expertise in modern frontend technologies, including React, ES6/7 JavaScript, Webpack, HTML, and CSS. * 2\+ years of experience with backend technologies including Node.js, Express, Postgres, and AWS. * Experience working with large datasets using S3, Athena, OpenSearch, or similar services. * Strong SQL skills and an analytical approach to problem\-solving. * Experience working with internal APIs and integrating third\-party APIs. * Experience with React Hooks and other modern React features. * Ability to create clear documentation for new and existing features and functionality. * Experience developing software using AI\-assisted tools such as Claude and Cursor. Preferred Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree. * UI/UX design specialization. * Experience developing Chrome extensions. * Experience with web scraping. **Benefits** At Seamless, we invest in our employees by offering a comprehensive benefits package designed to support health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth. Eligible employees have access to benefits that currently include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options * 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions * Company\-paid life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, and short\-term disability coverage * Voluntary supplemental insurance options * Employee Assistance Program * Annual wellness reimbursement * Paid time off, company holidays, and paid parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Remote\-first work environment * Employee discount and perks program * Professional development, ongoing learning, coaching, and career\-growth opportunities Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan documents and may be modified by Seamless at any time.

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * hybrid * Competitive salary * Opportunity for advancement **Job Title:** Senior / Lead Agentic AI Engineer – LLM Evaluation \& Observability **Location:** Dallas, TX (Hybrid) **Duration:** Long‑Term **Experience:** 8\+ years **Interview:** Client round, in‑person **Important:** *This is a hands‑on engineering role. Candidates with practical experience building and evaluating AI applications are preferred over those whose experience is limited to AI strategy, architecture documentation, conventional QA automation, or using AI coding assistants.* We seek a Senior/Lead AI Engineer with experience building, orchestrating, monitoring, and evaluating production‑grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications. The ideal candidate is expert in Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, LLM observability, and evaluation frameworks. The role focuses on creating reliable, scalable, production‑ready AI applications, emphasizing agent orchestration, AI testing, LLM evaluation, and continuous quality monitoring. The candidate will collaborate with Engineering, QA, and platform teams to establish best practices for building, testing, monitoring, and improving AI‑powered applications. The testing focus is on GenAI evaluation, RAG pipeline assessment, agent behavior validation, LLM quality benchmarking, and automated evaluation frameworks, not conventional UI test automation. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. **Agentic AI \& GenAI Engineering** * Design, develop, and deploy production‑grade agentic and generative AI applications. * Build and orchestrate AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, Amazon Bedrock, and AgentCore. * Implement multi‑agent workflows, tool calling, state management, memory, and orchestration. * Create scalable LLM‑powered applications and reusable AI components. * Deploy agentic workflows with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, handling runtime management, tool integration, and execution orchestration. 2\. **RAG \& LLM Application Development** * Design and implement Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. * Develop pipelines for document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and context management. * Optimize retrieval accuracy, response quality, latency, and cost. * Apply grounding, hallucination reduction, and context‑relevance techniques. **3\. LLM Evaluation \& AI Testing** * Build automated evaluation frameworks with RAGAS, DeepEval, and similar tools. * Evaluate RAG pipelines using metrics such as Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision, Context Recall, and Answer Correctness. * Implement LLM‑as‑a‑Judge techniques to assess generated responses, retrieval quality, agent behavior, and workflow execution. * Establish evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and regression‑testing pipelines for continuous quality assessment. **3a. Agent Evaluation and Observability** * Implement end‑to‑end tracing of multi‑agent workflows, including tool invocation, agent handoffs, execution paths, and failure handling. * Establish observability practices to detect hallucinations, reasoning failures, tool‑calling errors, and execution inconsistencies. 4\. **AI Observability \& Monitoring** * Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability with OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, and Langfuse. * Track LLM requests, agent execution flows, tool calls, latency, token consumption, errors, and performance. * Develop debugging mechanisms for complex multi‑step agentic workflows. * Create monitoring practices to detect performance degradation and operational issues. 5\. **AWS AI Platform \& Production Engineering** * Deploy AI applications using Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. * Integrate foundation models, agent frameworks, APIs, and enterprise data sources. * Apply production‑readiness practices covering scalability, reliability, security, and performance. * Support CI/CD integration and automated evaluation of AI applications. * Optimize model selection, inference costs, latency, and resource utilization. 6\. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Provide technical guidance to engineering and QA teams. * Establish reusable frameworks, implementation patterns, and best practices. * Collaborate with architecture, DevOps, QA, and engineering teams. * Participate in design discussions, code reviews, proof‑of‑concept development, and implementation. * Mentor engineers and help teams adopt effective AI development and testing practices. **Required Technical Skills** **Agentic AI \& Orchestration** * LangGraph * LangChain * Amazon Bedrock * Amazon Bedrock AgentCore * AI agents, multi‑agent orchestration, tool calling, workflow management **Generative AI \& RAG** * Large Language Models (LLMs) * Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) * Embeddings and vector search * Prompt engineering and context management * LLM application development **LLM Evaluation \& Testing** * DeepEval * LLM‑as‑a‑Judge techniques * Evaluation metrics and benchmarking * Automated evaluation and regression testing * Assessment of hallucination, faithfulness, relevance, and response quality * Hands‑on experience with RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent frameworks * Strong understanding of RAG evaluation metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision, Context Recall, Answer Correctness) * Experience building automated evaluation pipelines for RAG‑based applications **AI Observability \& Monitoring** * OpenTelemetry * LangSmith * Langfuse * LLM tracing, debugging, and performance monitoring **Production Engineering** * Deploying and operating production‑grade GenAI applications * API integration and backend engineering * CI/CD and automated testing integration * Scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization * Strong hands‑on programming experience in Python. * Experience developing REST APIs and integrating LLM frameworks with enterprise applications. * Familiarity with asynchronous programming, API integrations, and backend development. **Preferred Qualifications** * 8\+ years of software engineering or IT experience. * Demonstrated hands‑on experience building and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI applications. * Recent experience in LLM engineering, agent orchestration, and AI evaluation. * Experience with enterprise‑scale AI implementations. * Familiarity with AWS cloud services and enterprise AI security practices. * Experience establishing AI quality standards and evaluation methodologies. * Strong problem‑solving, communication, and technical collaboration skills. **What Success Looks Like** * Development and deployment of production‑grade agentic AI applications. * Reliable orchestration and execution of AI agents and workflows. * Effective LLM evaluation and automated AI testing frameworks. * Improved AI application accuracy, reliability, observability, and performance. * Reusable engineering practices for building and maintaining enterprise GenAI solutions. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. You can speak concretely to how these agents are actually built and operated (MCP protocol, what a harness is, how to differentiate agent\-design strategies rather than just naming tools), to context management (e.g., progressive\-disclosure strategies for surfacing the right information without dumping everything into context), and to securing agent actions (scoping authorization, guardrails, what's available in the AI infra ecosystem to enforce it). + ***SRE application:***That agentic work is pointed at infrastructure and reliability problems specifically — you use AI to move at a materially faster pace in the SRE domain, not as a general\-purpose coding aid. * SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions. * Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing). * Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools. * CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable. * Programming: strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * **Nice\-to\-have:** agentic systems depth beyond the gate above. Can speak concretely to how AI agents are actually built and operated — e.g., the MCP protocol and what a harne stem to enforce that. **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $147,600 USD \- $221,400 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $137,900 USD \- $206,900 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **Job Title:** Forward Deployed AI Engineer **Location:** Hybrid, Dallas/Las Colinas office (approximately 10% travel) **Department:** Information Technology, Data \& AI **Reports To:** Sr. Director, Data \& AI**Job Overview** ---------------- We are hiring a **Forward Deployed AI Engineer** to embed with Shermco business units, find where AI can change how work gets done, and build the solutions that prove it. You will spend real time with teams in field operations, estimating, sales, finance, HR, and other functions, learning how their work actually happens before deciding what to build. This is a builder role, not an advisory one. You will move quickly from discovery to a working solution, put it in front of users, and iterate until it delivers measurable value. You take low\-code and configuration solutions built on Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Microsoft Fabric all the way to production, each with a named business owner. Work that needs extensive custom code or a complex agent goes to the AI Product Engineer. You will be judged on adoption and business outcomes, not on the number of demos produced. The role sits on the Data \& AI team and reports to the Sr. Director, Data \& AI. You will work closely with the AI Product Engineer, who builds the solutions that need custom code or complex agents, and with data engineering, analytics, and governance colleagues who provide the platform, data, and controls your work depends on. In short, you find the problem, prove the value, and ship most solutions yourself; the AI Product Engineer takes on what needs custom engineering. Your customers are internal Shermco teams. Success means business units seek you out because your work has made their jobs measurably easier. **Work Authorization Requirement:** Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. Shermco does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Responsibilities: **Embedded Discovery*** Work with stakeholders at every level, from technicians and field crews to managers and directors to VPs and executive leadership, to understand day\-to\-day workflows, team needs, and larger organizational initiatives. * Turn vague requests into scoped, written problem statements, and identify and size AI opportunities by the time, cost, risk, or revenue they could affect, and recommend where AI is not the right answer. * Build trusted working relationships with business leaders and front\-line users so the team hears about problems early. **Build and Delivery*** Build solutions quickly using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Claude, Python, and other approved AI tools and models. * Integrate with operational systems such as Salesforce, on\-premises Business Central, Dayforce, and field service platforms to put AI where work already happens. * Put solutions in front of real users early, gather feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes. * Agree on success measures with business owners before building, track results after launch, and recommend changing course or stopping work that is not delivering value. **Production Ownership and Handoff*** Take low\-code and configuration solutions on Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Fabric all the way to production, each with a named business owner, documentation, and evaluation cases, and support them in production, including a light shared support rotation for business\-critical solutions. * Hand off solutions that need extensive custom code or a complex agent to the AI Product Engineer, packaged with documentation, known limitations, and data and access requirements. * Partner with the Data \& AI Governance Engineer so every solution follows data access, security, and responsible AI standards from the start. **Adoption and Enablement*** Own adoption after launch through training, office hours, champions in the business unit, and follow\-up on usage. * Teach business users to recognize good AI use cases and to use approved AI tools effectively and safely. * Bring field insight back to the Data \& AI team to shape the roadmap, reusable components, and priorities. **Team Practice*** Use AI\-assisted development throughout your own work while remaining accountable for accuracy, security, and maintainability. * Contribute reusable patterns, prompts, templates, and lessons learned to team standards. * Share knowledge, provide peer review, and help shape Shermco's broader AI strategy. Qualifications: * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, applied machine learning, solutions engineering, or a related technical role, including 2\+ years building AI or LLM\-based solutions used in production. * Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience integrating with REST APIs and enterprise systems. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, and basic evaluation. * Experience with a cloud AI platform such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI. * Demonstrated ability to run discovery with stakeholders from front\-line staff to executive leadership and translate ambiguous problems into scoped, buildable solutions. * A track record of shipping quickly, measuring results, and iterating based on user feedback. * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining AI capabilities, limits, and risks to non\-technical audiences. * Comfort working independently, traveling to business unit locations (approximately 10%), and managing several engagements at once. **Preferred*** Experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, internal consulting, or embedded product role. * Experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, or Microsoft Foundry. * Experience with agent frameworks and protocols such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Practical experience using Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or comparable AI tools to accelerate development. * Experience with Salesforce, on\-premises Business Central, Dayforce, or field service management platforms. * Experience with document intelligence, unstructured data, or speech and image use cases. * Light front\-end or low\-code app building experience for prototypes. * Background in construction, electrical, field services, or another operations\-heavy industry. * Microsoft certification such as AI\-102 or AI\-900\. **What We Offer** ----------------- * A fast\-growing Data \& AI department where you will shape how AI is applied across the company * A small, senior team with real ownership and direct access to leaders in every business function * Current AI tooling across the Microsoft stack and Claude, with an operating model that favors speed and enabling governance over process for its own sake * Work that shows up in how a real\-world business estimates, schedules, and delivers **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER \| DRUG\-FREE WORKPLACE** Shermco is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Shermco is a drug\-free workplace.**NO AGENCIES PLEASE** Pay Range: USD $130,000\.00 \- USD $140,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II (Full Stack)
jobs.description: At Shutterfly, we make life's experiences unforgettable. We believe there is extraordinary power in the self\-expression. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a primary focus on frontend development and meaningful backend experience. * Expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3, and GraphQL. * Working knowledge in Java, Spring Boot, Python or similar technologies for backend development. * Comprehensive understanding of frontend architecture, single\-page application (SPA) design, and modern rendering patterns. * Hands\-on experience with canvas rendering, custom UI engines, or performance\-critical frontend components. * Strong computer science foundation, including data structures, algorithms, and performance analysis. * Experience designing and integrating with RESTful and GraphQL APIs. * Proven track record in Test\-Driven Development and automated testing using tools like Jest. * Familiarity with cloud\-based deployments, especially AWS. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision. * Demonstrated success in building maintainable, scalable, and cost\-effective solutions across the stack. * Adaptable to evolving product requirements and technical constraints while balancing user experience, engineering excellence, and long\-term maintainability. * A mindset of continuous improvement \- bringing forward ideas that promote modern engineering standards, tooling, and best practices. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar. * Experience working with LLMs (Large Language Models) and generative AI applications, including prompt engineering and fine\-tuning strategies. * Experience building frontend build, deployment, and CI/CD workflows. * Experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ. * Experience with workflow engines. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform. California : \[$117,750\-166,000] Connecticut and New York: \[$117,750\-152,000] Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota and Washington: \[$117,750\-140,750] Nevada: \[$110,500\-152,000] Maryland and New Jersey: \[127,250\-152,000] Hawaii : \[$110,500\-132,250] This position may be eligible for a bonus incentive, health benefits, a 401K program, and other employee perks. jobs.title: Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Slide** --------------- Slide is a modern, security\-first Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery (BCDR) company built exclusively for Managed Service Providers. Founded by Austin McChord (Datto Founder \& former CEO) and Michael Fass (former Datto General Counsel \& Chief People Officer), Slide is led by a team of industry veterans with deep expertise in backup, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity. Built from scratch, from a clean\-room code base, free from legacy technical debt, to deliver the MSP\-centric backup and recovery platform of the future. By focusing on security, performance, and simplicity, Slide provides a powerful, cost\-effective, and easy\-to\-use solution that ensures MSPs can protect their clients' data without the constraints of outdated technology and restrictive pricing models. **About the Job** ----------------- We're hiring an engineer to automate how Slide runs. You'll work across every business line (sales, finance, support, customer success, operations, and people), finding the manual, repetitive, glue\-work that each team lives with and engineering it away with integrations, automation, and AI. This is not an IT\-support or infrastructure role: IT Operations runs the day\-to\-day, and a separate systems team owns product infrastructure. Your focus is the business itself, making the whole company run faster and cleaner. Because so much of modern automation now runs on AI and agents, you'll also be our point person for healthy AI adoption: helping teams use AI well and safely, and building the agentic workflows that take real work off people's plates. You'll report to the CISO, partner with leaders in every department, and have the autonomy to go find the highest\-impact problems and solve them. You’ll join a small, high\-trust Security \& IT team that favors good tooling over bureaucracy and treats AI as a force multiplier, with direct access to leadership and a real mandate to make the whole company more efficient. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Partner with business leaders to find high\-value automation** \- embed with teams across the company, map how their work actually flows, and prioritize what to automate for the biggest impact. * **Build cross\-functional automations and integrations** \- connect the business stack (e.g., HubSpot, Stripe, Rippling, Google Workspace, Jira, support tooling, data tools) so work moves between systems without manual handoffs or copy\-paste. * **Design and ship AI / agentic workflows** \- use LLMs and agentic tooling to automate work that used to need a person: summarizing, routing, data entry, reconciliation, drafting, and research \- with sensible guardrails. * **Drive healthy AI adoption across the company** \- evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools; help teams use them well; and set the guardrails (approved tools, access, and data\-handling rules) so people get the upside without creating risk. * **Make automations reliable and governed** \- build in monitoring, error handling, and data\-handling review with security, so what you ship is trustworthy infrastructure, not fragile scripts. * **Measure and document impact** \- quantify the hours saved and errors removed, and document what you build so it stays maintainable and others can extend it. **In your first 6 months, you'll** ---------------------------------- * Run a discovery pass across the business lines and publish a prioritized automation backlog with estimated impact. * Ship two or three high\-impact automations end to end \- e.g., a finance reconciliation, a sales\-to\-finance handoff, or an AI support\-triage workflow. * Roll out AI tooling with clear guardrails and publish a simple, usable AI\-use guideline people actually follow. * Stand up a lightweight framework and standards for building, monitoring, and documenting automations so they scale beyond you. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years building automations and integrations across business systems \- in RevOps/BizOps engineering, solutions/automation engineering, or a similar builder role \- with a track record of shipping things that saved real teams real time. * Strong integration and scripting skills: APIs and webhooks, an iPaaS platform (Zapier, Make, Workato, or n8n), and real code when it's warranted (Python or JavaScript). * Fluency with the modern SaaS business stack (CRM, billing, HRIS, support, collaboration, data) and a clear mental model of how data should flow between them. * Genuine AI fluency: hands\-on building LLM\- and agent\-powered workflows, with an informed point of view on where AI helps, where it doesn't, and how to use it safely with the right data\-handling guardrails. * A consultative, cross\-functional style \- you can sit with a finance or sales leader, understand their real problem, and translate it into a reliable automation. * A bias to measure impact and document your work, and the judgment to build durable solutions rather than one\-off scripts. **Nice to have** ---------------- * You've built AI agents or LLM\-powered workflows that ran reliably in production. * RevOps / BizOps automation experience at a SaaS company; familiarity with HubSpot, Stripe, Rippling. * Data and analytics plumbing \- SQL, warehouses, and light data engineering. * A security\-conscious approach to automating over sensitive business data. **Why join us** --------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. * Paid Time Off: Generous paid time off and holiday schedule. * Retirement Plan: 401(k) * Professional Development: Opportunities for training and professional growth. * The opportunity to do your life's work in a dynamic and creative environment with like\-minded individuals. Compensation Range: $130K \- $150K

Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. *Agentic \& AI Engineering* * + Design, build, and operate production\-quality agentic applications using agentic SDKs/harnesses — including multi\-agent orchestration, subagent delegation, tool integration, and lifecycle hooks. + Design Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool and resource interfaces that give coding agents/harnesses safe, reliable access to backend systems and enterprise data. + Engineer prompts for reliable structured output (JSON schemas, few\-shot examples, validation/retry loops) and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality. + Manage context effectively across long documents, multi\-turn conversations, and multi\-agent handoffs; jobs.title: AI Implementation Engineer & Project Coordinator
jobs.description: **Allocation:** 50% project coordination and client delivery; 50% on\-premises Document AI solution implementation **Reporting:** Project/Account Lead for client delivery; AI Architect/Technical Lead for solution implementation **Location:** Albuquerque, NM , with periodic client site visits (10% Travel) **Role purpose** This role has two parts. The first is coordinating client document\-processing projects: workload scheduling, client communication, production reporting and delivery reconciliation. The second is turning business and document\-processing requirements into clear specifications, then validating the on\-premises Document AI solution and supporting its integration, deployment and operational readiness. The role works closely with the AI Architect, who owns technology selection and architecture, and with the offshore development team, which owns Python application development. **Project coordination and client delivery (50%)** 1\. Planning and workload management * Work with client managers to schedule work based on delivery priorities, available capacity and agreed deadlines. * Keep a delivery tracker covering intake, owners, due dates, dependencies, risks and open issues. * Coordinate internal resources and production teams so delivery commitments are met. * Find schedule risks early and propose ways to reduce them. 2\. Client communication and governance * Report project status, delivery progress, delays and any decisions the client needs to make. * Prepare and send weekly production and delivery reports. * Hold status meetings and keep meeting notes, action items and decision logs. * Visit client sites periodically to review each department’s scope, document types, extraction requirements, naming conventions, folder structures and acceptance criteria. 3\. Delivery reconciliation and quality * Reconcile opening backlog and new intake against work that is completed, delivered, rejected, on hold or outstanding. * Check delivery counts and identifiers, look into missing, duplicate or inconsistent records, and report any discrepancies. * Keep audit\-ready records of what was delivered, when it was accepted and how issues were resolved. 4\. Scope and change management * Keep a register of requirements and change requests. * Get written agreement from the designated owners before scope or delivery changes take effect. * Turn approved client requirements into implementation tasks with testable acceptance criteria. **Document AI solution implementation (50%)** 1\. Requirements and functional specifications * Gather and document requirements for document intake, classification, extraction, validation, reconciliation, search and reporting. * Define document types, metadata fields, extraction rules, naming conventions, folder structures and expected outputs. * Prepare source\-to\-target mappings, sample input and output datasets, workflow descriptions and acceptance criteria. * Turn approved requirements into development tasks, answer the development team’s questions, and keep requirements traceable to what gets built. 2\. SQL, data validation and reconciliation * Write SQL queries and approved database routines for validation, reconciliation, exception analysis and reporting. * Define validation rules for completeness, format, lookups, duplicates and consistency across documents. * Check processing results against source documents and expected outputs. * Prepare exception reports with supporting evidence and track each issue until it is resolved. 3\. Integration testing and solution quality * Test the document\-processing workflows, APIs, database outputs and integrations the development team delivers. * Build representative test datasets that cover document variations, poor OCR quality, missing information, duplicates and conflicting values. * Score extraction and retrieval results against agreed reference answers, and confirm that outputs keep source\-document and page references. * Test retries, reprocessing, interrupted jobs and human\-review workflows. * Log defects so they can be reproduced, coordinate the fixes, and confirm the corrected behavior. 4\. On\-premises deployment and operational support * Support environment setup and deployment, following the architecture and procedures the AI Architect has approved. * Coordinate installation prerequisites, configuration, database connectivity, internal endpoints and access requirements. * Run deployment checklists, check service health and confirm processing works end to end, including offline operation where required. * Monitor processing, review logs, investigate failures and escalate issues as needed. * Maintain configuration records, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides and release checklists. 5\. Development coordination and user acceptance * Manage the implementation backlog, priorities and dependencies with the offshore development team, and report progress against milestones. * Run solution demonstrations and user acceptance testing (UAT). * Record user feedback and separate defects from new requirements. * Prepare release\-readiness evidence for sign\-off, and provide user training and operational handover. Qualifications (suggested) * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. * 4\+ years of combined experience in project coordination and technical implementation, preferably in document management, ECM or data processing. * Strong SQL skills and experience with data validation and reconciliation. * Familiarity with OCR, document classification, data extraction and AI/ML\-based document processing. * Experience working with offshore development teams and running UAT. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience in client\-facing roles. * PMP, CAPM or Agile certification is a plus. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
jobs.description: Data, Research \& Insights Data Science Permanent New York, Boston or Washington D.C. The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist\-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles: Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later. Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music. Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions. Artist\-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist\-fan connections. For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025\-10\-16/artist\-first\-ai\-music\-spotify\-collaboration/ What You'll Do * + Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engage with generative AI music. + Design and run large\-scale analyses and evaluations of generative music systems, from prompt interpretation to model output quality, using Spotify's unique behavioral datasets, annotations, and experimentation platforms. + Partner with Engineers and AI Researchers to integrate evaluation signals into model development loops, debugging workflows, and product iteration, making sure scientific rigor informs technical direction. + Identify the behavioral and market dynamics that shape sustainable consumer demand and creator participation, and translate them into clear strategic recommendations. + Build practical, scalable metrics and decision systems that define what "good" looks like for AI music: credibility, user delight, safety, creator alignment, and ecosystem trust. + Bring together model, user behavior, and ecosystem signals into clear narratives that shape product strategy, cross\-functional alignment, and long\-term priorities across Spotify. + Create the datasets, dashboards, and long\-term measurement systems that give Spotify a lasting, comprehensive understanding of product health and impact. + Work closely with Product, Design, Research, Legal, Trust \& Safety, Marketing, Policy, and Licensing teams, bringing statistical rigor and principled measurement to help build artist\-first systems that scale responsibly. Who You Are * + You have a track record of using insights to shape strategy for major company initiatives involving many different partners. + You have significant hands\-on experience in advanced analytics or data science, ideally in a domain involving LLM evaluation, user\-generated content, or complex user behavior. + You communicate clearly, form well\-founded, evidence\-backed points of view, and can bring together messy, multimodal signals (quantitative, qualitative, and model telemetry) into clear narratives for senior executives, researchers, engineers, and the music industry. + You're proficient in advanced analytics with Python and SQL, have analyzed large datasets, and use AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot) to increase your productivity and impact. + You have experience developing metrics frameworks for complex products that help teams measure impact and reason clearly about priorities. + You have experience with machine learning frameworks, designing and assessing multimodal or embedding\-based models, and validating them against LLM judges or human ground truth, with an understanding of how to evaluate models beyond offline accuracy. + You have a solid grounding in experimental design and causal inference, such as A/B tests, quasi\-experiments, and power analysis. + You thrive when tackling loosely defined problems in ambiguous, zero\-to\-one spaces. Where You'll Be * + We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home + This team operates within the US Eastern timezone for collaboration Learn about life at Spotify The United States base range for this position is $144,714–$206,735 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six\-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward\-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know \- we’re here to support you in any way we can. Our global benefits Extensive learning opportunities, through our dedicated team, GreenHouse. Flexible share incentives letting you choose how you share in our success. Global parental leave, six months off \- for all new parents. All The Feels, our employee assistance program and self\-care hub. Flexible public holidays, swap days off according to your values and beliefs.

jobs.title: Cyber Security AI Engineer 4

Design technical cybersecurity enterprise solutions across multi\-team efforts. * Provide expert assistance, insights, and contributions to proactively shape new solutions' impact on cybersecurity controls amidst emerging threats, while conducting comprehensive risk analysis and offering direction on risk mitigation strategies for organizational technologies and Cyber Security policies, standards, baselines, and controls, to maintain the organization's security posture. * Lead technical collaboration with cybersecurity partners to drive the effective and efficient utilization of technology and/or services. jobs.title: Applied Research Lead, AI for Teaching
jobs.description: **About the lab** The EduNLP Lab at Stanford develops natural language processing methods and tools that support equitable, student\-centered teaching. We build measures of what teachers and students say and do, such as how students reason aloud in small groups, how teachers respond to student ideas, and how teachers adapt curriculum. We use those measures both as research outcomes and as feedback teachers can act on. Our work has been deployed and tested at scale with edtech partners; for example, automated feedback on teachers’ questioning, delivered through a partner product, improved questioning quality in brick\-and\-mortar classrooms. This position is part of Teacher CoPilots II, a multi\-year research program in partnership with the AI Teaching Assistant strand of Stanford SCALE’s AI Hub for Education. The program studies where and how much AI support strengthens teachers’ decision\-making while preserving their skill, and releases measures, benchmarks, evaluators, and protocols as public goods. **About the role** Research has the most impact when it reaches the products teachers use, and studying those products in real classrooms produces some of the most informative research. This role sits at that intersection. You will work with edtech partners, such as Coteach and Amplify, to bring the lab’s measures, evaluators, and feature concepts into their products; design and run the studies that test them; and publish what you learn. You will also help us study the translation process itself: what it takes for research tools to become product features that scale sustainably. You will work closely with the lab’s project manager, who leads our educator and district partnerships, and with technical staff, postdocs, and graduate students who build and validate models. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer, but you do need to be fluent enough to work directly with data and with partners’ engineering teams. **Position Summary** **Partner\-embedded research** * Scope joint projects with edtech partners, matching each one to a research question and a feasible study. * Balancing between different pacing, metrics, and level of agility across stakeholders * Translate between product and research needs: turn research measures into specifications, evaluation harnesses, or prototypes that product teams can integrate, and turn product questions into testable designs. * Lead multidisciplinary teams that span the lab and partners’ product and engineering teams. * Build and maintain data pipelines from data use agreements to transfer, storage, and organization of data. **Study design, analysis, and writing** * Collaborate with the principal investigator to design the research approach for each partner study, and integrate results across studies. * Design experiments in settings with few precedents, such as in\-product A/B tests and randomized or quasi\-experimental studies, including power analyses and preregistration. * Independently select approaches for developing, testing, and evaluating new methods, including LLM\-based evaluators and measures used inside products. * Analyze outcomes for teacher practice and student learning using the lab’s validated measures. Lead and co\-author peer\-reviewed papers (e.g., ACL, Learning@Scale, LAK, education research journals) and briefs for practitioners and developers, and present findings at academic conferences. * **Implementation science, public goods, and team** * Document each partnership systematically, recording what was asked, what changed, what shipped, and what got in the way, and use these records to lead cross\-case research on moving research into products. Prepare documentation and usage guides so other developers can adopt the lab’s released measures, evaluators, and toolkits, and contribute to dissemination. * Formally supervise and train graduate and undergraduate research assistants on partner\-facing projects, including hiring, performance management, and instruction on techniques. * Complete project\-related administrative and budgetary responsibilities of limited scope, such as tracking partner deliverables and coordinating data\-use agreements with the project manager. Other duties may also be assigned. * **To be successful in this position, you will bring** **Minimum education and experience (required)** Graduate degree in an applicable social science related field and five years of applicable experience, or combination of education and relevant experience in an applicable social science. Relevant fields include education, learning sciences, education data science, economics, statistics, and computational social science. **Minimum knowledge, skills, and abilities (required)** * Expert level knowledge and skills in field of science related to our lab’s work. * General computer skills and ability to quickly learn and master computer programs. * Strong analytical skills and excellent judgment. * Ability to work under deadlines with general guidance. ingual learners, or proficiency in Spanish. * If you meet the required qualifications but not every preferred one, we encourage you to apply. People reach this work by many routes, for example from the classroom into edtech or from research into product, and we value that range. **Physical requirements** Frequently perform desk\-based computer tasks, grasp lightly/fine manipulation, lift/carry/push/pull objects that weigh up to 10 pounds. Occasionally stand/walk, sit, use a telephone, writing by hand, and sort/file paperwork or parts. Rarely twist/bend/stoop/squat, kneel/crawl, rarely reach/work above shoulders, operate foot and/or hand controls. **Working conditions** May be exposed to blood borne pathogens. May be required to work non\-standard, extended or weekend hours in support of research work. **Work standards** Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations. Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned. Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University’s Administrative Guide, http://adminguide.stanford.edu/. **How to apply** Please submit: * A CV. * A cover letter (up to 2 pages) describing a time you translated research into a product or practice, or a product question into research, and what you learned from it. * One writing sample, such as a paper, technical report, or substantial blog post. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning November 16\. Finalists will complete a short exercise drawn from the role’s day\-to\-day work. Stanford cannot provide visa sponsorship for this role. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, please let us know. **Core Duties** : * Assist principal investigators with designing experiments constituting a phase of a research project for which precedents are few;
