jobs.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure, liftlab - Stanford Law School
jobs.description: **Stanford Law School Salary Budgeted Range: $117,536 \- $165,000** **Job Description** **Research Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure** **Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab), Stanford Law School** Stanford Law School’s Legal Innovation through Frontier Technology Lab (liftlab) is seeking a Research Engineer to design and implement the software systems that make the lab’s research possible. Working at the intersection of software engineering, computational research, and agentic AI, the engineer will build infrastructure for coordinating research agents, rapidly provisioning research environments, and running large\-scale empirical experiments. The Research Engineer reports to the lab Directors, Prof. Julian Nyarko and Dr. Megan Ma. The Directors collaboratively design the research agenda, study designs, and methodological requirements. The engineer develops the technical response to that design: assessing feasibility, contributing architectural and implementation ideas, translating research specifications into working systems, and iterating with the scientist as findings and requirements evolve. The successful candidate will combine strong programming and systems architecture skills with an understanding of research methods and reproducibility. They will build modular, configurable infrastructure that allows researchers to vary models, datasets, agent strategies, and experimental conditions without rebuilding workflows from scratch. Their responsibilities will span the software development lifecycle, from technical design and prototyping through testing, deployment, maintenance, and performance optimization. Developing classifiers and baseline models will be part of a broader responsibility to turn collaboratively developed research ideas into reliable, adaptable computational capabilities. **Your Duties Will Include:** * **Research Collaboration and Technical Design:** Translate research designed with the Directors and other research scientists into technical specifications, implementation plans, and deliverable milestones. Assess feasibility, identify computational constraints, explain technical tradeoffs, and contribute design feedback that informs continued research development. * **Agentic Infrastructure and Software Development:** Design and implement modular systems for deploying and coordinating research agents, integrating models and tools, managing data, and executing experiments. Develop reusable interfaces and configuration\-driven workflows that accommodate changes in research questions, methods, and experimental conditions. * **Research Environments and Scalable Experimentation:** Rapidly provision reproducible computing environments with appropriate software, dependencies, and data access. Build parallel or distributed experiment pipelines that support comparisons across datasets, models, prompts, and agent strategies, with appropriate logging, checkpointing, and recovery mechanisms. * **Computational Methods and Validation:** Implement classifiers, baseline models, analytical tools, and evaluation harnesses as research needs require. Read research papers and associated source code, test implementations against reference results, and collaborate with the research scientists and fellows to investigate discrepancies and validate computational behavior. * **Software Quality and Reproducibility:** Lead code review, automated testing, debugging, change control, and technical documentation. Establish practices for tracking code, data, model, configuration, and environment versions so that experiments can be reproduced and results traced to their computational inputs. * **Operations and Performance:** Maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade research applications and infrastructure. Diagnose complex failures, evaluate libraries and platform changes, and optimize runtime, data access, scheduling, and resource use while preserving experimental conditions and reproducibility. * **Technical Leadership and Collaboration:** Lead engineering delivery, exercising independent technical judgment within agreed research requirements and priorities. Mentor research staff as needed; develop clear implementation guides; and collaborate with computing and data professionals on development standards, deployment practices, and infrastructure planning. **Preferred Education** * A Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, strongly preferred. PhD in computer science, software engineering, data science, computational methods, or a related field, would be ideal. **Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong programming skills in Python and the ability to select, adapt, and quickly learn appropriate scientific programming tools and libraries. * Demonstrated ability to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain complex software systems. * Strong understanding of modular software architecture, API integrations, data architecture, and data modeling. * Ability to rapidly configure reproducible research environments and resolve complex software dependency and installation issues. * Experience with scalable data processing, parallel or distributed execution, and performance optimization. * Working knowledge of research design, statistics, and machine learning sufficient to implement and test computational methods in collaboration with researchers. * Strong code review, debugging, quality control, and documentation skills, with attention to computational accuracy and reproducibility. * Ability to translate evolving research specifications into reusable technical capabilities and communicate feasibility constraints and design tradeoffs clearly. * Ability to plan engineering work, deliver against agreed milestones, and collaborate effectively with researchers and technical colleagues. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience designing, implementing, or evaluating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems, including tool integrations, workflow orchestration, and evaluation frameworks. * Experience building reusable infrastructure for large\-scale empirical experiments, including configurable pipelines, containerized environments, and reliable execution across computing platforms. * Experience with advanced statistical or machine learning methods, or demonstrated ability to learn and implement such methods quickly. * Experience reading research papers and associated code to support replication, computational validation, and evaluation. * Experience with R or other scientific programming languages in addition to Python. Experience mentoring developers or research staff and establishing shared practices for software quality, documentation, and reproducible research **Core Duties** : * Conceptualize design, implement, and develop solutions for complex systems/programs. * Work with a variety of users to gain information, and develop intra\-system tradeoffs between different users, as necessary; interact with a diverse client base and outside vendor contacts. * Document system builds and application configurations; maintain and update documentation as needed. * Provide technical analysis, design, development, conversion, and implementation work. * Work as a project leader, as needed, for projects of moderate complexity. * Serve as a technical resource for applications. * Compare, evaluate, and implement new features and technologies, and integrate them into the computing environment. * Follow team software development methodology. * Mentor junior software developers. **Minimum Education and Experience:** Bachelor's degree and five years of relevant experience, or a combination of education and relevant experience. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** : * Expertise in designing, developing, testing, and deploying applications. * Proficiency with application design and data modeling. * Ability to define and solve logical problems for highly technical applications. * Effective communication skills with both technical and non\-technical clients. * Ability to lead activities on structured team development projects. * Ability to select, adapt, and effectively use a variety of programming methods. * Knowledge of application domain.

jobs.title: Manager, Cloud Migrations
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data\-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms. But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020\. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin\-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward\-thinking, innovative force in the market. Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting\-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued. Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment. **Job Description** **The Role:** The Manager, Migrations will lead our regional migration function as we transition customers from on‑premise deployments to our SaaS cloud platform. This role owns the end‑to‑end migration delivery for assigned customers, ensuring timelines are met, contractual obligations are honored, and customer expectations are managed throughout the Transition Use Period (TUP). You will manage a team of migration engineers, coordinate closely with Sales, CON (Consulting/Implementation) teams, CLS (Customer Lifecycle/Success), and other cross‑functional stakeholders. Your focus is to deliver predictable, high‑quality migrations, avoid TUP extensions, and support pre‑sales POCs and infrastructure deployments that align with customer contracts. **Location Requirement:** This role requires full\-time onsite presence at our corporate headquarters in Tysons Corner, VA, five days per week (Monday–Friday). **Key Responsibilities** **Migration Delivery \& Ownership** * Own the end‑to‑end planning, execution, and completion of customer migrations in the Americas region. * Ensure migrations are completed within the agreed Transition Use Period; proactively identify and mitigate risks that could drive schedule extensions. * Establish and maintain migration plans, milestones, and success criteria for each customer. * Coordinate with internal stakeholders and customers to align migration scope, timelines, and responsibilities. **Team Leadership \& Management** * Lead and manage a team of migration engineers, providing direction, prioritization, and coaching. * Allocate resources across concurrent migration projects and POCs to ensure optimal coverage and delivery. * Build and enforce best practices, standards, and repeatable processes for migrations and POC deployments. **Customer Escalations \& Requests** * Act as primary point of escalation for migration‑related issues for the Americas region. * Ensure customer requests, concerns, and escalations are addressed promptly and effectively. * Communicate clearly and transparently with customers on status, risks, and mitigation plans. **Cross**‑**Functional Collaboration** * Partner with CON/Implementation teams to align migration activities with broader deployment and onboarding plans. * Collaborate closely with Sales and Pre‑Sales to support Proof of Concept (POC) requirements, including environment setup, data migration, and technical validation. * Work with CLS/Customer Success to ensure the deployed infrastructure, configuration, and service levels match contractual obligations and support long‑term adoption. * Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams on technical dependencies, platform capabilities, and improvement opportunities. **Governance, Compliance \& Quality** * Ensure migration and POC environments are deployed in accordance with contractual terms, SLAs, security and compliance requirements. * Track and report on key metrics (e.g., on‑time migration completion, TUP extensions, customer satisfaction, defect rates). * Drive continuous improvement across migration processes, tooling, documentation, and templates. * Contribute to playbooks and knowledge bases that improve consistency and reduce delivery risk. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in managing technical delivery teams in a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment. * Proven experience leading complex customer migrations or implementations (on‑prem to cloud strongly preferred). * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders in a fast‑paced environment. * Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (e.g., virtualization, networking, storage, security, scalability). * Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to interact confidently with customers and executives. * Experience handling escalations and driving issue resolution under time pressure. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a global SaaS company undergoing large‑scale on‑prem to cloud transitions. * Familiarity with common cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise integration patterns. * Background working closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services organizations. * Project management certifications (PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum) are a plus. * Experience defining and tracking KPIs for service delivery and customer success. **Key Competencies** * Ownership and accountability for outcomes * Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills * Structured problem‑solving and risk management * Customer‑centric mindset with a focus on quality and predictability * Ability to lead and motivate technical teams **Compensation** The base salary range for this role is $103,900 to $186,900 and represents a good faith estimate of the range at the time of posting. Strategy maintains broad salary ranges to account for differences in skills, experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, market conditions, and business needs. Candidates are typically placed within the range based on these factors, and it is not common for individuals to be hired at or near the top of the range. The posted range reflects base salary only. Eligible employees may also participate in bonus programs, sales incentives, equity awards, and comprehensive benefits, as applicable. **Additional Information** Strategy is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other legally\-protected basis. Strategy provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in the hiring process. If you have any difficulty using our online system and you need an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us about your interest in employment at application\_accommodations@strategy.com. Visit Strategy’s Careers page for additional information.

We’re open to candidates with a wide range of experience—if you bring strong troubleshooting skills, a hands\-on approach, and the ability to drive improvements, we want to hear from you. #### **Responsibilities:** * Improve reliability and availability of rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, agitators, gearboxes, motors, seals, lubrication systems). * Lead and facilitate root cause analyses (RCA) for equipment failures and recurring downtime; drive corrective actions to completion. * Identify “bad actor” equipment and build practical improvement plans with measurable results. * Optimize preventive maintenance (PM) and support predictive maintenance (PdM) efforts (vibration, oil analysis, thermography, ultrasound, motor testing—based on site needs). * Partner with Maintenance and Planning to improve job plans, work quality, and execution readiness. * Strengthen CMMS/EAM work history and failure data so we can make better decisions (failure coding, downtime tracking, equipment history). * Interface with the MI/Inspection program by connecting reliability history and risk to inspection priorities and follow\-up actions (repairs, operating changes, design improvements). * Spend time in the field validating issues, confirming equipment condition, and ensuring fixes are implemented correctly. * Support safe work practices and change control (e.g., MOC) when equipment changes are required. **Experience and Skills:** -------------------------- * Engineering degree preferred (Mechanical/Chemical/Electrical), but equivalent experience will be considered. * Experience in reliability, maintenance, operations, or engineering in an industrial environment (process manufacturing preferred). * Ability to solve problems in a structured way and drive actions to closure (RCA/troubleshooting/improvement plans). * Comfortable working in the plant and collaborating with technicians and operators. * Working knowledge of maintenance processes and CMMS/EAM work order history (SAP, Maximo, etc.). Preferred: * Chemical/process plant experience. * Strong rotating equipment background and/or condition monitoring exposure. * Familiarity with reliability tools (asset criticality, bad actor management, RCM concepts, FMEA). * Certifications such as CMRP/CRE, vibration/lubrication training, or equivalent. **What We Offer:** ------------------ * Competitive salary and benefits package * The U.S. annual base salary range reasonably expected to be paid for this new hire is: $98,720 to $123,400\. environments used by engineering or software development organizations where reliability and performance directly affect productivity * Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, Startpage
jobs.description: Startpage is a private search engine with roots going back to Ixquick in 1998, owned by System1 (NYSE: SST) and competing with DuckDuckGo, Brave and Ecosia. We are expanding from search results into a broader set of consumer products for people who want privacy without giving up a modern experience. You will be a senior full stack engineer on the Startpage Consumer team, a small North America\-based group where every engineer works with AI coding agents as a core part of the job. You know how to run agents in loops, coordinate multiple agents on one problem, and judge their output critically. The stack is mostly Python and JavaScript. You will own features from first commit to production across the web frontend, backend services and data pipeline, shape the architecture as the product grows, and pay down the tech debt that slows us. The team ships weekly, so your work reaches millions of monthly users within days. **This position is an onsite role requiring you to work in our headquarters located at 4235 Redwood Ave. Los Angeles, CA 90066\.** ### **What you'll work on:** Expect to work across the full breadth of the product rather than one slice of it. * New consumer products that extend Startpage beyond the search box, on desktop and on the web * The search results page itself: new features for subscribers and for everyone, within the constraints of our search partnerships * Real\-time decisioning that shapes what a user sees for a given query * The homepage and engagement features that bring people back * Traffic quality and abuse prevention for a product that attracts automated traffic * Data instrumentation and reporting so the team can see what is working ### **Responsibilities:** * Design, build and ship features end to end, from API and data model through to the UI * Drive your work with AI coding agents: give them the tools, context and guardrails they need, run them in loops against a spec, orchestrate several agents in parallel on one problem, and review what they produce with a critical eye * Turn interactive prototypes from product into production code, keeping the intent and cutting what does not hold up * Own services in production on Kubernetes: deploys, monitoring, the on\-call rotation, and the latency and uptime targets a search product demands * Shape architecture decisions and lead tech\-debt reduction so the codebase stays fast to change * Protect user privacy in every design decision: no tracking, minimal data retention, and no third\-party calls that leak queries * Write automated tests as a matter of course * Instrument features and read your own results in Sigma and Snowflake; propose the next iteration from the data * Work with outside partners and agencies so web and app experiences stay consistent * Write clear tickets, PRs and design notes; review teammates' work the same day ### **Requirements:** * Daily, hands\-on use of agentic coding tools: you can run agents in loops, write the evals that keep them honest, coordinate multi\-agent workflows, and know when to take the keyboard back * 5\+ years of professional web development, owning both frontend and backend in production * Strong Python, plus JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and modern CSS and HTML * Hands\-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Redis * CI/CD and monitoring tooling, and AWS or a comparable cloud platform; comfortable being paged for what you ship * Solid automated testing habits * SQL fluency and the habit of checking your own feature's numbers after launch * Care for performance: you know what a 100 ms regression costs on a search results page * Clear written communication with a distributed team and outside vendors ### **Nice to have:** * Desktop browser or mobile app experience, especially Chromium, Electron or a shipped native app * Prior search or privacy product experience * Ads or recommendations systems, especially serving ML models at low latency * Bot detection, fraud or abuse prevention * SEO\-driven site generation at scale * Familiarity with EU privacy regulation ### **How we work:** * Small North America\-based team, weekly releases * Product work starts as a clickable prototype; engineers are expected to push back on it before building * Agents do the typing; engineers own the architecture, the review and the outcome * Data over opinion: every feature ships with instrumentation and a success metric * Jira for tracking, GitHub for code, Sigma and Snowflake for analytics, Slack for the day to day ### **What we have to offer:** * Competitive salary \+ bonus \+ equity * Generous PTO \+ 11 company holidays * Open sick time * 100% covered Medical, Dental, Vision for employees * 401k with match * Health \& Dependent Care Flex Spending Account * Paid professional development * Leadership \& growth opportunities * Virtual company and team building events The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is **$133,000 \- $183,000**\+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: TE Wire \& Cable LLC As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. TE Wire \& Cable LLC Come join a team where People make a difference! We rely heavily on people with the aptitude, attitude, and entrepreneurial spirit to drive our success, and we're committed to attracting and retaining top talent. Join our dynamic team at TE Wire, a renowned industry leader at the forefront of cutting\-edge technology. With over 80 years of industry expertise and a legacy dating back to 1941, TE Wire has become synonymous with excellence and reliability in the wire and cable industry, offering industry\-leading products and exceptional customer service. Join us and contribute to our rich history while shaping the future of flight! **Position Summary** We are seeking a data\-driven, hands\-on Process Engineer to aggressively drive On\-Time Delivery (OTD) by optimizing machine utilization and reducing downtime. In this role, you will be part of team behind transforming our asset efficiency. You will identify underutilized or single\-function equipment, engineer multi\-functional tool\-up solutions so machines can handle broader wire/cable product mixes, and execute time\-studies to slash setup times. Our team is exploring new technologies (e.g., self\-centering tooling, advanced quick\-change fixtures), but we need an engineer who will dig into the shop floor, analyze our raw setup/run data, and precisely justify those investments to maximize machine runtime. **Core Responsibilities \& Focus Areas** 1\. Machine Utilization \& Multi\-Functional Tooling (Asset Efficiency) * Asset Auditing: Audit and continuously track machine utilization across the floor; proactively identify and flag equipment that sits idle or is bottlenecked by single\-function limitations. * Cross\-Functional Re\-Tooling: Design, source, and implement mechanical modifications and tooling kits to adapt single\-purpose machines into multi\-functional work centers capable of running multiple cable configurations. * Capacity Expansion: Strategically "tool up" auxiliary or under\-utilized machinery to ensure a balanced, agile production floor with maximized total running hours. 2\. Setup Time Reduction (SMED) \& Time Studies * Time Study Analysis: Conduct structured time and motion studies on the shop floor to cleanly isolate machine setup/changeover time from actual production run time. * Targeted SMED Execution: Lead Single\-Minute Exchange of Die (SMED) initiatives to re\-engineer an existing 45\-minute setup process down to a target of 25 minutes or less. * Technology Evaluation \& Justification: Evaluate make recommendations to our Director of Operation to build capital expenditure (CapEx) business cases for quick\-change innovations, such as self\-centering tooling, magnetic or pneumatic locking mechanisms, and modular guiding blocks. Standard Work Creation: Establish clear, visual standard operating procedures (SOPs) for changeovers to eliminate variance between operators and shifts. * 3\. AS9100 Compliance \& On\-Time Delivery (OTD) * Rigorous Change Control: Ensure all machine modifications, new tooling implementations, and process parameter shifts strictly adhere to AS9100 configuration controls. * Validation \& Documentation: Author and execute validation protocols for any newly introduced tooling or quick\-change equipment; support when process changes impact product geometry. * OTD Driven Engineering: Align line balancing and machine availability improvements directly with the plant’s weekly shipping schedules to eradicate production delays. Required Qualifications \& Skills * Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * Experience: 3–5\+ years of process/manufacturing engineering experience, ideally within a continuous processing environment (e.g., wire and cable extrusion, braiding, stranding, or cabling). * Lean Expertise: Proven track record of successfully executing SMED projects and time\-studies that resulted in measurable downtime reduction. * Technical Acumen: High proficiency in analyzing mechanical constraints and deploying advanced tooling solutions (e.g., self\-centering systems, modular fixturing). * Quality Systems: Solid understanding of working under AS9100 / ISO 9001 quality management systems, including formal root cause analysis (8D, RCCA) and engineering change notices (ECN). Soft Skills: A "dig\-in" personality who prefers spending time on the production floor working alongside operators over sitting exclusively at a desk * Additional Skills \& Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Manufacturing Engineering or other related Engineering discipline. * Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing * Strong interpersonal and communication skills * Team first attitude w/the ability to work \& produce results independently * Self\-starter with ability to effectively utilize resources to solve problems * Strong data analysis skills * Strong Microsoft Office skills with heavy utilization of advanced Excel tools. Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job\-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

You set your own priorities and own problems end to end. * Globally distributed, fully remote, and async\-first. **Team Operating Rhythms:** * Roughly a 6 hour overlap with 8:00am to 5:00pm PST. * Embedded side by side with the teams you serve, with a connection back to the AI Automation team and engineering. * Async\-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. **Interviewing with TRM** ------------------------- Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. * **Recruiter Intro:** Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. * **Hiring Manager:** Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. * **First Round:** 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. * **Final Round:** Hands\-on case study. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. * Impact\-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. * Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. * Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. **Join our Mission** -------------------- At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed\-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. **Privacy Policy and Additional Information** --------------------------------------------- By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Target Tech builds and operates the intelligence powered architecture that fuels these outcomes. Our teams design scalable platforms, modern data ecosystems, and resilient infrastructure that allow thousands of engineers to deliver secure, high performing systems at enterprise scale. **About the Core Platform Services Team** ========================================= Target’s Infrastructure strategy is built around one idea: make the right thing the easy thing. The Target Application Platform (TAP) is where that happens. Builders tell TAP what they need, and the platform, more and more with help from AI agents, gets it done safely. In an agentic world, many more people create software. Builders at Target include engineers, product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and analysts. Core Platform Services builds the common services that connect Target’s platforms, so builders get a delightful experience that feels like one connected platform. We work closely with our Product Manager to find where builders lose the most time and decide what to build next. Our first major capability is Action Center, along with the tools that help builders act on it: * **Action Center.** A shared service and API that platform teams use to publish the work they need from builders, such as instrumenting with OpenTelemetry or upgrading a runtime. It tracks that work across the more than 5,000 applications on TAP and gives each one a single prioritized list, in place of requests scattered across tickets, chat, and email. * **Remediation guides.** A shared framework that lets a platform team write the fix for a common problem once and make it available to every application. * **Agentic remediation.** AI agents that follow a guide, make the code change, and open a pull request for the builder to review, either in the background on TAP or inside the builder’s own coding agent. A person approves every change. Action Center is a starting point. Over time, the team will build the features and integrations that remove friction across the full builder experience, from starting a new project to running it in production. We track adoption, time to complete, and manual work removed, and use that data to decide what comes next. We serve two groups: the builders who create software on TAP, and the platform teams who support them. We earn adoption by building services people want to use, and we measure success in builder time returned. The platform has already given back more than 500,000 hours, and this team’s work is a big part of growing that number. We operate business\-critical services in 24x7 production environments. jobs.description: **About Taskrabbit:** --------------------- Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to\-do's, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more. At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast\-paced. We're looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data\-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we're creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world. Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025\) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed! **Prior to applying please note:** * **We are currently** **unable** **to provide visa sponsorship for this position (including H\-1B, OPT, F1, CPT or other employment\-based visas). Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.** * **This role is hybrid requiring 2 days in office at our San Francisco hub every Tuesday \& Wednesday (located at 130 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA).** **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** to join our Site Reliability Engineering team at Taskrabbit and help improve the reliability, scalability, and operational maturity of our engineering platform. The SRE team sits within Engineering and partners closely with Cloud Infrastructure, Developer Productivity, Security, Architecture, and application engineering teams to keep our production systems reliable, scalable, and resilient. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex production challenges, building automation, and improving how systems operate at scale. You'll work across applications and infrastructure to investigate reliability issues, strengthen observability and incident response, and build tools and practices that make our systems easier and safer to run. At the Senior level, we expect you to independently own complex technical problems, collaborate effectively across teams, and help drive lasting improvements to production reliability. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Improve production reliability.** Partner with engineering teams to define and evolve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and availability, latency, and capacity targets. Identify reliability risks and implement improvements that make our production systems more resilient. * **Strengthen observability and incident response.** Improve telemetry, alerting, dashboards, and on\-call practices. Reduce noisy or unactionable alerts and turn incident learnings into lasting improvements. * **Investigate complex production issues.** Troubleshoot problems spanning applications, infrastructure, data stores, networking, and deployment systems. jobs.title: Senior SIP Engineer
jobs.description: **About Telegent** Want to use your mobile phone to set up call routing? Transfer a call to a colleague or an AI agent? Set up call filtering or a receptionist? All without an app, directly on the mobile network. ✅ Done. Now, want to do all of that without a SIM installed on a mobile device, or without a device at all? That's headless programmability: AI\-native workflows on a real mobile number . Come help us build the mobile network for all agents, and the safe tech it can power . **Culture \& pace** We build fast, deliver fast, and ship fast, and what we ship is high\-quality code. You'll move faster than you ever imagined and feel truly accomplished doing it. This may be some of the most meaningful work of your career: building technology that doesn't exist anywhere else. Expect to contribute to patents and verifiable work, and to learn more here than anywhere you've been. **Who you are** A 200 OK is your love language, you've been ghosted by a missing ACK, and you know a 486 Busy Here isn't personal. One\-way audio gives you NAT flashbacks, and you know it's always the SBC... until it's DNS Seriously , though, you: * Have a deep understanding of SIP: registration and REGISTER/auth flows, NAT traversal, SDP/RTP , codecs, and SIP trunking. You'll get hands\-on with SIP registration and WebRT C paths for integrations with UC and video platforms like Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Webex * Know IMS core setup inside and out: P\-CSCF, I\-CSCF, S\-CSCF, HSS, and how VoLTE and VoWiFi calls actually flow * Have set up and configured SBCs: topology hiding, transcoding, security, and interop * Know routing: call routing, number and L CR routing, failover and STIR/SHAKEN * Have put AI voice agents on real calls: media streaming to AI, with latency kept lowenough that conversations feel natural * Have mastery over agentic coding, including: * + Worktree management vs. multi\-agent workflows, plus skills, hooks, and routines + Flexibility across clients: Claude Code, Cursor , Codex, even custom harnesses like OpenClaw and Hermes + Token optimization, plan mode, and structured approaches like SDD , TDD , SpecKit, and role\-based development + Knowing the difference between vibe coding and enterprise\-grade agentic coding * Geek out over paradigm\-shifting approaches, like TypeSafe's Jev decision model routing an agent's steps, but don't let shiny object syndrome get in the way of shipping * Know the end\-to\-end systems lifecycle and full\-stack development, own your work end to end, and have deployed systems at scale with solid observability (when a call drops, you know exactly where and why) You can't imagine coding by hand anymore. Your best friend might be an agent, and it probably speaks SIP . We don't judge. You can't imagine a world without Wispr Flow , and you can't believe humans used to spend their time typing. **Level**: Senior **What you'll do** * Own call routing. Design and run how every call moves through our network, across our SBCs, media servers and carrier trunks, including keeping calls between our own numbers on our own network. * Connect carriers and customers. Bring new SIP trunks and interconnects live in days, not weeks, and be the expert partners turn to when calls fail. * Build programmable voice. Ship the features developers build on: call control APIs, webhooks, recording, IVR and real\-time audio streaming to AI. * Power our AI voice products. W ork with product on call screening, scam detection and voice agents that run on live calls. * Retire legacy voice. Move traffic off older third\-party voice platforms onto direct SIP trunks, with no downtime. * Lead caller trust. Own STIR/SHAKEN, caller ID (CNAM) and recording consent, so our calls are signed, trusted and compliant. * Make it reliable at scale. Redundant SBCs, routing by geography, capacity planning, monitoring and disaster recovery, as traffic grows many times over. * Debug fast, then automate. Trace failed calls through SIP logs and packet captures, fix the cause, and turn every fix into a test or a runbook. * Share what you know. Record decisions as ADRs, review code and make voice approachable for every engineer on the team. The voice stack you will own: **Component \& What it does** * SIP proxy / SBC \- Call routing and SBCs at the edge, facing carriers and customers * Media proxy \- Media proxy that anchors call audio * In\-memory data store \- Routing data looked up on every call * Application server \- Media and application server for call features: IVR, recording, bridging * Programmable voice platform \- Programmable voice layer behind our APIs and AI Voice apps * Carrier SIP trucks \- Direct links to our Tier\-1 mobile partner and other carriers * Speech and AI services \- Speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech and AI agents on live calls * Call monitoring and observability \- Call tracing, call quality and alerting * Cloud hosting and infrastructure as code \- Multi\-region hosting, defined as code **What we're looking for** * Deep SIP and RTP. You read SIP traces fluently and know SDP , codecs (G.711, G.729, AMR\-WB, EVS), NAT traversal and media handling inside out. * SIP servers and SBCs. Production experience with OpenSIPS or Kamailio, and FreeSWIT CH or Asterisk, at carrier scale. * Carrier interconnects. SIP trunking with carriers, number routing and IP\-based peering, plus the US rules that come with it: STIR/SHAKEN, CNAM and E911\. * IMS core. Hands\-on P\-CSCF, I\-CSCF, S\-CSCF and HSS setup, and how VoLTE andVoWiFi calls flow end to end. * Troubleshooting. Wireshark, sngrep, SIPp, Homer or V oIPmonitor . You find the cause of a failed call, not just the symptom. * Code and infrastructure. You write services and tooling in Python, Go or TypeScript, work with Redis and REST APIs, and run Linux, Terraform and cloud networking (Azure first). * AI\-native. You practice enterprise\-grade agentic coding, not vibe coding, and you move easily across coding clients and harnesses. You arrive with your own setup of agents, skills and automations, and ideas on how to make ours better. * Ownership and judgment. You take work from idea to production without hand\-offs, raise problems early, and help keep the team pointed in the right direction. **Nice to have** * jambonz, or building CP aaS voice APIs (call control, webhooks, media streams) * Running voice across several clouds and colocation sites * Building to SOC 2 controls from the first line of code **How we work** * Learn, assess, benchmark, prepare solutions. Every responsibility runs this arc, done fast. Your first deliverable is your own assessment and 100\-day plan. * AI\-first. Design and implementation are agent\-driven across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and multi\-agent workflows, so one engineer moves at the pace of a team. * You build it, you run it. No hand\-offs to a separate operations team. You see the whole product end to end and ship it yourself . * Small, reversible changes. Versioned, behind PRs with CI, with release tags and documentation that updates as the code does. * Security from the start. New systems are built to SOC 2 controls, with architecture decisions recorded as ADRs.

jobs.description: ##### **Persons in these roles are expected to work from our offices in Seattle. On\-site requirements vary based on position and team. This is first and foremost a controls role: you will bring up and tune real\-time, torque\-level control on arms, multi\-fingered hands, bimanual systems and humanoids, make it stable and safe enough that researchers run experiments on hardware every day, and build the interfaces that learned policies plug into. Experience with humanoid whole\-body control and with Unitree platforms (G1, H1 and similar) is a strong plus, as humanoid and whole\-body work is a growing share of the lab. You will also design and build the hardware the research needs, from end\-effectors to test rigs. You will work closely with research scientists and the simulation team so that what is learned in simulation shows up as reliable behaviour on hardware. **Who We Are:** The Robotics team at Ai2, led by Dieter Fox, uses scalable simulation to study how foundation models scale and generalize for robotics. We focus on manipulation, humanoid and whole\-body control, large\-scale simulated training, sim\-to\-real transfer, robot foundation models and skill learning. We publish at CoRL, ICRA, RSS, CVPR, NeurIPS, ICLR and ICML, and everything we build is open source. **Your Next Challenge:** * Build and own the real\-time control stack: joint, impedance, operational\-space and torque control on torque\-controlled arms, hands and humanoids, with motion planning, safety layers and the interfaces that learned policies plug into, across embodiments. * Bring up, tune and stabilize whole\-body controllers for humanoids and bimanual systems: QP\-based or MPC\-based whole\-body control, state estimation (IMU, encoders, force/torque), contact handling and fall or fault recovery, and the sim\-to\-real transfer of learned locomotion and loco\-manipulation policies. * Lead the setup, calibration, maintenance and tuning of our robots: arms, grippers, multi\-fingered hands, humanoids, cameras and tactile sensors, across single\-arm, bimanual, mobile and legged platforms. * Diagnose stability, latency and contact problems across hardware, firmware, control and learned policy, using system identification and dynamics models to turn algorithms into reliable real\-world behaviour. * Design and build the hardware the lab needs: end\-effectors, fingertips, sensor mounts, fixtures and test rigs, from CAD through 3D printing or machining, including integrating cameras, tactile sensors and hands. * Build the runtime and tooling around the robots: teleoperation and data collection, logging, monitoring, deployment and operator\-facing tools, so the platform scales across robots, tasks and people. * Contribute to open\-source releases and publications. **What You'll Need:** Minimum Qualifications: * Master's with 3\+ years of experience, or PhD, in robotics, control or a related field. Strong candidates with a bachelor's and 3\+ years of industry experience are also considered. * Controls: you have implemented and tuned real\-time controllers (joint, impedance, operational\-space or torque control) on physical robots, with a solid grounding in rigid\-body dynamics, control theory, stability analysis and system identification. You can explain why a controller went unstable and fix it. * Whole\-body and floating\-base control: you understand floating\-base dynamics, contact constraints and inverse dynamics, and have worked with at least one of QP\-based whole\-body control, operational\-space control or MPC, on hardware or in a high\-fidelity simulator. * Manipulation: substantial hands\-on experience with real\-robot manipulation, including bring\-up, calibration and control of arms with grippers or hands. * System design: you have designed robot software systems end to end (control loops at 500 Hz to 1 kHz, state estimation, data flow, and the interfaces between planning, perception and learning) and can reason about latency, reliability and failure modes. Strong Python; solid real\-time C\+\+. * Mechanical design: you have designed and built hardware that was used on a real robot, such as end\-effectors, mounts, fixtures or rigs. CAD required (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape or similar), with design\-for\-manufacturing experience for 3D printing or machining. * Robot learning: you have trained or deployed learned policies (imitation learning, RL or VLA) on real robots, and are comfortable with PyTorch and at least one simulation ecosystem (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo or similar). * Debugging across the full stack, from perception through control to hardware, and clear communication nd even quicker to share and jointly problem solve our failures. * **We are in Seattle** – and our office is on the water! jobs.title: Data and AI Engineer - July 2027
jobs.description: The Brattle Group, a privately held, global economics consulting firm, is looking for a **Data and AI Engineer** to join our **San Francisco, CA** office to start in **July 2027**. The Data \& AI Engineer is an early\-career role within Brattle’s Data \& AI Engineering team, focused on hands\-on technical work across client delivery, applied R\&D, and internal capability\-building. This role is designed for candidates who are strong builders, fast learners, and clear communicators, and who want to develop technical judgment in a setting where problems are varied, ambiguous, and often time\-sensitive. This is not a narrowly defined pipeline role or a heads\-down engineering track. Data \& AI Engineers work across data engineering, applied analytics, machine learning, and AI\-enabled workflows, staying close to implementation while learning how technical choices affect real client work. Candidates are not expected to arrive as experts across data engineering, solution architecture, and applied AI research. They are expected to be hands\-on, curious, coachable, and comfortable learning quickly. **Where This Role Sits at Brattle:** The Data \& AI Engineering team is a specialized technical group embedded within Brattle’s consulting staff. The team supports client work while also serving as an applied R\&D function for the firm: researching emerging technologies, prototyping new analytical and AI\-enabled workflows, and translating useful methods into reusable capabilities. The team partners with economists, consultants, industry experts, and internal stakeholders to improve how the firm works with data, analytics, machine learning, and AI through project delivery, reusable tools, documentation, training, and knowledge\-sharing. Data \& AI Engineers work under the guidance of more experienced technical leads, including Senior Data \& AI Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Research Engineers. As experience grows, the role can develop toward deeper execution ownership, increased responsibility for solution design, more advanced AI and research work, or some combination of those paths. **Nature of the Work:** Data \& AI Engineers work on problems where the technical path is often unclear, the data is imperfect, and the constraints are real. Source materials may be incomplete, inconsistent, degraded through prior systems, or difficult to interpret. Some matters also involve restricted or confidential workflows that shape how data can be accessed, handled, or shared. The role requires practical judgment. There may be multiple valid approaches, each with trade\-offs, and limited ability to go back to the source for clarification. Data \& AI Engineers are expected to reason carefully from imperfect inputs, document assumptions, surface limitations, and help build solutions that are defensible, reproducible, timely, and fit for purpose. Project timelines may shift quickly based on external events, negotiations, litigation deadlines, or client needs. Some work is recurring and operational; some is one\-off or exploratory. The right candidate is a resourceful, practical builder: someone who can stay organized, adapt to changing constraints, and make progress without losing rigor or composure. The team environment is academic, collegial, grounded, and highly collaborative. We value curiosity, humility, initiative, clear communication, and practical intelligence. The work can be technically advanced, but the culture is not ego\-driven. We are looking for people who are resourceful, friendly, proactive, flexible, and able to work well with others in a global, connected consulting environment. **Some of the day\-to\-day responsibilities of this role include:** * Prepare, inspect, clean, reconstruct, and validate data from a wide range of sources, including structured datasets, documents, reports, exports, PDFs, scans, and other formats that may not have been created for analysis * Use Python, SQL, notebooks, version control, and related tools to build reproducible workflows, test assumptions, troubleshoot issues, and document how work was performed * Identify data limitations, quality issues, assumptions, blockers, and open questions early * Support applied analytics, machine learning, and AI\-enabled workflows where they are useful to the problem * Contribute to workflows involving text extraction, classification, summarization, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation, automation, visualization, or rapid prototyping * Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate learning and execution while maintaining responsibility for accuracy, confidentiality, defensibility, and quality * Support applied R\&D by helping prototype, test, and evaluate new tools, methods, and workflows before they are adopted more broadly * Communicate progress, technical findings, assumptions, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly to consultants, economists, technical peers, and other stakeholders * Participate in code review, collaborativ r a related field * Equivalent hands\-on technical experience, internships, research work, or project\-based experience may also be considered * 0\-3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics, applied AI, machine learning, software development, research, or related technical work * Must be available to begin full\-time employment in July 2027 * Hands\-on experience building at least one working AI\-enabled application, tool, or automated workflow through coursework, research, an internship, a capstone, or an independent project. * Ability to explain the problem addressed, your individual contribution, the technologies used, and how you evaluated the solution’s performance and limitations. * Comfort working in ambiguous problem spaces where the task may need to be clarified, decomposed, and revised as new information emerges * Strong foundation in Python for data analysis, scripting, automation, or prototyping, with exposure to libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, or comparable tools * Working knowledge of SQL and relational data concepts, including joins, aggregation, filtering, and practical data exploration * Foundational understanding of statistics, data analysis, machine learning, or experimental evaluation, with interest in strengthening applied judgment over time * Exposure to generative AI workflows, such as prompt design, embeddings, vector search, retrieval\-augmented generation, summarization, classification, or model evaluation * Ability to work with structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, including text\-heavy documents or heterogeneous data sources * Familiarity with software development practices such as Git, notebooks, code review, documentation, testing, and reproducible workflows * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure or comparable environments is helpful but not required * Ability to learn new tools quickly and use AI\-assisted development responsibly without treating generated output as automatically correct * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical work, assumptions, limitations, and next steps clearly * Ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams in a fast\-paced environment * Flexible mindset to adapt to changing project priorities and client needs *Brattle offers a competitive benefits package, base salary, and bonus program for eligible roles based on individual and firm performance. The anticipated base gross salary range for this position in San Francisco, CA is $100,000 \- $126,000 annually. Actual salary will depend on a variety of factors, including experience and training.* *This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.* **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** The Brattle Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, height, weight, domestic partner status, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome or HIV status (AIDS/HIV status), genetic information, sexual orientation, disability (where the applicant or employee is qualified to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation), marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, drug or alcohol abuse or alcoholism, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We encourage all applicants to click here to review our full Equal Employer Opportunity Statement. **THE EMPLOYER** The Brattle Group answers complex economic, finance, and regulatory questions for corporations, law firms, and governments around the world. We are distinguished by the clarity of our insights and the credibility of our experts, which include leading international academics and industry specialists. Brattle has 500 talented professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific. For more information, please visit brattle.com.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: ### **Our Mission** As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2\+ billion swipes per day, 20\+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190\+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real\-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. ### **Our Values** * **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down. * **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today. * **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate. * **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same. * **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us. * **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters. **The Team or Role** -------------------- Agents now do real work at Tinder. They review code, security risks, accessibility, make UI improvements, help marketing teams with their workflows, and run inside engineers' coding tools and in Slack. Every one of them reaches our internal systems through our agent platform: a gateway, a growing set of MCP connectors, and the identity, policy and observability layers around them. We're hiring the engineer who owns that platform's design and functions by closely collaborating with internal teams on real use cases. You'll make it safe by default for agents that can read sensitive data and take consequential actions, fast and reliable enough that teams want to build on it, and simple enough that the next connector or agent takes days, not weeks. **Where you’ll work:** ---------------------- This is a hybrid role and requires in\-office collaboration three times per week in our Palo Alto, California office. ### **In this role, you will:** * Work closely with internal teams to build real solutions for challenges they are facing day to day. * Own the design of the agent platform across gateway, connectors, identity, policy, guardrails, observability and cost, and write the roadmap for how it evolves. * Design identity and delegation for agents: acting on behalf of a user, agent\-owned identities for unattended jobs, short\-lived scoped credentials, and every action traceable to a responsible human. * Build access control beyond tool allowlists: per\-action, per\-argument and per\-data\-class policy, human approval for irreversible actions, and policy that's reviewable and tested. * Build guardrails enforced at the tool boundary, not in prompts, against prompt injection through tool output, confused\-deputy access, data exfiltration and over\-broad scopes. * Make agent behavior observable: traces of tool calls and decisions, audit trails investigators can use, evals that catch regressions when models or prompts change, and per\-team cost attribution. * Set the bar for connectors and third\-party MCP servers: onboarding, review, versioning, sandboxing and safe defaults. * Run the platform as production and own its on\-call: latency budgets, failure modes, rate limits and quotas, kill switches and incident response. * Partner with Security, our forward deployed engineers and platform teams, and mentor the engineers who build on and contribute to the platform. ### **You'll need:** * Great communication and collaboration skills, experience working with real challenges of customer * 8\+ years building backend, infrastructure or platform systems that other teams depend on, with recent hands\-on work on LLM agents, tool use or MCP. * Experience shipping identity or authorization systems: OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC, token exchange or delegation, service identity, and policy models (RBAC, ABAC or relationship\-based). * An attacker's mindset about agent systems, and the ability to explain why prompt\-level defenses aren't enough. * Experience operating gateways, proxies or other services in the critical request path, including on\-call, observability and incident response. * Strong skills in Python or TypeScript, and daily use of AI coding tools with a clear sense of where they fail. * A track record of working well with security teams and impatient internal customers, turning "no" into a safe "yes, like this." ### **Nice to have:** * Experience with policy engines or workload identity. * Built or operated an LLM gateway, model router or MCP server in production. * Familiarity with OpenTelemetry and tracing for non\-deterministic systems. * Contributions to agent identity or MCP authorization standards. * Engineering background in application protection, identity and access management, or threat detection and incident response. $225,000 \- $265,000 a year The salary range for this position is $225,000 \- $265,000\. Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job\-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Palo Alto. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting. ### **As a full\-time employee, you’ll enjoy:** * Flexible Vacation, 10 Sick Days * Time off to volunteer and charitable donations matched up to $15,000 annually * Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage * 100% 401(k) employer match up to 10%, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * 100% paid parental leave (including for non\-birthing parents) and family forming benefits * Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000\+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual $3,000 stipend for your professional development * Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, paid concierge medical membership, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy * Free subscription to Tinder Gold **Commitment to Inclusion** At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Developer
jobs.description: Truliant’s mission is to improve lives by putting our members first, providing great service and straightforward financial solutions. Our core values of Member Focus, Service, Guidance, Relationships, and Community define how we interact with members to fulfill our mission of improving lives and providing a foundation on which we conduct ourselves. Our Promise to Our Teammates: Truliant strives to provide all teammates with an enjoyable place to work where they feel valued, empowered and rewarded for all that they do. * **This position is remote within our NC, SC, VA footprint. Although this position is primarily remote, there are occasional events and meetings that may require you to work on\-site at one of our Truliant locations.** **Why this role matters** ========================= At Truliant Federal Credit Union, better technology helps our teams work more efficiently and creates a smoother experience for our members. As an AI \& Process Automation Developer, you’ll help turn business needs into secure, reliable automation and AI solutions that reduce manual effort and improve how work gets done. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, building practical technology, and learning alongside experienced developers, architects, and business partners. **What you’ll do** ================== In this role, you’ll help design, build, test, deploy, and support enterprise automation and AI solutions. jobs.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. **How we LEAD:** Universal Music Group is building an Applied AI and Machine Learning function to help our teams discover and develop artists, connect with fans, make stronger commercial decisions, and protect the integrity of the music ecosystem. We are looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer to build, ship, and operate reliable machine learning and AI systems that create durable value across UMG. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software and systems expertise with practical knowledge of the AI and ML lifecycle. You will turn models, data products, and AI workflows into maintainable production capabilities across revenue forecasting, artist, catalog intelligence and talent scouting, release marketing, and rights and ecosystem integrity. The role focuses on reproducible development, rigorous evaluation, safe deployment, observability, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement. **How you’ll CREATE:** ### **Core MLOps \& Production Infrastructure** * Lead initiatives from problem framing and data assessment through deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and sustained adoption (versus reach a well\-evidenced decision not to build). * Build and operate reliable ML and LLM\-powered workflows, including retrieval and grounding, structured outputs, tool and API integrations, orchestration, batch or real\-time inference, CI/CD, and safe rollback. * Establish AI evaluation and observability using representative and adversarial test sets, regression tests, human review where appropriate, traces, drift detection, latency, quality, safety, usage, and cost metrics. ### **Data \& Feature Engineering** * Build reliable data and feature pipelines from streaming consumption data, release metadata, social campaign data, catalog information, and commercial finance systems; monitor completeness, freshness, anomalies, and data lineage. * Develop and operate models across personalization, recommender systems, search and ranking, time\-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and decision support—choosing a simpler reliable approach whenever is appropriate. ### **Business Stakeholders** * Move generative and multimodal AI capabilities from prototypes into dependable, cost\-effective workflows that help people make decisions and take action. * Partner with ML scientists, data engineers, product managers, designers, domain experts, A\&R, Marketing, Finance, and labels; contribute to architecture, code reviews, mentoring, and pragmatic build\-versus\-buy decisions. **What success looks like in your first 12 months** --------------------------------------------------- * Ship production ML or AI capabilities that improve a meaningful UMG decision or workflow. * Establish automated evaluation and regression coverage for AI workflows, with trusted measures for quality, safety, latency, cost, and business usefulness. * Improve the reliability, observability, performance, scalability, or cost\-efficiency of existing workflows. * Move a prototype or manual process into a dependable workflow used for a real decision, such as allocating marketing spend, prioritizing an A\&R opportunity, reviewing a forecast, or investigating an integrity alert. * Raise the technical bar through documentation, reviews, and mentorship. * Effective collaboration and communication with business stakeholders, labels, central teams, and other non\-technical partners. **Bring your VIBE:** * A bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 5\+ years of experience in software, machine learning, data, or platform engineering with ownership of production systems and ambiguous, high\-impact problems. * Experience engineering modern AI systems, including LLM\-based workflows, retrieval, grounding, structured generation, tool use, safety controls, and human review, with clear evaluation and monitoring practices. * Strong Python and software engineering skills, including testing, code review, version control, debugging, maintainable design, and experience with a second production language or equivalent systems experience. * Experience with cloud\-based data and ML platforms. UMG workloads use GCP and BigQuery; experience with services such as Vertex AI, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer is valuable, while equivalent AWS or cloud\-agnostic experience is also relevant. * Experience building and operating data pipelines, distributed systems, APIs, services, workflow orchestration, model serving, batch or online inference, and refresh or retraining processes. * Ability to collaborate across technical and business disciplines, communicate tradeoffs clearly, take ownership without formal authority, and choose a simpler reliable solution when it is better than a more complex model. **Especially valuable** ----------------------- * Experience in music, media, entertainment, streaming marketplaces, advertising, or another industry where culture, consumer behavior, and business conditions change rapidly. * Experience working with complex non\-tabular data, such as audio, text, images, or video. * Experience building decision\-support products and automated workflows rather than standalone models or static dashboards. * Experience establishing model governance, data provenance, copyright safety protocols, or human\-in\-the\-loop review systems. * Experience building systems for artist discovery, catalog understanding, fan marketing, rights management, fraud detection, or trust and safety. **Perks Playlist:** Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer): * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Including 100% coverage for out\-patient in\-network mental health services * Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants * Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year) * Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement * **401(k) with 100% immediate vesting** on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution A variety of ways to prioritize much\-needed time away from work including: * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees * 3\-weeks PTO for non\-exempt employees * 2\-weeks paid Winter Break * 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day) * Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day) * Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site. **Disclaimer: This job description only provides an overview of job responsibilities that are subject to change.** **Universal Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We are an E\-Verify employer in Alabama, Arizona, Georgia, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Utah. jobs.description: **Posting Number** req27567 **Department** Steward Observatory **Department Website Link** https://astro.arizona.edu/ **Location** Tucson Campus **Address** Tucson, AZ USA **Position Highlights** The University of Arizona's Steward Observatory invites you to apply to the role of Software Engineer, Adaptive Optics Instrument. The Center for Astronomical Adaptive Optics (CAAO) at Steward Observatory is developing and operating world\-class adaptive optics (AO) systems at large ground and space telescopes. A growing team of software engineers will work together to develop production software to support the scientific operations of these systems. The team is looking for candidates with expertise in remote computer systems management, communications protocols, and hardware controls to support our on\-going efforts. Candidates with experience in any subset of these responsibilities are encouraged to apply. Steward Observatory is both a century\-old observatory on the University of Arizona campus and one of the University’s oldest research units. The Observatory brings together students, staff, faculty, engineers, and technicians to explore the universe and share discoveries through world\-class research, education, and outreach. This position is responsible for all aspects of IT system administration, enabling the University's research, teaching, and academic units to excel in their work.
