jobs.title: Cloud Engineer I
jobs.description: Job Summary * The Enterprise Cloud \& Infrastructure Services team is seeking a motivated Cloud Engineer I to help deploy, secure, and operate production workloads across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, using automation and best practices wherever possible. * This is a hands\-on role in the University’s Infrastructure Services. The cloud engineer will assist in the development and deployment of cloud solutions and environments, gain exposure to projects from governance through operations, and build a strong foundation in cloud architecture, security, data protection, and identity management. The cloud engineer will be expected to work independently as skills grow. Minimum Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered. Preferred Education and Experience **Education and Certifications** * BS degree with a minimum of four (4\) years of experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field. * Entry\-level cloud certification, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Fundamentals or Administrator Associate, or Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer. * AWS Platform experience, understand some of the following AWS service provisioning including EC2, ECS, VPC, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, Redshift, SWF, SQS, etc. * Understanding of Cloud Computing: virtualization technologies, Infrastructure as a Service, Platform as a Service, and Software as a Service Cloud delivery models and the current competitive landscape. * Understanding of DevOps methodology, including CI/CD tooling, monitoring, and alerting. * Experience in AWS costs optimization. * Experience migrating workloads between local environments and the public cloud. Understanding of highly available systems and disaster recovery methods. * **Cloud Platforms and Services** * Hands\-on exposure with AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud deployment, technical and security architecture, database architecture, and virtualization architecture. * Familiarity with native cloud services (compute, storage, networking, databases, containers) and how they differ from traditional on\-premises services. * Exposure to deployment and functionality of container services (e.g.: Docker, Kubernetes, Container Service) desired but not required. * Understanding of Infrastructure as Code, Platform as a Service (PaaS), and other “as a Service” models (IaaS, SaaS). **Automation and Coding** * Scripting or programming experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use of Git. * Exposure to automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible. **Infrastructure and Architecture** * Understanding of virtualization (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Hyper\-V, KVM) and its role on premises and in the cloud. * Understanding of enterprise architecture dependencies, including resource, network, and protocol integrations (e.g., DNS, TCP/IP, VPN, SMB/NFS, HTTPS). * Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems. * Ability to assess efficiencies and make adjustments/recommendations for improvement. * Good understanding of various operating systems, OS vulnerabilities and patching, third\-party application vulnerabilities, and patching. **Security and Identity** * Understanding of the importance of security, data protection, and identity and access management (e.g., Entra ID, AWS IAM, Google Cloud IAM, SSO/MFA). **Additional** * Understanding of AI technology models and how access to them is provided and governed in the cloud (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI). * Experience in an educational or research environment. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Strong analytical skills to review and troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and fix code, scripts, and templates leveraging methodology and awareness of industry standards. * Excellent written and oral communication skills; Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical staff, can clearly articulate architecture to peers. Solution design and implementation experience. * Ability to work independently with limited supervision, manage priorities, and seek guidance when appropriate. * Ability to produce clear technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles. * Willingness to learn emerging technologies and collaborate with team members, customers, and vendors. Other Qualifications To the extent this position requires the holder to research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure as defined in Section 117\.001(2\) of the Texas Business and Commerce Code, the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the critical infrastructure is a minimum qualification to be hired and to continue to be employed in the position. Essential Duties and Responsibilities * Assist in developing, implementing, and documenting standards and best practices for cloud computing. * Engineer, deploy and configure cloud resources i dure, and knowledge base articles. * Participate in collaborative sessions to evaluate the architecture of services and systems. * Perform other duties as assigned. Physical Demands and Working Conditions * Sitting for extended periods of time. * Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and other computer components. * Lifting and transporting moderately heavy objects, such as servers, storage devices, network switches, computers, and peripherals. Physical Activities Working Conditions Additional Information * Hybrid remote work available for Texas residents subject to business need and manager approval with availability to travel to local data centers for service or support. A UT Dallas Remote Work Agreement will be required within 14 days after approval. * Occasional after\-hours support and on\-call availability may be required for planned maintenance and service emergencies. * Visa sponsorship is not available. **What We Can Offer** UT Dallas is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer an employee\-friendly work environment with a comprehensive benefits package including: * Competitive Salary * Tuition Benefits * BCBS PPO Medical Insurance Options – including 100% paid employee medical coverage for full\-time employees * AD\&D Insurance * Dental \& Vision Plan Options * Optional Long and Short\-term Disability * TRS Retirement Plan * Fertility Benefits * Paid time off All UT Dallas employees have access to various professional development opportunities, including a membership to Academic Impressions, LinkedIn Learning, and UT Dallas Bright Leaders Program. Visit https: **https://hr.utdallas.edu/employees/benefits/** for more information. **About Us** UT Dallas is a top public research university located in one of the nation’s fastest\-growing metropolitan regions. Our seven schools offer more than 140 undergraduate and graduate programs, plus professional certificates and fast\-track programs. Our student body is 31,000 strong, reflecting students from over 100 countries and a multiplicity of identities and experiences. UT Dallas is committed to graduating well\-rounded members of the global community whose education has prepared them for rewarding lives and productive careers in a constantly changing world. jobs.title: Applied Data Scientist
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** **A Specialty Path to Good Health** Upperline Health is the nation's largest provider group dedicated to lower extremity, wound and vascular care. Founded in 2017 with the ambitious goal of transforming specialty care, Upperline Health is a pioneer in bringing value\-based care models into specialty care. Upperline delivers a more efficient path for patients to receive consistent and effective treatment for chronic illnesses. **Triage is temporary.** **Treatment is transformative.** Upperline Health providers coordinate patients' care among a team of specialists \- physicians, advanced practice providers, care navigators, pharmacists, dieticians, and social workers for integrated treatment that addresses patients' immediate and long\-term health needs. **We put patients at the center of value\-based care.** **About the Applied Data Scientist, Model Pipelines** We are looking for a talented Applied Data Scientist to build, validate, deploy, and maintain predictive healthcare models. You will build the feature and model pipelines that turn claims and EHR data into predictions people use (risk stratification, utilization, expense/revenue projection, outreach prioritization) and own them from framing through monitoring. This role is ideal for someone with strong data engineering skills and the modeling depth to build, validate, and defend a model, including looking back at how past predictions performed. **What You'll Do** * Design and implement data pipelines using SQL and Python (Databricks) to synthesize large medical claims and EHR records into usable data features on governed data * Build, refine, and validate machine learning models in Python, with attention to performance, calibration, bias, and drift, in collaboration with analysts and engineers * Conduct lookback analyses: backtest model predictions against historical claims and outcomes, and measure whether outreach or interventions changed results * Deploy models through shared engineering tooling, manage model artifacts, then monitor and retrain * Ensure data quality, reproducibility, and performance in the pipelines * Contribute to best practices for data governance and model deployment * Explain results to non\-technical leaders and tie each to an action **Qualifications of the Applied Data Scientist, Model Pipelines** * Degree in Data Science or a related quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Biostatistics); Master's in Data Science preferred * 2\-5\+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer, or related role, with at least one model in production and a focus on building and maintaining production\-quality data pipelines and machine learning infrastructure * Proficiency in SQL/Databricks and Python; willingness to learn SAS as needed for dataset generation (prior experience in SAS is not required) * Experience with lookback (retrospective) analysis and backtesting, and evaluating model performance, calibration, bias, and drift * Experience building scalable data pipelines, working with large datasets, and transforming raw data into reliable features for machine learning workflows * Strong working knowledge of machine learning workflows (e.g., scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy) and Git, with judgment on when a simpler model is better * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, sharp critical thinking skills, and a keen eye for details * Comfortable with a fast\-paced workstream that requires flexibility to work on multiple projects or analyses at the same time **Nice to Have** * Background in Healthcare Analytics, experience with Healthcare Claims Data (e.g., Medicare Claims), ACO REACH, or risk adjustment * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), databricks orchestration, and EMRs (e.g., athenahealth) * Projects (personal or work) related to building \+ deploying machine learning models to answer specific business\-related questions **Benefits** Comprehensive benefit options include medical, dental and vision, 401K and PTO. **Compensation** Compensation is commensurate to compensation for similar positions in the region and based on prior training and experience Job Type: Full\-time Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Products - MCP Manager
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hybrid: New York, NY (2\-3 days per week in office). The office is located in Midtown West, less than a 10\-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square. **SHAPE THE FUTURE OF AI GOVERNANCE WITH USERCENTRICS** ------------------------------------------------------- Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub. As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections. This is a category\-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Software Engineer who wants to be on the ground floor of defining that category and to build the product enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents. **THE ROLE** ------------ As a Software Engineer on the MCP Manager team, you will build the features customers use to govern their AI agents, such as gateway configuration, identity and access policies, and audit logging. You will split your time evenly between our Vue.js front end and our Python/Django and TypeScript back end, all running on Google Cloud Platform. You will work closely with our Product Manager, our designer, and your fellow engineers to take features from spec to production, and you will own the quality of what you ship. You will join a small, high\-ownership engineering team that operates like a startup inside a larger company, with a short path from customer feedback to shipped code. The role exists now because buyers are moving from AI experiments to production agent rollouts, and they need the governance layer beneath those agents to keep pace with new MCP servers, clients, and security requirements. **YOUR TASKS** -------------- ### **Feature Development** * Design, build, and ship features across the full stack, from Vue.js interfaces to Python/Django and TypeScript services. * Turn product specs and designs into working software, raising questions and tradeoffs early with product and design. * Design clear APIs and data models that other engineers can understand and extend. ### **Quality \& Reliability** * Write automated tests alongside your code and help keep the test suite fast and reliable. * Review teammates' pull requests thoughtfully and respond constructively to feedback on your own. * Investigate and fix bugs, including issues escalated from customers, by tracing problems across the front end, back end, and infrastructure. ### **AI\-Assisted Development** * Use Claude Code and other AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code, while taking full ownership of everything you ship. * Share techniques that make the team faster and help refine how we use AI tooling in our engineering practices. ### **Collaboration \& Growth** * Contribute to planning and technical discussions with honest estimates and early warnings about risk. * Build a working understanding of MCP and of how enterprises connect AI agents to their business systems. * Document what you build so that teammates and future engineers can pick it up quickly. **Requirements** * 3 or more years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production web applications. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript and experience with a modern front\-end framework, ideally Vue.js. * Experience building back\-end services and APIs in Python, ideally with Django. * A solid understanding of relational databases, schema design, and query performance. * Experience deploying and operating software in a cloud environment, ideally Google Cloud Platform. * Daily, hands\-on use of Claude Code and other AI coding assistants, with the judgment to review, test, and stand behind AI\-generated code. * Ideally, experience with the Model Context Protocol, AI agent tooling, or AI gateways, or a background in developer tools, security, or governance software. * Comfort operating in an early\-stage, category\-creation environment where the playbook is still being written. * Clear written and spoken communication in English, and a habit of giving and asking for feedback directly. **Benefits** * 401(k) plan contribution with employer match * Commuter allowance (transit stipend) * 18 paid vacation days (PTO) * Health insurance * Personal development budget for every employee * Hybrid workplace * Online wellness sessions * Team events including team buildings, happy hours, company breakfasts/lunches, in\-person and virtual * Refreshments: snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office Salary Range: $170,000 \- $185,000 The annual base salary range is determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, role\-specific skills, relevant experience, and internal equity. Usercentrics is committed to transparent and equitable compensation practices. Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **WHY JOIN USERCENTRICS?** -------------------------- * Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast\-growing, diverse, and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially\-minded people who build our success story together. * Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant, and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally. * Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love seeing people from all departments enthusiastically participating in cross\-department projects and shaping our future. * Your work\-life balance matters. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy). * We always remember to have fun, both in our day\-to\-day work and at our regular team events in our offices across Munich, Prague, Lisbon, Copenhagen, Odense, Buenos Aires, and New York, or online. * You are our most valuable asset. We offer a personal development budget, job\-related language courses, and much more to support your wellbeing and growth.

jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Engineer, NA
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **Position Overview** **This position can be based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Santa Clara, TX; Ashburn, VA; New Albany, OH, Shackelford County, TX; Atlanta, GA; Quincy, WA in accordance with our flexible work policy (3 days onsite required, 2 days remote).** Vantage is seeking a **Principal Engineer, Mechanical Engineering** to serve as a senior technical leader within the Design Engineering Department, driving innovation, quality, and performance across hyperscale data center projects. This individual contributor role is responsible for setting engineering direction, solving complex technical challenges, and influencing cross\-functional initiatives. The Principal Engineer will act as a trusted advisor across teams, mentor other engineers, and represent the mechanical discipline in strategic planning and customer engagements. **Essential Job Functions** Technical Strategy \& Leadership: * Define and drive mechanical engineering strategy across North American data center projects. * Lead complex technical problem\-solving and provide expert guidance on design, construction, and operations. * Influence engineering standards, design principles, and long\-term planning across the organization. Project \& Initiative Oversight: * Provide technical leadership on major projects and initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals. * Review and approve critical design decisions, submittals, and change management actions. * Support commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness activities. Cross\-Functional Collaboration: * Partner with internal teams including electrical, architectural, operations, and innovation engineering to ensure integrated solutions. * Represent mechanical engineering in Centers of Excellence (CoE), strategic forums, and executive\-level discussions. * Support customer\-facing engagements, including RFP responses, technical presentations, and post\-lease coordination. Mentorship \& Technical Development: * Mentor and support engineers across all levels, fostering technical growth and knowledge sharing. * Contribute to onboarding, training, and development of mechanical engineering talent. * Promote a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: * Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, applying insights to improve system performance and efficiency. * Lead efforts to refine Vantage’s mechanical design standards and best practices. * Conduct forensic analysis and root cause investigations for operational issues and failures. Additional Duties: * Perform other duties as assigned by management. **Job Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. * 5\-8 years of experience in mechanical design, construction, and operations, with data center or mission\-critical experience required. * Proven track record of leading complex technical initiatives and influencing cross\-functional teams. * Expertise in design and documentation tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, CFD modeling) and reporting platforms (e.g., Excel, Power BI). * Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. * Deep knowledge of building codes, standards, and industry best practices (e.g., ASHRAE). * Travel is expected to be up to 15–25% but may increase as the business evolves. **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. **Additional Details** * Salary Range: $170,000\-185,000 Base \+ Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations) * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. * \#LI\-AP2 \#LI\-Hybrid We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. highly available, scalable infrastructure solutions that support business\-critical payment systems operating at global scale. * Ensure platforms and services meet security, compliance, governance, deliver, and operate reliable engineering solutions. * Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical planning activities, contributing engineering expertise and best practices. * Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, operational procedures, and engineering standards that improve team effectiveness and knowledge sharing. * Participate in on\-call rotations and incident response activities, driving operational improvements and helping teams learn from production events. * Take ownership of assigned initiatives from design through implementation, deployment, and operational support while continuously seeking opportunities to improve systems and processes. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.**Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree with 2\+ years of relevant automation experience using Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language. * Experience supporting Linux\-based systems and troubleshooting distributed applications or infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience with one or more logging or search platforms such as Splunk, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, or Elasticsearch. * Hands\-on experience with metrics and visualization technologies such as Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, or Bosun. * Experience developing backend services, APIs, command\-line tools, integrations, or operational automation. * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS or GCP, and with cloud\-native architecture and services. * Experience with containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent enterprise and platform requirements into maintainable engineering solutions and clear technical documentation. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work jobs.title: Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY The Industrial Engineer is responsible for analyzing, developing, and improving manufacturing processes, production workflows, and operational systems to maximize efficiency, productivity, quality, and cost\-effectiveness within the Company's precast concrete manufacturing operations. This position evaluates production methods, labor utilization, equipment performance, material flow, and facility layouts to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence. The Industrial Engineer works collaboratively with Production, Operations, Engineering, Scheduling, Quality Control and Safety to implement practical solutions that reduce waste, improve resource utilization, minimize downtime, and support production schedules and business objectives. The Industrial Engineer reports to the Operations Manager. DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES Process Improvement \& Operational Efficiency * Analyze existing manufacturing processes, production workflows, and operational procedures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement. * Develop and implement process improvements to increase productivity, reduce waste, improve quality, and optimize overall manufacturing performance. * Conduct time studies, work measurement analyses, and process evaluations to establish production standards and identify opportunities for improved labor and equipment utilization. * Evaluate production processes, including form preparation, reinforcement placement, concrete batching, pouring, curing, stripping, finishing, and material handling. * Develop and recommend standardized work procedures and best practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and overall production performance. * Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement methodologies to streamline operations and eliminate non\-value\-added activities. * Identify root causes of production inefficiencies and recurring operational issues and implement sustainable corrective actions. Production Planning \& Resource Optimization * Evaluate production capacity, labor requirements, equipment utilization, and material flow to support efficient production planning and scheduling. * Analyze manpower allocation, crew productivity, and production cycle times to identify opportunities for improved resource utilization. * Collaborate with Production and Scheduling to improve workflow, reduce production delays, and optimize manufacturing schedules. * Assess equipment capabilities, production constraints, and facility capacity to support operational planning and future growth. * Develop and recommend improvements to production layouts, workstations, material staging areas, and equipment placement to maximize efficiency and minimize unnecessary movement. * Assist in evaluating staffing levels, labor standards, and production methods to support operational and financial objectives. Data Analysis \& Performance Measurement * Collect, analyze, and interpret production data to evaluate operational performance and identify trends. * Develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) related to productivity, labor efficiency, production cycle times, equipment utilization, downtime, material waste, and manufacturing costs. * Prepare reports, dashboards, and performance analyses to communicate findings and improvement opportunities to management. * Establish measurable performance benchmarks and monitor the effectiveness of implemented process improvements. * Analyze production variances and recommend corrective actions to improve performance and cost control. * Utilize data\-driven methods to support operational decisions, capital investments, and long\-term business planning. Manufacturing Systems \& Continuous Improvement * Evaluate and improve manufacturing systems, equipment utilization, and material handling processes to support safe and efficient operations. * Collaborate with Engineering and Production teams to improve manufacturing methods, formwork processes, and production sequencing. * Identify opportunities for automation, equipment upgrades, and technology improvements that enhance productivity and operational reliability. * Assist with the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of manufacturing software, production tracking systems, and other operational technologies. * Support the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and process documentation. * Lead or participate in continuous improvement initiatives involving multiple departments to improve overall operational performance. * Evaluate proposed process changes for feasibility, cost\-effectiveness, safety, and impact on production. jobs.title: Applied R&D Engineer
jobs.description: Build what's next in wood products. At Weyerhaeuser, we are a global leader in sustainable forestry, wood products, and timberland management. For more than a century, we have helped shape the built environment through innovative wood\-based solutions for residential, light commercial, and home improvement applications across North America and beyond. Our success is built on the talent, creativity, and dedication of our people. We foster an inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives, rewards results, and supports continuous learning and professional growth. We are committed to safety, integrity, sustainability, citizenship, and innovation. In return, we offer competitive compensation, exceptional benefits, and meaningful opportunities to develop your career while contributing to a renewable future. Join Our Applied R\&D Team! As an Applied R\&D Engineer, you will contribute to the development of innovative wood product solutions that are used in real buildings throughout North America. Working at the intersection of engineering, product development, manufacturing, and building science, you will help transform ideas into commercially viable products and applications. In this role, you will collaborate with engineers, scientists, and market analysts to solve complex building challenges. Your work will include product research and development, structural analysis, code evaluation and laboratory testing. We are seeking a curious and driven engineer who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, embraces innovation, and takes pride in delivering practical solutions that create value for customers. **Why Join Us?** * Develop product and building solutions that directly influence how structures are designed and built. * Work alongside a highly experienced and collaborative team of analysts, engineers and scientists. * Gain exposure across the complete product lifecycle, from concept development through manufacturing and market implementation. * Help advance innovation in a growing industry centered on sustainability and renewable materials. * Contribute to solutions that support a more resilient and sustainable built environment. Key Responsibilities * Promote and actively contribute to a strong safety\-first culture. * Develop innovative building and product solutions using structural analysis, engineering principles, and mechanical testing. * Apply building codes and design standards, including IBC, IRC, NDS, and ASCE standards, to support new product development and applications. * Develop and evaluate technical concepts for code compliance, manufacturing feasibility, and field application. * Plan, conduct, and oversee structural testing programs, including test design, execution, data analysis, and technical reporting. * Interpret technical data and translate findings into actionable product development recommendations. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to advance products from concept through commercialization. * Support code approvals, technical documentation, and engineering guidance for new products. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution. * Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Five or more years of engineering experience. * Strong knowledge of North American building codes, structural design principles, product applications, and engineering analysis. * Experience with wood design, engineered wood products, or building materials. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to identify meaningful product development opportunities and translate them into practical solutions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Join us and help create the next generation of wood products and building solutions. At Weyerhaeuser, your ideas, expertise, and innovation can make a lasting impact on the future of construction. **About Weyerhaeuser** We sustainably manage forests and manufacture products that make the world a better place. We’re serious about safety, driven to achieve excellence, and proud of what we do. With multiple business lines in locations across North America, we offer a range of exciting career opportunities for smart, talented people who are passionate about making a difference. We know you have a choice in your career. We want you to choose us. **What We Offer** **Compensation:** This role is eligible for our annual merit\-increase program, and we are targeting a salary range of $98,800\-$160,400 based on your level of skills, qualifications and experience. You will also be eligible for our Annual Incentive Program, which offers a cash bonus targeting 10\-15% of base pay. Potential plan funding may range from zero to two times that target. **Benefits:** When you join our team, you and your dependents will be offered coverage under our comprehensive employee benefits plan, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, and life insurance. We offer a pre\-tax Health Savings Account option which includes a company contribution. Other benefit options are also available such as voluntary Long\-Term Care and Employee Assistance Programs. We also support personal volunteerism, sponsor a host of diversity networks, promote mentoring, and provide training and development opportunities to help you chart your path to a fulfilling career. **Retirement:** Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, which includes a paid company match in addition to our annual contribution equal to 5% of your base salary. **Paid Time Off or Vacation:** We provide eligible employees who are scheduled to work 25 hours or more per week with 3\-weeks of paid vacation to use during your first year of employment. In addition, after being employed for six months, eligible employees begin to accrue vacation for future use. We also recognize eleven paid holidays per year, providing a total of 88 holiday hours and paid parental leave for all full\-time employees. Weyerhaeuser is an equal opportunity employer. Inclusion is one of our five core values and we strive to maintain a culture where all our people feel a sense of belonging, opportunity and shared purpose. We are committed to recruiting a diverse workforce and supporting an equitable and inclusive environment that inspires people of all backgrounds to join, stay and thrive with our team. \#salary Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **SUMMARY** #### **As a Manufacturing Engineer II at Wilson Tool, you will focus on optimizing processes to support safe, efficient, and high\-quality production. This role plays a key part in advancing operational excellence through process improvement, performance metrics, and enhanced product flow.** **While this is not a formal leadership position, it requires strong leadership qualities, including the ability to influence, mentor, and guide engineering and operations teams. You will help foster a culture of continuous improvement and contribute to the development and implementation of global operational excellence standards.** **This position is designed for individuals with the desire and potential to grow into future leadership roles, supporting long\-term succession planning and organizational growth.** **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Applies engineering principles in managing, supporting, and maintaining the production of new and existing products and implementation of design changes and product improvements. * Plans, schedules, conducts, and coordinates detailed phases of the engineering project or work as part of a major project. * Performs independently on most assignments with instructions as to the general results expected. Documents work and reviews progress and results with manager. * Designs and develops production processes, fixturing and equipment. * Develop and optimize work instructions and procedures. * Drive continuous improvement efforts in the plant in terms of safety, quality, cost and delivery * Develop value stream maps, standard work/process sheets, routings, capacity analysis, and line layouts to assist continuous improvement efforts * Utilize Lean concepts to eliminate waste, reduce process variation, increase production throughout, and improve material flow and part availability * Conduct and participate in Kaizen events and train line workers to drive Lean principles like Kanban and one\-piece flow * Identifies the root cause of manufacturability issues, implements corrective actions for those relating to design, and communicates findings to other team members or to those responsible for other types of issues. * Interfaces with Production, Quality, design engineers, and/or supplier to resolve manufacturing, quality, equipment, product design, and/or component issues so as to meet the company’s objectives. * Communicates well orally and in writing. Able to present ideas and proposals to all levels of the organization. * Participates in design reviews. Communicates with applicable resources to assess manufacturing feasibility and potential issues of product changes and new products. * May be assigned to supervise other personnel. * Performs other assignments as directed **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Minimum 10 years’ experience in an advanced high\-mix manufacturing environment and Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering Degree * Must possess strong understanding of Lean principles/methods including Value Stream Maps, 5S, Kaizen, etc. * Must be a “hands\-on” problem\-solver with the ability to multi\-task on several projects and maintain high quality and timeliness of deliverables * Must have strong communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to effectively communicate with all areas of the organization * 2\+ years of experience implementing Lean methodologies and tools such as 5S, Kaizen workshops, Standard Work, and Kanban systems to drive process improvements * 1\+ year of experience with project management methodologies and leading cross\-functional teams to achieve project objectives within established timelines **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** * 10\+ years of experience as a manufacturing engineer * Lean Bronze certification preferred * Proficient in Microsoft Office skills, experience with SAP and/or MS Dynamics * SolidWorks experience * Visual Basics programming * CMM programming **ATTRIBUTES** * **Adaptability:** Ability to adapt to changing work priorities and environments, demonstrating flexibility and willingness to take on different tasks as directed by the hiring manager. * **Communication Skills:** Effective verbal and written communication skills, enabling clear and concise communication with team members and supervisors. * **Safety Consciousness:** Commitment to adhering to safety protocols and procedures, ensuring a safe working environment for oneself and others. * **Desire for Learning \& Continuous Improvement:** Eagerness to learn and develop new skills, with a willingness to participate in training programs and pursue continuous improvement opportunities within the role. Actively seek opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity within assigned tasks, suggesting ideas for process enhancements or workflow optimization. * **Reliability:** Dependability in fulfilling assigned tasks and responsibilities consistently, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the team. * **Positive Attitude:** A constructive and optimistic approach to challenges and tasks, fostering a supportive and encouraging work environment. * **Team Player:** Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, demonstrating respect, empathy, and cooperation in achieving shared goals. * **Problem\-Solving Skills:** Capacity to approach issues or obstacles with creativity and resourcefulness, seeking practical solutions to improve processes and outcomes. * **Professionalism:** Conducting oneself with professionalism and integrity, adhering to ethical standards and company policies in all interactions and activities. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands and work environment are representative of those that must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. In addition to continuous sitting and working on a computer, the role may involve continuous reaching forward between shoulder/waist, bending/twisting/rotating, and simple grasping and writing. Occasional exposure to an indoor manufacturing environment, chemicals, and/or fumes may occur. The ability to stand and walk frequently and occasionally lift and carry up to 25 lbs. is required. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** Inside; Office and some manufacturing floor. **SALARY** $110,000\- $125,000 Annually DOQ **MACHINES, TOOLS, EQUIPMENT, AND WORK AIDS** Working knowledge of manufacturing machines and inspection equipment. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** Wilson Tool is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description: Job Title: Production Engineer, AI Storage for HPC Clusters L2 City: Dallas State/Province: Texas Posting Start Date: 11/6/26 Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com. **Production Engineer, AI Storage for HPC Clusters** ==================================================== **Quantity:** 2–5 openings **Location:** United States Candidates Only! **Work Arrangement:** 100% REMOTE **About the Role** ------------------ The customer's Cloud Foundation AI Services team builds and operates the storage that lets AI researchers train models reliably and efficiently across cloud environments. We connect high\-performance filesystems, object storage, and data\-management services to AI compute, so training datasets and model checkpoints are fast and available wherever they are needed. We are looking for a hands\-on storage system engineer who can turn demanding AI workloads into reliable, scalable infrastructure. The work spans software development, performance analysis, automation, and production ownership. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and operate distributed file and object storage for AI training: shared researcher filesystems, training datasets, and model checkpoints. * Diagnose and improve end\-to\-end storage performance (metadata, throughput, latency, caching, network) so storage I/O stops stalling training. * Automate the storage lifecycle (provisioning, scaling, upgrades, recovery) using Kubernetes and infrastructure\-as\-code. * Move and migrate data across clusters, regions, and clouds without losing integrity or slowing researchers down. * Keep it reliable through observability, alerting, testing, safe rollouts, and incident response, partnering with research, security, and storage\-provider teams. **Must\-Haves** --------------- * Built or operated production distributed storage, high\-performance filesystems, or large scale data infrastructure. * Strong Linux skills, and can debug filesystem, network, and concurrency issues in production. * Writes maintainable software or automation in a language such as Python, Go, C\+\+, or Rust. * Has owned a reliability or performance improvement end to end, from spotting the problem through deployment and verification. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with **cloud infrastructure** and **Kubernetes,** or a comparable large\-scale orchestration environment. * Depth in NFS/POSIX and distributed\-filesystem internals: metadata, caching, consistency, availability, and recovery. * Hands\-on with one or more distributed or network storage systems such as Hammerspace, Lustre, ZFS/OpenZFS, VAST, or Pure Storage. Depth in comparable systems counts; you do not need every product named here. * AI or HPC storage patterns: high\-throughput data loading, checkpoint writes and restores, metadata\-heavy access, and staging data for accelerator clusters. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and observability tooling (Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes operators; metrics, tracing, benchmarking), and object/S3 storage with tiering and cross\-region movement. Experience: \>10 YEARS . The expected compensation for this role ranges from $100,000 to $200,000 . Final compensation will depend on various factors, including your geographical location, minimum wage obligations, skills, and relevant experience. Based on the position, the role is also eligible for Wipro's standard benefits including a full range of medical and dental benefits options, disability insurance, paid time off (inclusive of sick leave), other paid and unpaid leave options. Applicants are advised that employment in some roles may be conditioned on successful completion of a post\-offer drug screening, subject to applicable state law. jobs.title: Senior Product Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are hiring a Senior Product Software Engineer to design, build, and operate business\-critical customer and internal applications. This is a hands\-on full\-stack engineering role for an individual who can take complex and sometimes ambiguous problems from initial intent through specification, architecture, implementation, validation, deployment, and production operation. The engineer will apply Agentic Spec\-Driven Development and Agentic Product Development Lifecycle practices to improve delivery speed, quality, traceability, and engineering effectiveness. This role requires demonstrated experience using AI engineering agents as disciplined participants in the development lifecycle, while maintaining strong human oversight, architectural integrity, security, and accountability. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, APIs, databases, Microsoft Azure, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure software development. They will combine strong technical depth with product thinking, sound judgment, ownership, and the ability to increase the effectiveness of the engineers around them. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Own product capabilities end\-to\-end, from problem definition and specification through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production validation, and continuous improvement. * Apply Agentic Spec\-Driven Development (SDD) and Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) practices to transform product intent into executable specifications and leverage AI agents throughout design, development, testing, review, and delivery, with appropriate validation and human oversight. * Design and deliver full\-stack solutions across Angular/TypeScript user experiences, C\#/.NET services, REST APIs, integrations, relational and NoSQL databases, and Microsoft Azure. * Make sound architectural and engineering decisions that balance speed, security, scalability, reliability, performance, observability, and long\-term maintainability. * Solve ambiguous technical problems independently, including diagnosing production issues, performing root\-cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions rather than short\-term fixes. * Increase the effectiveness of the broader engineering team by creating reusable components, patterns, automation, and engineering practices, and through mentoring, design reviews, and high\-quality code reviews. * Collaborate effectively across Product, UX, Architecture, Quality Engineering, DevOps, Operations, and Security to deliver solutions that meet customer and business needs. * Demonstrate ownership and accountability for outcomes, proactively identifying and addressing technical risks, delivery bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve engineering quality and productivity. **Qualifications** **Required** **Experience/Skills:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex, business\-critical applications from design through production. * 1\+ year of hands\-on experience with Agentic Spec\-Driven Development (SDD), using specifications and AI agents to drive software design, development, testing, validation, and delivery. * Strong full\-stack development expertise with C\#, .NET/ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, REST APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, and Microsoft Azure. * Strong understanding of modern application architecture and engineering practices, including API\-first design, microservices/distributed systems, design patterns, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure software development. * Demonstrated ability to solve complex and ambiguous engineering problems, make sound technical trade\-offs, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. * Demonstrated ability to elevate the effectiveness of other engineers through technical leadership, reusable solutions, automation, engineering standards, mentoring, and high\-quality design and code reviews. **Preferred** **Experience/Skills:** * Experience designing and delivering Agentic AI or Generative AI capabilities, such as workflow automation, information extraction, document processing, intelligent assistance, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Experience applying **Agentic Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC)** practices across multiple stages of product development. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree is a plus. **Our Interview Practices** --------------------------- *To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.* *Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.* **Compensation:** $92,700\.00 \- $161,850\.00 USD *Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.* **Additional Information****:** ------------------------------- Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, \& Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: **About Wonder** Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise. Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20\+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine\-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on\-site by our culinary team and served hot. Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale. *Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.* **About The Opportunity** Wonder’s Enterprise Technology team is hiring an Infrastructure Engineer to establish and scale the hosting, deployment, and integration foundations that support builders of all technical levels as they launch and maintain the apps and agents they’ve built with AI. You’ll work across enterprise technology, platform engineering, security, data, and business teams to turn employee\-built prototypes into secure, reliable, supported applications. **The Impact You Will Make** * Build and operate the infrastructure for employee\-built applications, including deployment environments, hosting, databases, networking, and appropriate access controls. * Help assess and implement the right hosting and development platform for Wonder’s needs, working with platform engineering, security, data, and business teams. * Create repeatable deployment paths that help teams move applications from local prototypes into secure, reliable cloud environments. * Set up and maintain integrations with the tools employees use, which may include Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, Salesforce, Looker, BigQuery, and other business systems. * Design and implement version control workflows, including Git and GitHub integration, so applications can be reviewed, tracked, maintained, and safely rolled back. * Build reusable infrastructure patterns and automation, using infrastructure as code where appropriate. * Establish secure foundations for application hosting, including identity, secrets management, environment separation, data access, backups, monitoring, and incident response. * Help teams understand how to deploy and operate their applications, and provide hands\-on guidance from initial setup through launch and ongoing support. * Learn how employees work and shape the platform around their needs: reduce unnecessary complexity, make common tasks self\-service, and explain technical steps in clear language. * Provide highly responsive, patient support to builders with different levels of technical experience. Follow through on issues and help users become confident operating their applications. * Gather feedback from users and use it to improve platform workflows, documentation, examples, and support. * Document architecture, deployment procedures, integration patterns, operational ownership, and maintenance expectations. **What You Bring to the Table** * Experience building or operating cloud infrastructure and application deployment environments, ideally on Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider. * Strong understanding of application hosting, networking, databases, identity and access management, and production operations. * Experience with version control systems, especially Git and GitHub, and workflows for code review, release, and rollback. * Experience automating infrastructure and deployments with tools such as Terraform and CI/CD systems. * Experience integrating applications with APIs and business systems, and a practical understanding of authentication, authorization, and secret storage. * A customer\-focused approach to infrastructure: you care whether people can successfully use the platform, not just whether it is technically sound. * Ability to make complex technical workflows approachable for users who may not be professional software engineers. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills. * Good judgment balancing speed, simplicity, security, reliability, and cost. **Got These? Even Better** * Experience building platforms or paved paths for internal developers, citizen developers, or low\-code/no\-code teams. * Experience with Vercel or comparable application hosting and development platforms. * Experience with platforms such as Superblocks, Lovable, or similar AI\-assisted app\-building tools. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled software development workflows and the infrastructure needed to take generated code into supported applications. * Experience with Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, or integrations across enterprise productivity systems. * Experience supporting applications that handle sensitive data or require strong access boundaries. **What Success Looks Like** * Existing employee\-built applications have a clear path to secure, supported cloud hosting. * Teams can deploy and update applications through documented, repeatable workflows with version history and rollback. * Integrations and permissions are reliable, appropriately scoped, and maintainable. * Employees can make progress without needing to understand every layer of cloud infrastructure. * Builders receive timely, highly supportive help and grow more confident using the platform. * The platform balances ease of use with security, reliability, and cost controls. As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role. CA: $208,500 \- $225,000 Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience. **Benefits** The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands. Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here. **A Final Note** At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. **We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Model Platform
jobs.description: **About Wonder** Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise. Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20\+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine\-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on\-site by our culinary team and served hot. Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale. *Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.* **About The Opportunity** Wonder's Model Platform team builds the systems that take machine learning models from prototype to production and keeps them running well once they're there. Our models rank restaurants and dishes, predict delivery times, price orders, and dispatch couriers for millions of diners across Grubhub and Wonder. Most of those predictions are served to high\-traffic Java services. How well a model works with those services matters as much as how good the model is. We're hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer with deep Java backend experience to set the technical direction for how our models and services work together. You'll define how every team calls our models. You'll set the standards for load testing and performance across the services that use them. You'll also lead complex ML work that spans multiple teams and systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You'll write code, design models, and take on the hardest production problems yourself. You'll be the main technical link between Model Platform and our software engineering teams, and you'll partner with Applied Scientists, our data and infrastructure platform teams, and senior engineering leadership. Our interview process includes the same Java coding interview our software engineers take. **The Impact You Will Make** * Define the standard architecture for how Java services call ML models, including client libraries, API contracts, latency budgets, and fallbacks. * Set the standards for load testing, performance benchmarking, and capacity planning for every service that calls our models, and build them into the release process. * Drive performance work such as profiling, JVM tuning, caching, request batching, and concurrency for our highest\-traffic model integrations. * Lead the design and delivery of complex ML solutions that span multiple teams or systems, and make the architecture decisions that cross team boundaries. * Build reusable ML architectures, pipelines, and deployment patterns that get Applied Science work into production faster. * Set the standards for ML reliability, scalability, monitoring, and lifecycle management, including model scorecards, reproducible training, safe rollout, and SLOs for tier\-1 models. * Own model architecture and tuning for our most demanding deployments, balancing accuracy against latency, scalability, and cost. * Run design and code reviews across ML and software engineering teams, and push back on technical decisions when the evidence supports it. * Own the platform's technical roadmap with engineering leadership, sequence work across teams, and raise risks early. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, take part in hiring, and build depth on the team so no critical system depends on one person. * Explain technical trade\-offs in business terms to product and executive stakeholders, and write down key decisions and the reasons behind them. **What You Bring to the Table** * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise building and running high\-traffic backend services in Java * 5\+ years building and running ML systems in production, including 3\+ years at senior scope setting technical direction across teams or systems * Expert Java and object\-oriented design skills, including service frameworks (Spring Boot or similar), REST or gRPC APIs, and JVM performance tuning * A track record of setting load testing and performance standards (Gatling, JMeter, or similar) and planning capacity for services as load changes * Experience designing highly available distributed systems (99\.99% uptime) with automated testing and monitoring built in from the start * Deep expertise in production ML architecture, including training pipelines, batch and real\-time serving, feature pipelines, model versioning, and rollback at scale * Strong Python and hands\-on model development experience with common frameworks (XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow), including choosing and tuning models under real latency and cost limits * Strong data engineering skills in Spark and SQL, including building and debugging streaming or batch pipelines * Deep experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP (SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent), Docker, and Kubernetes * Experience with experimentation, including A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and knowing when an offline metric is misleading * Proven technical leadership across ML and software engineering teams, including leading architecture reviews beyond your own team, influencing decisions without direct authority, and mentoring senior engineers * Clear communication of model behavior and technical trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives **Got These? Even Better** * Experience in marketplace, e\-commerce, or logistics, such as ranking, recommendations, ETA prediction, pricing, or dispatch * Serving models inside or alongside JVM services (ONNX Runtime, TensorFlow Java, XGBoost4J, or similar) * Building an internal ML platform used by multiple science teams * Cassandra or other distributed NoSQL databases * Streaming data systems (Kafka, Flink) * Leading an ML platform migration between cloud As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role.
