jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Workato** ----------------- Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com. **Why join us?** ---------------- Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company. But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That's why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you! Also, feel free to check out why: * Business Insider named us an "enterprise startup to bet your career on" * Forbes' Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world * Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America * Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers **Responsibilities** ==================== We're looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to help build the distributed backend that powers our AI agent platform and the developer\-facing products around it — the event\-driven services, real\-time integrations, and APIs that let agents reliably do real work. You'll be building the systems that need to stay correct and available on our path to 1M users over the next year. In this role, you will also be responsible to: * Build event\-driven, horizontally\-scalable backend services that process work reliably and correctly even when parts of the system fail. * Build real\-time surfaces and integrations — streaming connections, gateways, and CLIs — that hold up under load. * Integrate LLMs and agentic harnesses into production systems. * Drive features end\-to\-end — from ideation and architecture through deployment, observability, and iteration. * Raise the engineering bar through clean, well\-tested code, thoughtful reviews, and mentorship. **Requirements** ================ ### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills** * 5\+ years shipping and operating production backend systems at scale. * Strong proficiency in Python, and the judgment to write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code under it. * Deep distributed\-systems fundamentals: you know how to keep systems correct and available under partial failure, backpressure, and load — and you design for it by default. * Hands\-on experience with event\-driven, streaming, or real\-time systems (queues, pub/sub, long\-lived connections). * Comfortable operating services in production on Kubernetes in the cloud — and instrumenting them with metrics, tracing, and dashboards so you can debug what you ship. * Solid API and software\-architecture instincts; you make and defend sensible trade\-offs in ambiguity. * LLM/agentic and developer\-facing product experience (MCP, RAG, APIs, SDKs, CLIs) a strong plus. Our stack: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Kubernetes, AWS. You don't need prior experience with all of it — we care that you can pick it up fast. ### **Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics** * High agency and ownership: You drive work end\-to\-end, from ambiguity to shipped and iterated, without waiting to be told. * A reliability mindset: You design for failure, not just the happy path. * Product\-minded: You care about the users using what you build, not just the system behind it. * AI\-native: You use modern AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code) in your daily workflow and stay at the cutting edge of what it can do. * Excellent written communication: We work async and write things down. **(REQ ID: 3006\)**

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) organization sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution across Agent Factory, Sana, Products, and the Developer Platform. When Workday launches new AI agents and products, early deployments surface complex real\-world challenges—from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge\-case enterprise workflows. FDE pods deploy directly into active customer engagements to resolve technical friction, debug complex setups, and build lightweight integrations. Crucially, FDEs serve as the primary feedback engine for Product and Engineering: field insights, recurring customer friction, and configuration patterns are converted directly into scalable, out\-of\-the\-box product capabilities. **About the Role** As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will bridge hands\-on software development with high\-impact customer technical strategy. You will partner with enterprise customers to architect, deploy, debug, and optimize Workday’s AI agents and developer platform solutions within live customer environments. Working across the full deployment lifecycle, you will collaborate with AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. Your primary objective is twofold: drive immediate customer success and eliminate implementation friction over time by embedding field\-tested solutions back into the core platform. **What you'll do:** * **Technical Deployment \& Engineering:** Deploy, configure, and debug AI agents and integrations directly inside live enterprise tenant environments against complex customer workflows and real\-world data. * **Customer Discovery \& Solution Architecture:** Lead technical discovery sessions with key customer stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust product configurations, POCs, and integration specs. * **Product Feedback Loop:** Capture field telemetry, edge\-case failures, and customer friction points to directly influence the core product roadmap and engineering backlog. * **Productization of Field Insights:** Identify recurring deployment challenges and transform custom fixes into standardized, automated out\-of\-the\-box product capabilities. * **Cross\-Functional Ecosystem Alignment:** Partner closely with Workday Services leads, AI Deployment Architects, and Account Teams to ensure seamless project delivery while staying focused on core product strength. * **Engagement Milestones \& Graduation:** Guide engagements through structured milestones—from kickoff to graduation—enabling self\-sustaining customer ownership within standard 6\-month deployment cycles. **About You** **Basic Qualifications** * **Experience:** 7\+ years in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Software Development. * **Technical Execution:** Hands\-on coding and debugging skills (e.g., Python, Java, or similar) with solid understanding of REST APIs, object\-oriented design, system architecture, and integration patterns. * **Customer Interaction:** Proven experience working directly with enterprise clients on complex software deployments, live data troubleshooting, and custom workflow integration. * **Travel:** Willingness and ability to travel up to 20% to customer sites as needed. **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton Primary Location Base Pay Range: $176,000 USD \- $264,000 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $148,200 USD \- $264,000 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law. Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible. **Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!** At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers. Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not. In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

jobs.description: If you’re looking to learn from a winning information technology team and receive outstanding benefits that support your family\- while working for a company that takes a people\-first approach to business, we invite you to explore our IT Support Engineer position. * This is an on\-site position that requires traveling to and working at client locations in Phoenix, AZ, 1\-2 days/week. **Primary Purpose and Function** The overall performance objective of the Support Engineer I is to provide the best possible support and customer service to our clients. They are responsible for handling requests that are submitted by our customers (typically by phone) and in all cases using good judgment and timeliness in responding to and resolving each issue to the customer’s satisfaction. Success is defined by the timely resolution of requests in the best possible order based on priority. The position requires accurate documentation, tracking, and monitoring to ensure a timely resolution. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities** Customer Facing: * Provide front line phone coverage, and participate in various call center groups * Provide on\-site assistance to clients within your local geography * Provide excellent customer service to Xantrion’s client base. * Provide technical support as assigned for issues related to computer systems, software, and hardware. * Log and track support requests in a ticketing system \- our primary system is ConnectWise. * Prioritize and/or escalate tickets as required to ensure customer satisfaction. * Brief customers, as well as management, on the status of current resolution efforts. * Work with third party support providers when necessary. * Follow up with customers to ensure an issue has been resolved. Administration: * Submit semi\-monthly timesheet and expense reports. * Attending scheduled training and meeting sessions. * Meet with your manager regularly to discuss opportunities and achievements. Service Desk Duties: * Ability to work a variable shift any time during Xantrion’s business hours. * Perform audits of customer information and systems as necessary to ensure accuracy. * Take support tickets from the dispatching team. * Update and schedule service tickets until issues have been resolved or further escalated. * Perform other duties or special projects as assigned. **Position Requirements** Formal Education \& Certification: * Bachelor’s degree from a four\-year university or equivalent experience (not required) * Technical certificates are a plus. Knowledge \& Experience: * Basic diagnostic and analytical skills. * Basic competency in the use and troubleshooting of MS Office products. * Experience using Windows 10 \& 11, and/or Mac OS. * Basic computer literacy across both hardware and software. * Ability to be proactive and able to take direction and establish ownership of issues through resolution. * Minimum of 3 years of technical support experience required. * On\-site technical support experience preferred. Personal Attributes: * Positive attitude. * Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills. * Strong telephone presence with organized follow\-up skills. * Ability to follow established operating procedures * Strong, service oriented, customer focus. * Strong attention to detail. * Experience working constructively in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment. * Ability to effectively multitask, managing time and prioritizing and executing tasks in a high\-pressure environment. * Demonstrated interpersonal skills, able to foster strong relationships internally and externally. * Can follow directions, as well as apply judgment and be flexible as the situation warrants. **Performance Metrics** * Manager and peer review of goal achievement. * Coachability, willingness to work as a member of a team. * Detailed ticket notes at every step of the resolution. * Appropriate amount of time is correctly coded per day. * Ticket queue is properly scheduled. Assigned tasks do not “fall through the cracks”. * Internal and external customer satisfaction scores. * Ticket closure rate relative to peers. **Physical Demands** * Sitting or Standing for Long Periods: Ability to remain seated or standing at a workstation for extended durations, with regular breaks to prevent fatigue and maintain comfort. * Viewing a Computer Monitor: Sustained ability to focus on a computer screen for tasks such as reading, typing, and data entry, with appropriate lighting and screen settings to reduce eye strain. * Digital Dexterity and Hand/Eye Coordination: Proficient use of hands and fingers to operate office equipment, including frequent alpha/numeric keyboarding, mouse usage, and handling other peripherals with precision. * Oral Communications: Engaging in clear and effective verbal communication over the phone, video calls, and occasionally in person, requiring strong speech and active listening skills. * Use of Peripheral Devices: Handling and operating devices such as a mouse, headset, and other computer accessories with precision and ease. * Basic Ergonomic Adjustments: Ability to adjust seating, monitor height, and other workstation elements to maintain comfort and reduce physical strain. * Environmental Awareness: Maintaining a workspace free from excessive noise and distractions to ensure focus and productivity. * Occasional Lifting and Moving: Ability to lift and move light objects, such as laptops, documents, and office supplies, as needed. * Periodic Travel to Customer Offices: Willingness and ability to travel to customer offices as required, which may involve air travel, driving, ride\-sharing, or using public transportation. * Periodic Travel to Xantrion’s Office: Willingness and ability to travel to Xantrion's office or shared workspace as needed, which may involve air travel, driving, ride\-sharing, or using public transportation. * Light Lifting and Carrying of Computers and Equipment: Ability to lift and carry computers and related equipment, typically weighing up to 20 pounds. * Moving Heavy Equipment: Ability to move heavier items such as personal computers, servers, and battery backup systems, weighing up to 75 pounds, using proper lifting techniques and equipment to ensure safety. **Company Policy and Procedure Compliance** * Follow and support company policies and procedures as Unless arranged by Xantrion, shared work environments, such as coworking spaces, are unacceptable. Client information must always be kept private. * Must use Xantrion\-provided PC and headset to execute job functions. **Benefits*** Salary range $55K \- $65K; depending on experience. * 100% of medical, dental, and vision for you and your family. * 401K with company match up to 4% of salary. * Certification reimbursement and annual training budget. * 17 Days PTO per year in addition to paid training days. * Bonuses for referring new clients or employees. **Equal Opportunity Employer** *Xantrion is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, YouTube, Recommendations ML
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience designing and building large\-scale machine learning models. * 8 years of experience building, testing, maintaining, and launching software products that require running and analyzing experiments and working with user data. * 5 years of experience in a people management, supervision/team leadership role. * Experience creating and aligning cross\-organizational technical roadmaps across multiple software engineering, research, product management, and data science teams. * Experience conducting research or applied research on recommender systems models or in related areas (e.g., ranking, retrieval, or user). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Experience guiding research programs in relevant areas for small teams. * Experience with hardware ML model ML, and framework co\-design. * Experience optimizing compute or hardware capacity. * Publications in Recommender Systems, LLM’s, large model performance and efficiency. **About the job** ----------------- Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. In this role, you will guide large machine learning (ML) models for recommender systems. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gravitee** ------------------ Recognized in Gartner's inaugural 2026 Magic Quadrant for AI Agent Management Platforms and named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for API Management for three consecutive years, Gravitee brings AI agents and the APIs they rely on under one unified control plane. We provide a platform for managing and securing APIs, event streams, and AI agent interactions. Organizations including Michelin, Roche, and Blue Yonder use Gravitee to control and observe systems their businesses depend on. **Why join us?** * **The mission:** Help define how enterprises securely adopt AI agents, alongside the APIs and event streams they already rely on. * **The momentum:** Join a high\-growth market leader that combines proven technology and customer trust with the pace of a scale\-up. * **The culture:** We hire pragmatic builders who take ownership, collaborate openly, and Hold Nothing Back. **The Role \& Why It Exists** ----------------------------- We are looking for Senior Software Engineers to build Gravitee's core products and the next\-generation product surface in Gamma. You will join one of three areas: API Management (APIM) and the gateway runtime, Access Management (AM), or the Event Gateway for Kafka. The work sits where API governance, identity, event streaming, and AI agent management meet. These are new roles in the US. Today, most core platform engineering is based in Europe. These hires build US\-hours ownership of Level 3 and Level 4 escalations for our products, and add delivery capacity toward parity in Gamma and the AI Agent Management roadmap. You will split your time roughly 80% feature delivery and 20% L3/L4 support and bug fixing (it varies week to week), working as an embedded member of a product team based in Europe. We will match you to the area that best fits your experience. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable moving between services, APIs, data models, and technical design. **Location:** Denver, Colorado preferred. Elsewhere in the US is acceptable, with monthly travel to the Denver hub. **What You Will Be Doing** -------------------------- **In this role, you will:** * Design and deliver features end to end, from technical design through implementation, testing, release, and iteration, on one of Gravitee's product areas: API Management and the gateway runtime, Access Management, or the Event Gateway for Kafka. * Build and evolve Java services and APIs, including performance\-sensitive, asynchronous code in the runtime. * Contribute to the customer experience in the Gamma console, across backend APIs and TypeScript and Angular interfaces, as your team needs. * Keep security behavior and upgrades safe: secure defaults, certificate and secret handling, audit logs, safe migrations, and backward compatibility. * Own US\-hours Level 3 and Level 4 escalations for your product as part of the L3 pager duty rotation. * Help bring AI agent management to the platform, including AI Gateways, MCP, and agent\-to\-agent interactions. * Use LLMs and AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully for prototyping, implementation, testing, and debugging, applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI\-generated work. * Write meaningful automated tests and contribute to reliable delivery, across Gravitee's open\-source platform and Enterprise Edition. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers, including teams based in Europe, and improve solutions through code and design reviews. **Essential Skills** -------------------- **We are looking for evidence that you can succeed in the role, whether gained through employment, open\-source work, or equivalent practical experience:** * 5\+ years building and operating production software, on a team that ships and supports its own product; you have personally resolved production incidents. * Strong Java experience, including maintainable REST APIs and backend services. Strong C\# with the same object\-oriented depth is also considered. * A solid understanding of API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and asynchronous workflows. * Experience with relational or document data stores, including safe migrations and backward compatibility. * A security\-first mindset: authentication and authorization fundamentals, secure defaults, and certificate and secret handling. * Experience with automated testing, Git\-based development, code review, and iterative product delivery. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants as part of an engineering workflow, combined with the judgment to review and improve their output. * Clear communication, and the ability to take an ambiguous problem through to production. * Willingness to join an L3 pager duty rotation in US hours. **Desired Skills** ------------------ **You do not need to match every item. We would be especially interested in experience with:** * Gateways and runtimes: reactive Java (Vert.x, RxJava, Netty), or an API gateway, proxy, or service\-mesh vendor or platform team (for example Kong, Google Apigee, MuleSoft, Tyk, Solo.io, Traefik, WSO2\). * Identity: implementing OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows, SAML 2\.0, SCIM, MFA, WebAuthn/FIDO2, or FAPI, CIBA, and UMA profiles. * Event streaming: Kafka internals, binary protocols, backpressure, and performance under load. * Frontend: TypeScript with Angular or another component\-based framework, including data\-rich interfaces. * Cloud native: Docker, Kubernetes, operators and CRDs, and Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. * AI: MCP, Agent2Agent (A2A), tool calling, LLM proxies, or building LLM\-powered applications. Prior production experience is not required. * Open\-source software or enterprise developer platforms. **Who Thrives at Gravitee** --------------------------- Our growth is powered by people who bring passion to what they build, professionalism to how they work, and a commitment to doing things well**.** **You will thrive here if you:** * Bring energy and a constructive attitude to the team. * Adapt quickly and enjoy learning unfamiliar technologies and domains. * Take ownership, communicate clearly, and follow through with urgency. * Balance delivery speed with thoughtful engineering judgment. * Start with the customer problem and care about the quality of the experience you create. * Enjoy working in a fast\-moving, collaborative, international environment. **Life at Gravitee** -------------------- At Gravitee, we invest in humans, not just roles. **You'll get:** * **Salary:** Up to $180,000 * Competitive medical coverage. * Pension / 401(k) program options. * Stock options \- you build it, you own it. * 25 days of holiday plus in\-country national holidays. * Three mental health days and a wellness allowance. * Your birthday off. * A professional development budget to support your growth. * A hybrid work culture with hubs across regions. * Quarterly team events and an annual company offsite. * A collaborative, international company culture. * Opportunities to grow your scope and career as Gravitee grows. *At Gravitee, we believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams.* *No employee or applicant will be treated less favorably on the grounds of sex, marital status, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, religion, or belief.* *By applying, you consent to Gravitee storing and processing the personal information you submit as part of the recruitment process.*

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** -------------------- iDC is building its own software to replace legacy vendor systems. The Operator Platform is the application our operators, customers and leadership use for warehouse operations and manufacturing. Its stack, deployment platform and core architecture are established and documented in written decision records. The Senior Full\-Stack Engineer owns a product surface on the Operator Platform end to end. The first is the manufacturing execution system (MES) that runs the iDC Made assembly line, which is mid\-rollout to manufacturing customers. A second surface follows once MES reaches steady state. The role also contributes to iDC’s AI\-forward products: Travis, an AI agent that answers questions across the company’s operational data, and Pastrana, a platform where people across the business build and ship their own tools with AI. The engineer works with an AI product manager on features where a model does real work inside the product. **Scope of the Role** --------------------- Platform\-wide foundations (stack, deployment, authentication, observability and core architecture) are established and jointly held by the engineering team. This role owns the design of the surfaces assigned to it, including data models, integrations and new architecture decisions on those surfaces, recorded through the existing decision process. The role works as a peer to the other full\-stack engineer, who owns billing. The two review each other’s work. The role has no direct reports. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field. * **Full\-stack development:** has built both the backend and frontend of a production web application in TypeScript, with Node and React or a close equivalent. * **Relational data modeling:** designs schemas and owns migrations on a transactional system, with attention to the correctness of inventory and financial data. * **Production operations:** responsibility for running systems, including deployments, monitoring, on\-call or equivalent, and incident response. * **Integrations:** has built against external parties’ data feeds and APIs. * **Working within established architecture:** works effectively in code and decisions they did not originate, and raises disagreements through the decision record. * **Correctness practices:** applies reconciliation, idempotency and audit trails as standard practice. * **Code review:** reviews code for correctness, including AI\-generated code. * **AI\-assisted development:** uses AI tools as a regular part of engineering work for research and building; has built tooling for their own workflow; verifies AI output before relying on it. * **AI product features:** has shipped at least one feature where a model does real work for users, including evaluation against real examples and safeguards for incorrect output. * **Communication:** clear in writing and in conversation with operators, customers’ operations staff and executives, including explaining technical work to non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Manufacturing, MES, WMS, ERP or supply\-chain domain experience * NestJS * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), document processing or agent workflows in production * Replacing a legacy system that remained live during cutover * Terraform on Azure * Systems that handle money, including decimal precision and rounding rules * Specifying or reviewing work for engineers outside their own team **Work Environment** -------------------- * Two\-person application engineering team of senior peers, with dense pairing during the first three months. * Established stack: Azure, Node and NestJS in TypeScript, React and TypeScript frontend, Postgres, Terraform, and Microsoft Entra for authentication. * Written decision records and documented engineering conventions. * Direct contact with product managers, operations users at iDC and at customers, and executive leadership. * Delivery driven by a customer rollout calendar. **Benefits** The company offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as basic and voluntary life and voluntary ancillary coverages for accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity. Full\-time employees are eligible for paid sick leave, bereavement, holiday and vacation pay. Employees are eligible to participate in the company 401k plan on the first day of the third month following hire date. **Why Join iDC Logitics?** At iDC Logistics, you will join a growing organization committed to operational excellence, innovation, and employee success. We offer the opportunity to make a significant impact by partnering with leadership, shaping organizational culture, and helping drive business performance through people\-focused strategies. *iDC Logistics Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, citizenship status, uniform service member status, age, disability, sexual and gender orientation, genetic information or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of the company’s employment practices including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, promoting, transferring, compensation, benefits, training, leaves of absence, termination, and other terms and conditions of employment.* *This job description is intended to set forth the core functions required for this position and describe the general nature of the work performed by employees in this position. It may not contain a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees to do this job. Employees may be assigned additional* Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible spending account * Health insurance

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data and AI Platforms
jobs.description: who we are lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth\-focused environment for our people. about this team The Enterprise Data \& AI organization is a strategic and operational driver of growth for lululemon, owning and building the data and AI platforms and services that enable the enterprise to operate with intelligence at scale. The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, AI\-driven data analytics and insights, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, while embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data \& AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency. Our data and AI platform foundation is built on enterprise data lake architecture, standardized ingestion and integration frameworks, and canonical semantic models spanning product, customer, and supply chain domains. The platform advances data insights and AI capabilities while maintaining rigorous data governance, observability, and platform reliability. The team delivers self\-service data capabilities and shared platform services that enable consistent, trustworthy consumption across analytics, AI/ML, and operational use cases at enterprise scale. core responsibilities As a Principal Software Engineer, you will own the system design and implementation of lululemon’s enterprise data \& AI platform and the systems that ensure delivery of data products and services that power high\-impact business data\-driven insights and AI use cases. You will ensure data pipelines and services that enable analytics, AI/ML, are reliable, efficient, and governed, and support operational consumption at scale. You will design and build enterprise\-grade data and AI infrastructure and reusable components that enable multiple product teams and business domains to build, publish and consume data products. You will build a context and semantic layer infrastructure that enables insights and AI use\-cases. You will enable and influence the engineering delivery of data insights and analytics across multiple use\-cases. You will establish the direction and system design for the enterprise data platform, set engineering standards and platform practices adopted across the domain, and serve as the definitive technical authority on the enterprise data platform. You will partner closely with product, business, and technology stakeholders including VP\-level leadership, on technical strategy, platform roadmap, and cross\-functional initiatives. This role may require availability outside of standard business hours, including on\-call support, based on business needs. **select responsibilities include:** * Define vision and approach for enterprise data initiatives and effectively and efficiently deliver the technology solution design * Collaborate closely with architects on enterprise data platform technical architecture and system design, and provide deep technical expertise on implementation approaches, feasibility assessment, and operational implications * Be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption * Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption * Build platform components for ML/AI applications such as point\-in\-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale * Architect robust multi\-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross\-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads * Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers * Write high\-quality production code to solve the complex technical challenges when hands\-on expertise is required * Challenge and improve existing architecture decisions by identifying limitations in current systems and proposing techni \-to\-end, including ingestion frameworks, pipeline orchestration, DataOps disciplines (CI/CD, SLAs, observability), platform reliability, and security, privacy, and access control in partnership with risk and compliance teams * Deep experience analyzing complex system interactions to identify optimal solution approaches; proven ability to make technical trade\-off decisions balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term scalability and organizational impact * Experience defining implementation plans and execution approaches for complex, cross\-organizational technology programs; familiarity collaborating with architects to translate architectural designs into actionable engineering roadmaps * Recognized depth in engineering implementations, combined with breadth to assess system\-wide implications; proven ability to make rapid, high\-confidence judgements on when to engage directly with engineers versus delegating * Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and investment decisions through technical insights on feasibility, risk, and business impact * Experience defining enterprise semantic layers and canonical models — including taxonomies, ontologies, and knowledge graphs — used across multiple product teams and business domains * Exposure to AI\-driven systems including optimization, predictions, and Agents; experience working with knowledge representation for LLM\-powered applications * Experience building knowledge bases or data platforms in retail or similarly complex consumer domains must haves * Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life. * Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results. * Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same. * Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. * Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. * Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously. additional notes **Please note:** Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role. compensation and benefits package lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay\-for\-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $205,600 \- $269,900 annually; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and equity offerings, subject to program eligibility requirements. At lululemon, investing in our people is a top priority. We believe that when life works, work works. We strive to be the place where inclusive leaders come to develop and enable all to be well. Recognizing our teams for their performance and dedication, other components of our total rewards offerings include support of career development, wellbeing, and personal growth: * Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans * Paid time off * Savings and retirement plan matching * Generous employee discount * Fitness \& yoga classes * Parenthood top\-up * Extensive catalog of development course offerings * People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few) **Note:** The incentive programs, benefits, and perks have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice. workplace arrangement **Hybrid :** In\-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture.
